comments: Very charming home and great location!

Wonderful family home in the heart of the beaches!
The location cannot be beat- so close to all the great shopping of Queen Street East, Kew Beach park, and a 5 minute walk to the beach!
A great home especially if you have kids-lots of family-friendly amenities.
Katharine was lovely to communicate with-very helpful with special touches that made us feel so welcome.
Would definitely stay again!

We had a lovely stay at this great house in an amazing neighbourhood! The house was very charming and had everything we could have possibly needed including everything for my 3 year old son and 6 month old daughter! My son especially loved the trampoline and rock climbing wall in the backyard!
Katharine was a very gracious host and it was lovely meeting her!
We couldn’t recommend this place more!

Great location that is close to a lot of great places to eat & shop, as well as public transportation. Easy to get downtown. Katherine is very kind with great communication. It is a very old house so keep that in mind when you reserve
Stellar location, couple minutes away from park, beach, TTC, and shops and restaurants!
Absolutely fantastic place, great neighbourhood, walking distance to the beach and Katharine is really great!  We had a  perfect stay!!!
Wonderful location and cute house. Katharine was very responsive and helpful! Great value for the central location in The Beaches. Lots of amenities within walking distance.
Easy check in and out. Katharine the host answered all questions and was easy to reach. Great location.
The house is situated on a hill so it might not be ideal for those with mobility issues.

This is not a high luxury accommodation but it is 100% user friendly and we were very happy we stayed there. it is perfect for families and Katherine and her husband have left a lot of toys and children's activities. We were able to walk to the lake easily and this feature was one of the highlights of our trip. We would be happy to stay here again.

House is in a great location, close to all amenities. The house was the perfect size for our party and suited us well, however it could do with some TLC in areas. Katherine was an amazing host, before, during and after our stay.
Great location in the beaches! Fantastic for kids, back yard was a huge hit. Katherine was prompt in her responsiveness with any needs.

Excellent location!!! Just a few minutes walk to the beach and lots of nearby restaurants. Easily accessible to downtown via public transportation. It’s an older home so just keep that in mind as you enjoy the location and convenience.

Katharine is a wonderful host and their home in the beaches was a perfect place for our visit to Toronto. It’s so close to all the activity on the boardwalk and Queen Street, yet quiet and peaceful. We look forward to returning and staying again next year!

The house was super charming and quirky with tons of old-fashioned charm.  The location could not be better- a block away from Queen Street, Kew Gardens, and the beach.  The host was quick to respond to questions and was really helpful when the wifi didn't work right away (we stayed the day after the major Rogers outage).   Our kids loved the backyard and the proximity to the park and the beach.  We would definitely stay here again!

Katharine's house is lovely and well situated. A short walk from the beach, a big park with a splash pad (a hit with my toddler) and lots of local stores and restaurants. Communication with her was smooth and efficient. We definitely enjoyed our stay.
Thank you Katharine!

Our stay was short - just two nights but it was nice. The house is old - so there are the old house quirks. Katharine was really communicative and open - very easy to work with! Some of my guest found the houses tilt to be a bit nauseating so if you have vertigo, be warned!

We had a wonderful stay at this charming and characterful house. Beautiful location for enjoying the Beaches area of Toronto. Katherine was responsive and hugely helpful throughout our visit, going out of her way to provide information about family activities in the local area and connecting the gas cannister so we could enjoy a BBQ.
We adjusted reasonably quickly to the sloping floors, but would warn anyone with mobility issues to not book this house.
The garden was excellent, with a large table, comfortable seating area and a large and clean gas BBQ.
This air bnb is ideal for families as it is so close to parks, beaches, public transport and a huge variety of local shops.

Nice place to stay close to shops, restaurants, the beach, and the bike trail.  Although there was no driveway, we  usually could find a place to park pretty close to the house. It was a quiet street and in a nice neighborhood.
Katharine's place is a gem in one of the best neighbourhoods in Toronto.  Just a 5 minute walk from the famous Beaches boardwalk, you couldn't ask for a better location.

Katherine was very responsive and thorough. She even included an email with a break down on the location, parking, near by places, descriptions on sleeping arrangements, etc… kitchen is fully equipped if you choose to cook your meals. Queen ST is a 2min walk away
The house is very clean! Really neat with a lot of original finishes in the century home. Would strongly recommend ear plugs for the sensitive sleeper.

I can't fault this place. It's calm. The neighbours are wonderful. The house is quirky in the most wonderful ways, full of character from age. The fact that the neighbours are lovely and helpful just adds icing to the cake. The positioning is also perfect for outside travel and of course lastly but no least, Katherine is a brilliant friendly communicative host. Thank you!
Had a wonderful stay!
Very nice home, comfortable and safe area. The location is close to the beach and many shops. Thank you.

The is old but very cute and charming. It had everything we needed for the purpose of stay. Everything was clean and comfortable. You can’t beat the location for the beaches and park cute stores and lots of great food within walking distance. The neighborhood was beautiful and felt very safe. They neighbors were very helpful and friendly.  Check in and check was very easy and the host gave us great communication before, during, and after our stay. Would definitely stay here again
Can't beat the location! Only minutes from the beach. Great restaurants at walking distance.

My husband and I stayed at Katherine’s place just for an overnight. It is very great location in the center of the beaches and steps away from great restaurants, cafes, shops and park. Katherine was very accommodating to check our bags before the time of check in which we really appreciated that. I would definitely recommend this place.

The location is very good. Check in was easy. Communication is good. We were able to work out the parking, though not always easy. The house is very old and it shows lots of wear and tear. Doors don’t shut right, floors are extremely unleveled and in general, in need of lots of repair. The outlets are very loose and don’t hold the plugs well. Some outlets are exposed, not sure if it is up to code (it would not be in the US, but not sure of the Canadian regulations) All legs of the queen bed frame are very wobbly, definitely feel unsafe to hold two people.
The location, again, could be enough to overlook other inconveniences. Plenty shops and groceries nearby.

Location, location, location. In the heart of the Beaches with easy access to restaurants, groceries, shops, Kew Gardens, transit and of course the beach.
House is older but very charming with all modern conveniences. We especially loved sitting on front porch or in the backyard.
Our four night stay was too short. Katharine was a great host and extremely responsive to our communications.
Highly recommend.

Had a wonderful stay in Katharine’s place. My husband was in Toronto for work so I was mostly alone with my children, recovering from jetlag but it all worked out wonderfully. Such a safe area with friendly neighbours, so close to shops and restaurants and park and beach. Special mention to Buds coffee, a 5 min walk and my daily saviour! Even the first day when their card machine was down and they trusted me to come back. Must have looked like I needed that coffee :) The house was perfect and we all enjoyed the garden and the toys and everything that was kid friendly. Unfortunately the only thing played on the beautiful grand piano was ‘Baby Shark’ for my son - apologies to your neighbours! The house had everything we could think of from towels, facecloths to kitchen paper and washing detergent and Katharine’s information was all very helpful and she was very responsive. Really felt like our home for the 5 nights and we were all sad to leave ❤️
Katherine is a great host.  The house is an older home and it reflects that with some historic charm.  We enjoyed our stay very much.
Une belle maison à quelques pas du parc et de la plage! Nous avons beaucoup apprécié en famille!

Katharine‘s place is in a great location with the beach and a great neighbourhood in walkable distance. The house is a good size, though it is quite old, and some renovations and updates would really help make it more attractive. We still enjoyed our stay and Katherine was a lovely host to deal with.

Katherine is a great host and very responsive.
The location of this home is perfect, a lovely quiet street, a short walk to the beaches and shops on queen street.
The property is lovely but would benefit from an upgrade and a bit more attention. It’s looking a bit tired inside and the garden too. The kids loved the trampoline.
Quartier exceptionnel, tout y est à distance de marche, la plage les jeux d’eau les restaurants etc
A house full of character in a brilliant location.

The location is great, close to Queens Street and the beach. Rather busy on weekends, quiet during the week. The house is quite old, and renovations/maintenance would really help make it more attractive. Nevertheless, we enjoyed our stay.
Great place in a fantastic neighborhood. We loved being able to walk everywhere and will definitely be back. House was great for our family and kids. Felt right at home.

Not what we had expected. High price for a home that is in desperate need of renovations.
Can’t beat The Beaches as an amazing neighbourhood however, we would definitely recommend that if you are looking for accommodation in The Beaches, shop around and if this home is the only one left to rent, take a tour of it and then decide if you are going to stay there.
Great stay and easy check in/communication with Katherine. Place was clean/good value.

Katharine’s place was a perfect location for us - close to friends and family we were visiting and easily walkable to all kinds of shops and restaurants. We especially appreciated all the kids stuff - crib, highchair, toys, books and especially the outdoor yard toys. It made traveling with little ones so much easier and much more fun!

Quintessential Beaches house with lots of original character. Clean. Great location! Katharine was very connected with our stay.
Even though the house is in its best original build, it has great heating throughout.
So close to everything, park it and forget about it.
thanks a million to the host for sharing their home.

Lovely, whimsical and historic house in The Beaches area. We chose this as it's close to family.
Walkable to Queen Street where the LCBO + super markets are + plenty of places to eat. An easy walk to the Lake, board walk etc.
Katharine was super responsive in her communication, so we were never left in any doubt when we had any questions to resolve.
Would definitely stay again.

Great neighborhood and a really communicative host in Katharine.  The house was absolutely spotless.  It is a historic house and people should not expect all the mod-cons, but it was warm, comforting and very unique.  Neighborhood is fantastic.
Nice house, good location. Perfect for my needs.
Lovely and charming little house in a vibrant neighborhood our whole family enjoys. Perfect for us and Katharine is a terrific host.
Great host. Very responsive to when needed. The place was clean.
We had a fun time in the beaches and History was super close.
Katharine was a great host, very responsive and ensured a simple and welcoming check in process. Would definely book this place again!
Charming Victorian home in the heart of the beaches. Katharine was extremely responsive to my messages and gave great local recommendations. Definitely recommend this spot.

Quaint house in a great neighbourhood which is close to all the beaches area of Toronto has to offer. The house was clean and accurate to the photos. Katharine was an excellent host and was really quick to respond to messages. We had a great stay and I would recommend this place.
Tres belle place tranquille propre . Tres bien place . Je recommende ca vault la peine .
Katharine is a fantastic host - great, proactive communication. Fantastic location in the beaches, easy to walk to restaurants, parks and the beach.
Excellent location in the Beaches on a quiet street. Historic, funky, soulful house! Comfortable beds. The sleeping setup was perfect for our family of 5 - kids close by the adults' room. Sweet spot.
location, location, location. Charming place, felt like home.
Fantastic location for this charming beach cottage. Excellent communication. I would not hesitate to come back.
Katharine was very helpful and communicated quickly to our questions. Great host!
The house is in a great location, but needs renovation.

We stayed here for one night while we were in town for a concert. Katharine was proactive and provided parking instructions. the house was great, exactly as described, charming. In a great location to walk to restaurants. Would definitely stay here again next time we're in Toronto

Katharine’s house is a fantastic place to stay and I highly recommend it! The location is hard to beat, it’s one of the cleanest air bnbs I’ve ever stayed in, and Katharine was a tremendous host. She was very responsive and accommodating. The house is on the older side, but that’s part of its attraction and what gives it its charm and character. We loved staying here as a family of five (two adults and three small children).

Katharine's century home was very well located. The home was clean and well equipped. We really enjoyed the backyard deck.
The photos were accurate, beds were comfortable. Area was quiet and communication was good.
We would stay again.

Great location, very comfortable beds!!!
Katherine was so helpful and responsive…we will be back!!!!

This place in the beaches is a perfect spot and a great place to rest and rejuvenated from a vibrant part of the city.  The house has friendly neighbours and is spacious with arrangements inside and out.  The rooms are great and the pillows are top notch.   We can't wait to be able to book this place again!

Thanks for sharing your space, as 5 adults from the same family, we really appreciated the indoor and outdoor areas, room to move throughout the house. Plants and gardens around the house will look great after spring clean up.
Beds were comfortable and back yard was relaxing. I would recommend this location.
It’s a beautiful home, with all the right amenities. Visiting from Edmonton for a concert it was a perfect fit. Would recommend for anyone visiting the beaches area.
We love Katherine’s oasis in the Beaches. We felt immediately at home. Nothing was too much trouble. We can’t wait to return!
Wonderful place, great neighborhood. Katharine is an amazingly friendly & helpful host. Highly recommended 😊
Gorgeous house! Quirky and cozy. Loved our oasis in Torontos beaches

You can’t beat the location of Katherine’s home, it’s a very short walk to Queen Street. The house itself is homey, quirky and cute, which we loved. We both commented that we had the best sleep in a while!
Katherine is super quick to respond and gave very easy to follow check in and out instructions. All in all a great stay in the Beaches!
Great location and fun stay with our family including 2 children. Lots of room particularly enjoyed the back deck.

The location is excellent. Close to the beaches and the very walkable boardwalk in both directions. There are beautiful houses and gardens and lots of good restaurants nearby. It was lovely in May, I can't even imagine how fun it would be in July and August when you can swim.
The host was wonderfully communicative and made everything so easy.

A great place to stay.
The place felt very homely and is in an excellent location. There are a lot of shops and restaurants in walking distance.
We went sailing from the local yacht club which was very easy to walk to along the boardwalk.
Highly recommend!
Great location if you need to be in the Beaches. Old home with inconveniences. Just be prepared for that.
Katharine is a great person. She has a wonderful place to stay. I highly recommend!
We had a great time! The location is incredible. The house had everything we needed. I hope we can go back soon.

La casa esta muy bien ubicada, a unas cuantas cuadras de The Beaches, un lugar muy lindo para pasear, caminar o recorrer en bicicleta. La casa en general es como se describe. Sería bueno hacer limpieza y organizar el porche y el patio trasero, son unos espacios muy bonitos que están desaprovechados y que en tiempos como este (verano) son perfectos para una bebida o compartir.
This cosy, quirky house was very well equipped and in an excellent location. We felt very at home and Katharine was extremely welcoming. We would definitely stay again.
Katharine's place was great. Beautiful house and backyard for hanging out in, great location in the beaches. Would definitely recommend!

This was a trip with the family back to the Beaches after living there for a number of years and it was great to go back down memory lane. The location of Katharine’s place is perfect for parking your car for the entirety of your stay and walking everywhere in the Beaches. Fantastic location. Katharine was attentive and quick to respond and the cottage was both clean and well appointed (I.e., microwave, dishwasher, etc.). The one thing I would highlight is that this is a cottage. It may be in a neighborhood with million plus dollar homes but the space is rustic. Are the floors straight? No. Are there some scuffs and such here and there? Yes. Should any of this take away from your stay? As long as you approach your stay with these things in mind; no. Embrace the unique-ness of the space and enjoy the Beaches community.
Loved the location!
As advertised. Great location close to Queen St E. Definitely recommend if you’re looking to be walking distance from a lot of good options for food, drink and fun.

Oh my goodness. This home was perfect for our family of 5 (two adults and kids ages 9, 12, and 14). We stayed two nights on a road trip and we were as comfortable as we would have been in our own home. SO MUCH is walkable. The beach felt like we were at the ocean, down to the boardwalk and its ice cream shops. Parking was easy to figure out and we enjoyed the restaurants and shops. Steps away from public transit that would have taken us downtown if we had decided to use it - but really, we were happy just to stay on foot and explore our neighborhood. Katherine was extremely responsive when we had random questions about the tv and for any other needs that came up. I don’t know if we will find ourselves in Toronto again, but if we do - we’ll be staying here!

Most authentic beach home ever!
Wir haben als Familie selbst viele Jahre in Toronto Beach gelebt und wollten während unseres Aufenthalts die vielen schönen Erinnerungen wieder aufleben lassen, die wir mit diesem Ort verbinden. Und schon mit Betreten dieses liebevoll gepflegten alten Hauses war der Zauber wieder da. Es hat alles, was wir von unserem eigenen Haus und den Häusern der Freunde erinnern, die alle Geschichten erzählen, die mit den Besonderheiten dieses Ortes zusammenhängen und die es gilt herauszufinden. Man muss dem Haus nur zuhören …
„The backyard“ (der Garten) ist wunderschön gepflegt und mit allem ausgestattet, was man für einen typisch kanadischen Abend braucht.
Und obwohl The Beach nicht besonders groß ist, ist Wheeler Ave eine fast perfekte „location“., um diesen besonderen Ort zu erkunden.
What‘s left is to cordially thank Katharine for having provided the basis for an amazing and unforgettable experience!

Unfortunately, I can’t say that we had a good experience at Katharine’s place. While we were well aware that her place is rustic with an antique style (which I was looking forward to), this doesn’t justify the uncleanliness and drastic need for repairs. Prior to our check-in, Katharine was very quick to provide instructions (which I appreciated a lot). However, on the day of the check-in, she was not as responsive (not responsive at all actually). It took us 30 mins to figure out how the lockbox works. Coming in, there was a terrible cigarette smell that they probably tried to hide with spray/perfume. We couldn’t open most windows to let some air in and there was a cracked window. I am not sure that the place was cleaned before as the floors were sticky, the sheets on one of the beds were stained and the shower was stained. The place was in such poor conditions that we couldn’t stay the night. We ended up contacting customer support who were very helpful, as we couldn’t reach the host.

Katharine was a helpful and responsive host. She gave wonderful recommendations about sights to see and places to eat during our stay in the Beaches neighborhood of Toronto. She even sent maps highlighting different places that would be of interest. Her home was full of the charm that only an older home can offer. It was comfortable and offered plenty of space for our family of five. The private backyard was a favorite of my kids. The kitchen was tidy and had what we needed. The beds were comfortable and the AC units were much appreciated.

This house is in a fabulous location - so close to Kew Gardens, the swimmable beach, restaurants, shops ... it has it all.  It is worth staying here just for the neighbourhood! The beds were comfortable and we had good sleeps.  With Katharine's instructions, we pre-purchased a parking pass and never had problems finding a nearby spot (often right in front of the house).  The yard is large and pleasant.  We were fine with the eccentricities that come with an older home, as Katharine describes in her listing.  We did find that the furniture and dishes were tired and worn.
Grace was a great host. Very helpful and provided a list of nearby places for coffee and groceries with a map. I loved staying at the apartment.

Grace is a great host. The apartment is great clean and well equiped A/C washer dryer full kitchen.

I would stay again.

Grace was an amazing host, helpful and very kind and made sure that I had everything I needed to make myself feel at home. She was generous with all info needed in getting to know Toronto with great suggestions for local restaurants, cafés etc as well as super flexible with my arrival/departure time.
Grace’s apartment is beautiful and in a great location (I was staying for TIFF and it turned out very convenient, it is literarily 30sec from King Str. West). Grace obviously has impeccable taste - her home is very tastefully decorated, yet cozy and comfortable. Spacious and sunny with everything one may need. The kitchen is perfectly equipped. Very comfortable bed, an espresso machine and the sunrise light made every morning unforgettable.
Grateful for the AirBnb choice. Thank you for welcoming me into your home Grace! Very thankful.
Grace couldn't be nicer and has the best sense of style.  Her place is so close to the action that you won't want to drive...or park ;-)  Great for a night in the city!
I had such an amazing experience with Grace.  I truly amazing, design forward spot.
The location can't be beat and Grace was a gracious host! Thanks for a great stay.
The apartment was tastefully furnish with care, style and flare. Cannot provide Grace with a higher recommend everthing was perfect. A truely wonderful experience

Grace was an unbelievable host, extremely accommodating and on several occasions went above and beyond to assist us with our travels in her home city and make us feel welcome.
Her home is well kept with beautiful touches (exfoliating hand soap!) that really added to our stay. It is perfectly located, a minute walk to King-West street which is in the heart of the entertainment area - loads of cool/funky bars and nice restaurants - take your pick.
I'd recommend grace's home to anyone visiting Toronto - a truly beautiful home and person.
Thanks Grace

Grace was an extraordinary host and very easy to communicate with during the booking process and throughout my stay. The condo was exactly as described, extremely comfortable and centrally located. Grace offered tips on local dining and was kind enough to provide a nice bottle of wine. I would happily stay here again.

I booked Sasha's place for some colleagues coming in from out of town. They thoroughly enjoyed the place. It's located in a great area of Toronto, easy access to Transit and the rest of downtown's amenities.
Just before they arrive the A/C broke in Sasha's appartment (it was 40C out), but she made sure it was fixed before anyone arrived. She always made herself available, and was easy to connect with. I would highly recommend staying in Sasha's place. It also has the best patio!!

I spent two weeks in this apartment and it's an awesome one. Neighborhood is great, everything is close: shops, gas stations, restaurants, subway, ATM machines,....
You'll find a beautiful kitchen with everything you need inside, a large living room with a great home theatre. 2 Larges bedrooms. The terrace on the roof is a wooden one, where you'll be very well resting.
A very good place to stay for holidays or for business trip considering the whole apartment got WIFI with free access.

I would recommend it without any hesitation !
Thanks to Sasha for everything.

Pascal

Sasha was a great host, very responsive to requests and super friendly in person! The location is ideal for getting around & several fun young bars in the area. Great office space, rooftop garden & netflix with a fantastic screen! I recommend this space to anyone!

We stayed in Sasha's spacious loft during a four day visit to Toronto with our two kids, aged 5 and 1. From the first contact to the last goodbye, Sasha and her friend Chris where very attentive towards ensuring that we would have a good stay. Sasha was very communicative and considerate, despite her being posted in Europe at the time, and had graciously organized for her friend Chris to greet us upon arrival and check-out.

The space is equipped with high ceilings, a fully furnished kitchen for cooking (which we do our fair share of), and lots of space to hang in the living room, to watch the huge movie screen or for the kids to play. And boy did they play! There were tons of toys courtesy of Sasha's son, which were really helpful for us to keep the kids entertained. A kids bedroom with books and a bunkbed completed the advantages for our children, with especially our five year old girl shrieking of joy for a space for her (rather than a generic hotel room).

The upstairs boasts a office nook, which the husband gladly used for the sporadic moments of needed work time, and dinners where all consumed on the lovely roof space, which was overflowing with lush plants and atmosphere.

There was plenty of closet space in the master bedroom, and the bed was a decent size for my husband and I - we certainly did fall asleep after each hefty day!

The area was very adorable, with treelined streets with individual houses, and parks nearby, including a playground. The main street is within walking distance for 24 hour pharmacy and for grocery shopping, however, we preferred to drive to places such as Fiesta Farms and Whole Foods to equip ourselves with ample quality produce.

We will definitely consider staying here again, as the space certainly fit all of our needs! Thank you Sasha for sharing your special place!

Sasha was an amazing host! Don't look any further. Her lovely apartment was spacious, tidy and welcoming. She went out of her way to make us feel at home and incredibly attentive. She was also very knowledgeable about the area and always eager to help.

We loved staying with her and hope to visit again in the future! Top notch host, in a beautiful apartment and a fantastic location.

I stayed here with my two sons, 6 and 4 year old. It was a great space for them and Sasha was able to accommodate my last minute request. Sasha was very accommodating, and welcoming. The home is definitely child friendly which was a bonus for us.
The neighbourhood is a great location, I would definitely stay here again.
Sasha was a wonderful host and very easy to communicate with. She provided me lots of information and suggestions for my first time in Canada.
Thank you for having us! Wonderful hosts!

We spent Thanksgiving weekend in Toronto for a family visit.  This location was super for access on the subway and highways.  The accomodation was great and we were able to cook our Thanksgiving dinner without a problem.  A bit tricky finding the laneway for the parking spot, but we got it after the second loop!

I stayed for a week and can't find anything to complain about. A clean, comfortable place (and warm too, good thing in a sudden spring cold blast) with all the necessary amenities.

I know the neighbourhood well and it is a good on to stay in. Peaceful but connected. Toronto's best park is close by, as are all the shops and coffeeshops you might need. A few nice restaurants as well and the Bloor subway line that brings you downtown within 20 minutes.

Attentive hosts, nice people. (e.g. I asked if there was a shoebrush in the place, and Wies left a new one in the mailbox the very same day.)

A wonderful home away from home, convenient to subway and street cars, located centrally to much of Toronto. Wies was an excellent host assisting us very happily and obligingly with some variations to original arrangements. Many thanks Wies for your part in our wonderful Toronto holiday, highly recommended.

This was a great location for my family. We were in Toronto for 2 weeks with a 2 and 4.5 year old. The Roncesvalles strip was easily accessible on foot, and getting anywhere else was easy with the subway and 4 major east-west streetcar lines less than 2 blocks away. There are also many playgrounds, each with their own character, nearby by foot or public transportation. The toy park at Souraren Park was our kids' favorite and within walking distance from the location.

The neighborhood itself was quiet and relatively dark - something that was important to me since our kids are light sleepers. Wies provided a pack-n-play for my son and the rest of us slept in the bed. There were some toys in the space, and the backyard was an amazing space for keeping the kids entertained - sidewalk chalk, herb garden, bench swing, flowers, balls, a tree with log-hanging branches that the kids declared as "their house" and a table to run circles around!

We had everything we needed in the kitchen for preparing snacks and meals and easy access to grocers. There was a grill we used when we had family stop by for dinner.

All in all we had a great visit to Toronto and this location was a perfect home base for our stay.

I can't recommend Wies highly enough. The apartment was clean, tasteful and had everything I needed. Wies was a considerate attentive host and I was made to feel very much at home. The neighbourhood is one of torontos best and it's very easy to get around. I'll miss staying there!
The listing is exactly how it looks online.  Lovely backyard, front porch and interior all set in a fabulous location.  Wies was so helpful whenever we had a question or concern.

We stayed in the garden 1 bedroom apartment for 9 days in October. We did not meet the host but he certainly provided enough information to find the apartment, let ourselves in with the code lock and understand the general rules of the apartment. We loved staying in the area and the apartment was perfect for our needs. There are some aspects of the flat which were slightly below expectations but we noted those to the host and he supposedly dealt with those for the benefit of the next guest.
The listing was exactly as described.  Perfect location with a lovely backyard and front porch.
Great place, wonderful hosts! Very comfortable and clean. Would stay there again!
Excellent apartment. Clean and equipped with everything you need. The host, Wies is extremely accommodating and friendly.  We would recommend this listing to friends and family.
The apartment was clean, well-located (close to transit, restaurants and shops). It was well-appointed and as is shown in the photos. I would stay there again.
This is in a wonderful neighborhood  with easy access to public transport, High Park and The Lake.  We would use it again.

Lovely garden!
Parking is a little difficult to locate, but we're happy that it's available.

Great location in a quiet neighbourhood. Comfortable and clean unit with a nice backyard including BBQ. Communication with host was easy, pleasant and quick. Fast wifi and great cable options.
Note that there may be tenants above and below during your stay which can be a bit noisy depending on their habits. Loud walking and conversation can be heard.

The apartment is very nice, and the yard secure for pets. Understand though that the house has three residences, so you're sharing the roof with two other occupants, one above and one below. We stayed in the unit 2 for almost six months, so it became a bit like home.
It's an old house, so the floors are very squeaky, and you'll hear your neighbors. But that's to be expected. You'll also want to watch for your pets in case your housemates do not secure the gates. My dogs are runners, so I accompanied them whenever they were outside.
The kitchen is very functional with useful and newish appliances. The living room is actually fairly spacious. We entertained up to 6. Between the couch, chair, and dining set, it entertained just fine.
The couch is a fold out bed. My mother, however, couldn't sleep on it due to the hardness, but the couch itself sleeps okay for a third. We ended up buying an inflatable bed, and put it in the living room. The bed in the bedroom is comfortable, and the bedroom itself is spacious and functional. The bathroom is clean and appears newish as well. All linens are hotel-clean and comfortable. Unit 2 has a washer/dryer in a closet in the kitchen. Very useful.
The neighborhood is awesome. You walk to everything you need, including High Park, which is a beautiful place to spend time. There's an enormous off-leash dog park and a cute zoo, all walking distance. The Bloor-W. Dundas neighborhood is great with restaurants, bars, and grocery stores within a block. If I moved to Toronto, I'd want to live there.

He was so well prepared and has everything available for you from aux cables to toiletries to candles and lighters. My boyfriend and I absolutely loved our stay and want to go back so many more times. It was the perfect weekend getaway for us and Michael's apartment made it memorable. He was very easy to communicate with and extremely accommodating. I would HIGHLY recommend anyone and everyone to stay here, it is truly AMAZING!!!!

Michael was a wonderful host! He communicated with us throughout our stay making sure we were enjoying our time or needed anything. We were even two hours late upon arrival and lost cell phone service and he still waited for us without compliant just to welcome us! As far as his apartment, well it was just wonderful. Very cozy and art everywhere! The balcony was also a plus to view the city skyscrapers at night. Thanks again Michael, your place was the perfect city spot and within walking distance to some of the greatest bars, restaurants, etc. We love Canada!!
This was a great place! Michael was very helpful and accommodating!

Spent a lovely weekend in this sunny/brightly lit apartment. Great location near all amenities. Very clean (spotless!), stylish decor (paintings, pillows, plants, furniture - such taste!) and we felt very comfortable using the space as our own. Nice sized balcony with chairs, plants and pillows where we spent one morning reading and tanning (in November!). Told us we could use whatever was in the apt. We couldn't believe how soundproof the apt was! (barely heard the neighbours above) Communication was easy with Michael and his sister (she left the keys/prepared the apt for us because Michael was away). They both replied quickly to our questions. Can't recommend this place enough! Will be back for sure!

Michael and his sister were wonderful hosts, very flexible, communicative and open. I had no issues at all and appreciated the quick replies to messages. The apartment was perfectly located in easy walking distance to two subway stations and anything downtown, with lots of shops and amenities in the neighbourhood. The inside was very comfortable and quiet, with art everywhere and everything I could possibly need. I just hope his place will be available next time I'm in town. I would definitely recommend it!
Artistic but a little shabby. Apartment.

Mike's place had everything we needed for a lovely weekend in Toronto. Mike's sister, Agi, made the checkin process very smooth, and the apartment was clean and ready upon our arrival. We felt at home surrounded by all the artwork. The location was also ideal, just a block away from the heart of the city. We would definitely stay at Mike's place again!

Fantastic apartment in a nice area of Toronto. We were looking for a place that wasn't a hostel, and that didn't have the price tag of a hotel and this place definitely fit the bill. We contacted Michael (very) last minute and he and Agi were still able to accommodate us. Had everything we needed and more. Would, without question, stay here again.
We had a wonderful stay at Michael's - a great location and a sunny bright apartment full of great art work. Thanks!

This is a very well located apartment at an affordable price. For inner city and a 1960s building, it was pretty quiet (only heard some sirens outside; it was a Saturday night). Michael provided everything we needed, and responded promptly when I had a question about the parking. For those with cars, you need to ask Michael about guest parking in advance, or order a permit from the City for street parking after 6pm, or there's a lot one block away for $10 overnight.

Great experience overall. The apartment is very cute and close to a subway station. Just be aware that there are a lot of large windows in the apartment. We personally liked that, but it may be difficult for others who have light sensitivities.

An easy, convenient, trouble-free night's lodgings in a cozy home in the centre of town. What more can one ask for.
Thanks Michael.

Michael was a great host. Super responsive and excellent communication with him and his sister Agi who met me as scheduled to let me in to the apartment. The listing is exactly as per pictures with a nice little balcony.

What’s not to love here? I had a great stay. The apartment is cozy and artsy, and more than amply stocked with lovely linens, kitchen gadgets, etc…everything I needed.  The location is awesome…Loblaws is a block down the street, public transportation is just a five minute walk away. Parking in the back lot wasn’t available during my stay, but there’s a very convenient lot right around the corner for $16/day. It’s centrally located, but very quiet. And Michael is awesome!  Very responsive and communicative. I felt at home. I can’t recommend this place highly enough!
Communications before arrival were easy and pleasant. The apartment was clean and decorated lovely. Checkin was also pretty simple! We highly recommend this apartment for your stay in Toronto!
beatiful location, seamless exchange between host. would definitely use again!

Michael was a great host! He was consistently very quick to reply -despite being contacted very least minute. He was curteous, accommodating, professional and overall an absolute pleasure to deal with. The  apartment was exactly as represented, very clean and pleasantly furnished. Great value! I would definitely recommend Michael as a host for anyone looking for a great location at a great price.

Michael left fresh flowers! He was very attentive to orienting me to the apartment, the area and using the amenities. I felt comfy.
The apartment was in a great location for walking, shopping, yet quiet enough to sleep well. Beautiful tree lined street across from a public school (happy laughing during the day). And best of all, wonderful mattress!

Michael was very accommodating and the apartment was in a great location relative to the village. It certainly felt like borrowing a friend's apartment for the weekend and I wouldn't have it any other way. The apartment overall was charming, his art was beautiful, and the balcony was clutch. The building left a bit to be desired, but as I was on vacation it wasn't very important to me.

Michael prepared his apartment for my parents at the last minute and was very kind and helpful! Though they weren't able to stay as long as they'd hoped, they found the apartment very clean and well located. I would definitely rent with Michael again.

This is a cozy city apartment that is in the best part of Toronto...The Village. Out the front door and less than 1/2 block to Church. The location was perfect. The apartment has a artsy eclectic vibe with a view of downtown Toronto. Michael was the best airbnb host that I've experienced. Very personable and a dedicated host. We were last minute guests and he went out of his way to accommodate us. We feel like we have a new friend in Toronto. We'll be back!

We had a lovely summer trip in Toronto--only made better by Michael's welcoming and gracious hosting! He provided excellent suggestions on places to eat, things to see/do, and specific instructions on expectations of staying in the apartment. (No one has to wonder--awesome) He was responsive to our questions and arranged things optimally prior to our arrival. His place was a great value, cozy, & perfectly located for a 25 min walk to things downtown. And parking could be pre-arranged--thank goodness!

Michael welcomed us and made us feel right at home. A fun apartment decorated with original art! Great location that was perfect for attending an event at the Mattamy Centre at the Gardens. BTW don't miss the new Loblaws!

Honestly the bed on the balcony alone is reason enough to stay at Michael’s. It is SO fantastic, it’s the most relaxing place to sit and enjoy the sunshine. Multiple times I’d have friends over just to sit and have tea on it. I’m going to set one up in every place I live at from now on. It’s that good!!
I stayed at Michael’s place for a month in the summer. It was a fantastic experience that I’d definitely do again. Everything I needed for a stay was there, kitchen and bathroom supplies, ample space, and that balcony bed 😍 Michael is also a fantastic host, he’s extremely responsive (he’d respond within 10 or 15 minutes at most) and was very helpful and always able to help out in some way. I had some special asks during the stay as well and he helped in big ways.
The location is great too, very central and close to major streets and subways stations.
I totally recommend staying here if you’re thinking about it!

I had an incredible month-long stay at Michael's place in the heart of the city. The location couldn't have been more perfect, with an abundance of restaurants, bars, clubs, and other amenities just steps away.
From the moment I reached out to Michael, our interactions felt like reconnecting with an old friend. He exuded warmth, kindness, and genuine hospitality. Michael not only provided invaluable insights about the neighbourhood but also went the extra mile by tapping into his network of friends for additional recommendations on my behalf.
The apartment immediately felt like a home away from home. Impeccably clean and thoughtfully lit, it radiated a welcoming ambiance. Like many others before me, I must emphasize the balcony's enchantment. That place was made for reading, napping or just chilling.
I want to thank Michael once again for being an exceptional host throughout my stay.

I stayed in the apartment for 3 months.  Michael is super friendly and very involved.  he checks in regularly to ask if everything is going well.  I felt very much at home in this beautiful apartment and recommend it to many people.  in addition, the apartment is really in a perfect spot in Toronto.  close to bars, shops, public transport and supermarket.  really recommended!

Amazing stay. Michael's place felt like home and location cant be beat. Right in the heart of the village, super walkable area and close the subway so you can get anywhere fast. Michael was also super quick to respond and friendly.  Would 100% stay here again

Great place to stay in Toronto. I stayed for a month while on rotation nearby. Michael was very conscientious, friendly, and responsive. The place has everything you could need for short or long term stays. It looks even better in person than the photos, and the balcony is fantastic. I stayed in the summer and was a bit worried about how warm it may be, but the window AC unit in the bedroom was enough to keep the place cool. Highly recommend staying here!

An excellent landlord sent me a message every few days and asked if I needed anything.5 minutes walk from the subway and close to everywhere thank you, I will stay again and I love the bed on the balcony. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻🇨🇦🇨🇦🇨🇦🇨🇦

I really enjoyed my stay at Michael's! The apartment is bright and spacious, very much like the photos. It was clean and comfortable. Michael was also very helpful - responded quickly to my questions, gave recommendations of things to do, and helped me resolve minor issues that cropped up. It's also pretty easy to get close to the harbour / kings and queens street from the apartment. If I'm back in Toronto, would love to stay again!
Michael has been a great host.  I did not need much during my stay but he checked in and was very responsive with the couple questions I did have.  Thanks Michael!  Until next time.
Good host!
Stayed here for a month and I highly recommend, Michael was super responsive and helpful and the unit is cozy and clean, in a very convenient area
Encantado de haber podido vivir en el apartamento de Michael.

I had a wonderful two-month stay at this apartment. Its downtown location is really convenient, having everything within easy reach: a supermarket is just a 5-minute walk, the metro station is only 7 minutes away. The proximity to lots of excellent restaurants and bars was a huge plus.
The apartment itself is spacious and well-equipped. The dedicated workspace was a real asset for me since I was working remotely during my long stay. The kitchen also contains all the necessary items for cooking.
The only minor issue was the lack of noise insulation at the entry door- sounds from the hall could be heard quite clearly inside the apartment. However, this was a small inconvenience compared to the many significant pros this listing offers.
Also I would like to highlight great communication and support. My flight was delayed that leads to a very late 1 am check-in. I truly appreciate the property manager who kindly waited for me and assisted the check in process.

What a beautiful house. Vivienne has a beautiful home near everything. Near the train station, near restaurant and near a shopping mall. My friend as well as myself walked into a very clean house with alot of space. There is a big backward. I first meet Vivienne and her husband. They made sure to give me as mucha information as possible. Of all  my airbnb experience this was the most beautiful place that I have been. Thank you Vivienne

We have no hesitation in recommending this beatiful house. Its location is excellent, near public transport and many cafes, pubs and restaurants and an easy walk to downtown Toronto. The house is the star, lovely art, very comfortable beds and sofa, great showers and a jacuzzi. The garden was lovely and we enjoyed watching the squirrels and racoons. Vivienne and Michael kindly met us on arrival and generously allowed us to use the contents of their kitchen. The wi fi was a major bonus. We really enjoyed our time there.
Vivienne is an exceptionally wonderful lady that made my guests feel very welcome in her home. The home itself is gorgeous!

I was in Toronto earlier so had a chance to come by to see the house, to have a walk through and to pick up the key. Vivienne was most welcoming. She has a binder for guests to use with useful information about the house and area. When I arrived there was a bouquet of flowers and everything was clean.

Vivienne was available on email which she answered without 24 hours and her son lives nearby.

The area is quiet and I felt very safe (I was travelling on my own). The house is a duplex and the neighbours were home. The soundproofing is excellent, I only once heard the neighbours in the middle of the afternoon for about an hour. I never heard them any other time in the 15 days I stayed here.

They have a beautiful Jacuzzi bathtub and very large bathroom.

Transit is good - it is two shorts blocks to the Dufferin Street bus which is frequent and takes you to the subway. You can see the
buses from the house.

The kitchen is well stocked with utensils, dishes and cutlery. There's a gas stove which was a bonus. (I love cooking). There were empty shelves in the fridge and cupboard for me to use.

I was working and delighted the internet worked perfectly. There was a large TV in the upstairs den and a good sound system in the kitchen.

I don't live in a city with recycling so wasn't quite sure how to handle the 3 different containers. There was a recycling calendar on the fridge showing what had to be done each week and explaining what goes in each of the 3 garbage bins.

The area has good restaurants, markets, places to buy flowers and is safe to walk anytime. (in fact, Toronto is so safe).

I would happily stay here again.

I actually rented Vivienne's home for my parents who were visiting me. My main motivation was that it would be close to my place, the second motivation was the view to the Dufferin Grove Park. My parents had a lovely stay.
Thank you Vivienne and Michael.

The location of this house is great, especially for getting around town.  There is a metro line within a few blocks that allows you into head into downtown and then return to a very quiet neighbourhood.  The back garden is really nice and I enjoyed having coffee outside each morning of my visit.  Vivienne's son, Morgan, was very hospitable and answered all of the questions that we had upon our arrival and throughout our visit.  He even pointed us in the direction of a day trip north of Toronto where we checked out the leaf changes and picked up some maple syrup. I would definitely recommend this location to anyone staying in the GTA.

We had a lovely stay with Lin, she was so welcoming and friendly and really helped us feel at home! Was great to have a private space with a private bathroom. Lin served us great breakfasts in the morning! She laid it all out on the table for us and left tea and coffee making facilities for us to help ourselves once we were up!

Location was good for the city - a great walk in along Queen St W, cool shops, bars & restaurants! Much nicer to stay just outside the city and walk in if you want to.

Perfect stay, would visit again if we're ever in Toronto!

Our stay at Lin's place was full of welcoming, cozy hospitality and comfort. The atmosphere of Lin's home is great, our time there
full of enjoyable details: really tasty coffee in the mornings, Lin's engaging conversations, the playful charm of Lola and a fun neighbourhood at our doorstep(to list just a few). Thanks for a wonderful stay, Lin!

Lin was a wonderful and gracious hostess. We arrived and she had cold water and Italian Soda waiting. The location is quiet, beautiful and very close to TTC transit and served as a great hub from which to explore the city. She was wonderful in providing helpful information about the area and nice conversation and also provided us ample privacy.

A few words about the space. The guest room is located in the basement and is very cozy. There is not a door at the top of the stairs but this was not an issue. It was quiet at night and a small barrier was in place to prevent her dog Lola from keeping us company at all hours.We had a great visit and would recommend Lin to other travelers without hesitation.
Lin was flexible about arrival, welcoming when we finally got to her home, and very knowledgeable about the area.  There was plenty of space, and it was very clean.

Cem and I had a fantastic week staying with Lin and her dog Lola. Lin is accommodating, friendly and filled with great tips on how to enjoy the city. We loved the location of her arty, welcoming home as it is so close to downtown and Roncesvalles itself is interesting and filled with cool restaurants, shops and galleries. Our room and private bathroom were well kept, quiet and perfect for relaxing after a day in the city. Thanks to Lin for being such a great host and making our first airbnb experience so memorable. We were sad to leave.

I had a great first experience staying with Lin, Sophie and Lola. It's a great location and the house is very quiet. Lin was very warm,  friendly and helpful. Their dog Lola is super sweet and so cute. I would definitely recommend staying here.

Lin was a superb host. She is a lovely lady who was very welcoming and friendly. She was happy to chat us but also gave us our space when needed. She was very accommodating when we needed to leave some bags at her place and collect them the following day which was a huge help to us. Her little dog is also very friendly and playful.


The room itself was spacious with plenty of room for our bags and it was great to have our own bathroom.

The house is walking distance from lots of nice cafes, bars and restaurants and is close to the street car so you can easily access downtown.

Thank you for having us and I would definitely stay again.

I spent 2 nights in Lin's house whilst visiting Toronto. Lin was very welcoming with biscuits and fresh water left in the room. Large plastic box provided for me to put any of my food in that didn't need refrigeration. Very spacious accommodation which is in the basement leading off from the kitchen; there is no door at the top of the stairs so not completely private but this wasn't a concern for me as I was on my own. Lin showed me around kitchen where I was welcome to cook for myself or make tea/coffee. House is in a lovely quiet residential area within walking distance to the streetcar into town (about 20 minutes ride) and lots trendy shop and restaurants.

Lin was a very open and accommodating hostess. She made every effort she could to make our stay as pleasant as possible. The room is as described and represents great value. It is in a beautiful old residential neighborhood that is safe and easy walking distance to great shopping, eating and public transit.
I would however point out that this room may not be appropriate for everybody. It is a basement and has some of the characteristics one might associate with one. Nonetheless, for this price it is great value for a place with a private bathroom and accommodating hostess.

Very charming and friendly host and Lola the cute little dog (dosent loose its coat). We had our privacy in the basement even without door. Bed is queensize fits for trim figure.
Own bathroom, perfect. Some little rules to follow but thats totally ok for living in a house that's not yours. Transport to the city is easy once you figured out what to take. Thank you Lin for the nice days in Toronto.

Thank you for a great 4 night stay in this great neighborhood. Lin is a great host, welcoming and friendly. The room is exactly as described - very quiet and cosy. I wish I'd had more time to be around the front porch and to enjoy the tree lined street but the access to transport and the funky Parkdale/Roncesvalle neighborhoods was too tempting!

I would certainly return again and recommend this rental. Lola the dog was friendly, cute and quiet...an added bonus
Lin is a kind host. The room located in the basement is spacious and comfortable. It is a good option if traveling on a budget.

Lin is a very friendly and welcoming host. She provided breakfast, fruit, tea and coffee. We enjoyed having our own private room and bathroom in the basement, but we were also free to sit upstairs in the living room, kitchen, or on the porch.
Lin has a small dog, Lola, who is friendly and will often greet you when you come in. Lola roams the main floor, but Lin provides a barricade to prevent her from going into your room downstairs if that is your preference.

We had 2 good nights in Lin's room. Lin was very responsive and helpful. Note that the bed is a bit on the small side - maybe not wider than 140cm -. We liked being in a non touristic neighbourhood, public transport to downtown is just around the corner.
Lin was a great host. The location was perfect for me to enjoy my fun filled Caribana weekend. The neighborhood is really nice with quaint little shops. Parking wasn't difficult to find either.

Lin was really accommodating to us. She could recommend us about where to go in the neighborhood. She left us a sheet note about how things work in the house which was really helpful. She let us access to the kitchen and had dishes available to us in case we wanted to bring our food home. Some people mention in their review that the bed was small for them. I’m 5foot7 and it was fine for my height. Once she show us the place Lin let us do what we had to do and she was respectful about the space we occupied. I could always come to see her if I had question before and during my stay. I came in car and she recommended me to have a temporary permit from the city which I did so I could walk or use the streetcar during that time. I was in Toronto only for a week-end and Lin made it easier for us so we could focus about visiting the city.
Lin was very friendly and the accommodation is in a beautiful location. Our stay wasn't very long but enjoyable.
Great neighbourhood.  Friendly host
Lin was very welcoming. Her place was very convenient to public transport and a good base to explore Toronto.
Great location, great host
非常糟糕的一次住宿体验，地下室没有门，厨房就在上面，主人做饭的味道和苍蝇全部跑到地下室。不提供洗发水、沐浴露和洗衣液，洗衣机不好用，非常不方便！我们本来订了7天，结果只住了三个晚上就搬去朋友家住了，房租白白浪费掉了！

I stayed at Lin's for a week. The place is awsome. It's filled with art and you will love their amazing style. Lin is the kindest host ever. She is warm and sweet. I found Italian soda on my table on my arrival. Also she baked the best coconut cookies during my stay. The place is awsome and homy.. And, I loved Lola.. she is a precious little dog.. she is the sweetest when she walks on her back feet 😙😙😙 the neighborhood is one of the nicest in Toronto.. it's quiet and safe and if you walk to west, you will find a lot of cafes, restaurant and boutiques in dundas street. Also it is so close to high park. Subway gets you to downtown in 15 mins. Staying at Lin's, is like staying at your own home.
It was a pleasure staying here. Friendly and inviting. Clean and adequate one room that backs into a pretty small backyard. Enjoy the walk and smells to Dundas past the chocolate factory.

Great stay overall. Isil is very helpful and responds quickly if anything comes up. The place has all the everyday essentials and a newly renovated washroom. Lots of natural light as well. A separate entrance ensures privacy.

The apartment was perfect for my needs when I moved back to Toronto and looked for more permanent housing. Malcolm and Isil were always responsive to requests or issues that arose, while also being respectful of my privacy. The outdoor space in the summer and fall was great, particularly the use of the BBQ. Lots of light and enough space for what I needed.
Everything was great and perfect, best Airbnb experience! I totally recommend Isil and her cozy apartment. 5-Stars!

Very nice place, clean, lots of light and private. Up and coming neighbourhood. Nice places easy to reach on foot, close to metro and streercar stops. We found quite a lot of nice restaurants cafe in the neighbourhood. Grocery shops could also reached by foot.
Isil’s place is great, which near the public transit and you have total privacy on your own.
highly recommend

Disappointing-dirty, noisy, & worn down place.
Dirty everything-tables, chairs, shower, toilet, drains smelled of sewage(?), kitchen towels, & rusted French press.
Broken-entry ledge to place had gaps letting cold air in & was not sturdy & oven did not keep temperature.
Not enough supplies-no facecloth, one face towel, two towels (not sufficient for a four month stay-28 day min booking-especially with no laundry on site.
Unsafe-window lock was broken & no light in half the alley way to backyard.
Uncomfortable-bed is thin & old & could feel springs, duvet cover was broken.
Raccoons heard under the house.
I booked this place b/c it was a private space w/ desk for homework - but I had to leave everyday b/c the noise from the city construction beside the house waking me up by shaking the bed & rattling the dishes at 7.00am was unbearable.
Wifi constantly cut out.
The pictures on this rental appear very old.
Avoid. Kind enough people but this neglected dump was a money grab.

During the last two months when I stayed in this place, I was genuinely grateful for having a space with a sense of home. I arrived in the city very late in the night after a long flight,  the host waited and welcomed me with a warm showing around. This apartment is very private, quiet, convenient and cozy. It was perfect because I needed to study and commuted to downtown on a daily basis.  I found no problem with finding everything I needed with a walkable distance in the area. The host is also very responsive, respectful and friendly. She answered my inquiries promptly and I felt very comfortable communicating with her. Overall, it was a great experience of staying!

I had an amazing stay at Isil’s place! Isil and Malcom were both extremely friendly and helpful. Any concerns I had were immediately addressed in a kind manner. The apartment itself was beautiful and very cozy. And I loved living in the neighborhood, so many great restaurants and things to do, very safe and beautiful to walk around. I would recommend anyone looking to stay in the area to come here!

I stayed at Isil’s studio for 5 months and it was a great place to spend a long-term stay. The place is exactly as it shows in the pictures. Also it was clean, sunny, comfortable and quiet. I loved that it was very close to the TTC, buses, trolleys and the subway. Also, the UP station was 5 minutes away . It quickly takes you to Pearson or Union St. The area is surrounded by vintage stores, restaurants, coffee shops, bars, a mall, grocery stores and pharmacies. It’s also walking distance to Roncesvalles which is a very quaint neighborhood. This was really a great deal and the hosts were super friendly and helpful. They answered my messages immediately and they were always happy to help or answer any questions I had. I loved my stay at isil’s and I totally recommend it!

I stayed at Isil’s studio for 5 months and it was a great place to spend a long-term stay. The place is exactly as it is shown in the pictures. Also, it was clean, sunny, comfortable, and quiet. I loved that it was very close to the TTC, buses, trolleys, and the subway. Also, the UP station was 5 minutes away. It quickly takes you to Pearson or Union St. The area is surrounded by vintage stores, restaurants, coffee shops, bars, a mall, grocery stores, and pharmacies. It’s also within walking distance to Roncesvalles, which is a very quaint neighborhood. This was a great deal, and the hosts were extremely friendly and helpful. They answered my messages immediately and they were always happy to help or answer any questions I had. I loved my stay at isil’s and I recommend it!

Era la mia prima volta in Canada, sono stata qui per un soggiorno di un mese e sono stata davvero bene,   Il posto mi ha fatto sentire a casa, e i proprietari sempre carini e immediatamente disponibili !

Grace was a wonderful host. she responded to emails very quick and guide us very professionally. Her place was very clean, organize, and comfortable. We loved and enjoyed it. Her apartment was very close to downtown. I strongly recommend her apartment.

Initial inquiries and booking over airbnb with Grace when we were relocating to Toronto as new immigrants resulted in prompt responses and after confirming our booking, a few phone conversations with her resulted in satisfactory answers to our queries.

Grace’s apartment was organized, clean, comfortable, cozy and functional. Interiors and furnishings were top notch and very tastefully decorated. Grace is a thoughtful host as she had kept reusable grocery bags, torch, scissors, umbrella, good quality toiletries and slippers for the use of guests and even accommodated our request of an iron and ironing board. She had a good shower, a real bed along with a sofa cum bed and clean good quality linen, towel, comforters etc. Grace had made sure that we were not confused and left many instructions that included a small card with door codes and address for both of us, and also a personalized welcome note.

My wife found her kitchen to be well stocked and even had some basics such as sugar, salt, pepper etc. She had a nice collection of complete set of crockery, flatware and again good quality appliances. She replied to our questions / doubts promptly most of the time. Her cable connection has plenty of channels to choose from with a reliable and decent internet connection. There is a coin operated washer and dryer on the premises. The neighborhood and street is very quite, well-lit and we felt safe coming home even at late hours.

A narrow side entrance that leads down to her lower level unit may not create the best first impression. However, the clean, well furnished unit with a decent bathroom, good TV, well stocked kitchen and cozy neighborhood more than compensate for it.

Would we stay there again? Definitely yes!!

Everything was fine and as expected.
Grace is easy to reach.

Grace was wonderful in providing a quick response throughout the booking process and during our stay at her apartment. The space was well appointed, provided privacy and convenience. The area includes a wonderful bakery just around the corner and a grocery store down the street as well as being close to an up and coming Toronto neighbourhood. Transportation routes very near the house made it very easy to take streetcar/bus/subway trip to the downtown area within an hour. Our only minor complaints would be occasional noise from the upstairs unit and the adjacent laundry room. Otherwise, a wonderful stay and a great host!

Grace and I never got the chance to meet, but communication was easy and always accessible. The space was everything I hoped for. Not only did it feel like home away from home, but it was a beautiful and comfortable space to stay in.  The location was perfect, close enough to where I needed to be.  I could comfortably walk to my placement/work, to stores and restaurants,  and to a TTC station. It was a 25 minute ride to the heart of the city. I loved everything about this space. I would recommend the space to anyone visiting Toronto, and I would definitely stay there again!

Grace is a really nice person and host, she answered all my questions really fast since the booking process.
The place is very good, neat and comfortable.
We recommend it.

I very much enjoyed my stay at Grace's space. The apartment is exactly as described and photographed. It is clear that a lot of thought, care and effort have been put into creating a space that Grace's guests will feel comfortable in. I had everything I needed and felt very much at home. Thanks, Grace!

We stayed at Grace's place for the month of May, 2015. Her response rate as we secured the booking was excellent, and she answered all of our questions thoroughly. Grace's communication throughout was top-notch. Upon arrival we were greeted by a spotless and stylish apartment, exactly as pictured, along with a welcome note and a thoughtful treat - thank you Grace! There were extra linens, many towels, and kitchen basics (spices, oils, etc.) which was great. Lots of closet space in the bedroom. Coin laundry facilities are conveniently located right outside the apartment door, in a shared hallway.

The apartment is in a great area (Junction Triangle), steps from a bus stop which links to Dundas West Subway Station. The Junction area itself is thriving, with new restaurants and shops opening all the time.

We would definitely stay at Grace's apartment again if we need a short-term place in Toronto!

Grace is a fabulous person and an excellent host.  She was very attentive and also easy to communicate with. The photos are accurate and the unit is attractive and comfortable.  It only takes 1 minute to walk to the convenience store, a few restaurants and a coffee shop. Also, there is a frequent service bus around the corner which only takes a few minutes to get to the street cars/subway station and a supermarket, so it is very convenient. I got to stay with Grace in this beautiful apartment for 2+ months. It is a cozy, stylish and comfortable apartment that has everything you need at your finger tips. The place is impeccably decorated and very functional for you to feel very comfortable. I would not hesitate to stay with her again, at any of her properties and recommend her to any of my friends who are looking for a place in Toronto.

The unit is close to public transit; great affordable food options within walking distance; and in a safe neighbourhood.

NOTES: This is a basement suite with a long term tenant living above you. If you are on the taller side (I am 5'8), this could feel a bit cramped. Grace was fantastic! She was very easy to reach and talk to. The apartment is exactly as it seems in the pictures, too. I would defenetely recommend her! I really enjoyed my stay. Thanks Grace!

Minha esposa e eu ficamos 40 dias neste apartamento e fomos muito felizes.

Em relação ao apartamento, o valor está um pouco acima da média, mas acredito que compense pelas facilidades encontradas no espaço. Tem absolutamente tudo o que se precisa em uma casa. Cabides, panelas, talheres, roupa de cama, toalhas, lavanderia (paga), taças, vasilhas de vidro entre outras coisas essenciais para quem vai passar uma temporada em Toronto.
A parada do ônibus da linha 26, que faz integração com o metrô, está apenas a 3 minutos de caminhada, o que permite chegar ao centro em 25 minutos. A vizinhança é tranquila e o bairro possui tudo o que precisamos. Supermercados, academias, restaurantes, bibliotecas, pizzarias, bares e bancos.
Mas, é importante vir convicto e preparado para morar em um porão de uma casa. Ou seja, local inadequado para pessoas altas demais; para quem é claustrofóbico, pois não tem janelas grandes ou quem tem sono muito sensível, pois ouve-se o barulho dos andares superiores. Enfim, se voltasse a Toronto, com certeza ficaria no mesmo lugar.
Desejo votos de felicidades a Gracie e aos seus futuros hóspedes.
Recomendo!

Grace's place is convenient, with eateries and grocery stores located nearby, within walking distance. It is located on a street that is relatively well lit as compared to other streets at night. Grace's place is perfect for a holiday to Toronto. My parents stayed here whilst visiting the city for the first time and felt very comfortable throughout their stay. Grace's place was cozy and comfortable to stay in. It is a good place for long term travellers. There are a couple of grocery stores, parks ,a library and restaurants nearby.

The host will go above and beyond for you! I had a pleasant stay. The apartment is one that you can easily become attached to. love the secret hide away. Walls are a little shallow but neighbours are great and it’s easy to get around the city being in such a decent part of Toronto.
The facilities are great with a nice powerful shower and enough space in the kitchen and front room to comfortably make whatever food you want. Great stay , perfect stay. Great location, right next to small park ,all I can say is perfect.

Definitely recommend staying at Grace's apartment.
Grace was responsive and very accommodating to our needs throughout our one month stay. The apartment was comfortable, easy to find and secure.

With Toronto property prices constantly increasing it can be difficult to find a place you can call home that's near downtown and reasonably priced. The place was great too. The neighbourhood is quiet. The place is comfy. I slept like a baby in the bed. The kitchen was better stocked with cooking utensils and food basics than most places which was very much appreciated.

I would definitely recommend Grace's place to anyone else looking for something that's close to the action, comfy, and more reasonably price than some other options.

Grace is an excellent host and the apartment has everything required for a great stay. Any amenities you might need are within an easy walk, as is public transport. Would happily recommend to anyone coming to stay in Toronto!

Stayed at Grace's apartment for nearly 4 months and it was a pleasure. The apartment is clean, nicely furnished and has everything you need. Grace is an awesome host and helps out wherever she can if you have any questions and problems, and I can thoroughly recommend staying with her!!
Note: The upstairs neighbors can be quite noisy at times.

Although the housing is small with a misleading entryway, it was a very nice space. The area was very clean and all the necessary utilities were there. Several routes for transportation are also very close-by. Grace is a great host who responds very fast.

We had a lovely 3 month stay at Grace's place. The apartment was very clean and nicely decorated. Great facilities in kitchen also - and laundry onsite was very handy. Grace was very helpful and always available if we had any concerns. Noise upstairs was a little loud late at night- but of course that is not Grace's fault. I would definitely stay here again due to the ease of check in and the area it is situated in. Supermarket is very close - 5 min walk, as well as UP express to Pearson Airport and Union station. Dundas West subway not too far either. Thanks Grace!

Fomos muito bem acolhidos por Grace e tivemos momentos felizes em seu airbnb. O check-in e o check-out foram bastante tranquilos.
O espaço é agradável e bem decorado.
Devido à intensas chuvas na cidade nas vésperas de nosso check-in, nos deparamos com poças de água no quarto e na sala, que haviam causado estrago nos rodapés e alisar da porta do quarto.
Apesar do desconforto inicial, a simpatia, a educação e a postura proativa de Grace ao ser informada da situação e as providências por ela adotadas para buscar solucionar o problema e para diminuir nosso desconforto foram suficientes para nos garantir uma hospedagem prazerosa durante as duas semanas que passamos lá.
Por se tratar de um basement, a movimentação no andar de cima pode ser percebida, contudo não é intensa e não chega a incomodar. Da mesma forma, pode-se perceber a passagem do trem de cargas nas proximidades da casa, o que também não prejudica a tranquilidade do local.
A entrada do basement é nos fundos da casa e o acesso é por um corredor muito estreito localizado entre duas casas. A iluminação não alcança todo o trajeto, o que dificulta (mas não impossibilita) o deslocamento com malas ou bolsas, principalmente à noite. O vão de entrada fica alguns degraus abaixo e o teto neste local é baixo.
O colchão da cama é confortável e, juntamente com a qualidade dos lençois, travesseiros e cobertor, proporciona um delicioso descanso.
O sofá cama é confortável como sofá, mas não funciona tão bem como cama, sobretudo para pessoas com problemas de coluna, pois alterna partes firmes e moles.
As máquinas de lavar e de secar roupas são ativadas com moedas, ao custo de 2 dólares por ciclo. O hóspede deve providenciar o sabão em pó e o amaciante.
É importante ter em mente que o espaço não dispõe de mesa e cadeiras para se fazer refeições. A alternativa é utilizar como apoio a mesa de centro da sala ou a escrivaninha.
A cozinha é bem equipada e com utensílios suficientes para o preparo de refeições.
A dispensa estava repleta de mantimentos, tais como açúcar, sal, azeite, vinagre, temperos variados, cereal matinal, achocolatado, arroz, macarrão, enlatados. No freezer, havia alguns itens, tais como pães e mix de frutas congeladas.
A iluminação da casa é bastante aconchegante, pois possibilita ajuste de intensidade nos ambientes conjugados de sala e cozinha, além de opções de iluminação de teto e de iluminação indireta em todos os ambientes.
O banheiro é bom e a pressão na água do chuveiro é ótima. É preciso tomar cuidado ao se calibrar a temperatura da água, pois aquece muito rapidamente e o box não é grande. O armário espelhado sobre a pia do banheiro tem espaço suficiente para se guardar organizadamente os itens de higiene pessoal. Além disto, as gavetas abaixo da pia são espaçosas.
A casa fica de frente para uma praça com campo de baseball muito agradável e bem conservada, onde os donos levam seus cachorros para brincar. Lá também tem quadras de tênis e mesa de ping-pong, além de uma estrutura fixa e ao ar livre de ginástica e uma horta comunitária.
Há nas proximidades outras praças muito bonitas e com parquinho para crianças brincarem.
Foi um prazer conhecê-la, Grace!

A cozy hideaway, perfect for both shorter and longer stays. This basement apartment has it all: a fully equipped kitchen including fridge, freezer, stove/oven, microwave and dishwasher, a small but perfectly sized bathroom with a shower, and a separate bedroom with enough closet space for even a longer stay. The apartment is definitely unique, since it's custom built and decorated. There are some architectural quirks that add to its charm in my opinion, such as the small ground-level windows that appear at roof level in the apartment, a slight floor level difference with a step from the hall and bathroom section to the kitchen/living room and bedroom section, and a clean, interior design with well thought out lighting. Outside the apartment door is a well-lit basement space with a coin-operated washing machine and dryer. The entrance at the back of the house is reachable via a small staircase leading down to the basement level, creating the private hideaway atmosphere that gives this place its name.
Grace is a wonderful host, very attentive and friendly. At the beginning of my stay, there were some issues with the internet provider, and Grace immediately addressed the issue and compensated me for the trouble. I felt very welcome and would definitely recommend her as a host.
Grace offers a great place with an even better value! Definitely recommend to people looking for a place in Toronto! Great communication through multiple apps and thorough details.
