Dave is a hugely helpful and friendly host and the loft is exactly as beautiful as it appears. Great hot yoga down the block and also recommend the Vietnamese around the corner as well as the farmers market.

Ho soggiornato per un mese nell'appartamento di Arthur e Basmatee, che ha senza alcun dubbio molti pregi: è a soli 20 minuti a piedi dal campus di St. George, ha una cucina ben attrezzata (ha un frigo capiente, il forno, i fornelli, il microonde, la macchina del caffè e il tostapane), ferro da stiro, e un ottimo smart TV Samsung collegato alla rete wi-fi (anch'essa ottima e velocissima). Meno attrezzata la camera da letto, priva di un vero armadio.
Arthur è stato gentilissimo e sempre molto disponibile: è rimasto reperibile fino all'ora del mio arrivo a Toronto, verso le dieci di sera, ed ha prontamente risolto un paio di piccoli problemi con l'aria condizionata e l'illuminazione (grazie Arthur!).
Tuttavia l'appartamento ha anche qualche difetto: la pulizia, innanzi tutto, molto al di sotto della media: briciole dappertutto al mio arrivo, scaffali della cucina sporchi e perfino un sacchetto di patatine aperto (difficile non vederlo!), forno immondo, vetri delle finestre opachi, divano pieno di patacche e macchie e molta polvere sotto ai cuscini (direi che è giunto il momento di cambiarlo con un divano nuovo...).
Un altro aspetto che personalmente non mi è piaciuto, ma con il quale nel tempo ho imparato a convivere, è la posizione dell'appartamento rispetto alla strada, che non è una delle tranquille stradine interne tipiche dei quartieri residenziali di quella zona (come lascia intendere la dicitura "quiet neighborhood" data dalla descrizione), ma il lungo e trafficato stradone che dal campus porta verso la periferia ovest di Toronto (quindi un po' più a nord della vera Little Italy, di strade come College street, ecc.). Purtroppo le foto degli esterni si riferiscono non alle immediate vicinanze ma ad alcune strade più a sud e non ci sono foto che mostrino l'esterno dell'appartamento, ben diverso dalle tipiche casette canadesi che gli stanno alle spalle, nelle vie residenziali interne.
Sinceramente, non so se sceglierei ancora questo appartamento, soprattutto se dovessi viverci per un periodo così lungo: forse per lo stesso prezzo (2800 CAD!) ne sceglierei uno più lontano ma in un conteso residenziale più gradevole.
Un ultimo aspetto che non ho gradito (e che probabilmente non riguarda gli host ma airbnb) sono le politiche di cancellazione e modifica. Le prime, purtroppo, le conoscevo, e sono estremamente vessatorie per il cliente. Le seconde, invece, non mi erano chiare all'inizio e mi sono parse decisamente punitive quando, dopo la prenotazione, ho provato a modificare la prenotazione stessa: possibile mai che per ridurre il numero degli ospiti da 4 a 1 airbnb chieda un assurdo sovrapprezzo di più di 1000 dollari al mese?

David’s house was much beyond our expectations and we instantly fell in love with the space. The house, porch, rooftop terrace, and backyard make a peaceful oasis in midst of a bustling city and offer so much space to gather or spend some time alone. The home is well appointed and has everything and more you could ever need. The surrounding area is vibrant and plentiful in terms of restaurants, cafes, and independent stores. The photos truly don’t do justice to the house - it really is a gem.
Thank you, David, for being a wonderful, responsive host!

David’s place was fantastic!  The location was perfect for us, and the pictures don’t do the house justice.  The neighbourhood is quiet but super convenient with restaurants, cafes and transit nearby.  Thank you for a lovely stay David!

Location was everything for me. I was there for just under a month for work and everything I needed was in walking distance or TTC route. The place was super clean , with very comfortable beds which is always most important for me. Easy check in and check out. David was very responsive and the pics don't do it justice.

We had a lovely long weekend stay here. It's in a great location -an easy Uber or an energetic walk from downtown. The space is great and tastefully decorated. It felt like home and I'd happily return the next time we're in Toronto.
I was very pleased with my stay at David's home. It is a beautiful space, very comfortable and clean. I would definitely stay here again on a future trip to Toronto.

David was a great host.  His place is very quirky, spacious and very close to downtown Toronto, and within easy reach of Harbor Front, The Beaches and St Lawrence market.  We asked him if he provided any baby equipment and after we mentioned what we required he bought high chairs, a travel cot and plastic bowls and spoons. Would definitely recommend his place.
A fantastic house in a great location! Excellent value! David was a great host, quick to respond and very helpful!
Amazing, super accommodating.

What a great house to stay in while visiting Toronto! It is a beautiful home and very comfortable. The neighborhood is great too. The outside space is also very nice for relaxing or enjoying a meal. We had a great experience with both the house and David, he is an excellent host.

A fantastic spacious, quirky and full of character home in a really convenient area of Toronto.  The neighbourhood is great i itself, but also so close to downtown and also easy to reach the Beaches.  The house is just amazing and all of the other reviews are right that the photos don’t do it justice.  David is a wonderful, relaxed yet responsive host.  5 stars.
Lovely and chic house. We'll located with lots of restaurants cloe by but not a far taxi from the centre so you can get to things really easily. Coffee machine a lovely touch.

Excellent location, comfortable, clean and well-appointed home.
This was our 2nd stay here and will return - highly recommended.

Our stay at the house was so wonderful. It’s a lovely and large home with great energy and tasteful decor. The top floor room is a great loft space with upstairs deck access, two bedrooms and a washroom (with large bath and a shower) on the second floor, and a great basement room with an en-suite washroom with shower. All that with the living room, kitchen, dining area, backyard, and front porch make it a spacious and comfortable home. The neighborhood has tons of great spots to eat, get coffee, or anything else you need - and conveniently located close to the center of town. Would happily stay there again!!
Très bon rapport qualité prix à Toronto. Logement très confortable et nous n'avons manqué de rien.
This old house had eclectic and interesting decor. Lovely patios and a great location. We enjoyed the bread from the bakery across the street.
The sunroom off the kitchen is fantastic.
Amazing spot!
Maison délicieuse, très bien située, et le propriétaire était très attentionné ! Le seul "défaut" est qu'il n'y a pas de place de parking et se garer à proximité peut être un peu cher...
This is my second stay and both times were great. Well stocked and clean!

David’s home is stunning! I was surprised to find that the listing is actually too modest and doesn’t do the home justice.
I live in the city, but rented this space to host my family for Christmas. It was perfect for a group with four distinct sleeping spaces, a well stocked kitchen, large eating area, and plenty of space to relax. Having been in many homes similar to this one in Toronto, I really appreciated how well it was laid out and decorated.
David was a great host and was happy to accommodate the couple of requests I had.

A estadia foi excelente. Ficamos em 5 adultos e cachorro e tudo correu maravilhosamente bem.
A casa tem uma decoração incrível, é muito espaçosa, aconchegante e ainda mais bonita pessoalmente.
A cozinha é muito bem equipada.. e as grandes janelas de vidro foi minha parte favorita da casa.
A vizinhança é tranquila e a comodidade de serviços locais próximos ajudou muito para fazer supermercado e açougue.

David’s place is absolutely awesome. It is unique and special and was the perfect home away from home while our house was on the market.
The pictures don’t capture how neat the place really is!

David’s place is amazing - we travelled from the UK and wished we could take it back with us! The location is fab and the house has such character, it’s the best one in the area! David was really responsive and helpful when we messaged about a couple of things. Would highly recommend!
Great location and space. David was a responsive host and accommodating.
We had a great time at David's beautiful house. Great location too! David was very reactive and helpful before our arrival. Highly recommended!
David is an excellent communicator who made booking a place in Toronto a breeze!

We are extremely positive about our stay at David's house, which is truelly lovely and situated in a very quiet and nice part of the city with many small shops,restaurants,bakeries etc. nearby. The center of Toronto is easily reached by public transport. The house was verrrrry comfortable and perfectly equipped for a (longer) stay. We were four, using all bath- and bedrooms. Felt right at home and very much regretted having to leave after 1week!! The 3 regular bedrooms are sizeable and comfortable, the main bathroom is very large. We were grateful for being able to use the washer&dryer!The basement room was a bit messy and smelled musty (humid summer) with no way to vent properly b/c there is no window as we had expected. Solved quickly by placing a ventilator, and overall the person staying there was satisfied: the bed was good and there was a large and modern bathroom at her disposal. David is an excellent host, friendly, responsive, helpful and flexible. We would higly recommend!!!

David is very responsive to any questions or issues that arose, a great host.  The location is so convenient for access to downtown, and the major highways for quick zipping to various attractions (Toronto Zoo, Yorkdale Shopping Centre, etc).  Very quiet street/home with (3) exceptional bakeries within an easy walk, including an authentic French scones/croissants/bread place just around the corner.  An interesting neighbourhood with a variety of restaurants, bars and small shops.  Presence of homeless people in the area might concern some but you're going to see this anywhere in the Toronto core area, especially in Summer.  If you are a night owl and need pitch black bedrooms in the morning, only the basement suite really provides that, with the top floor bedroom having skylights that let morning light in, but that didn't bother us as we're usually up by 7:30 AM.  It is difficult to find such a large multi-bedroom home in this convenient a location, so this effectively met our needs.

We had a fantastic stay in David’s house.
It felt quite cluttered as it is a lived-in house with lots of interesting ornaments, but this was not a problem and it was really clean. It is also quite dark downstairs, again not a huge issue for us.
Kitchen has everything you could need.
We liked the area. It has a nice feel to it and there are lots of restaurants and shops along the nearby main street.
Excellent public transport into the centre (so ideal for older children), which only takes 10 minutes or so, but make sure to read up on how/where to buy tickets….the system makes no sense to me!
David was a great host, many thanks to him!
Great house, great location. Peaceful yet easy to shops and restaurants. Good transport links via the streetcars but perfectly walkable into Downtown. More than ticked all the boxes.

A lovely house in a very walkable neighborhood. The place seemed clean and there were so many interesting things to look at. My own problem here is that there are a lot of bugs in this house (fruit flies, ants everywhere).

Honestly one of the best airbnbs I've been to in a long time. Big and spacious for our group of 8, AMAZING space. The style is very eclectic and there's a little bit of everything decor wise, but it made it so fun to be at. the MOST well stocked airbnb, from spices and kitchen tools to extra linens and bathroom needs.
I would 100 stay here again in Toronto!
David’s place was very beautiful and cozy and our family stayed happily! The location was very convenient too. Thank you for the wonderful stay!
It was a beautiful home in a wonderful neighborhood. Could ask for more!
David's place is WONDERFUL. One on the best airbnb I ever stayed in. The kind of place that makes you wanna stay there and chill. Huge space. Close to downtown. Loved our stay there!

Fantastic location. Lots of restaurants and shops within minutes by foot from the place. It was perfect for the six people (3 couples) we had. The kitchen was well equipped with tea and coffee. The dining room and living room were spacious. The bathrooms were also spacious and clean. The bed that we slept in could be a bit firmer but it wasn't a big deal. All in all, a great place and we would definite consider staying here again, especially with a big group of people like we did. Thanks for hosting, David.
Wonderful stay for a group of four. Beautiful house on a quiet street. Thank you, David!

We gathered at David’s for our Xmas holiday. It was a great location, felt like a real home since it is indeed a home! Plenty of space for us all and easy to accommodate us for family games and family gingerbread house making!

We loved staying at David's place, the pictures don't do it justice. The glass roof kitchen area looks out to a tree lined sky and our family loved hanging out here each morning before starting our day. It was equipped with everything we needed and all supplies and gadgets were eco-friendly, which added to the good feelings!
The surrounding streets and houses are delightful, with a relaxed neighbourhood vibe. David's place is in a very cool 'brewery district' area, and we took one evening to sample the local delights (we loved the 'Avling' establishment especially).
Super close to the tram that took us right into town in a moment. Highly recommended!

a fabulous 10 night stay. The house was a  great size for a family holiday close to lots of shops and restaurants in a lovely neighbourhood. David was a really helpful and responsive host. We would definitely stay again

Home is beautiful and well decorated. Great outdoor space. Beds were very comfortable. Very walkable area. Parking was a little difficult as it is street parking. Great place for a group of adults visiting Toronto, however I do not think this listing would be good for people traveling with small children due to the breakable home decor and fragile plants.

La casa es amplia, por lo que mi familia y yo tuvimos cada uno un espacio. Se encuentra cerca del centro de toronto (aprox 20 min en transporte público). Todas las amenidades y servicios descritos se encontraban funcionando perfectamente en la casa 👌🏼
Beautiful, cozy, unique home - does not feel like the cookie cutter AirBnB experience (in the best way)! Highly recommended and would definitely stay again!

Lovely home! Very clear it is a lived in home and we loved all the special touches of being in someone’s home. Housed our crew of 6 adults, 2 kids no problem with all the essentials we needed. As someone previously mentioned, not a place for families with destructive toddlers, but our 4 and 2 year old had a great time with some careful guidance about things that were not ok to play with. Thanks so much!!
Overall good stay. Beds and layout are a little cramped for a group setting and a lot of personal objects left in the space.

This was one of the best Airbnb's we've stayed in (and we stay in a lot!). Tons of amenities and spotlessly clean, David's house was a great home away from home for a week in Toronto.
He was easy to work with and laid out a pack'n'play, high chair, and utensils for our 1-year-old. There was more than enough room for our family of 5 and the kitchen is stocked with whatever we needed.
The neighborhood is perfect for visiting. It's a short 15-minute drive to downtown, plenty of nearby parking, plus easy access to the trolley lines. Within walking distance, there are more than a dozen restaurants, cute shops, plenty of cafes, several great playgrounds (there's a park right next door) and a couple grocery stores.
The house has beautiful touches — a back patio that's quiet and shaded, the sunroom/dining room full of plants, and a little balcony getaway. Lots of space to relax, spread out, and enjoy vacation. We would love to stay here again.

In a lovely place, slightly secluded yet easily accessible to many parts of Toronto whether you go by foot or streetcar.
The place was immaculately clean with easy to follow instructions.
지하를 포함한 총 4개의 층으로 이루어진 숙소였어요. 총 6명이 숙박했고 이 인원이 숙박하기에 충분한 공간이었습니다. 주방, 거실, 방 상태는 깨끗하고 바로 사용할수있는 상태였습니다. 6명이 묵가에 가성비가 좋습니다! 그리고 호스트의 대응이 빨라 문제가 생겼을때 해결하기 쉬웠습니다

David was a great host. His property was as described, and was a great central location to explore Toronto! Thoroughly enjoyed our trip.
Thanks David!!

David's beautiful and eclectic home is a worthy sancturary for any worldweary traveller to find calm in the heart of the big city. The back of the house has the feel of a solarium where you can work at a desk that overlooks a picture perfect backyard space. The spaces were very comfortable and the home filled with curiosities to enjoy exploring.
It has been a while since I’ve felt like I was living in a true home. David’s home is a one of a kind and I would definitely stay there again!
Best spot in Toronto. Period.

A home with soul! The house is a hippy treasure trove, full of plants and objects from David’s travels. The kitchen is well serviced and the kitchen/dining room and garden are lush.
It was a great space for the two of us. It’s worth noting that, while it can sleep up to eight people in the three large bedrooms, there is only one, large, bathroom.
We often stay in this eastern side of the city and love the local street shopping and the easy access to the beaches and Tommy Thompson.
Would definitely stay again.

We stayed at Lisa's basement for 8 days. Lisa was a great host, she made everything ready before we arrived. The flat's location is very good. The street is quite, but you can blend into lively Bloor and Bathurst with a few minutes walk. Wi-fi was weak from time to time, but we recommend staying there.

This basement flat was exactly as described. Very comfortable, dry, warm and cozy. No dampness at all. A great value for the area! Lisa was more than helpful and communicative. She went above and beyond on a few details. Really made us feel welcome and at home. Lisa lives upstairs, and although we did not meet her, she was available at a moment's notice. She is very easy-going and even accommodated our very late arrival time in Toronto.

The area was ideal for us. Very close to endless food and drink options. The house itself is on a quiet street, only steps away from Bloor. The flat was perfectly clean, and includes all the basics for cooking at home. The furniture in the flat is very comfortable, cozy, and tasteful. We really wished it was ours :)

I would recommend the flat to anyone looking for an affordable place in a great area, especially a couple. I will definitely try to reserve this place next time I'm in Toronto. 5 out of 5 stars.
Lisa was great. Very communicative and accommodating. The place was nice and exactly as described. Perfect host.

This little apartment is great, it had everything we needed for a Toronto vacation. Lisa had everything set up for us on arrival, and was accommodating to our arrival and departure times.

I would be happy to stay here again!

Me and two friends stayed here for a month and we found Lisa's place to be in a perfect location next to a large amount of shops and bars and public transport. There is a subway station round the corner as well as a shopping mall about ten minutes walk away.

The apartment itself was as described and had everything we needed; cooker, toaster, kettle, microwave etc. We were not bothered by the lack of television because the wifi was very good and meant we could use our laptops to watch Netflix. The only fault we could find was that the freezer wasn't working and meant we couldn't buy any frozen food, which would have been cheaper and easier for us. However, this won't be a hard problem to fix.

As a host, Lisa was very accommodating and helped us out whenever she could. She gave us space but was always around to answer any questions. She washed the towels and bedding weekly, printed a resume for me when I was job hunting and even brought us a brand new dehumidifier for warmer days and nights.

Overall, this apartment was exactly what we needed and in an ideal location to explore the city.

Lisa's apartment was great. Everything is as described and we didn't have any problems. The location was very convenient with the transit station right on Ossington. Even though Lisa wasn't in town the first day of our stay she made sure that we had everything we needed and that if we needed anything, it wouldn't be a problem to contact her still.

I would definitely stay here again if I were back in Toronto.

:)
Ci siamo trovati bene, proprietaria gentile e disponibile. Appartamento come in foto
L'apartament de la Lisa esta molt be. Tot es tal com diu l'anunci. Pero sobretot esta molt ben situat. Barri tranquil, segur, viu i agradable amb metro molt a prop. Si tornem, repetirem!
We had a wonderful time in the flat! Lisa was extremely helpful and provided us with all the information we needed! The flat was very clean and spacious, we felt right at home!

Lisa didn't mind us arriving earlier than expected to the property, she immediately explained to us few things about the house, the property was a in the photos, in an excellent location near the TTC and many bars, and restaurants. Excellent value for money and excellent host

Lisa is a model Airbnb host, very laid back and helpful.  Her place was nice and it's in a great neighbourhood.  Lisa went out of her way to help us have a good stay - I'd gladly stay again and would recommend her to anyone.
Lisa was a very good host. The house was clean and well located. I suggest to everybody this room because it was really confortable.

Lisa's place was in a great spot, minutes away from the Ossington subway station and walking distance to lots of places to eat.
Lisa was very helpful and tended to our every need. The only thing that concerned me was the place could have been cleaner upon arrival.

My parents stayed at Lisa's place for a week in September. Her apartment is in a perfect location and was spotlessly clean! Lisa was on hand if they needed her for anything and check in and out was easy. She was very quick with a reply from the first stages of inquiry. I would recommend Lisa's place to anyone, and my parents would definitely stay here again!

I loved every moment of my stay here! Lisa was so warm and welcoming when we arrived and thoughtfully supplied us with plenty of information about the surrounding area.

The apartment was immaculately clean and stocked everything we needed to fend for ourselves although we couldn't help but eat out all the time because of the surrounding cafes and pubs.

Lisa had definitely paid attention to all the little details such as board games and everything we needed for a cup of tea. All of these extra details were really appreciated. Lisa was also really understanding about giving me a flexible checkout because I had a late flight. (Thanks again).

The flat was literally 2 minutes from Ossington station with regular services to downtown. Next time I stay in Toronto I hope Lisas' place is available!

Hyggelig kælderlejlighed i pæn stand. Vi boede fire personer, og det fungerede fint. Kvarteret var meget hyggeligt og trygt, med gode restauranter, cafeer og indkøbsmuligheder. Tæt på metro med hurtig adgang til downtown Toronto. Vores vært var meget venlig, og særdeles hjælpsom med råd om muligheder i lokalområdet, m.v.

Warm and friendly, Lisa was the perfect host. We only saw her a few times during our 7-day stay, but I knew she was available if  we needed anything. The flat was immaculate, cute as a button and well-stocked. It was Exactly as pictured and described, and in a great location only moments from the outstanding public transportation Toronto provides. From a pricing perspective, her flat is a wonderful bargain and an outstanding value. So if you are coming to Toronto, check this location first! And if you are fortunate enough to find it available, grab it! You won't be sorry! :)
The apartment was super cute, in a great area ... I would definetly recommend :)
Easy check-in and check-out, basement apartment very clean and convenient, great location... everything I was looking for.

This is a great spot if you like to eat out! SO many options in the neighbourhood!  Lisa was awesome at answering any questions we had.  Perfect place if you are going to be out all day and need somewhere to lay your head.

Six of us stayed here because our band had a show in the neighborhood. The neighborhood had tons of food and coffee and it was really quiet. Lisa was really helpful when it came to parking and even gave us an extra mattress. The apartment was perfect for our situation but I wouldn't recommend more than four people in the space unless you're hard pressed. We had a blast!
Lisa was a great host! The space was very neat and well organized. Perfect location in downtown for such a good price.

Lisa was a great host, always answering to any of our doubts or necessities. The location is great, very close to the subway station, the neighbourhood is very quiet too. Sheets and towels were changed every week.
However, I wouldn't recommend this place for more than two people. My parents and my sister that stayed there, reported that the sofa-bed meant to locate the extra one or two guests, is not in the bests quality conditions for a person to comfortably sleep for more than two days, it needs to be replaced for a new one. There is a foam mattress pad to place on top of the sofa, however, when my sister tried to use it, it was covered with dust and unclean sheets. Additionally, and this is not possible to see in the pictures or the description, the heat/air-conditioner system is located in the basement itself, doing disturbing noises constantly during the night, what it seems to be the engine of the system, goes on and off repeatedly, this is right next to the sofa-bed, making very difficult to rest for a person that is sleeping there. Unfortunately, because of this, I have to give to our overall experience two stars.

We had a great time staying in Lisa's flat. We ate at one of the places she recommended. We used the subway and then visited the Royal Academy Museum, the Bata Shoe museum and play board games at Snakes and Lattes, all along Bloor St. We made dinner in one night and had breakfast every morning in the apartment - saved money!

Everything was just as expected and suited our needs perfectly. I really liked the location as it's walking distance to many great restaurants and shops but is also very quiet. I found the temperature to be comfortable, cooler as we slept but very warm (especially in bathroom) during the day. I was very happy that our host could be flexible with check in/out times. I wouldn't recommend this for a very tall person as the ceiling is on the low side but average height people won't have a problem. There were a decent amount of kitchen accessories and games. Last but not least- the bed was comfortable! I would definitely stay here again.

Lisa's place is clean and cute, the bed is firm but comfy, and it's in the perfect neighborhood! I was able to park once and walk everywhere I needed to go, I always felt safe and there are SO many restaurants to choose from. There is noise from the heater but it did not bother us in the bedroom, and the wifi worked great. I would stay again!
Lisa was fantastic! Very helpful and immediately responsive. The neighborhood is adorable and quiet which fantastic food and great bars. We had a wonderful time.
The place was well located, clean, and Lisa was very friendly/communicated easily.  It was the perfect place for a short and affordable weekend stay in Toronto.

Great benefit/cost equation.
Really close to the subway station and near to several interesting
points.
Basement looks exactly like you see in the photos, well equiped and the bed is pretty confortable. We just had one problem, because the heater wasn't working fine, but Lisa helped us with a "smaller" heater. Also, if you are too tall (more than 1,90cm) it could be a problem at some parts of the place.
Other than that, everything was perfect. Lisa was a good host, helping us with a earlier checkin and answering our messages quickly.

Lisa's flat was great. Although we did not interact face to face, Lisa did a tremendous job getting the place available earlier than scheduled and left the key for us in the mailbox. The apartment was well stocked with amenities and necessities both. The neighborhood was right on Bloor and not far from the Ossington Subway station. There were half a dozen restaurants and bars just on the neighboring blocks and a 15-minute walk in any direction netted just as many wonderful discoveries. I highly recommend Lisa when you are in Toronto.

On the whole we enjoyed our 2 night stay at Lisa's. The basement apt has a cute vintage vibe that I enjoyed and is very accessible by transit. The only main concern I had was that the door the apt didn't seem very secure- it was light-duty wood and had a pretty large window. Someone could probably kick down the door easily or break through the window if they wanted to. That being said, it didn't seem like a really sketchy neighbourhood or anything I am just the type of person who likes to feel secure.
I found the apt pretty cold during the night and there was no thermostat to control it.
Bed was very comfortable, there were good places to eat in the area, and Lisa even left us some welcome chocolate.

Great location and very accommodating! The surrounding neighborhood was lovely with plenty of restaurants, cafes, pubs, and shops nearby, as well as the Metro just a few blocks away for easy access to other parts of the city. Far enough off of Bloor Street that it was quiet at night and we slept soundly. Towels, linens, shampoo, soap, coffee, and tea were all provided.
Great neighbourhood, and so close to the subway stop! It was very convenient to get in and out of downtown. The place was nice and exactly as pictured

This was an excellent excellent experience. Lisa is very easy going and allowed me to check in early. This was a major help. The listing is accurate and its proximity to the subway made it accessible and convenient to come and go multiple times throughout the day.

The apartment has charm and is comfortable for 3 people.

We were there during some very warm weather and the apartment stayed nice and cool.
Places was cozy and a great location!
Everything was great. Great neighbourhood and it was very convenient to get in and out of downtown. The place was nice and exactly as pictured.
Lisa was very helpful during our stay, having a parking pass ready for us when we arrived. Her apartment is very clean and quaint, we felt right at home!
The flat was exactly as described in a nice neighborhood, really close to a subway station. There are nice bars, restaurants in the near streets!
Our stay with Lisa was great! The place is very cute and has all the amenities you could hope for, even board games. Lisa is a kind and helpful host.

Lisa's place was awesome. Great location close to everything.
Nice and cool host. Great place to chill out after a hot toronto summer day. Very comfortable bed.
We had a nice stay at Lisa's place. She was easy to reach out and answered all our questions. The flat was well located and clean. I recommend Lisa's place if you want to stay in Toronto.

Had a pleasant stay in Toronto! The flat was in a nice neighborhood with plenty of good food and accessible entertainment nearby. It was a hot weekend but although there was no air conditioner, the dehumidifier kept it cool and comfortable.

Our one night stay was good. Easy check in process and we were easily able to park on the street (had to buy a $10 24 hour parking permit pass beforehand via the Toronto Council website which Lisa told us about and was easy to get). The neighborhood is a good central location and felt very safe. The place was as described and Lisa even left us a block of chocolate as a welcome present. She also provides a good list of places close by including transport, restaurants and services (such as post office which we actually ended up needing). As others have stated the back of the apartment has lower ceilings due to it being a basement apartment so my boyfriend who is 6”2 just fit through the doors etc, but I think if you were any taller it might be a little uncomfortable for a long stay.

All in all a good and easy stay.

The apartment was as described, in a quiet neighbourhood that felt safe. Lots of parking available on the street for $10 overnight. The ceiling in the back of the apartment is low (fine for me, but if you were over 6' tall, it may feel a bit tight ;) ). It is super cute and has everything you would need for short or long-term stays. There is no a/c, but being a basement apt, it was cool enough to be comfortable (and it was HOT outside when we were there). We were headed out for the evening so loved that it's close to the entertainment district ($10 cab ride).
The apartment was as-pictured and clean. Lisa was a flexible host which allowed us to have a great time in Toronto.

Apartamento em "basement" (Embaixo da casa principal) bastante confortável e com excelente localização (Diversos mercados e lojas a 1 quarteirão de distancia, 2 quarteirões de distância da estação de metrô, 10 minutos do centro de metrô). Estrutura do apartamento atendeu as nossas necessidades (1 casal mais 2 crianças, de 1 e 7 anos). Ambiente um pouco escuro, mas a localização compensa. A proprietária, Lisa, deu todo o suporte necessário antes e durante a viagem, sendo muito rápida nas respostas as minhas mensagens. Recomendo.

Lisa's place is super cute and cozy. It's in a great location which is walkable to shops, bars and restaurants. You can get a parking pass online to park nearby. We traveled from New York and ending up arriving a little earlier than I thought, but we just walked 5 minutes up to the main drag and got a few drinks while we waited til everything was ready. I would recommend staying here as a home base to explore Toronto!

Lisa's place was great. It was nice to relax there and escape the heat of the city. The location was also perfect, with lots of cafes, restaurants, and bars close by. Not to mention just around the corner from the subway.

L'hôte nous a donné des instructions pour aller jusqu'à l'appartement et récupérer les clés. Nous sommes restés 2 nuits et nous n'avons jamais pu rencontrer la propriétaire, elle n'était pas très disponible!
Le ménage ne semblait pas avoir été fait, le sol était sale ainsi que la douche, il restait une serviette de toilette sale dans la salle de bain et les draps du sofabed ne semblait pas avoir été changés! Les murs étaient très humide et la peinture s'écaillait! Nous ne retiendrons pas ce logement pour une prochaine visite à Toronto, même si il est situé dans un quartier calme et proche du métro.
