Cependant, un stationnement payant est disponible très près de la maison et est super abordable.
Lovely place to stay in Toronto. Great area and the bakery nearby is wonderful. Aleksa’s house is clean and comfortable. Parking can be an issue but there is a lot further down the street if needed.
A great place to stay and very convenient to transit was a big plus

Nice place to stay to explore the Danforth area and a quick walk to the subway. The house was very clean and the beds were comfortable. Note, there is no parking with the house but paid parking is nearby. Stairs to the second floor may be challenging for some people.
If you like to have coffee in the morning, it would be advisable to bring your own, (coffee maker filters are available in the kitchen) or be prepared to pop out to pick up coffee on the Danforth.

The place is ok, but there are a few problems. The biggest problem is that there are ants in the kitchen and upstairs in the bedroom area. Secondly the parking was hard to set up. The printer in the house does not work, the city parking is far away. The communication by host is a bit lagging as well. Lastly, the host request the guests to take out garbage and recycling even though we were only here for a two day visit, I consider that a bit lazy on the host's part.
Lovely home, great location. Only reason for 4 stars is the ants in the kitchen and there was only 1.5 rolls of toilet paper so we had to go out and buy more

We rented Aleksa's home for my family to stay in for our wedding, and they loved it! An ample space with plenty of room, full kitchen, and a wonderful little patio table to enjoy the sunshine. Highly recommended!

Great place and location. Lots of close shops and bakeries. 15 min drive into downtown. Parking is a bit tricky as most streets are permit and there's no easy way to find a street that isn't. Ended up with 1 parking ticket
Great place to stay for a trip to Toronto. Not far from the subway station either and the house is very clean. They provide almost everything needed like pots, pans, towels and more!!
Wonderful experience

The home is beautiful, spacious. Location is great, it’s only a short walk to Pape subway station. Plenty of amenities in the house provided including condiments, cookware/cutlery. Nicely furnished and super comfy beds. We’d definitely stay here again!
Good location, easy walk to great greek food, great pizza and great park (Withrow). The Danforth is a great road to just walk.
Beautiful home in a lovely neighborhood.

A fabulous property in a great neighbourhood . We loved our stay here and wish we could have stayed for longer. Wonderful restaurants and convenient shops for groceries, highly recommended for a visit to Toronto.

This cosy little house is well kept and immaculate. It is in a friendly neighborhood and a very convenient location close to transportation, shopping and restaurants. Aleksa is a wonderful host, prompt with communication and attending to our needs.
This was our second time staying here and we look forward to coming again on future visits to Toronto. We highly recommend this lovely home!

Spacious and comfortable house in a lovely neighborhood. House has all necessary appliances, the beds are very comfortable and the terrace at the back perfect to enjoy the good weather! (Make sure you go to the Greek bakery Serranos close by!)
Wonderful place and conveniently located!
Very nice and spacious place to stay, pleasant neighborhood and close to the city
Location is excellent and beds are very comfortable. Nice friendly neighbors made the stay even more enjoyable. Note: the thermostat is also the air conditioning if you find it gets a little warm.
Location. Location. Location! Such a great area to visit and hang out. The Greek Food is fantastic!

Aleksa was a great host. Very responsive. The Airbnb is clean and is in a great location. The living room set up is a little small and the tv only has a few channels, but we didn’t spend much time at home anyway. Great visit.
We had a great stay at Eaton Avenue. Property was perfect for our tour of Toronto. A lovely quiet neighbourhood. Host was excellent at communicating if needed.
A great place to stay in a fantastic neighbourhood.
Bien situé,  quartier calme. Logement spacieux.

The property was well presented, well equipped and enjoyable to stay in. A great location with easy walking distance to all GreekTown & Rivervale had to offer. The location is lovely and quiet.
The district has lots to offer in terms of restaurants, cafe's and bars.
We enjoyed coffee at Schmooz on Pape, a lovely family run cafe serving great coffee.
We really appreciated the assistance of our host Aleksa, who provided us great support.
All in all we had a very relaxing time at the property.
rented for my in-laws to stay for a wedding. it worked out great! thank you!
Beautiful home and great location.
We loved the neighbourhood ambiance and Aleksa's friendly neighbour, John.  We will return an our next visit.

This is a cute place with a 10 minute walk to Pape station. It was a nice size home and would be great for a family to stay at with a nice sized kitchen and bedrooms.
Some of the things I wish were better: The shower is good but a challenging set up with half a door and very little pressure from the head. The master bedroom had a very strong smell similar to Raid or perhaps a strong disinfectant. The host wasn't as prompt in responding as I have experienced from other Airbnb hosts. And lastly and most importantly for visitors to know, parking is difficult. The listing says free street parking, but everything is listed as permit only. When I messaged about that, the response I got was, "if you can't find free parking, you can pay for parking at Pape station." Fortunately, I was able to get a permit, but it was definitely stressful trying to find any free parking options.
Still, I'd probably stay here again because of the location and how cozy the home is.

Great location, bright and clean. The house is well appointed and very comfortable. We rented the house for my wedding weekend for my family to stay and it was great. Parking can be a challenge but there is a green P down the street that helped solve this.

This home is located in a great area with lots of great restaurants within walking distance. The space is well decorated and very comfortable including the beds.
I saw several reviews mention issues with finding parking, so I’ll note that while the street is permit parking only between 12am and 7am, you can purchase a visitor permit pass easily from the city of Toronto and use this for your stay if you don’t want to have to move the car around.
All in all, a wonderful property that I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend

This was our second time staying at this property and we absolutely loved both of our stays.  The house is conveniently located just a few blocks from the Danforth, subway, restaurants and shops yet the street is so quiet.  It’s a lovely neighbourhood.  The house is equipped with everything you need and Aleksa is very responsive and helpful.  We will definitely book this property again next time we travel to Toronto. We went on-line and purchased a City of Toronto parking permit which made street parking so much easier.  I highly recommend doing that if you have a vehicle.

Hi Aleksa thanks to recive my family in your house. It was very special, your house is realy nice. We realy appreciate the neiborhood and the house. Super tks
Best Regards,
Thiago Dávi and Karina Dini
Great airbnb close enough to a subway station (about a 5 minute walk). Would stay again on a trip to Toronto. Host was also great at responding to communications.

I really enjoyed staying at this Airbnb. Check in was super easy. The place was very clean with all the amenities you would need.  A very warm and well decorated home in a wonderful safe location. The host was very quick to respond to any communication. Would recommend.

Aleksa's place was perfect for our trip to Toronto. The house was clean and well stocked. We had some trouble with the lock (due to the extreme cold weather), but the host had an alternative solution that day. Street parking was easy to reserve on the Toronto site and we were able to find parking spaces nearby.  I would note that the stairs to the bedrooms/bathroom are very steep and there is not a railing for the last few steps. We were fine, but it might be an issue for someone unsteady or very young. Will definitely stay again when we go back to visit.
Very pleasant stay at this property! Clean, quiet, very safe neighbourhood, well equipped, close to TTC and to Greek Town. The host was really responsive and met all our demands. Recommend!
Great, cozy spot in a lovely neighborhood. Host was very responsive and helpful.
Great location and easy entry. Clean conditions. Problem using tvs but no big thing. Host responsive. Would return. Thanks Alexsa

The stay was comfortable and the house was kept in beautiful condition. The parking was a slight inconvenience as we did not know w that we can park in the front driveway. we paid the parking fee to the city and that was unnecessary. Overall we had a pleasant stay
Street parking only. Just something to consider if you have a car. Must pay for permit and find place to print permit before you can park. Other then that the place is amazing!

This is our third stay at Aleksa’s lovely house just a few blocks from the Danforth.  We love the location with the proximity to shops, restaurants, and transit.  The house is very comfortable and well equipped with everything you need.  The beds are very comfortable.  The neighbourhood is  very quiet, despite being so close to the Danforth.  We love listening to the sound of the birds in the morning!  Thanks again, Aleksa!

The host had nice touches to make the the house was very warm, welcoming, clean, and inviting. There is a nice peaceful backyard to relax and have a nice meal in with no pesky bugs around (I stayed in June). It is located in a very peaceful and quiet neighborhood, with nice coffee shops a few blocks away, and is only a 10 to 15 minute walk from the main commercial corridor with restaurants and shops. I would stay in this neighborhood again. The houses around are lovely and makes walking to and from Danforth a very enjoyable experience. Although it didn't bother my stay at all, there was a minor leak from the shower to the bathroom floor, and the printer which easily connected to my mobile phone, needed new ink, which would have been helpful for me to print the parking permit.
We had a lovely family weekend at Aleksa’s place. The location is perfect, and the house has everything you need for an easy vacation. Great neighbourhood feel!

We loved this cozy home in Greektown. This was our first time in Canada with our two kids and we wanted a place away from downtown where we could unwind after long days of sightseeing. This is exactly what Aleksa’s place provided. The beds are the most
Comfortable I’ve EVER slept in. The house was tidy and clean. The neighborhood is a little older and quiet. There’s coffee shops and an amazing Greek bakery - Serano - just around the corner - all an east walk around the corner. Aleksa’s place is a nice hideaway tucked away in one of Torontos older but well established neighborhoods.

Lovely, old house, complete with squeaky floorboards and all the character. It gets a little warm upstairs, though the main floor stays very cool. I would recommend staying here as a work trip, it's very easy to get around, and there is lots of space to work and relax indoors.

The house is in a great, peaceful neighborhood that is close to lots of restaurants and cafes and only a short subway ride to downtown. We've had a great time and enjoyed our stay! The house had everything we needed. The patio to the back is so nice! We were really impressed with how nice and peaceful the neighborhood was, just two short blocks in from Danforth Ave that is full of restaurants and cafes. It's a great place to be in for a few days visiting Toronto. Highly recommended!
This is great place for either short or long term stays. Extremely clean, newly renovated, close to shopping and restaurants. Had a great time. We loved our stay

We loved staying at Aleksa’s place near the Danforth! The location is so convenient, the house had everything we needed, and Aleksa was super responsive. When we checked in, we tried to print a parking pass, but the printer was out of ink. Aleksa responded right away, printed our parking pass, and dropped it off the same day. We’d definitely stay at Aleksa’s Family Getaway in Greek Village again!
Super comfy. Great location. We felt very welcomed.
This was a very nice and comfortable place for two couples to stay for a few days. Super easy check-in, quiet and cute neighborhood, very walkable and close to public transportation.

The place was fine. Neither great nor bad. I would give it 3.5 stars if I could.
Pros: Clean kitchen and bath, comfy beds, nice linens, peaceful neighborhood, nice kitchen and generously stocked, outdoor table, easy walk to main road with restaurants
Cons: We were 2 adults + 1 teen while sleeping situation was good, family room furniture was small and uncomfortable (e.g. one shortish couch + one chair without arms); parking was extra $; curb appeal is poor; squirrels spent 1 of our 3 nights scurrying across the roof loudly; backyard is not private and a bit rundown; towels thin and not plentiful for 3 people.
Good to know: Stairs are steep and short and no rail at the top, so might not be for everyone.
N/a
Good location close to Danforth strip and Pape subway station.

Wonderful place to stay! Very nice neighborhood and easy to get to great shops, transportation, and restaurants.  The house is beautiful and exactly like the pictures. Our host sent information and phone number if we needed to reach them.  Toronto is a lovely city and we hope to stay at this residence again. Thank you for everything!!

Recommended. Very clean .Modern nice decor Perfect size for two couples. Easy to find parking, though it’s best to secure a parking permit before you arrive. Quiet street. I agree with others that the lack of a stair railing at the top should be mentioned. My 90 year old mother needed help getting down the stairs. The one bathroom is  upstairs.
Really nice place, super comfortable, we've added it to our favorites.  Highly recommended.

great weekend in the city.
close to restaurants and cafes.
print your parking permit before you go!
Happy to continue our stay.
the host was really nice all the time, the place is in a really good location and really clean. Thank you
Great location, perfect house for exploring Toronto
Wonderful area, clean home.
This is a comfortable, detached house in a leafy residential neighbourhood. Very well equipped with everything you need.
Very clean and peace full place
I pay one week 2143 Canadian dollars but after he charge me American dollers I’m very upset

House was easy to find, and in the heart of Greek town so walkable to restaurants.
Cable was spotty and hard to use. Only had a few channels available. TV upstairs did not have a remote so wasn't really usable.
Host was nice and called when I had TV issues.
Would be great for a vacation house but not for business travelers.
Great location.  Nice comfortable home with the basic things you will need.  A few minor maintenance opportunities.  Parking not ideal but easy to get a temporary permit for on street parking.

Great location with fantastic restaurants and easy access to subway for travel downtown. Communication was good with Aleksa. The home does need some TLC with the back deck needing some attention and interior blind in master bedroom needs to be replaced. Best to print your parking pass prior to getting to this location. Overall, great location in a fantastic neighborhood. The location was clean upon my arrival (bathroom and Kitchen was spotless).
the house was exactly what you need. Aleks was responsive. Beds were comfortable. Could not figure out the TV and no speaker etc. to listen to music, but otherwise good.
Excellent location in Toronto. Very clean and comfortable.

Aleksa was very responsive and helpful. There are opportunities to refresh some rooms and replace appliances. I was disappointed that the dish detergent did not clean the dishes so I had to purchase my own and clearly someone added water to the olive oil.

We had a great stay at Aleksa’s house! Everything was as described and we were provided with all the listed amenities. Aleksa was very a very friendly and responsive host! The surrounding neighbourhood is filled with restaurants and shops, but the subway is also mere steps away if you want to get downtown.

Me and my family enjoyed our stay, it was cozy and the airbnb was consistently cool inside which was great. It was in a quiet area and accessible to everything. I would suggest a fan or two for the upstairs as it can get warm but other than that, we enjoyed our stay. I would come again :)
Great place and host
Fantastic stay at Aleksa’s Airbnb, great location and family friendly. We look forward to our next stay.
Accommodation was as described , would definitely stay there again.

We stayed at Aleskas place when we were in town for a concert! This place was very well located, an easy subway ride to the city centre. The place we clean and looked just like the pictures. We all had a great stay and would return.
Very good, quiet neighbour hood

I really have to say that these guys were the best!  The place was amazing.  Wine, cheese and a baguette were there to welcome me into their beautiful pad!  The fireplace was an incredible touch.  Can't say enough about how lovely the space was and how accommodating Jen and Paul were. A hundred stars.  When I'm back in TO I'm definitely going to look them up.

The apartment was better than the pictures, and Michael and Jennifer were incredible hosts, quick to respond to any questions I had. My wife and I (and our pup) enjoyed our Christmas and New Years SO MUCH. 8 thumbs up. Will  be  back for sure.
Thank you so much for a warm welcome and great place to stay while showing Carl around! Great space!! Michael and Jen were friendly, warm and accommodating! Best wishes!

Our stay at the Walkers' was just perfect, the suite is fully equipped, very beautifully decorated and everything was clean and well organized (we traveled with our pet and there was even a double dish for her!).  Jen welcomed us very nicely even with our late arrival. We 100% recommend, it worth it!

Michael and Jennifer were very friendly and hospitable. The unit was very nice and provided exactly what was listed. It was fitting to our needs and we felt safe and secure. I would recommend this unit and would stay there again if we were to ever visit Toronto again.

Jen was an amazing host! She really went that extra step and then some to make sure we felt at home and enjoyed our stay. For example she knew we were Australian so left a care package with lots of wonderful things (including Vegemite!)
We absolutely loved the apartment! We loved having a log fire too (coming from a warm climate this was a real novelty).
We can't really stress enough how accommodating Jen was and how well looked after the apartment was.
The location was in a beautiful street close to the city center but still with a neighborhood feel.
If you ever stay here go to House on Parliament nearby, such a great pub!!

Thanks again Michael and Jen for a great stay!

I arrived late evening and was greeting with a warm welcome from Jen and Michael. They made me feel right at home and walked into a beautifully decorated open space with a bottle of wine with my name on it.  They quickly helped out when the wifi wasn't working and made sure everything I needed was available. The space was one of the best price that was walking distance from the core. I wish I could have stayed longer.

Great place, nice interior, large rooms and very nice patio in a quiet street in the middle of Downtown Toronto! Stayed here two weeks during an MRI conference and couldn't wish for a better place to experience Toronto. Everything within walking distance, if not a rented bike can be stored outside. Very friendly, flexible and enterpreneurial house owners. I highly recommend this place if you're visiting Toronto! Best, Henk-Jan

Michael and Jen's appartment in Seaton Street is perfectly located. With a morning-sun deck with bbq, there's little more one visiting Toronto could wish for. Oh wait, laundromat? That's included too! If you're coming to Toronto and want to visit downtown but be in a nice historic area, come here!

Ein unglaublich schönes, zentral gelegenes Apartment, dass VOLL ausgestattet ist. Straßenbahnhaltestelle nur 1 Gehminute entfernt, zur U - Bahn (Dundas Square) lediglich wenige Straßenbahn-Minuten.

Die Gastgeber Jen & Michael haben sich wunderbar um mich gekümmert. Eine solch große Hilfsbereitschaft & Gastfreundschaft habe ich bisher noch NIE erlebt. Es war wunderbar, ich habe mich wie zuhause gefühlt.

Wer ein tolles Apartment nahe Downtown Toronto sucht mit sehr guter Anbindung und eine familiäre, freundschaftliche Atmosphäre liebt, ist hier genau Richtig!

Nur zum Empfehlen :)

A very pleasant experience indeed. The apartment appeared as advertised- clean and comfy. Jen was very helpful - both before and during our stay. To our surprise, Jen had left welcome tasties - much to the delight of our daughters. Can only recommend Jen's if you're staying in Toronto.

Wow! What a gem! The apartment was perfect and catered for all our needs. I've stayed in many air bnbs but this by far was the best! Jen and Michael were very welcoming making us feel immediately at home. My boyfriend and I were certainly impressed. We will be back guys!!

This is our first time getting a place to stay through airbnb and it turned out awesome. We didn't worry about this place and it was better than we expected. This place was nicer than the photos posted. Once you arrive at the place, you have everything that you need while you are staying here. We were not able to see the host while we were there, but Jen kept in touch with us almost everyday and checked how we were doing. Check-in & out was also great. Jen provided such detailed instruction which was easy to understand. Thanks for all the nice things that you have done for us!

This was an A-rated experience staying at Jen & Michael's clean, beautifully decorated, and well-purposed apartment. Jen & Michael were not around during our stay, but we received advance communication and directions from Jen before arriving, and they were responsive by email if anything went awry (it didn't). The listing is exactly as described, with fun touches like a record player (which my boyfriend enjoyed), Apple TV, and a bottle of wine waiting for us on arrival (which we didn't drink as we were out most of the day and night, enjoying so much of Toronto's food and cocktail scene).

The neighborhood is a mix of urban professionals and diverse locals, with a frequently-running streetcar no more than a 3 minute walk from the apartment. The apartment has A/C in the living room, and a oscillating fan in the bedroom made for a comfortable sleep. The bathroom is stocked with all the essentials.

All in all, we had a lovely stay and would recommend Jen & Michael's apartment to anyone visiting Toronto!

Jen did an outstanding job with her hospitality, everything was well organized, every information was provided double- and thrice-checked, lots of tourist informations/maps available. The appartment was marvellous, in particular kitchen and balcony (including a gas grill that made me buy a similar model at home, too), and is quite central. The only drawback for us was that it is difficult to keep the bedroom dark (small windows/skylights, but no shades or curtains for the skylights). Compared to other appartments quite luxurious, although we left e.g. the Home Entertainment System untouched. Definetely a recommendation!
The host were not in town, but everything was in order and there were instruction that answered all of our questions.
Wow, great,cool, stylish accomodation! Jen was very helpfuly und lent us some bikes!

We were so pleased with our experience at Jen & Michael's flat. First off- they have finely tuned the check-in/out procedure so it's so convenient and easy to arrive/depart. The apartment is lovely, very thoughtfully appointed and outfitted with anything you would need (bathroom supplies, kitchen basics, usual amenities like hairdryer/iron etc.) bonus features like Washer/Dryer, bikes, grill, parking spot and record player!- and then icing on cake is their stylistic point of view is expressed with the furnishings and decor. Jen made herself available by text & airbnb message as needed and was extremely responsive to inquiries before and during our stay. As accommodating a host as one could ever hope for!

The place is so conveniently located we were in the center of downtown quickly either by foot or tram and found ourselves in the Distillery once each day by foot. We recommend taking advantage of the bikes they have for guest use- we were able to explore the farther reaches of the east side in our last 24 hrs in town which would not have been achieved otherwise. We also recommend checking out the farmer's market in River Dale park in Cabbagetown on Tuesday if you want to make dinner one night. There is a butcher on Parliament- which we did not find in time but would have been great for grilling out on the deck! (grill provided by hosts!).

We hope to make it back to Toronto in the future and if/when we do we will definitely check in with Jen to see if we can stay with them again!

We had a really great time in Toronto. Everything we needed was provided and the host helped us where ever we had questions. Close to the city. Everything can be done by feet.  So all in all a great stay in a great apartment.

This place is like stepping into a magazine. We were only there for three nights and spent most of our time outside of the apartment with friends, which kinda made me sad since it was so perfect. We didn't meet Jennifer, but she remained in constant contact with us so we felt well taken care of!

We thoroughly enjoyed our time in Toronto, and the third-floor apartment on Seaton St was very handy for us.  Good location for the university and downtown.  The deck was nice to use, the laundry machines were great, there was room to entertain, parking was included, and we were able to do everything we had hoped.  Jenn & Michael have done a good job setting up this place, and their communication was quick and clear.

Jen is a wonderful hostess. She made me feel at home right away. She answered with promptness all my queries. Her place is very comfortable and has all the amenities one could want.  The location is great. I will definitely return here. Thanks Jen!!!

Michael and Jennifer were really welcoming for us!  We were late due to traffic and they were more than happy to help us check in and get everything sorted out.  The apartment is spacious, well equipped, and stylishly decorated.   Very convenient for getting into town and plenty of good food options nearby.

Jen and Michael are the most amazing hosts! Always kind, super helpful and open minded. And the place is perfect und beautiful - the patio gives the whole apartment a lot of sun. Even in autumn. If you stay there, you won't miss anything. We stayed three weeks and enjoyed it a lot.

Michael and Jennifer's apartment was a great choice for my wife and I.  It is a roomy one bedroom in a lovely old brick house, beautifully decorated and well-equipped.  It also came with lots of very clear instructions for everything from what to do with the garbage to accessing the WiFi.  And Michael and Jenn were great hosts.  They were easy to communicate with,  warm/friendly, and quick to fix a small problem with the toilet that cropped up.  We especially liked the fact that they made sure to have some basic supplies like butter and coffee [excellent quality as well] in the kitchen.  While their place is a bit outside of the very centre of Toronto, it is still centrally located, well served by public transit and with taxis readily found on the main streets.  The surrounding areas, Cabbagetown is a  mixed neighbourhood which is certainly interesting as well as safe, but the number of restaurants and places to shop are somewhat limited.  We would certainly stay there again

Wow, those would be the first words we would use to describe the loft. For the location you can't go wrong, it so easy to get anywhere downtown from the house and Michael & Jen were great enough to leave all the information you could possibly need in Toronto!
As far as the house goes it was a perfect match for us. Kitchen was big enough and the atmosphere was very bright and cheerful.
I would highly recommend this to anyone planning to stay downtown and we will be looking forward to the opportunity to come back again :)

Jen and Michael were exceptional hosts! Jen was great at communicating with me the check in and check out process and she was sweet enough to stop by after what seemed to be a long day of work and make sure the TV was working properly. The place is spotless and very very spacious. The neighborhood is within walking distance of the tram, and 5 minutes away from vibran Toronto.

Jen was a great host to us, we felt comfortable and at home. She gave us great places to go while we were there and made us feel more than welcomed. I would definitely recommend and return if I were to visit again!

From our initial correspondence until our departure from Cabbagetown, Jen was an amazing host. She was helpful and flexible with the key collection/check-in and check-out procedure and the little attention to detail "things" in the apartment were most thoughtful. Plenty of local suggestions and a basket full of "what's on" guides, walking/cycling maps and transit guides.

A great experience. Our hosts were gracious, welcoming and - beyond that - highly organized and professional about hosting. Every need was foreseen - for example, there are bikes for guests, and helmets and locks, AND an electric pump for the tires if needed. Everything is thought through like that. Plus the space itself is charming, stylish and comfy. The location right in the heart of the city was ideal for our needs. As the hosts advise, the area can be a little rough around the edges, but we encountered no problems.

We had a great time at Jen and Michael's place. Loved the vintage vibe throughout the place! Especially enjoyed the vintage record player and the fireplace.
Cabbagetown is a great community. Great restaurants within walking distance. A convenience store is located 1 block away from the apartment and a grocery store and pharmacy are within a 10 minute walk.
We managed to say a quick hello to our hosts as we were checking out. We would not hesitate to book this place again as it was a very positive experience.
Happy New Year Jen and Michael!

We loved this place! It was centrally located and well appointed. The open floor plan and big table was terrific for entertaining. The hosts were attentive and very responsive. We would definitely stay here again!!

All in all a good experience.
Hosts were good at communicating and when we needed them, they were readily available to assist despite being on vacation themselves.
Comfortable living situation made better by being able to use the fireplace. Loved the artsy vibe of the place and interesting selection of books and records. All the cookware we could have possibly needed was supplied.
We rented a car because we planned to explore a wide range of the city, but there are a number of places in walking distance (though some may feel too far on a very cold winter day/night) and the residence isn't too far from TTC.

This place was perfect right from the start corresponding with Jen was super easy. The place is bright and very clean. Jen is also very accommodating and will try to help with anything you could have possibly forgotten. The kitchen is well stocked with anything you could need for cooking a meal and the laundry was defiantly very useful :). I would stay again in a heartbeat. You are within walking distance to almost everything downtown and with a ttc pass it's even easier!

Michael and Jen were great hosts! The place was clean and as advertised in a vibrant community. While we experienced a random encounter, Jen was quick to action to ensure our safety and comfort by going out of her way to offer an alternate solution. (Note, the encounter couldn't have been prevented and was at no fault of the hosts'. It was greatly appreciated that they stepped up and took initiative!)

Michael and Jen were very thoughtful and made sure every aspect of my stay was taken care of, including amenities within the property, such as toothbrush, toothpaste, a lightly stocked fridge, and much more!

I would highly recommend Michael and Jen as a host and look forward to the next opportunity to book with them!

Great place in a great location with easy access to various areas of Toronto via foot, uber, streetcar, bike, etc. Was able to explore the Distillery District, CN Tower, Kensington neighborhood, and make a day-trip to Niagra with a visit to a local winery and dinner at the vineyard. Just wish we had more time to explore and utilize the porch, but the weather didn't quite cooperate.

Although Jen and Michael were on vacation in China, Jen was easy to communicate with and took care of the one minor issue we had with parking before the end of our first day (so it wasn't even an issue). Would stay again and recommend this area as it is just east enough to be quiet and affordable, but close enough to still enjoy all that Toronto has to offer.
We had a lovely stay at Michael and Jennifer's suite. The apartment had everything we need and the experience was very smooth and professional. I would stay there again.

The apartment was just as described but even nicer! It was clean and had numerous amenities available from shampoo to hair dryer.
We stayed during a hot weekend and being on the third floor was quite warm but thankfully there was a
fan available (AC on the other side of the apartment from bedroom).
There have been comments about the neighborhood but we felt entirely safe the entire time, even at 1:30am when we arrived the first night.
We had a little difficulty with the lockbox but Jen was always very available the whole stay! We would highly recommend this place to stay.
Great space and location. Thanks for the hospitality!

It was wonderful to stay at Jen's House. nice location and good interior! The weather is so hot when we were in Toronto, but Jen took care of us a lot. She changed to New Airconditioner and gave us more fan. So much helpful :) I believe Jen and Michale is the best host for Airbnb users. We was able to feel cozy with them. So nice staying. defenately recomendable!!

Everything was excellent and very professionally prepared. Jen was extremely responsive throughout the process and we were well taken care of. The apartment is great and in a fantastic location, short walk down to the entertainment district where a lot of our events were. Had a great time!

Nice upper floor gives sense of getting away, one's own space yet very convenient to public transport and downtown.  Impressively quiet space.  Loved the shower and the cutting board counters in the kitchen.  Very welcoming host.

This place was beautiful. Super close to Dundas square, Jen was extremely helpful. 10/10. But if you want me to complain about one thing... the light switches was a little complicated fir my level of IQ LOL.

We had a great time! The apartment was well and thoughtfully stock. We had great communication. We were thrilled to find a place with parking behind the unit and also a place where we could safely store our bikes. The location was so convenient to make places we'd hoped to visit in east TO. Thanks for a great listing!

Jennifer and Michael could not be there to welcome us in person for personal reasons, but they did all what was needed that we felt at home. Jen frequently asked if we would need any assistance, but we did not need anything because there is everything. We loved this stay so much, this location is according to our needs one of the best. Everythins is hassle free. :-) Thanks a lot!

Staying in Michael & Jennifer's apartment was great. The space is beautiful, spacious, clean and bright. Jennifer was excellent with communication ahead of time and, since they were away while we stayed there, checked in to make sure we had everything we needed and were comfortable. We felt perfectly safe in Cabbagetown.

Jen was very kind and helpful. There were a few minor issues and she dealt with them all very well. The space is charming and quite lovely.
Parking was a bit of an issue re the location. All fine.
The place is very nice and clean. The host was very kind and had great recommendations for us.
This apartment was just fantastic and is great value for the location.  The host, Jennifer is thoughtful and welcoming.  I would totally recommend this apartment to anyone.

Jen's place was our third and final stop on an Airbnb tour of the US/Canada - it was by far the best we stayed in! Great location in cabbage town and easy to travel to downtown (we mainly used uber) The outdoor space was an added bonus and great to sit out in the sun. Would recommend to anyone.

The host was exceptional!
A perfect example of what Airbnb should be about.

Thank you very much.
We will be back.

This third-floor walk-up apartment has ALL the comforts of home, a parking spot, and wonderful hosts, too. The spaciousness and privacy are very restful, and also helpful for getting work done as well. The bedroom is cozy, with a deep foam mattress, and the kitchen is full-sized.
It is near the Dundas streetcar and buses in several directions. On Dundas there are convenience stores and restaurants. A few blocks east on Parliament there are a couple supermarkets, Shoppers D/M, shoe repair/cleaners, and restaurants from organic/vegan to ethnic to pizza and Tim Hortons. You are about 15 minutes to Eaton Centre shopping and St. Michael's or to St. Lawrence Market in the other direction. The neighborhood is revitalizing and the street is home to families and B&Bs. Michael & Jen earn "Superhost" rating for a good reason. We very much enjoyed our stay there, and were close to family that we visited, so that we would definitely love to stay there again.
I absolutely love staying here.  The hosts are very amenable and always try to make my stay as easy as possible.

This house was perfect for our stay! It was clean and well stocked (i.e. Dishes, toiletries, laundry detergent, linens) which is always a plus when traveling. They left helpful maps and a list of recommendations which we relied on for all our meals. (House on Parliament and Figs are great!) She gave us a free placard for street parking and we always managed to snag a spot. The decor is nice and welcoming, bed is comfy, fireplace made it extra cozy, wifi is fast and bathroom looks recently updated. The porch is cute too although we came in winter and didn't use it. The hosts were great and I believe live downstairs. She responded to our call at 3a when we arrived and then didn't hover the rest of our stay. It was well priced too! We would stay here again and highly recommend it to others!

The self check-in was super easy! I loved all the little details and how gorgeous the place was decorated. There's plenty of great places to eat close by (about 7 minutes to the IRV). Jen provides travel pamplets, umbrellas, bathroom supplies and fire logs. I had an awesome time and woukd definitely stay again.

Jenn and Michael's place was the perfect landing pad! They've mastered this airbnb thing—great clear communication, a bunch of resources for us to check out, and a super cute, fun space! I would absolutely stay with them again. Thanks again, especially for the firewood & flexible check out time!

The unit I was in was beautifully decorated, super comfortable and homey, that their welcome basket was abundant, that they were fast in replying to questions and when I needed help with this or that. A real home away from home. I will book there again and recommend it to others.
Nice place. Cozy but lots of room. Clean. Much better deal than a hotel.
Great location, close to public transit, clean and bright apartment.  Excellent communication with easy check-in and check-out.  Hope to stay our next time we are in Toronto.

Seriously the best experience staying here. Everything was perfect, great location, anything you needed was there. I've already recommended this place to a bunch of people! Really hope to be able to stay here in the future! Thanks for everything Jen and Michael!

Third time at Michael & Jen's but my first time in the top floor one bedroom.  Completely surpassed our expectations.  The layout was perfect for a long term stay - felt like a home away from home - and we especially enjoyed the patio.  The apartment was fully stocked with kitchen and bathroom supplies and products that were lovely and beyond what we've had elsewhere so we felt spoiled on our holiday!  Check in and out was so easy and communication with Jen was really quick so we had absolutely no concerns.  Can't recommend highly enough.  We will be returning!
Nice location; easy self check-in; fast wifi and nextflix; comfortable bed and pillows = all I need! Definitely recommended.

Jen and Michael's place is truly a home away from home. It has everything you need – fully accommodated kitchen and bathroom, washing machine etc. The living spaces were great, and location perfect as we could walk or use the Bike Share city bikes to everything we wanted to see and do. Jen and Michael are super friendly people and were very quick to answer any questions we had. We can only recommend this place if you are staying in Toronto!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and it is definitely a "Downtown Private Stylish Suite". The location was perfect for exploring the city, steps away from a streetcar, and about 10 minutes walk to the Eaton Centre and to the huge Loblaws grocery store just north of the house. Jennifer and Michael were great at communicating and made us feel very welcome. The apartment is well appointed with everything and more you'd need including a sunny little deck perfect for coffee in the mornings or dining al fresco. We highly recommend this place and hope to return again soon.

This is a great Apt!! Jen was always very fast to respond with any question or concern I had befor what e, during and after my stay, Jen & Michael were wonderful hosts without ever being intrusive :). The Apt was really even better than it was described :)
I think the only thing I would say to future renters is that what Jen and Michael say about the neighborhood is very accurate. Cabbage town is a community that is full of lovely homes, some shops and some low rent city housing, The area south of the apt can be kind of "sketchy" at times. I never felt uneasy myself, but I might if I was a single female.

This AirBNB is a wonderful space. It has all sorts of added extras that make it a home away from home.  The deck is huge and gets sun from early morning until about 6pm in the evening. I loved how the place is divided into sections so one does not feel like it is crowded.  The location is great as there are lots of transportation hubs very close by. The owners work very hard to make the people living there feel welcome. I would highly recommend their place and would love to stay there again if I come back to Toronto.
It's very comfortable place and spacious.  If you don't mind the surrounding   neighborhood which is not so clean, this is the very good B&B.
An amazing space! I loved the fire place and balcony. Really easy to make yourself at home!

Great value for location and quality of accommodations. Close to a lot of Toronto hotspots. Nicely stocked kitchen and updated bathroom.
This is a neighbourhood is in transition and close to the Regent Park area - you may run into random drug addicts and homeless people. I never had any issue with the neighbourhood folk, but not everyone would be comfortable.
Overall, great bang for the buck.

Probably our all-time favourite airbnb place. Stylish and private space, many thoughtful touches, lots of info for tourists, quick and helpful responses, well-stocked kitchen and an amazingly comfortable bed.
숙소가 집처럼 너무 편안했습니다. 모든 장비가 잘 구비되어있었고, 궁금한 사항이 있다면 언제든지 Jennifer가 신속하게 해결해주어서 좋았습니다. 가격대비 분명 가치 있는 숙소라고 생각됩니다. 허나, 집 뒤쪽이 조금 위험한 지역같아보였습니다. 하지만 차를 가지고 다니지 않는다면 전혀 문제될 것 없을것 같습니다. 집 앞쪽은 평범한 주택가이기 때문입니다.

We had a wonderful time at Jen and Michael's place. The apartment is really spacious, light-filled, quiet, and packed with all the amenities you could possibly need for a very comfortable month's stay. Jen was quick to respond to queries and always went out of her way to make sure everything went smoothly. It's clear that a lot of thought has gone into making this space feel like a home - we enjoyed the selection of books, records and art on display. It's excellent value for money and we wouldn't hesitate to recommend this unique space. Many thanks to Jen and Michael for their kindness and for providing a super Airbnb experience.

Jen was very helpful and quick to respond. The description of the apartment and neighborhood is spot-on but the pictures don’t do the apartment justice. Jen has added a lot of touches to make the apartment feel like home.  We were a little worried about the parking due to some warning from the neighbors but it turned out that our car was fine.  Apartment was in a very convenient location, close to downtown and the streetcar.

Beautiful roomy apartment that was extremely well equipped with every amenity you could wish for, including logs for the open fire. The bed was super comfortable (so much so we’re now thinking of buying the same mattress at home!). When we had a minor maintenance issue, Jen was extremely responsive and got it sorted straight away, as well as going the extra mile and providing us with a gift voucher to a great local pub. The neighbourhood was very walkable and accessible to public transport, restaurants and shops, and is accurately described in the listing. We had a superb time and couldn’t recommend this place more highly!
Had a wonderful stay at their apartment and it made us feel like home. Jennifer was helpful and quick to response to any message or request.
They were very nice, helpful, and had lots of things to keep you busy. If I go back I would defiantly stay again!!

Les hôtes sont d'une grande gentillesse.
L'appartement est vraiment extra, propre, pratique avec tout ce qu'il faut pour passer un super séjours.
Le logement est proche des transports mais pensez a prendre vos weekly ou day pass au métro avant d'aller à l'appartement car ils n'en vendent pas dans le bus ou le street car.
Nous avons passé un excellent séjour.

Michael & Jennifer are exceptional hosts who go above and beyond to make your stay comfortable and enjoyable. The space they have on offer is a quiet little paradise on a quaint, tree lined street right in the middle of the bustling city. Everything we needed was provided, very clean and comfortable There is easy access to transit, restaurants and shops. We were able to get to Lake Ontario, Eaton Centre and the Distillery District all, by walking.
Would definitely recommend to anyone who wants a real taste of Old Toronto.

Michael and Jennifer definitely are the definition of superhosts. I an a first time Airbnb user, and they set the bar high! At one point during our stay we temporarily lost internet due to a storm. Jennifer was quick to offer us a new form of internet if it didn’t return in the morning. Thankfully, things were back to normal the next day, but the offer certainly left an impression. They understood that being away from home without internet is not fun. I would definitely choose them as my host again for Toronto.
Highly recommend this place. Jen and Michael are wonderful hosts. Always eager to help with local information.

The apartment is amazing! Super clean, the location is perfect, the decor superb, spacious, the hosts are extremely personable, friendly and had the best suggestions. We stayed for 8 nights and we had a blast! We’ll be back! Thank you Jenny & Michael!

Une place extraordinaire! Nous y sommes restés avec mon mari et mes deux enfants de bas âges et Jen et Michael nous ont organisés l’appart pour que nous y soyons comme chez nous: parc d’enfants, chaise haute, assiettes et verres en plastique pour enfants. La communication est excellente. Jen répond rapidement à toutes les questions que nus nous posons et va même jusqu’à les anticiper. Nous le recommandons vivement et n’hésiterons pas à la recontacter lors de notre prochain séjour à Toronto.

Michael &Jennifer's place is so cozy and clean! Everything we needed was available to us. The check-in and check-out process went very smoothly with Jennifer's clear instructions. We could not have enjoyed our stay more and would definitely go back.
Thank you Michael and Jennifer for your great hospitality. Wish you the best :)
Michale & Jennifer’s place was extremely clean, and very comfortable. All amenities were provided and it was very easy to access the apartment when I arrived. Would highly recommend!

Amazing hosts, very responsive to any needs. We would certainly recommend them!! The home has incredible decoration (specialy the black flat) with quick access to center town (15 min walk) !
They have everythings for the stay:
-soap
-shampoo
-washing machine
-air dryier
-barbecue
-dish washer
-netflix :)

We stayed for a week at Jen and Michael's and couldn't have asked for a better place to stay at. Jen was extremely helpful and quick to respond to any messages we needed to send her even when she was travelling for work. The place itself was spacious, clean and had so many little touches that really made the place special. There was even a sewing kit that saved me from a few bad outfit choices!
Thanks from Ciara & Stuart
This apartment was very nice! I would return for sure!

Très bel appartement décoré avec beaucoup de soin et de goût, il est propre et spacieux.
Il y a tout ce dont vous pouvez avoir besoin pour votre séjour.
Interesting space, worth coming home to.  They've even got a fireplace with logs ready to go for you!

Jennifer and Michael’s place far exceeded our expectations. The place was well-appointed with everything one would need and more, as well as being perfectly clean and very quiet. Best place we’ve stayed in Toronto by a mile!
Jen was a fantastic communicator, checking in on us whenever we needed and her initial messages made for a super smooth check-in.
Hope to stay again and highly recommended.

Jen and Michael place was just the right place for us to stay in. Aside of the gorgeous apartment, the owner are just more amazing. Here is my review separated in terms of each section:
The location:
We were planning for find a location in the downtown. We didn’t expect to find such a wonderful location that is just close to everything we wanted in downtown. There is a local supermarket just in a walking distance. We found it very helpful that the Dundas square is not more than 5 minutes drive. Not far from Front St either were we went to beautiful restaurants there such as Souk Tabule. The bicycles to ride upon charge was just on the corner of their street, very close by. Everything we wanted is close by: the downtown mosque, The Kabul cultural Supermarket (other many supermarkets are close too such as fresh co) The restaurants, the Cinema and the mall. It is just in the core of a Toronto spot that you just find it close to everything you want. Just the perfect location for us.
The Apartment:
I rarely say this however, in this particular apartment “it is the best apartment ever we been to in Airbnb ever”. It is just out of words to describe. Seeing it in real live was more beautiful and outstanding than when we viewed it in the pictures.
Trust me, if you have the chance to book in this apartment, you entered and watch you will be amazed and you won’t see my description through, unless you go and try by yourself. Everything is just cosy, difference and nothing is ordinary. It is by all meanings the real hard work results in it for the guests to be comfortable and relieved. The apartment is very big and that you will feel very comfortable. The apartment has everything complete the bed was very very comfortable and the pillows is something else. The couch was very comfortable everything in that apartment in terms of TV, Netflix and cableTV was just convenient to us when we want to watch something while we are eating. The kitchen has everything you want to trust I love that the washer and the dryer inside the kitchen so that all your work of cooking and washing your clothes are in one spot it was very convenient. The bed is very very very comfy. The balcony is really wonderful. Everything you need in terms of napkins, liquids for cleaning soap’s or anything were just right in the apartment presented for you to use.
My description wouldn’t fulfill the amount of comfort we had when we stayed in that apartment.
The Host:
Jen was very welcoming, smiling and very nice lady. She showed us the whole place and let us know where everything we need is in the apartment. Jen was quick to respond. Very attentive to our needs. Jen was very very very understanding and considerate. Thank you for the bottom of our hearts for being a wonderful host.
Really nice top appartment close to a shopping street.

Wonderful unit, wonderful hosts... We really felt home when we stayed at Jennifer's place. I would definitely suggest the unit and the hosts to anyone. Book without a single minute of hesitation.
Thanks Jenny :)

What an amazing space! Beautiful, stylish, and everything I needed for a two week stay in Toronto for work. Well stocked kitchen, washer, dryer, and parking spot was a bonus! Jennifer was great to communicate with, self check-in was a breeze. Thanks so much for such a great stay, would definitely stay again!
One of my top airbnb experiences - super cool place, lots of space, clean and great location. Everything you need is provided. Thank you!!!

Really enjoyed our stay! The apt (the pictures are pretty accurate if you want to get a feel of it) is on the top floor of a cute Victorian house, on a quiet little street full of other cute Victorian houses. Despite that, it’s only a short walk to the strict downtown & its high-rises. Or walk in the opposite direction to the Parliament St, and there’s everything you need too—groceries, pharmacy, great British pub/restaurant, even a hardware store to stock up on logs for the fireplace. We also made extensive use of the Apple TV w/ Netflix subscription (:
Couple of things maybe worth nothing: WiFi coverage in the bedroom is a bit spotty, so if you like falling asleep to YouTube/Twitch like I do, you might have to tap into your data plan. Also, it’s an old house with pretty thin walls, so on an occasion that a jet-lagged downstairs neighbor decides to watch TV in the middle of the night, you’re in for the ride.
All in all, we liked it a lot and would definitely come back! (:

Michael & Jennifer's place was the perfect spot for our weekend away in Toronto.  The decor is modern and delightful, and the apartment was equipped with everything we could have asked for.  We especially enjoyed the magazines and books that sparked lots of discussion on life as a Canadian and how to make the most of our trip to Toronto!
Great little spot - very handy - clean- eclectic retro chic - everything we needed
The place is great as everything is well thought of. Jennifer and Michael are amazing hosts. Definitely would recommend the place to everyone!

Jen and Michael are both extremely friendly. They helped us get our bags in the house and were only a text away anytime we needed them. The place is beautifully decorated and clean. We loved our stay and we look forward to visiting again sometime soon.

Très bien situé pour visiter le centre ville de Toronto ainsi que de plusieurs commodités. Nous n'avons pas utilisé la voiture pendant notre séjour. L'environnement est assez pauvre et défavorisé, mais le logement est impeccable.

I loved staying in this beautiful space. Everything I needed, and then some. Walking distance to everything, lovely patio to hang out on, Jen was very attentive, checking if I needed anything (I didn't!).  I hope to come and stay again.

Michael and Jennifer’s place was so nice and had everything we needed, and there was great communication about everything needed for check in! Would highly recommend their place! The only thing is that it was a bit far from what we were doing so we mostly drove/ubered, but the place itself made up for it!
Great apartment in Toronto downtown with parking. Only 15 mins by foot  to Eaton Center. Would love to stay there again.

Jennifer and Michael’s place is amazing. Super stylish and comfortable space and lots of local tips for how best to enjoy your time in Cabbagetown. Any time I had a question or request they were on top of it. The unit is close enough to downtown that a 5 or 10 minute cab ride will get you there but far enough removed to be very quiet. No problems getting good sleep here! Speaking of sleep, the bed is very comfortable - one of the best AirBnB beds I’ve ever slept in.
Plenty of closet space and even some complimentary toiletries in the bathroom just in case.
Worth noting: there are quite a bit of homeless in the area but I never once had any problems with them; they always seemed to mind their own business.
Very nice apartment with cool hardwood and tiled floors. Very clean bathroom with a comfortable shower. Wifi works great, and excellent instructions were provided for all aspects of my stay.

Michael and Jennifer's apartment in Seaton Street is an ideal base for a stay in Toronto whether for a few days or a longer visit.  Michael and Jennifer are flexible, responsive hosts who are long term residents so they really know the area and their advice can be relied on.  The apartment is very comfortable, with plenty of room so you can feel settled and relax.  We really enjoyed the mix and match old china dinner plates - a welcome change from the bland Ikea contents found in most Air BnB apartments. The kitchen is very functional if you like to cook and the apartment is close to the St Lawrence market which has a great range of fresh produce, especially at the Saturday Framers' Market.
Very stylish, quirky, fun, and comfortable unit. We had everything we needed in a home base for our trip to Toronto. Thanks so much, Michael and Jennifer!

Wir reisten mit unserer 1,5 jährigen Tochter nach Kanada, erster Stop Toronto. Die Wohnung ist super ausgestattet und auch sehr schön eingerichtet.
Sie ist aber nicht für Kinder geeignet. Offene Treppe im Wohnzimmer, 2. Stock und unten keine Möglichkeit den Kinderwagen stehen zu lassen, im Sommer ist das Schlafzimmer sehr warm und nicht abdunkelbar, Klimaanlage nur im Wohnzimmer.
200m von der Wohnung entfernt ist eine Kirche die Obdachlosen Essen und Obdach bietet. Es gibt keine Möglichkeit aus der Straße raus zu kommen ohne an den Junkies und Alkoholikern vorbei zu kommen. Sehr unangenehm mit kleinem Kind. (Die Straße an sich ist ok)

Communication was excellent. Even though, they were out of town during our stay, Jen was accessible and responded quickly to any questions we had. Can’t say enough about 204 Seaton. The space is large, updated and well equipped with anything you need for your stay. It is within walking distance or a short Uber/Lyft ride to great pubs, restaurants, coffee shops and groceries. Eclectic neighborhood, but felt very safe. Highly recommend staying at Michael and Jen’s space!

Wij hadden super verblijf. Het appartement is super en je bent zo in het centrum! Ook Parliament Street is (op het goede stuk) ook erg gezellig! Sommige stukjes rondom het appartement zijn wat onaangenamer (veel daklozen), maar daar loop je ook zo weer uit en het voelt verder niet onveilig.
Het appartement zelf is helemaal top en van alles is aanwezig. Ook het gevraagde kinderbedje en de kinderstoel.
Communicatie is helemaal goed en snel! We konden ook heel fijn eerder uitchecken én op dag van vertrek laat uitchecken (heeeel fijn met een avondvlucht naar Amsterdam).
Het was onze tweede keer in Toronto, maar als we terugkomen slapen we zeker weer hier!

The flat are very Nice !
Thank’s you for your hospitality and your recommandations. I recommand this flat

Michael and Jennifer's spot was a great deal for staying in Toronto in the summer. The place is quite spacious with a lovely sunny deck, a big dining room table and washer and dryer in home. On the top floor, so things were quiet and private. The kitchen and bathroom had lots of amenities as well!

The place was gorgeous with lots of stylish and thoughtful touches. Note that there's no air conditioning in the bedroom in case you're visiting in summer (although the area fans were enough to keep us comfortable). The neighborhood appears to be in an area of "transition." The street itself is full of beautiful renovated old houses, but a few blocks away still feels a little sketchy. That said, excellent walking access to public transit, groceries, restaurants, etc. And the rooftop deck was a real highlight! Hosts were very responsive to problems that popped up (not many). Would stay again!

This is a great accommodation, very convenient for downtown ,yet in a quiet street, though on top floor and in an attic it is spacious and all amenities are provided. Michael and Jennifer are great hosts and if We come to Toronto again we would like to stay there again.

Michael and Jennifer's place was exactly as listed. It was clean, comfortable and close to the centre.  We especially loved  the decor and Victorian architecture.  We wish we could have stayed longer!

Die Wohnung hat uns sehr gut gefallen,stilvoll angerichtet und sehr bequem für uns zwei. Check in und Check out waren problemlos und einfach. Die Verbindung ist gut, wir wohnten sehr zentral und konnten viel einfach zu Fuß erreichen.
Dieser Unterkunft empfehlen wir sehr gern weiter
Jen and Michael have earned their status as superhosts. I always felt welcome and everything went flawless. The place was clean, spacious and exactly as described. I will be back.

Une arrivée simple et autonome. Un appartement bénéficiant de tout le confort nécessaire. Propre et très bien agencé.
À 20 min à pied du Downtown.
Je recommande.

We really loved and enjoyed staying at this place! It is very pretty and definitely felt like a home away from home. The apartment is very spacious and has everything you need, the bed was super comfortable and we really felt homey during our time spent here.
The apartment is only a 15 minute walk from downtown so it is quite easy to get around, a grocery store and some more shops are even closer.
The parking space was great and it was good to leave the car there while getting to know the city by foot.
We can definitely recommend spending time here and would come back should we ever travel to Toronto again in the future :)
A wonderful and stylish stay. The location was great and we enjoyed walking to many of our destinations in Toronto.
Place was great roomier than I expected and helpful local tips about restaurants and such.

We were so happy to stay at Jen's home. Her apartment allowed us to have such a smoothly stay: we could work in the morning and then go out in the afternoon. Thanks to Jen's extraordinary recommendations, we ate so well in Cabbagetown (The Irv and House on Parliament were delicious, not to mention the Taiwanese tapas!); it is such a unique and fantastic neighborhood. Jen was so kind to let us check-out late to attend a concert (which was spectacular!) Many thanks for letting us stay with you, Jen, we had a wonderful time in Toronto!

Michael & Jennifer, were great hosts always available and willing to help.
Very clear with the directions on how to arrive and collect the keys and also gave us a lot of guidelines to have a really great stay.

We have had a great time at this place. Great and very reliable host, the apartment is very cosy and in a good location. If you look for your home away from home in Toronto, Michael & Jennifer's place does that for you.

This place is a dreamy place.
I was in Toronto for six weeks. I did not want to leave.
This place is not only very well equipped, it’s also comfortable and homey, and artsy, and modern, yet, also vintage.
I LOVED THE RECORD PLAYER!
Jen is a fabulous host. Thoughtful and communicative, and prompt.
Thank you so much for everything.
AND the maple gift!

Très belle maison de style victorienne dans un quartier très bien situé de la ville (environ 15 min à pieds du début du centre-ville), seul bémol, le quartier est occupé par quelques sans abris.
L'appartement est vraiment tout équipé et parfait pour une semaine de vacances (BBQ, terrasse équipée, beaucoup d'équipements de cuisine, Wifi, TV, Apple TV, etc.). De plus, on a accès au jardin avec la piscine hors sol mais toute vitrée et les équipements extérieurs ce qui est très appréciable.
Michael et Jen sont tres accueillants et sympathiques et dans l'ensemble répondent assez vites au téléphone lorsqu'on les texte. On a même eu le droit à des petites attentions comme des masques (COVID), des serviettes pour la piscine et même des recommandations de où faire notre épicerie le plus proche et leurs choix de bons restaurants à essayer.

My dog and I had a wonderful 2 weeks at Jenn and Michaels place . The space was spotless, stylish and cozy . We were a very short walk from the heart of cabbage town . Jenn was so accommodating and welcoming . I highly recommend staying here .

Overall really nice stay. Was in Toronto for 10 days and needed to find a place with parking. I would recommend this place if you're planning a longer-term of stay and looking for a cozy room with family touch on it. Be mindful it is not like a 5-star hotel when you're paying $100 a night.
Pros:
- Jen is an awesome host and really responsive on messages
- You'll have your own floor in a house with separate entrance. A lot of spaces for two people (we had to work from home during the days during our stay)
- Free parking in the back of the house, which is not common for airbnb in downtown area
- Lovely little balcony/patio to yourself with two lawn chairs and one swing chair. Perfect spot to chill (read during the day / drink at night)
Cons:
- wifi can be spotty in the unit due to the long layout of the floor. No wifi in bedroom can be a bit painful
- I used to like cabbage town when I lived in Toronto. But somehow this time when I was staying there I don't feel completely safe given they just set up a COVID shelter in the corner (most of homeless ppl are not harmful at all and indeed very nice, but when you walk down the street in the neighborhood there are just too many of them and you get concerned)

Staying at Michael and Jen’s place was the perfect place to tuck in during my very at home stay for a two week quarantine. I am so grateful for the care they took to ensure I was comfortable, felt safe with covid precautions, and made sure I wasn’t missing anything since I couldn’t be out and about in Toronto. From the bath and body amenities to kitchen extras I felt completely set for my stay. Jen was extremely responsive and was even kind enough to bring my deliveries to my door. She went above and beyond in many ways.
The apartment was cozy, very clean, a great bathroom, and having access to laundry right in the unit was great. My dog Tilda was with me as well and they were so accommodating to her too, even set out dog bowls and gave us a sweet little gift for her!
Thank you Jen & Michael for everything.

A very cute, stylish and cosy apartment! We quarantined here and it was absolutely perfect. There was a big balcony (which would be fantastic in the summer), wood burning fireplace, and lovely artwork and decorations everywhere. Jennifer was the most sweet and accommodating host, who brought us rose and a bath bomb as a gift on our last night.

The best Airbnb we’ve stayed at! I highly recommend going with this stay if you are stuck between options. This is a WONDERFUL place to stay long or short term! I can’t recommend it enough! It was spacious, clean, and beautifully decorated. The patio is the perfect private outdoor retreat. Jen and Michael are incredibly kind and accommodating. They made us feel completely welcome and comfortable and even set up the pool for us to use. Shout out to Lou and Betsy, the sweetest dogs that we were lucky to meet! We’ll definitely look out for this place when we are in the city next!

Nous sommes retournés chez Michael & Jennifer encore une fois cette année car ce sont d'excellents hôtes, très serviables, amicaux et ils répondent très rapidement si vous avez un problème.
L'appartement est très propre, fonctionnel avec Wifi, Apple TV, Netflix, le satellite, ustensiles de cuisine + BBQ (sur la terrasse privée de l'appartement), serviettes de bain + de plage (pour profiter de la piscine dans le jardin au rez-de-chaussée), articles de salle-de-bain, etc.
Il est également très bien placé dans la ville avec le centre-ville à distance de marche, plusieurs restaurants et commerces proches + un gros Loblaws ! Il y a également un espace de stationnement disponible en arrière.
Nous recommandons vivement leur logement.

Michael and Jennifer's place is perfect for a short or long stay. It's spacious and well-equipped with everything you could need (including 2 air conditioners!). Jen was super responsive and accommodating when we had requests. The backyard space is truly an oasis! If friends or family ever need a place to stay in the area, we'll definitely be recommending Michael and Jen's place!
Michael ans Jennifer we’re amazing hosts! Very accessible and responsive 😀 …Perfect host!!
This unit was very comfortable and perfect for us. Cute patio, good kitchen, ample table/work space, clean and uncluttered. Hosts were very responsive to requests. We'll stay again!

Jen’s place was as advertised- an interesting and eclectic space in a vibrant and diverse neighborhood.  Be prepared for some street action but it is a safe and family friendly neighborhood. Our 3rd floor apartment had a comfortable bed, well equipped kitchen and was spacious and relaxing.
Wonderful, clean space with lots of great restaurants and pubs in easy walking distance.  Michael and Jen are extremely friendly and communicative.

Michael & Jennifer were awesome hosts. The 2nd to last day of our stay we hit a big snag in the morning and they were able to bail us out in no-time.
The space is great. The decor is a lot of fun, and the kitchen is actually really great to work in (unlike a lot of places we've stayed at in the past). The neighborhood is great to walk to/from all around town in.

My husband and I really enjoyed staying at Jen & Michael's beautiful home. The apartment was super comfortable and spacious and had everything we needed. It was also nice and quiet and conveniently located. We will be happy to stay again and would highly recommend this place to others!
This place was incredibly charming. It was designed with the guest in mind, and the security and check in is well designed.

I had a great stay at Michael and Jennifer's place. The apartment is beautifully decorated and it was very clean when I arrived. The hosts were quick to respond to my messages. The apartment is walking distance from Dundas Square, St Lawrence market and other landmarks. Very quiet location despite being in the middle of downtown. I highly recommend staying here. Thanks Michael and Jennifer!
Good listing all around, good location near streetcar stops and major streets, and cheaper compared to other local listings of similar size and amenities.

For my first time visit to Canada the hosts were very helpful with info needed before getting there and responded to my questions accurately and swiftly. The airbnb itself had all that you needed plus more and the location is great. It did have some sketchy looking people on the main road, but they were doing there own thing. I would definitely stay here again. extremely great hosts!
The apartment was exactly as pictured and was very clean.

My stay at Michael and Jennifer's place was amazing! I rented for a month and couldn't have asked for a better stay :) They were great hosts, very friendly and always available if I ever needed any help. The apartment was clean and had everything you could ever need. I felt very comfortable there. The location was awesome, super close Dundas Square. Would definitely recommend!

Their place was very nice, just like the pictures. We didn't get to try out the pool since it was winter, but will book this place again in a warmer time! Michael and Jennifer were quick to respond and very helpful when we needed anything like figuring out the TV. We would definitely stay again =)
Michael and Jennifer are wonderfully responsive and excellent hosts. Many thanks!
Good location and nice set up inside

Jennifer's place was so well equipped from kitchen supplies, linens, towels, toileteries etc. I had a very comfortable stay. The apartment is nicely decorated and in a very charming house. Quirky, convenient and comfortable :)

5 mins from dundas/young square ,great location, fantastic large apartment with large balcony area - full kitchen, quiet bedroom, full tv services & good wi-fi ,lovely garden area ,clean ,stylish apartment- highly recommended & I will definitely be going back 🤘💚🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿

Very good stay overall. Same for the host: very responsive and helpful. Can definitely recommend it. The unit had literally everything needed and more. Good positioning too: walking distance to a lot of shops, very close to transportation network.

Perfect! Roomy, homely atmosphere, amazing location close to downtown, nice pool backyard, lots of appliances made it feel like a real home. It was really a home away from home.
Also really polite and nice hosts, were always available when we had a question.

Michael and Jennifer were the absolute DREAM Airbnb hosts. They go above and beyond to make sure you feel right at home. Such clear communication and always a friendly welcoming demeanor. They are often at home downstairs or hanging in the backyard and can assist with anything you need. They are always up for good conversation, but also leave you be to do whatever you please. The actual Airbnb itself was so homey and well-decorated. It had almost any cooking appliance you’d need, many dishes and silverware, and plenty of cleaning products and towels. Bathroom was very clean and renovated. The ONLY warning i would put out there is that towards the end of the street near Dundas, there is a homeless shelter and many of the residents hang around that area outside. I never felt in danger, but I would suggest having your wits about you when passing through that area. Otherwise, it was a dream apartment and I stayed there for six months— didn’t want to leave!
I definitely enjoyed my time at the place. The apartment was even bigger than I imagined. Also enjoyed having a private balcony to sit outside during the day.

We had a wonderful stay at Jen & Michael’s place. It was our first long-term AirBnb and it did not disappoint - there was plenty to do within walking distance, easy access to public transit, and Jen was super responsive. Thanks for a great stay!
Truly a beautiful haven as I was between places in Toronto. Jen and Michael were very hospitable, kind, and responsive!

I already miss this apartment and I only left 3 days ago! The apartment was impeccably decorated and stocked with everything you will ever need. The hosts were extremely accommodating and always there to answer any questions. It's also in perfect proximity to Toronto's hip downtown attractions. I hope to book this same apartment for my next visit to Toronto!

Shaka is organized, a good communicator and the apartment was exactly as advertised.  It is a very good location for anyone who wants to be near the financial and entertainment districts.  I would rent this unit again, and probably will.

Fabulous apartment ideally located in Toronto's downtown core and within walking distance of all the main attractions. The apartment is well equipped and very comfortable - and importantly - given the very central location - quiet. Check in/ out was hassle free and communications with the host were excellent.
Great condo...cosy with a good sized balcony. Pool was amazing and the gym handy as well.

The flat is really nice but only for 2 ppl as it is smaller than it looks in the pictures. .it's more like a studio,  the bedroom can be only  closed by a sliding door which leaves no privacy if there is  ppl. I do recommend this place   as at the end of the day u ll get a decent  communication even and it's really close to everything.

Honestly, an Amazing place to stay. right in the heart of the city, super clean, super modern, and ultra convenient!

Beautiful apartment right in the middle of all the action. Highly recommended.
Great location, well-equipped condo, proactive and responsive host - a fantastic place to stay in Toronto!

This was another great stay! The location is perfect, the condo well-equipped and clean, with very helpful and communicative hosts to make sure everything goes smoothly. An easy and enjoyable stay that's perfect for Toronto!
Great host !!!!
I had a great stay; communication was great and the place was fantastic.
Amazing condo in the heart of downtown. I loved the area and it was close to everything. I stayed here for 6 weeks and I didn't want to leave.  I would definitely stay here again!

It was just amazing and wonderful.

This place is great
Great location. Nice gym in the building. The flat is well presented and very functional. Very good communication with the host. Check in/out very easy and convenient.

I honestly could not have asked for a better place for my stay. Location is excellent, close to everything in downtown and steps to main subway line and rail car/busses for further travels. Bed is comfortable and supportive, and the in-suite washer/dryer extremely convenient. It has a well stocked kitchen and reliable WiFi.

The location of the condo is good (by Royal Alex Theater) however the condo is facing Adelaide and it is on lower floor (below 10) and therefore noise is unbearable on Thursday, Friday, Saturday - 1:00 am to 3:00 am.
