I had several issues with host communication. They were not responsive to my emails and call and it took several follow up to make an arrangement to pick the keys.
I had an issue with bites on my arm and neck. I had reached out to the host and they sent someone to visual inspect and spry. It was a bit better after that but left a bad taste for me. I asked if I could leave early as I was not happy and they would not make any compromises. They would not partially refund money if I left a week earlier due to these experiences, I had sent pictures of my marks to them. Airbnb on the other hand was very helpful and they were in constant communication with me and they refunded 50% of my money for the week that I left early. I would not recommend this condo due to the host and the bite situation and the noise but I am appreciative of how professional Airbnb support was.

I loved my stay at this apartment in Toronto! The location was central and the hosts were extremely responsive. Quick responses and the place was as advertised. Nicely located, everything was clean and worked as it should. Would stay again.

Shaka is a very good host. I enjoyed my stay very much and when I left I felt like leaving a bit of my home in Toronto.
Perfect Location, Amazing Amenities, Beautiful View, Friendly Building and Awesome pool.

I definitely recommend this place and I would like to stay again when I return to Toronto.

Nous avons passé un mois et demi dans l’appartement de LENNIE. Nous n’avons rien à redire. Lovely place with very nice decoration!
Great apartment in an amazing location!
Very convenient location and clean apartment
An excellent host. Great apartment in a brilliant location. Shannon / Lennie were extremely helpful and easy to get in contact with. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely go back.

The building itself was/is under construction so there was more noise & dust but didn’t really affect us once we were inside the apartment. The space was great, had everything you could need, was clean and tidy! Lennie was a super helpful host when we had some issues with the thermostat & got it all sorted right away! Overall, I’d definitely recommend Lennie’s place to anyone looking at staying right in the heart of Toronto!

Katherine's room was FANTASTIC!!!. It was clean, neat, modern and she provided everything I could possibly need or want from food to snacks to Netflix, even tooth brushes! I can't say enough about what a bargain this room was, especially for what I got.

The neighborhood is quaint and quiet and an easy walk to everything you could require.

Thank you for a great experience Katherine!!!

This studio is a true home away from home... Very clean, very comfortable, hosts are amazingly kind and generous, always ready to help with anything to make your stay even better. Fridge and kitchen were stocked with tasty and thoughtful snacks and beverages, and complimentary toiletries could be found in the bathroom. The location is ideal for those wanting to be close enough to downtown but who also want a quiet and peaceful stay away from the constant city buzz. Easy access to downtown Toronto. Highly recommended. Thanks to Katherine and Jurek for making our stay in Toronto a pleasant and memorable one.

Le logement est propre et calme. Bien desservie par les transports en communs et les magasins de proximités.
Katherine est a l'écoute de ses hôtes.
Merci pour ce séjour.

Couldn't have had a better experience with this place and host: Katherine was very responsive to all my questions during the time leading up to my stay, as well as during the stay. The place itself was so comfortable, clean and amazingly well-stocked for a "home away from home" experience -- from the snacks and refreshments in the fridge and pantry, to the maps of the neighbourhood provided, to the toiletries and essentials. It really has everything you need and it's very easy to get your bearings in the neighbourhood. The hosts are very pleasant, respectful, professional and prompt in responding to any needs. What an airbnb experience should be.

The private suite was exactly as described. The suite was very clean and Katherine even left snacks for us to eat. I would definitely stay here again if I'm ever in the area. Thanks for making our stay wonderful!
Great place at a great value
This mini apartment is set up so efficiently it really is a marvel.  It is a bit of a squish for 2 but perfect for one.  Katherine is excellent at communicating and being available to help of needed.

Good comfortable private space

We stayed here to celebrate Canada 150. It was perfect place to stay for two.  The place is less than half an hour to downtown Toronto (10 min no traffic).  Clean, safe and well maintained.  Fantastic hosts.

Katherine place is exactly as advertised. Although it might be small it had every amenity required to make our stay great. She was easy to communicate with and quick to respond. Perfect place to stay off the beaten path

I wish I had a week to hang out in Katherine's place. I was only around overnight. I like the design discipline and efficiency of small spaces, and this one certainly delivers. I readily recommend it for a stay.
Hands down best Airbnb I've ever stayed at. If I find myself back in Toronto, I will absolutely stay here again.

Place was great.  It is small like the description says but 2 adults were comfortable staying there.  We took the TTC which the bus stop is not far and the bus ride was around 15 minutes to Royal York station.  The communication was great and we were given very detailed instructions.  Everything went smoothly when checking in and out.  There is a small school parking lot across the street where we parked no problem for our stay.  The layout of the place is very smart and has great amenities.  It had everything we needed.  It was a nice touch with little snacks, coffee, tea, juice and stationary.  For an overnight stay in Toronto it was a great place to call home.

Katherine's place is an excellent stay if you are traveling around Toronto. The place was very clean, comfortable, and in a great location that is close to TTC and a GO station. Katherine is great at communicating and answered any questions that I would ask in a timely manner. I would recommend this space and her as a host to any friends and families that would be visiting Toronto!

Small but cozy. A great nest for two lovebirds. Everything that you could think of was provided. Katherine responded very quickly to any of our extra needs. The area was quiet, safe, and not far from downtown Toronto. 10/10 would do again !!

Katherine´s place was awesome. Very convenientely located and with all the "little things" you might need in your stay.
I was very happy to see that even though the room is small, it had it´s space very well distributed and it had all the things that I could´ve needed. In other words, If the place were mine, it would probably be as good as it gets, there's nothing I would add.
If there´s one thing that might be slightly negative, even though I never had a problem with it and didnt felt that it affected me much, is that if you are up after 10pm noise could be a problem since every room is very close to each other and it is hard to evaluate when could you be making too much noise, or when are you on the safe zone. Once I wanted to take a shower close to midnight but decided to do it until morning since I wasn't sure if the noise would upset someone else. But well, I made that decision on my own.
Great efficient apartment perfect for a short stay. Clean and quiet; just a short walk to restaurants on Lakeshore Blvd and the lakefront trail.

Great little place to unwind from visiting the city! The hosts were great with communication and asking how things were. Comfortable bed with lots of pillows, nice neighborhood, extremely considerate hosts, helpful guides on the desk, what more could one ask for :)
All of the reviews are absolutely true! We stayed there for four nights, and it was super comfortable and an easy, experience.

We highly recommend this place to stay. Perfect to drive to the city center with the ttc or by car. It was close to everything and many good restaurants in the area. (Sumo sushi, il paesano pizza) the host is also great for everything that was added to the flat. She's also fast to answer.

Excellent stay with Katherine. The place was exactly as depicted. All the instructions about check-in/check-out, parking, and directions were crystal clear. Communication was quick and easy. There were snacks and condiments as well as breakfast oatmeal stocked. A binder with everything you'd need (including take out menus!) was available in the airbnb. Really enjoyed my stay!

We had a great stay! It was really easy to walk to the grocery store and the GO train station. The train took about 20 min to get to downtown Toronto's Union Station.
Katherine's place had lots of little extras that made us feel very at home.
Great place! Highly recommend it!
Very convenient apartment.  Instructions from Katheryn are clear.  Easy to get access to the apartment even with a late arrival.  Ideal for 1 person or a couple for,a short stay.

I enjoyed very much the stay. The communication before arrival was excellent, the check in process was smooth. The location  is good also, less then 30 minutes from downtown by train. All the amenities mentioned in the ad are there, the place is very clean and well set up. The reason I gave four instead of five stars is that I found the bed uncomfortable. Otherwise, everything was perfect. Thank you very much Katherine for letting us stay at your place.

Katherine had taken care of even tiniest of details! When we reached the place, there was a power failurein the neighborhood. Again Katherine had stocked the apartment thoughtfully taking into account simple comforts like a pantry stocked with essentials like packets, peanut butter and health bars. Katherine was easily accessible via text messages which made it easier to communicate with her.

My husband and I liked everything about Katherine's place:  her communication was excellent, the rooms were spotlessly clean and contained everything we needed for a 4-night stay.  It is a small place but has all the essentials for cooking, sleeping & relaxing.  The B&B is only 15 minutes from Union Station in downtown Toronto by GO Train.   We would certainly stay here again.
Appartement vraiment fonctionnel proche des transports. Hôte disponible et pense à tout.

I loved staying at Katherine's cozy and very well planned space. Everything I needed was available including coffee, tea, sugar, jam, butter, soft fresh towels, soap, shampoo, and even an iron. The space was VERY clean and quiet. Will definitely stay here on my next visit to Toronto.
Very good place for a short trip, 5-10 minutes to the station by walk and 11$ for a day pass, going to downtown in 15 minutes.

A lovely compact apartment space well equipped for all needs. Beautifully decorated and very very clean. A very comfortable and cozy space that would be great for anyone looking for a nice quiet stay. Easy access to local shops, and food. Public transit is close by as well and it's only thirty or so minutes away by car from any downtown.
Ktherine的房间干净、舒适。靠近超市，开车去市区很方便，我们度过了温馨的三晚。
Great little place for a short term stay.
Awesome space, exactly as described a small apartment but close to a 7/11 and No Frills. Parking close by and Roku so we can watch TV.
Room was clean. Location of the house is very good. Would absolutely recommend for a trip to Toronto. Host replied quickly to questions and made my the whole stay seamless
Accurate description and great location! It is easily accessible by the TTC and their are many places to dine around the area.

Great place for a single person or a couple. Super clean. TTC very close by takes 45 mins to downtown via TTC and 25 via Go (which again is only 10 mins walk away). Katherine was very responsive wrt messages, we only met her husband once but she was available over phone/message throughout.
Nice place.  Very convenient for getting downtown
Very nice place close to the go
The place is very nice, and location is convenient as it is close to both public transport and a highway. Definitely recommending this place!

This apartment is great if you just need a place to crash while you are exploring the city. It is very easy to get to and from the city with the Go Train. The bed was a bit uncomfortable and the pillows were really thin, so we didn’t get a super good night’s sleep, but it was only 2 nights and we were so tired that it barely mattered. My biggest problem with this place was that we weren’t given an AC unit like the listing says, and it was 28 degrees (83F)  during our stay. This caused us to have to keep the window open, which is awkward at night because you can see right in from the street, and leaving the window open into the morning allowed for all the loud noise from the school across the street to come in. Katherine was out of town, so we were unable to ask for it. One other thing I want to add is that while this space does not have any shared area, it does not really feel like an “entire place.” You are basically in a bedroom that is converted to an apartment, so the door has a simple handle lock, and less that a foot from your door are 2 other doors to more “bedroom apartments.” The space didn’t feel very private or secure to me. Overall, the stay was okay...we weren’t there a whole lot, and Katherine left a really lovely and informative guide book with restaurants in the area. It was all we needed, but definitely lacked in comfort for the value.
Great place and location to stay for couple!! Very well designed room. You will find all the amenities mentioned.. Thank you Katherine..

Katherine's place was great. It is cosy, but I believe it is the perfect size for a couple and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. It was also super clean. I didn't get to meet Katherine, but she was very responsive to all enquiries and very helpful and accomodating. I would definitely stay again.
Great stay, the unit is small but fonctionnal perfect for our 3 night stay. The location is perfect, 10 min walk to the train and 2 station from Downtown Toronto
THIS PLACE WAS AMAZING AND MORE. GREAT LOCATION. FREE PARKING. CLEAN. IT HAS EVERYTHING YOU NEED. UTNOST PRIVACY AS WELL. VERY CLEAN.

Nice little bachelor not too far from the water. Worked very well for me. Would stay again.
I would definitely return to Canada & have no problem staying at Katherine's place again. Great neighborhood and distance from the downtown scene. My daughter and I felt very safe and welcome.
Great place! Super easy to go downtown from the appartment and the host is super friendly and helpful. Will book again if I go back to Toronto!

Katherine place is tiny but cosy. It has everything you need for a couple or solo going. We loved having everything we need for making our little meals. AC is an added value cause' it is really hot on summer night in Toronto.

Katherine’s place is clean and comfortable, with a great kitchen for the size of the space. A lot of thought went into what you may need if you are cooking rather than dining out every meal.
The space is small, but again clean and comfortable, and worth every penny for location to GO train. The city and surrounding areas are very accessible from this location.

A great and quiet place to stay. Just a short public transportation trip away from all the hot spots. Parked a short walk away in a lot for only $4 if you’re worried about getting towed. The apartment was hip and clean, bed was comfortable. Had a great time.
とても素敵な部屋で、リラックスして過ごせました。鍵の開け方や駐車場の場所なども事前に丁寧に教えてくださったので、安心感がありました。wifiのスピードがとても早くて助かりました。周辺の治安も良く、夜も外を歩けます。

Studio très confortable et bien équipé, il y a tout ce qu’il faut. Très bon rapport qualité/prix.

Just as advertised. Very clean. Would stay here again.

Espaço novo e bem funcional, exatamente o que mostra a foto, limpo, banheiro novo, rua super tranquila, próximo a mercados, ponto de ônibus em frente a casa e estação de trem 10 min caminhando (no frio talvez seja complicado), contato sempre rápido e cordial. Recomendo.

Great place near Mimico train stop. Would definitely go there again!

전체적으로 매우 편안하고 즐겁게 지낼 수 있었던 아주 좋은 숙소였어요. 덕분에 한달여행이 즐겁고 행복 했어요. 테라스 방충망이 고장나있어서 좀 아쉬웠으나 감당할 만 했고, 때로는 옆집들이 시끄럽고 옆집에서 깨진 유리조각이나 라이터같은
것들이 우리집 테라스로 오긴 했으나 괜찮았어요. 빌딩뷰이나 멀리보이는 온타리오호가 아름답고 일몰, 야경을 보는 것이 즐거웠습니다. 호스트는 처음 집 이용방법이나 중간중간 문의사항에 빠르게 답해주었어요. 이 집에서는 어디든 걸어갈 수 있어요. 날씨도 너무 좋아서 걷는것을 즐겼습니다.
7세 아들과 나의 토론토 한달살이가 덕분에 너무 행복했어요! 추천합니다.

Sam foi um ótimo host, respondia super rápido e deu boas dicas locais. O apartamento é muito bem equipado, extremamente bem localizado, ficamos durante um mês e ficaríamos mais. Cama confortável, temperatura ambiente também. Recomendo.

This was a nice stay. There were a few things that had to be fixed like the dishwasher and the bath tub stopper.
But everything was eventually fixed. The apt didn’t exactly match the photos but was still a decent stay. Great area!

I had a hard time with the mattress. But can be just my personal feeling, I didn't fit very well on the bed. Nevertheless, it was a great place, nothing to complain about it. Well located, you can find everything that you want near around. Sam is an easygoing person. Helped me in check-in and check-out. Easy to communicate with, seems to be a good person. I definitely will recommend this place, and, if I have other chances to come back to Toronto, I'll pick this place again. Is not the cheapest, but is competitive with the area, and is worth it.

The host had the unit tidied up well and stocked it up with toiletries, paper towels/toilet paper, clothing and dish detergent, clean towels and bedsheets, making it quite hassle free. The appliances worked well. Amazing view, unit, and unbeatable location - walking distance to prime landmarks and a Loblaws grocery store right downstairs in the adjacent building.
My only suggestion would be to be more proactive with communication - had an issue at check-in but resolved pretty swiftly after I called the host. The first week also had water supply issues on 2 different days due to maintenance (probably a rare chance) - an advance heads up would've helped me plan these days better as opposed to getting caught off-guard and reaching out to them (building sends out notices to owners in advance). The host did apologise and offer a credit for using external shower facilities which I politely refused. Overall this was a comfortable stay for a month-long reservation, and I'd recommend it.
Estancia muy agradable en una ubicación perfecta. Sam ha sido fácil de contactar y muy resolutivo. Muy recomendable.

Stayed two months with my husband.
We enjoyed our time living in core downtown, the location was absolutely great and the unit was tidy. However, the unit needs more attention when it comes to amenities. We had several problems with shower and dishwasher which resolved during our stay with considerable delay. Additionally the unit AC’s maintenance were missed for a couple of months causing air quality issues. Overall, I recommend you checking mentioned points if you stay long term at this unit.

Amazing location easy access to most attractions, cafes and restaurants. Condo is basic sometimes lobby smells of food delivery. Apartment itself is nice and clean, good for 2 people. The balcony is the star feature, it’s huge with an amazing view of downtown and partially the  lake. Furniture can use a bit of update. Sam is a good host and very responsive. Will stay in again the next time I visit Toronto.

The apartment was great, especially the balcony, which I really enjoyed. The location made it easy to get everywhere, and that was a big plus. Sam was always friendly and helpful, which made the stay even better. I'd be happy to come back and can definitely recommend staying here.
L'appartement est vraiment top, il est parfaitement situé si vous souhaitez découvrir Toronto. Sam a été très amical et réactif. Je recommande !

The place was absolutely wonderful—very clean, well maintained, and located right in the city center. The landlord is incredibly kind and responsible, always helpful and attentive. Thanks to him, I had a truly enjoyable and memorable Christmas stay. Highly recommended!
Great location and Sam was very responsive.

Beautiful apartment in the middle of downtown Toronto - surrounded by the big hotels and conference centers and only a few blocks from the water.
Charmaine was an excellent host and literally thought of everything we could possibly need, including toiletries, laundry, printers, ground coffee beans, and restaurant recommendations. Great experience.

Charmaine's place turned out to be a LOT bigger than it appears in pictures. Really well decorated and comfortable inside, and Netflix was a definite plus. Nice bed, kitchen was easy to use, I really have no complaints about the interior.

The location was also perfect, in my favourite area of Toronto with a 10 second walk to 1st Canada Place, and within walking distance to groceries, MANY restaurants, and nightlife.

There was a little construction outside the unit, but it was a minor obstruction and couldn't be heard from inside.

I would highly, highly recommend this unit.

Charmaine was fantastic. She thought of everything and was accommodating with my check in/check out schedule. She had labels on everything (tv, internet, washer dryer, etc), which made the place really friendly and accessible.

Location was great for me, very close to work, and close to large shopping areas. Great place overall.

Charmaine made my first stay on Airbnb and in Canada a great first impression! The condo was all what it was stated to be and she was helpful, flexible and accommodating. The location is a great central location to interest in area and I choose to walk it all, though all types transportation are close by.

Charmaine was great! She contacted me before the stay to make sure that I know the transportation to her place. She re-adjusted her schedule due to a change in our travel plans. The place was great - It's clean, a great location, and much bigger than how it looks on the profile. If you are looking for a place right downtown Toronto, check this place out!

Very spaceous apartment with everything you could need. We were very happy with the apartment, its very central location as well as communication and written instructions on how to use everything. Also liked having netflix. Would recommend this place!

My wife and I had a great stay at Charmaine's apartment. The place was clean, updated, quite spacious, and priced well compare to hotels in the area. The location was good as well, close to subway stations, eaton shopping center, and many eateries and nightlife. I appreciated that Charmaine had filtered water from the fridge.  Would definitely recommend staying here.

A delightful experience in a delightful apartment.  The apartment was everything Charmaine says it is and more.  Clean, spacious and beautiful.  Everything we needed was within walking distance (I was attending the APA convention at the Metro Convention Center), or easily accessible by near-by public transportation (my wife was able to explore Toronto more thoroughly). This was our first AirBNB experience and it couldn't have been better.  Charmaine was away, but Alan was an able and personable substitute.  The street was quiet at night and we slept like babes. WiFi much appreciated! Apartment is fully equipped for, well, anything!  If I were to move to Toronto, I'd want to live in this apartment (and have Charmaine decorate, as her taste is better than mine).
Chairmaine made us feel very welcome.she had everything well labelled as well as detailed instructions for using the electronics and appliances

Charmaine wasn't in Toronto when i arrived but her friend Alan was there and waiting for me. I discover a beautiful appartement in center of Toronto, if you have to discover this city or business time it's the place.
the appartement was clean, and all that you think to need is there.
I had a really great time and next time i will go back there.
I spoke with Charmaine by phone. She's lovely and she's into do anything for your trip.

listing was exactly as described, the place has everything you can possibly need, it even had a steamer for clothes! it was extremely well organized with notes on how to use everything. the location was perfect too it was in the heart of downtown.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here.  The apartment is exactly as shown in the photos.  Charmaine was gone, but we were met by Alan.  He gave a tour of the place and was available by phone for follow-up.  The location was ideal - close to the train station, walkable to many activities, and felt safe.  A great place to stay in Toronto!

Charmaine's loft was perfect for my stay in Toronto and was a needed respite from long work days. It had everything I needed to feel at home. She was responsive, polite, check-in was a breeze. Would love to stay there again on my next visit!

The host was traveling so was met by Alan. Met me at front door of building, let me in and gave me a very detailed tour of condo. Very comfortable bed. Waters were in refrigerator (nice touch) and great layout. Amazing location especially for a business traveler.

Best endorsement, I will book again!!

J'ai fait un beau séjour dans l'appartement de Charmaine. C'est Alan qui était là pour m'accueillir. Il m'a bien expliqué le fonctionnement et les particularités. La communication avec lui par SMS est très efficace.
L'appartement est bien située soit près de Hudson Bay. La rue devant est cependant moins passante que Bay, Young et Queen Street donc moins de bruit. L'aménagement est très bien. Bien que l'appartement soit au sous-sol, c'est lumineux grace aux 4 grandes fenêtres givrées (pour l'intimité). La cuisine est très bien équipée. Le lit en alcove est cependant moins pratique. Il faut y monter par le pied et se glisser jusqu'en la tête. Il y avait quelques petites mouches à fruits; héritage du prédécesseur probablement.
J'y retournerais bien volontié.
Jean-François

Charmaine was a great host and the space was ideal. The apartment is in an ideal location and in a quiet heritage building. Everything needed for a fantastic stay was available and clearly identified in the apartment. Charmaine was not able to meet me but she made alternate arrangements so that I would be warmly welcomed. All in all a great experience that reminded me just how fantastic Airbnb'ing can be.

Unfortunately, Charmaine was out of town, so her friend Alan handled passing off keys and explaining the general house expectations. He was both friendly and welcoming. Tip: for travelers coming from abroad with no phone service (as I was), be sure to at least use the UP Express free wifi to email Alan/Charmaine that you're well on your way. The walk up from Union Station is easy and shouldn't take more than 10-13 minutes.

The space lives up to the photographs, and Charmaine has done a wonderful job of labeling everything. There is space to put your things, and a very useful kitchen. The location of the apartment itself is ideal. As I said, a ten minute walk from Union Station and just steps from many notable downtown landmarks. There is also a grocer nearby as well as great shops for shopping and restaurants for dining. University of Toronto was about a 20 minute walk up University Ave.

This is a beautiful apartment in the heart of downtown Toronto. I was in town for a conference at Sheraton Centre. I simply crossed the street and was at the venue. It's hard to imagine my peers were paying $180 for a very basic Sheraton hotel room. This gorgeous apartment was available for far less and includes laundry, a full kitchen, a large shower and a fantastic entertainment unit. However, I would have been very, very pleased with this location had my conference been farther away. This location is close to easily accessible public transit, shopping, tourist sites, etc. I will definitely stay here the next time I'm in Toronto.

I really enjoyed the spaciousness and warmth of this condo.  Though it's on the basement level (of a beautiful heritage building), the large windows let in a lot of natural light and the ceilings are nice and high.  Location was great; access to the PATH underground is just a 15-second walk outside; super-close to transit and shopping.  The mornings can be a bit loud with rush hour traffic so, if you're a light sleeper and want to sleep in, a pair of earplugs might help you.  I'd definitely stay here again!

Excellent sejour chez Charmaine. Charmaine nous a reçu à notre arrivée, elle est vraiment charmante. L'appartement est vraiment bien, exactement comme les photos et la description, très bien situé, près des Metro et du PATH. Il est très propre, confortable, bien équipé et décoré, sans compter plusieurs petites attentions laissées par Charmaines. Nous y retournerons avec grand plaisirs.

Charmaine is a friendly and welcoming host!  I loved getting to know her a little bit as she shared information about her neighbourhood and her amazing place.  I attended a conference at the Sheraton Centre across the street- this was the PERFECT location; spacious and cozy, I had a home away from home.  I enjoyed the surrounding area and took advantage of the restaraunts and nightlife so nearby.  In the afternoon, I had a great time sightseeing downtown and took the streetcar to another exciting area and back.  I can't say enough about my terrific stay.  Thank you, Charmaine!
The listing was accurate. Great location for business trips as the apartment is in the heart of the financial district but also quiet. Charmaine was easy to get ahold of for arrival and departure.

Charmaine is an amazing host with the perfect downtown location. She is very welcoming and helpful in every way possible. This location is exactly as described and is literally 5 min walk to everything downtown. I can't wait to come back here again.  My daughter even left some items behind and Charmine is so nice she is mailing them back to us, this shows how awesome she is as a host and as a person. If you are going to Toronto and have the pleasure to stay here you will not be disappointed.
The apartment is well situated right downtown and Charmaine was very well organized and pleasant. A good stay.

We had an excellent stay here! The apartment is in a very convenient location - right downtown but on a side street so it's not noisy. It had everything we needed and was very comfortable. Charmaine was very responsive and helpful.

Had a great experience staying at Charmaine's apartment for a work conference. The apartment was even larger than I expected and Charmaine was very accommodating. The location is in a great part of downtown Toronto and I had no problem finding anything in the apartment.

This perfectly-situated condo was such a delightful oasis to which to return after either long conference sessions at the Sheraton Centre just across the street or long evenings spent walking around Toronto's many interesting downtown-adjacent neighborhoods. Charmaine is a very thoughtful and conscientious host, and her unit has all the amenities a business traveler could ask for. I definitely look forward to returning.

I loved my stay at Charmaine's place.  It is located in the centre of Downtown Toronto, close to many shops and restaurants.  The apartment is a step up from staying in a hotel - it is clean, quiet and roomy.   I got to meet Charmaine and experienced her as a very gracious host.  I will definitely stay here again.

Had a wonderful stay. Great location, very convenient for conference across the street at the Sheraton centre. Place is exactly as listed and shown. Very quiet building, and unit is spacious & light. It had everything I needed. Charmaine was very responsive to questions and welcoming.

Accurate listing , pictures do not do justice. Location in the heart of the financial district. Everything in unit labeled and simple to use. Everything worked and was spotless. Lot's of space in unit and very easy to get in and out of. Lot's of options very nearby and in between King and Queen.

Logement très très bien situé. Très fidèle aux photos. Beaucoup de flexibilité sur les heures d'arrivée et de départ. Réponses très rapides. Appartement très bien équipé avec tout le nécessaire. Je recommande ce logement. De plus nous avons reçu de très bons conseils pour la visite de Toronto ! Merci !!!

We had a wonderful experience staying at Charmaine's apartment.  It was conveniently located and Charmaine was incredibly communicative before check-in and throughout our stay.  The apartment itself was great: clean, comfortable, modern and very well-stocked with essentials.  Overall, I would definitely stay there again next time I'm in Toronto.

This was my first stay ever at an Airbnb and I have to say it was incredible. Charmaine is a wonderful host and so accommodating. Her apartment is so clean and very homely. Everything is labeled and there isn't any clutter. It is situated in the heart of downtown just a block away from city hall and minutes away from all of the tourist attractions. I highly recommend Charmaine's place for anyone visiting Toronto.

Charmaine's place was an amazing stay, and totally exceeded expectations! The location was perfection for me -- I was in town for work and staying right in the downtown/financial area was ideal. I can't imagine there are many other residential units in this location -- so it's a great find. The space itself is beautiful -- spacious, airy, and well lit (not what you'd expect for a basement unit). Charmaine was an wonderful host -- I arrived a couple hours past my expected arrival time (flight delays) and wasn't able to update her. However I had no problem getting in contact with her once I landed and she was there waiting to let me in and give me the tour when I arrived.

Lovely woman, incredible space, perfect location.

Hostess was waiting for me outside the place. I got there almost an hour later than I expected, but she was still there to greet me.  She took me on a tour of the place and it exceeded my expectation.  The amenities were great.  The fridge - including certain things in it - were at our disposal.  Great location.  Best place ever.

Charmaine is such a great host. I arrived late in the day and she was waiting patiently. The place is located very conveniently for me (I was there for work, offices around the corner), and the place looks exactly like the pictures, very clean, very homey, great design, very spacious. The bed was very comfortable, and the apartment was quiet.
Charmaine is very friendly and I'd definitely recommend this place to any of my friends and family.
Great location in downtown Toronto. Just a few minutes walk to Union station. The apartment had everything we were looking for and Charmaine was a great host.

This was my first time using Air BNB and I am impressed! Charmaine was away, but her friend Tammy introduced me to the place. Everything was neat and clean. The bed was comfy. She also provided me with shampoo/soap as well as coffee.

The place is only a few minutes' walk from Union Station and was quite easy to find.

I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again. Thanks so much.

Charmaine arranged for someone to meet me at the apartment to give me the keys and provide an orientation. (Not coffee or other amenities)
The apartment was spacious and very well located and the bed was very comfortable. However, it is quite clear that one is staying in an apartment where 'someone is living': The fridge was filled with condiments and opened bottles of beverages. The bathroom provided me with a cleared shelf for my toilet articles. The toaster oven was filled with crumbs from a previous stay, as were the trash bins. The space is not as bright & light as it seems in the photos, and without the too few lamps, it was 'dusk-like' day and night. For security reasons none of the windows open, and the apartment is completely below ground, so for me the absence of fresh air was somewhat of an issue. Lastly, the photos showed a large TV in the bedroom, (which I liked) and which was actually not there, and in texting with Charmaine, I learned it hasn't been there for over a year but "no one has complained". In Charmaine's defense, when some of my distraction reached her on her travels, she offered to refund a portion of my money if I wanted to find another accommodation. At that point however, I was leaving in a day and a half and tied up in meeting sessione all day and evening and had no time to relocate. In summary, if you don't care about light or fresh air or need a TV (or reading light) near the bed, the location is great, the apartment is spacious and the bed is comfy!

Tammy received us at the time we agreed. She was very nice and helpful.
She explained us everything about the apartment and also gave us information about the places around the neighborhood.
The apartment has all we needed (maybe more) and in great conditions. Also it has a really good location, we found every place we wanted to visit at a walking distance.

Charmaine was off traveling herself when we arrived, but she communicated that to us well in advance and even made arrangements for her friend/colleague to let us in after our late arrival. She and I communicated a few times from the time of booking to our arrival she made getting to her and into the place very easy.

Her place is in what we considered to be the perfect location for visiting the city and just exploring. We were walking distance from many places we wanted to visit (including the St. Lawrence Market, lakeside attractions, and Chinatown and Kensington Market. There are a convenience store and a Tim Horton's on the corners of her block and a market and wine store within two block using the Path.

Her place is cozy, unique and almost exactly as it is described and pictured in her listing. It was incredibly clean and we felt completely at home the entire time we were there. The only very minor issue for my boyfriend - as a light sleeper - was the high windows up above the bed that let in some light throughout the night. I did not have an issue with it at all, but for anyone who might need complete darkness to sleep, bring a sleep mask and you'll be fine. Also, city noise. If you can't handle some city noise, maybe don't sleep downtown. :)

Excellent communication, smooth flexible check-in, place in fantastic condition, plenty of space, everything very organized.  The place has everything a traveler could want/need.  Great location.  Comfortable furniture and working appliances.

Great location! Spacious and modern apartment in the heart of downtown. Tidy upon arrival.  Instructions for appliances (TV, cable, WiFi, washer, dryer) clearly labeled. All in all, my stay here was fantastic.

Charmaine is a fantastic and charming hostess that goes out of her way to make you feel at home and welcome.  Near hotels and restaurants the condo is perfect for business people as well as visitors that wish to explore the downtown core. I highly recommend getting in touch with Charmaine for your next stay in Toronto .  Thank you so much Charmaine you are fantastic.
Se quiser conhecer Toronto, ótima localização. lugar confortável e bem arrumado.
Great location and value close to downtown business areas. Charmaine was very helpful in the run up to traveling with suggestions and during the check in process
Charmaine was an excellent host.  She communicated quickly and was very accommodating to my unique situation. I highly recommend Charmaines place. I will definitely be going back in the future :-)

The apartment was exactly as described. Very comfortable and great location. Charmaine was a great host who accommodated my late check in. She was very friendly and gave lots of good tips for navigating the area. Would stay here again!

Charmaine was a fantastic host and her place was perfect! Very central and close to transit, shopping, nightlife, etc. The place felt private and had a nice 'loft' feel to it. Highly recommended and will try and stay here next time I'm in Toronto.

A stylish apartment and a great location! Super convenient to everywhere we wanted to visit, and really well put together. Charmaine was really friendly and helpful right from our first communication via airbnb.
The place is very well located and unique. Just what we needed for our week in TO.  Charmaine was very friendly and helpful.

My wife and I stayed at the apartment in may 2017.Charmaine and tammy give us a very warm welcome giving us all the informations we needed.The apartment was very clean and very nice.It's situated in the financial district, very close to the subway and the union station.It's walking distance from everything you want to visit.It's fully equiped.We stayes very well. Alvaro and Sabry
Great location and great apartment.  We would definitely stay here again.

Such a comfy place and great location. Close to public transit and nearby convenience stores. Good communication from our host; even though she was out of town during check in, she made sure her friend was available to help. No problems with the place or getting in/out. Really loved the area and would stay again. Thanks Charmaine 😁

Lovely apartment! Very clean and had everything you would need. Great location; close (walking distance) to a range of bars and restaurants. Charmaine was a very friendly and accommodating host and suggested lots of places to go / see. Would definitely recommend!!

I had a brilliant stay at Charmaine's place. It is a huge spacious basement apartment in a commercial building and has big fixed opaque windows on to the streets above, letting in lots of light. The bed was great, I felt right at home. In a great location too. Charmaine is a really great host, she picked me up from the train station and walked me to her place, explained everything,  she was really lovely. Highly recommended.

Our stay in Charmaine's apartment was perfect ! Charmaine was very kind and helpful during our arrival and leaving. We really enjoyed discussing with her.
We found the apartment clean, spacious and quiet. It has everything and we felt very comfortable.
The location is probably the best place if you want to visit downtown Toronto. It is very close to everything: subways, shops, restaurants, town hall, train station... We recommend it for sure !
This was the perfect place for the trip we had planned. Charmaine was an exceptional host and provided everything we needed. We would definitely stay here again!

The apartment was centrally located.  Attractions and eateries were minutes away.  The apartment was beautiful and clean.   Charmaine was a great host.   We had some issues with Air conditioning.  She promptly sorted them out.  We highly recommend this BnB.
Great condo, great location, great service! We were very pleased with our stay and would definitely come back for future visits!
Amazing place in an amazing location. Wonderful host, offered lots of information of things to do in area. Was easy to get ahold of. Would recommend to anyone

Charmaine's condo is spacious and exactly as pictured. It was clean, comfortable and had everything we could have needed. The building is mostly for business use, which means that it's very quiet. I think we must have seen only two people in the four days that we were there. It is in the city so there is some noise but coming from New York it felt quite peaceful. It's a ten minute walk from the Royal York, where the free shuttle bus runs from Billy Bishop City Airport. The condo is conveniently located for many of the  tourist attractions and has good public transport links. Communication with Charmaine was easy - she always answered promptly and was available to us throughout our stay, although we didn't really need to get in touch because there were no problems.  Prior to our visit, Charmaine also promptly answered my questions and was very helpful with local recommendations for places to eat and visit. I highly recommend staying here and when we go back to Toronto we would definitely consider Charmaine's place again.
A wonderfully unique and spotlessly clean apartment. Charmaine was a fantastic host. Highly recommend!

Charmaine's place was awesome!! The location was perfect- we walked everywhere. The apartment was really clean and amazingly well-prepared (Charmaine even had labels for the remote controls). The neighbors are really quiet and it's easy to feel right at home here. Charmaine was out of town during our stay, but she was super easy to reach and communicate with the whole trip. I would 100% stay here again!

We had an amazing time staying at Charmaine's apartment! It was exactly as shown in the pictures.  Charmaine had her friend Tammy meet us to let us in and later met us to show us around the apartment. Her apartment was very clean and well organized. It was easy to find everything we needed. The location was excellent and within walking distance of Union Station, local restaurants, Eaton Center, movie theaters and Younge and Dundas Square. Charmaine was always available to answer any questions we had and made us feel right at home. Charmaine is very friendly and easy going. We would highly recommend staying here.

Charmaine's condo was incredibly clean and comfortable and had all of the comforts of home. The bed was incredibly comfortable and the neighborhood was pretty quiet, which made sleeping really pleasant. The location couldn't have been more convenient and I ended up walking almost everywhere.
Charmaine was also very helpful, friendly and accommodating. She even checked in the day after we arrived to make sure that we were settled and didn't need anything. This was one of the best Airbnb experiences that I've had. I would highly recommend!

Charmaine's place is clean and in a great location.  The check in/out process is fairly simple and easy. Charmaine and Tammy were very friendly and helpful during our stay.  Definitely would recommend and stay at their place again!

Charmaine's apartment is just as adorable as the pictures she's posted! It was a very comfortable home base for my week-long business trip to Toronto. Charmaine was a wonderful host - very flexible regarding check-in and my phone issues, and gave lots of awesome local recommendations. I'd definitely stay here again.
Charmaine was very responsible when coordinating our stay. Her apartment is much nicer than the pictures! Highly recommend!! Thanks again for a great stay.

This was an excellent location for exploring downtown Toronto. We walked to many of our "must see" attractions and hopped on public transportation easily to go further afield. We loved having a well equipped and organized place to stay in and stock with fresh food. We appreciated the comfortable bed.  A very positive first time experience with Air Bnb.

I arranged this accommodation for a friend from India who was coming to Toronto on business. I did not stay there but I did visit the unit before finalizing the reservation.  The apartment is quite charming and though it is below street level the ceilings are high and the unit is bright.  Everything was provided, including a requested tea strainer, well beyond what would be provided in a hotel. It is a complete home. The unit is beautifully located in central downtown Toronto and there are many restaurants, shops and a major mall within easy walking distance. It is convenient to public transport. The one small difficulty is that there is no way to buzz a visitor into the unit... the occupant must go to the door.  Since the building is old and historic, the halls are a labyrinth and it is easy to get temporarily lost.  However, there are elevators and there is side access to Charmaine's unit which has an elevator and is less complex.  There is no telephone landline in the unit but there is WiFi.  This unit is not accessible for anyone requiring a walker or wheel-chair because of stairs in the corridors and the bathroom might not accommodate a wheel chair.
Great set-up!  Great location!  Definitely recommend!

Fantastic stay! Charmaine's place is clean, spacious, safe, a ten-minute walk from Union Station, well-stocked (condiments, Keurig with coffee pods, shampoos, washer and dryer, dishwasher, hair dryer, hair straightener, etc.), and well-priced. Charmaine and Tammy made check-in and check-out easy and made us feel welcome. Oh--and the bed is so comfortable I slept until 11:00 am for the first time in a decade! All my friends stayed at the Sheraton across the street and paid twice as much money for half the space. Can't recommend Charmaine's place highly enough.
Charmaine is a fantastic host. She has a lovely place, and she takes extra care to make sure her guests know where everything is. It was clean and very comfortable.

Charmaine place is original, beautiful and very organized to make any length of stay enjoyable.

I highly recommend this location

Some may prefer this method, but it was tricky as the host had to wait on my arrival while I had fluctuating plans (not by choice) for the day of check in. It was also a hot day and I wanted to drop off my belongings asap and shower but the host preferred to tour first. It was kind, but just not convenient especially after traveling. If you prefer this hands-on hosting it’s lovely but as a New Yorker it’s not ideal for me. Overall a great stay, no issues, and a lovely space!

Best Airbnb experience, great location near lots of great restaurants but quiet safe street. The patio facing the garden was fabulous with a swing chair too help you relax. Great help from Michele and Doug, really friendly and a good instruction book with a map etc, ooh and  fab shower. We used the city bikes share scheme which there are some near the house, we then cycled everywhere really easily. we would definetly stay here again.

Doug and Michelle's apartment is wonderful! It is beautifully and lovingly furnished and has a lovely terrace where you can sit comfortably in the evening. Doug and Michelle are very easy to reach for questions and just great hosts - thank you for a great time!

Doug and Michelle were amazing hosts!

Thank you so much Doug and Michelle for an amazing stay

We had an amazing stay. beautiful neighborhood in walking distance of the city center. Very clean, beautiful and spacious airbnb with everything you could possibly need. Extremely kind and helpful hosts. We really recommend staying here

Doug and Michelle are excellent hosts. The accommodation is very comfortable and lovingly furnished. We also really liked the neighborhood, with lots of small shops and restaurants and great connections for activities. We can highly recommend this AirBnb!

lovely comfortable space that felt very friendly.

very local and easy to get to lots of cafe bars and tourist attractions. public transport on your doorstep.

Douglas and Michelle had a very nice house with private apartment in a quiet neighborhood. We loved the restaurants and walk on foot to places of interest in town (returning by public transportation).

Before we set out on our adventures we met with Douglas and Michelle and they gave us some useful information and tips about taking public transit and always made sure that we were comfortable without being intrusive. Sehr schönes Airbnb, wir konnten die Sehenswürdigkeiten der Stadt zu Fuß ohne Probleme erkunden. Auf jeden Fall zum weiterempfehlen.

A super friendly host, a great apartment, a great location, all made for a great stay. Had a great stay!

I highly recommend this apartment and the host. Douglas was responsive, resourceful, kind, and welcoming. He provided great support and tips to my parents. The apartment is clean, pretty and well located. This will be my go-to next time I pass by Toronto.

Doug and Michelle were so welcoming and lovely! Great spot in a convenient location

Great stay for the Toronto experience. perfect location, very clean and tidy and cute. super friendly hosts. Wonderful hosts, very responsive and helpful. Quaint spot, not far from public transportation.

We had a brilliant stay at Douglas and Michelle's! The flat is so comfy and beautifully decorated. The location is perfect for walking around with nice arty shops and plenty of food/ coffee spots. We'll definitely be back to explore more.

The flat is a little dark because in the basement but you have access to a private terrasse and garden to take a coffee and enjoy the sun. We were lucky to have a great weather in Toronto, and accordingly a lot of street food festivals and activities in the city. Thank you a lot to Doug and Michelle for their hospitality !! Hope to come back one day.
The door of the bathroom is a bit hard to lock. Other than that, everything was amazing!

Nous avons passé un très beau séjour. le logement était bien placé, et nos hôtes très gentils, accueillants, réactifs et nous ont beaucoup aidé pour le stationnement de notre véhicule. Le logement était propre, au calme et proche de très bons restaurants.
Very good host. Make you feel like home. The apartment is in a very nice part of the city. Very quiet. I would come back!

Nous avons passé un merveilleux séjour chez Doug, l’accueil était chaleureuse, l’appartement au top du top, franchement rien à dire c’était une superbe étape dans notre road trip !
Je recommande fortement un séjour chez Doug, foncé les yeux fermés !!😉🫶

Our stay at Doug’s place was great ! You can feel that they have put a lot of thought into the apartment. It is clean, well equipped and well located. We found it really charming with the small outdoor space in the back. We would certainly recommend it or go back in our next time at Toronto !

Looks exactly like the photos. Michelle was lovely and welcoming. We didn’t really spend a lot of time in the Airbnb but the bed was surprisingly comfy and the shower was great! The location was perfect and so much to do on Ossington! Would stay there again in a heart beat!

Wonderful place with an even better host. The location is excellent—just steps away from subway and streetcar routes—making it easy to travel in any direction across Toronto.
Doug was consistently proactive with communication and provided clear instructions and helpful recommendations throughout my stay.
Excellent spot! Clean and a very affordable option for short stays in the city. Very walkable location which is a bonus! Would stay again.

Doug and Michelle are great! I’ve stayed in many places and with many different hosts over the years, but they were the kindest! They were so helpful with providing me with walking routes to different places and letting me know how/white street cars to catch. I highly recommend staying with them and in this general area if they’re booked. I look forward to staying with them again in the future!

Doug and Michelle are exceptional hosts and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay in their basement suite. Sipping our morning coffee on the patio, looking at the beautiful garden was a definite highlight. We hope to be able to stay here each time we visit Toronto! PS – the bed is much more comfortable that you'd expect for a pullout couch.

Doug and Michelle were very friendly and great hosts.  Their place was fantastic in a great neighbourhood close walking distance to lots of restaurants and coffee shops.  Also very close to to public transit making it easy to get downtown.

Très bel appartement situé au sous sol de la maison. Calme et bien aménagé.

L’accueil par les hôtes était très agreable, très chaleureux. Hôtes très compréhensif sur les heures d'arrivée et de départ.
Très bien situé près des transports pour rejoindre le centre et l'aéroport.
Airbnb fonctionnel.
Seul petit bémol pour nous, le lit, qui etait très mou pour plusieurs nuits... Nous préférons les lits plus fermes/dures.
Mais sinon un très bon logement dans Toronto, je recommande !

Die Unterkunft war wundervoll und total gemütlich! Wir wurden sehr herzlich von Michelle begrüßt, sie hat uns geholfen die Parkerlaubnis auszudrucken und uns die Wohnung gezeigt. Très beau logement. Confortable, bien placé, des hôtes très réactifs, très serviables.

Caledonia pub has 50 pages of Scotch choices for spirit lovers.  Overall a great experience!
Loved the place. Perfect for my plans. Definitely hope to be back
A really lovely place in a great neighbourhood
It was a first class place. The shower was to die for. We had everything we needed.

Doug and Michelle were incredibly welcoming and helpful. I felt right at home from the moment I arrived. The suite was spotless and equipped with all the basic amenities I needed. I would absolutely recommend staying here.

Doug and Michelle were absolutely lovely; very friendly and responsive with lots of great recommendations. The suite was a great place to stay for a great trip—would absolutely stay here again!

The apartment was clean and comfortable. The Hair of the dog pub downstairs was excellent, with great, good value meals and a wide range of beers and cocktails etc. So much better than staying in a boring, homogenised hotel chain.

Keir let me in a little early and out a little later. This is already what earns him 5 stars. The apartment was the perfect location to stay for my friends wedding. I used the 50$ certificate for breakfast and some Muskokas. Would bookagain.

This was a lovely place to stay! Clean and comfortable. It is very easy to check-in with Hair of the Dog staff, they approached us with the key upon arrival. Keir left a helpful Welcome folder of info on the coffee table. The bed is very comfortable, as were the chairs and couch in the living room. We used the washer/dryer in the bathroom, the abundant closet space and hangers, and full kitchen for cooking breakfast in the morning and dinner at night. The smoke alarm is more sensitive than I am used to, and I set it off twice with the toaster on setting 3, so watch your toast! There is a grocery store a block down the street. The location was very convenient for hailing taxis. Great artwork on the walls. Rooms and amenities are accurately represented in the photos (different couch, though, with back and arms). Water pressure and temperature start up slowly, but are very good. Physical set up: external door at street level, interior stairs, 2nd floor split between three apartments. Apartment is two rooms with a bathroom, nice finishes on the walls, ceiling and floors. If I moved to Toronto, I would want to live in this space.

This apartment was nothing short of amazing! The photos really dont do it justice. Prime location for shopping, eating and a few cocktails. Extremely friendly staff at the bar downstairs and you really cant hear a sound from the apartment. SUPER comfy bed and really modern decor :) would definitely stay again
L'appartement De Keir est certainement l'appartement le mieux décoré que j'ai pu réservé sur AIRbnb. Il est vraiment super et très bien placé.

This appartment was very nice. Even though my companion and I had seen pictures before booking we were still both pleasantly surprised by how nice it was. As well as how big it ended up being. We both had more than enough room to go about our business.
The bathroom was just right and we both thought it was great that there was a washing machine and dryer, although for our short stay we didn't need either.
The bed was perfect. I slept amazingly for the entire trip.
Finally I feel like i really must mention the pub downstairs because they're food was delicious. I was quite surprised to see that they had a veggie burger, probably one of the best I've ever had. I also had their pierogies, fried like I'm used to, and a fantastic curry that I would honestly go back for the next time I visit Toronto.
All in all a great stay in a perfect location that I would love to book again.

Keir was great with communication.  As soon as we sent our first request, Keir was quick to respond and was easily accessible before, during and even after the stay.  The apartment looks just like the pictures, if not a little bigger and better.  It was clean, quiet (even though it was above a restaurant), and easily accessible.   The location is excellent.  Check-in and check-out were very simple.  It's 1/2 block from a great grocery store.  It's also close to two shared bike stations.  By the way, we'd recommend checking out the Toronto Bike Share....it's worth it.  The $50 gift card Keir gave us for the Hair of the Dog worked great the night we decided to stay close to the apartment.    The food was awesome.  We didn't get to see all of Toronto so we'll definitely hit up Keir again if we come back.  We'd recommend Keir's apartment!

Keir was great to deal with. He was very accessible by email. Quick to respond and pleasant. The apartment is very convenient for anyone with out a car, as the metro is only a block away.
Apartment is super clean and modern (stairs may be tough for any one with bad knees).
BTW the restaurant down stairs had great food and beer.
I was actually surprised how quiet the the area was.
Great spot, very clean & comfortable. Hassle free key pickup/drop off
He was a greag host!!! Had a really good time, the place is really nice much nicer then the pictures make it look. Loved it
The place was great.  Super comfortable, modern, centrally located, and the host was very kind and accessible.

I had a great stay at this stylish, inviting apartment. The room was spacious, the bed was extremely comfortable and the staff at the pub downstairs were very friendly and helpful when I checked in.  I thought it might be too loud being on top of a pub, but it was actually really quiet and I had restful sleeps the nights I stayed there.   There was a bit of construction on the stairway when I was there but not enough to deter me from staying their again.

Keir was an AMAZING host. Apparently Canadian trains tend to run late so I arrived an hour after I expected to. No problem. His apartment was large and clean and had everything I needed. It's in an excellent location (easy access to subway, grocery and liquor stores a block away, at the beginning of the gay village. etc.).

I can't praise this location - or Keir - enough. I would stay again in a heartbeat!!! Thanks, Keir!!!

Communication with Keir was prompt and easy. The apartment is fantastic - it looks way bigger and better in person than in the photos - I had a very comfortable stay.
