A booklet of typed written information was available on everything you needed to know about the apartment and surrounding area including where to buy food and shopping.
Staff at the pub were very friendly and easygoing (I am a bit of a barfly so this was much appreciated!)
Overall I really enjoyed my stay here and would stay here again

Great apartment, really central. Keir is really attentive & accommodating. He left gift certificates for the excellent pub downstairs. Walking distance for attractions, groceries & best coffee at Fuel a few steps away--great neighbourhood.

Keir's apartment was perfect for our weekend stay in Toronto. It's very central (we walked everywhere), close to amenities (grocery store a block away) and is in a very vibrant neighborhood!  The apartment itself is clean, bright, modern and exactly as show. We would most definitely recommend it!

This is a great listing - It is a cozy charmer of an apartment (hello, vine covered windows) so centrally located. Subway and shops were all minutes away and there is not any of the noise one might expect from being above a bar.  Communication with Keir was easy from start to finish. I recommend this listing to Toronto visitors.

This is a great apartment in a perfect location downtown. Not too loud and very close to everything.  The pub downstairs isn't disruptive at all  and has some great food! We were very comfortable in this place and would love to rent it again on our next visit to the city. Keir was very welcoming and had a folder of useful info available as well.  Would highly recommend.

Keir's place was an excellent choice. It was bright, clean and decorated nicely - the location was within walking distance to everything I needed (impressive grocery store a block away, subway station two blocks away, and a bunch of restaurants every direction). The restaurant staff in the pub below was very nice and the food and service there were reasons we went back several times.

The apartment was perfect as a base camp for a weekend in Toronto. Everything is nearby or easily accessible by metro. The place itself is cozy and comfortable. The staff at HotD were helpful and very responsive. The entire transaction was seamless too. Thanks for letting us stay here Kier! Will definitely look to book again next time we're in Toronto.

Keir made us feel very welcome, with a small card and fresh flowers, as well as a notebook of useful information. The apartment is lovely and in a very convenient location, close to transportation and shopping. He was very responsive to communication, and followed up on our arrival to see if we need anything. Highly recommended!

Keir made a last minute booking very easy. He answered all my questions promptly and was super helpful during a busy few days.  I was able to drop off my luggage at the bar downstairs before check-in and he even made sure there was an iron on hand when I arrived.

Keir's place was fantastic. It was a great location. I walked all over downtown, and always found my way back easily. The unit itself was very clean and well kept. It was spacious, and comfortable. Highly recommended.

Keir's place really was quite beautiful, and was in a great location. The inside of the apartment was nicely decorated, with fresh orchids awaiting our arrival. The apartment is quite spacious, and the living room has a cozy feel to it, making it perfect for winding down after a long day. Keir maintained communication with us throughout the stay, checking to ensure that we felt comfortable. Thank you Keir for providing a wonderful place.  I am going to recommend this place to anyone who is looking to stay in Toronto!

Keir's apartment was the perfect location for our 1st trip to Toronto. The space was clean and well stocked. We enjoyed having a drink and some food at the bar downstairs - Hair of the Dog.  Everything was easy and Keir was a great host. We would stay here again.

I greatly appreciated the fact that Keir allowed me an early check-in after a rather long flight through the night. The welcome card was a kind and thoughtful touch. He responded quickly if I needed something to be looked after. The location is very conveniently located and the apartment is cozy and well equipped. Thank you.

Keir was a wonderful host. He was very receptive to my requests and responded quickly to my needs. The apartment is very accurate to the photos. The neighbourhood felt safe and close to everything. I loved the feel of the place - it was simple, understated, and masculine. I felt right at home.

The apartment was perfect -- central location, comfortable, clean, and lovely. Keir was very welcoming and prompt to respond to any questions or requests. The pub downstairs is a great place for dinner or a drink, and isn't at all noisy once you're in the apartment. I highly recommend staying here!

Great apartment! So much nicer than staying in a hotel.  It was just as nice as the photos show and it's in a great location downtown. The bed was super comfortable and there was a big desk I could work at. I would definitely stay here again!

Just as advertised. Nicely decorated, fantastic location (the Loblaws nearby was amazing!), comfortable bed and very clean.

Kier was accommodating allowing me to stay another night. I stayed for two weeks and a cleaner was offered half-way through.

Would stay again!

The apartment was lovely, cozy and perfect for our extended weekend trip to Toronto. It looks exactly as pictured and described. Very tidy, excellent location, with a reasonable paid parking lot is right across the street. The host was always reachable when needed. Highly recommend!!

Keir's apartment was exactly what we were looking for. It had a great set up and location, just steps away from everything we wanted to see and do in the neighbourhood. Checking in and out couldn't have been easier or more flexible. The apartment was very clean and tidy upon arrival. We plan to stay again if it's available.

Keir was quick to respond to my enquiries and made me feel welcome.  Apartment is well-situated, very comfortable and well-equipped, although as the extent of my "self-catering" ran to buying prepared meals at the amazing Loblaws a block away, was a bit surprised to not find a microwave.  In spite of being on a busy corner, it was very quiet and the folks in the pub very friendly.  Thanks Keir, I'll definitely book again if the opportunity arises.
I had a good experience in Keir's place and it was easy to get access to the apartment from the bar downstairs.  Loblaws (supermarket) is right up the block so I had access to everything I needed.

Absolutely loved staying at Keir's listing! He was easy to get in touch with to ask questions leading up to check in. It was beautiful and comfortable enough to feel more like home than a hotel. Great location. Easy check in and check out. Beautiful apartment with everything you could need, we were able to cook and loved it. Extras that we enjoyed were the welcome booklet, the use of the Bose speaker to enjoy music while lounging and the basic tv and Internet to use. Comfortable, attractive and clean, would totally book again :)

Keir was quick with his replies and very accommodating.  The apartment was comfortable and as nice as it is shown.  The pub below was a great asset for easy access to good food, drinks and company.  As Keir mentions, the apartment is quiet and there is no "noise pollution" from the bar below at all. A very nice and comfortable place where we would stay again without hesitation.

Keir's apartment was great -- centrally located in a fun and vibrant neighborhood, clean, and completely consistent with the photos. And the bed is so comfortable! Keir provided a helpful guidebook and was  responsive the couple of questions that I had during the stay. He was also flexible and kind to allow a late check out. Definitely a great place to stay in Toronto!
We really enjoyed staying at Keir's apartment.  It's a great location and Keir was easy to communicate with. Highly recommended!
Most things are good. You can find everything you need there. But the bathroom is a little bit small.

This apartment has character and comfort. Not to mention a great location. The gift certificate for the Hair of the Dog pub (also excellent by the way) made this even better value for money. Keir is an excellent host - he even came by in person when we coudn't figure out how to use the remote controls for the TV!

The place was extremely convinient and exactly as described. Love the proximity to transit, nightlife, and the Loblaws next door. Our host was excellent and accomodating. Would stay here again for sure.

Keir's apartment was perfect for our five-day visit to Toronto, our old home town. Everything we wanted to see and do was walkable, or easily reached by TTC.
The apartment was tidy, charming, and fairly well equipped. The nice old building is a "survivor" in a part of town now dominated by high-rise condos. The guys in the attractive small pub below were very helpful and kind, especially when one of us came home alone without a key.
We used Keir's gift of a $50 card for the pub for wine and a snack on our last night.
Note to prospective guests: pub noise does not reach the apartment, which is on the third floor.

The place was great, and Keir was really accommodating.

When we arrived our first night in Toronto, we went to the downstairs pub to get the keys to the flat The staff at the pub were all really nice, and were already expecting us.

Once we got to the flat upstairs, we felt at home. The place was clean, and spacious enough for two people.

The location of the flat is great: near the subway line and bus lines. There's a great supermarket (Loblaw's) a block away. The neighborhood is also really cool for drinks or great meals.

We'd love to stay at the flat again, if we're ever in Toronto.

This apartment is just as advertised. Its a cozy comfortable unit in a heritage building. It had everything I needed including good wifi, in suite laundry, an equipped kitchen and comfortable bed. Then location was perfect for me. One block to huge Loblaws an LCBO and 2 blocks to the Subway. There's good a selection of small shops and restaurants in the area. Keir was a great host, he responded right away if I had a question and I was greeted with some breakfast items in the fridge and a $50 gift certificate the character pub downstairs. ( No noise form that in the apartment).
This apartment was so comfortable and cozy I wished I could live here year round! Keir and the staff downstairs were all very friendly and accommodating. A great experience all around!

Keir était un hôte exceptionnel. Il était très accueillant et toujours attentif à nos demandes et questions au cours de notre séjour. Il nous a offert de nous mettre sur une liste VIP pour une boîte de nuit et a même été en mesure d'étendre notre séjour d'une journée. L'appartement était très beau, très propre, confortable et très bien situé. Il y avait tout ce que nous avions besoin.

Great location, 3 blocks from Ryerson, incredible gourmet grocery store and liquor store right across the street. Cozy and clean. Wonderful bar/restaurant downstairs - great food and staff and handy to pick up the keys there. After the first day they treated me like a regular! When in the apartment you would not have known there WAS a restaurant below - little noise and no smoke. Keir was responsive and thoughtful - I needed to sew a button on and asked him if he had a needle in thread - I came back to the apartment to find a sewing kit on the doorknob! I would not hesitate to receommend this central and charming spot!

You'd be hard-pressed to find a better space than this one! The apartment was neat, clean and so cozy that I wish I owned the place. The location was very convenient with a fantastic pub downstairs as well as a gourmet grocery store and parking across the street. The welcome packet was extremely useful and answered all of our questions. Overall, the experience could not have been better!

Everything was just perfect !
The location is great and the appartment is super cute, very comfortable, very well organized and equiped. It is actually bigger than it seems on the photos. We were really impressed.
Keir was really nice with us and very welcoming. He was also very flexible with our schedule and that is a very nice plus. It was very easy to get the keys and to leave them when leaving.
Everything we need was covered and all the questions we had were quickly answered.
Next time we travel to Toronto we hope the appartement will be available. We will definitely go back there :-)
Thanks a lot Keir !

Highly recommend staying at Keir's place. Such a great apartment with everything you could need in a perfect location. Keir was really accommodating and the pub downstairs was had great food. Will definitely stay here again next time I'm back in town.

Great stay, Keir was very accommodating and flexible with timing.
Definitely recommend, perfect location.

Keir's place was absolutely wonderful. The apartment itself was spacious and clean, beautifully decorated and fully finished including washer and dryer which was super convenient for warm towels!
The location was the best part of the stay. We were able to walk everywhere during our stay due to the central location and I would highly recommend the Hair of the Dog for breakfast!

Great location, lovely apartment for a great price. The neighborhood has an amazing grocery store and tons of restaurants/bars. Keir was fast to respond and was a pleasure to communicate with! Would recommend his place to anyone traveling to Toronto!
Keir's apartment is wonderfully located and charming. A relaxing spot in the midst of it all.

Keir's apartment is comfortable and well-appointed (having a washer & dryer is handy) and is less than a five minute walk to an excellent grocery store, a liquor store, a movie theatre, a fitness facility, and several unique restaurants and bars. Access to the subway is also close by.

I feel it important to note that the location of the apartment, at the corner of two very busy streets, made for some unpleasant traffic noise at night (earplugs were helpful).

Keir was a very accommodating and generous host; we appreciated the $50 gift certificate that he gave us for the Hair of the Dog pub/restaurant - delicious food and friendly staff. Keir also extended our check-out time to late afternoon so that we could keep our travel gear in the apartment until just before our flight home.

Overall, a good location and home-base for sightseeing in Toronto.
Nice place to stay in Toronto, you can go walking everywhere. Comfortable, clean and nice. Great experience.
The apartment was well-kept and conveniently located.  Keir left useful information in his manual, and it was nice to have the pub downstairs.

Keir's apartment was a lovely one bedroom spot above the Hair of the Dog bar. Just a short jaunt from the Line 1 station, it's right smack dab in the middle of downtown, making it very accessible to everything. It was the perfect location to allow us to go out and see the city. The area it's in is relatively quiet and was nice, with almost everything within a two minute walk.

The apartment its self was very nice. Modishly furnished and comfortable, it was the perfect location to relax for a long weekend. The noise level wasn't horrible, especially being over a bar. There was some, but it wasn't horrible or raucous, and it didn't keep us from sleep.

The only really issues we had at the stay was the hot water didn't seem to work. Even after letting it run for a bit, the water never rose above just below lukewarm, and we couldn't seem to get the cable to work. The latter wasn't a big issue because we just pulled out the laptop and watched Netflix (wifi was available, which was great!). Despite these issues, the stay was still great and thoroughly enjoyed myself!

I really enjoyed my stay at Keir's place. Bonus points for having washer/dryer, printer / scanner, and a nice little pub on the main floor.

I'd strongly recommend the suite for any professional doing business in the city.

Wonderful location and accommodation. We were able to walk as far as the SkyDome while enjoying the eclectic sites and architecture. Neighbour food excellent and groceries at Loblaws at Maple Leaf Gardens convenient and healthy! Met some great other renters at the apartment and the friendly downstairs pub staff and delicious food was a great way to launch our visit to Toronto! We will be back!

Keir is a generous host that responds to requests and messages right away. The apartment is VERY conveniently located within steps to all amenities. We were staying in town for work and pleasure so it was great to have car2go parking next door to the apartment. The extra bonus of the g/c to the pub downstairs was appreciated and we used it the very same night we arrived. The apartment itself is nicely decorated and is equipped with everything you need. In fact, we needed to print a document for work and Keir let us know there was a USB hookup to print it in the apartment - worked like a charm! Highly recommend this rental and will return again.

I had an amazing time in Toronto and really enjoyed having Keir as a host. The apartment was amazing, clean and very conveniently located. Keir was very responsive and flexible with allowing for early check in and a later check out. His guidebook was extremely helpful and I would definitely stay here again.

Great experience! Would absolutely stay again.
The apartment is a great 'home base' and even bigger than it appears in pictures. It's nearby to Yonge St, minutes from the subway, groceries, liquor store and plenty of food and nightlife.
The food at the pub is great and convenient! We didn't hear the noise from the pub at all and we did stay on a Friday night.
Thanks for everything Keir!

Excellent location and apartment. Clean, spacious and quiet. It's above a pub but we couldn't hear any noise at all. We could walk to pretty much anywhere we wanted to go and being downtown meant it was pretty easy to hail a cab to go further afield. Highly recommend!

Apartment is nice.
location is good.
Keir is fine.
BUT.....the cleanness of bed cover is terrible!!!
Keir replied very fast to all emails.  The apt is fantastic, has everything you would need and the location is golden

Thank you Kier for being such a great host and help to make our Toronto experience so memorable. The place and location is exactly as described and we would definitely recommend you to anyone visiting Toronto !

Great location, close to just about everything. Parking right across the street for $25/day as well as a giant grocery store and liquor store, bars, pubs, etc. Apartment has all of the amenities you need, including laundry and a handy welcome booklet. Wonderful stay!

We arrived by train from Montreal at Union Station in Toronto about 3 PM on a Wednesday. It was a very pleasant walk to get to Keir's home. Church and Wood street corner is a great location in the Toronto "Village". We were welcomed by the manager of the downstairs pub Jason who gave us the keys, directed us to the unit, and offered his assistance if we had any questions. Jason gave me an envelope from Keir which included a welcoming note and two $25 gift cards for the pub. Very nice added touch! When I opened the door to the unit and peaked inside, I said to my partner "you're going to really like this place". We both were immediately impressed. The place really feels like a home - very comfortable. Great living room, kitchen, adjoining bedroom/office, bathroom with stacked washer/dryer. Bed super comfy and restful. Nice street below views. For being above a pub, the place was amazing quiet and relaxing. We ended up visiting the "Hair of the Dog" twice and very much enjoyed the food and drink. Very easy as a base to travel around the city, and either rent a car or do a bus/train trip to Niagara Falls. Uber works well also around the city.
We had a great time for 4 days/nights in Toronto, wonderful city!

We truly loved our stay in keir's apartment and in the amazing city of Toronto itself!
Apartment was even better than the pictures, super spacious and well furnished and very clean and well equipt should you wish to eat in. We loved the fact that there was a washer (sad I know), but it just meant we didn't have to come home to all the washing!
Pub downstairs was brilliant, lovely vibe and the $50 voucher was a very welcome and generous gesture. Also some amazing restaurants elsewhere in Toronto, we enjoyed Volos and Canoe in terms of high end. Also big recommendation for "smith".
Keir was super helpful from initial reservation and throughout our stay. We didn't get to meet, but hope our thank you gift goes down well.
We chalked off pretty much everything Toronto has to offer; aquarium, bike tours, theme park, edge walk, amazing restaurants, islands and Niagara.... Oh and the amazing nightlife (Church street was perfect for the gay scene). Despite having done it all we defiantly intend to visit Toronto again and will book with Keir in an instant.

Keir's flat is a fantastic place for a stay in Toronto. The flat is spacious and well equipped. I really liked the design and layout and felt at home there quickly. The pub downstairs is a great place also. We were really grateful for our coupon for the pub, was a nice surprise, and had some good food and excellent drinks there. The location is excellent and we got to see loads of Toronto despite as short stay because it was so easy to get to places. We never got to meet Keir but he was really helpful replying to messages quickly and he left some useful info in the flat. Even helping to return some forgotten belongings!!The bar staff helped us with anything else we needed. Would definitely recommend Keir's flat as a place to stay!

What a delightful artsy apartment located close to everywhere you might want to go . It has old world features as well as being roomy . I loved the street views from the Windows too.
Comfy sofa, chair and bed and even a few convenience items in the fridge.
The pub below serves nice food and has a great atmosphere and if you want some company . Keir left a $50 voucher for the pub as well which I was grateful to have .
There is also a superb grocery down the road which has everything you could possible want including prepared food.
Also close to other restaurants and movie theatre.
The apartment is easy to reach by public transport which is important for me .
Would love to return on my next visit to Toronto.

El contacto con Keir fue a través de correo electrónico y SMS. Siempre respondió muy rápidamente a nuestras demandas. El apartamento está encima de un pub donde se come francamente bien. El apartamento está muy bien equipado y en condiciones. Se encuentra al principio del barrio LGTB de Toronto y está muy bien ubicado para moverse por el centro de Toronto con el sistema de transporte público. A los que les guste andar se encuengtra no demasiado lejos de ninguno de los puntos de interès de la ciudad. Globalmente la experiencia fue muy buena.

We stayed for three nights in Keir's apartment and it was just as advertised. Beautifully decorated and well-appointed apartment in a fantastic location. Great pub downstairs and a fantastic grocery store and liquor store right across the street. Easy access to the subway as well. Keir was a great host - we had everything we needed. I would highly recommend.
Everything was great and as advertised. Excellent communication with no hiccups

My boyfriend and I stayed at Kier's for two nights. We had a wonderful stay!! What an awesome apartment: great location, awesome pub, easy parking. Next time we're in Toronto we will absolutely stay here again.
I stayed at Kier's for two nights very nice. Your apartament has a good location, bars, supermarket and foods. kier's is very attentive and a good host.

My stay with Keir was wonderful. The building has a ton of charm, and the apartment itself is very welcoming and spacious. The welcome packet tells you all you need to know, and the location couldn't be beat. Highly recommend staying with Keir in Toronto, and plan to do so when I return.
Nice place, great location.  Very pleased with the accommodations. Thanks, Keir.
Overall great.

Keir's place is awesome. It's in a super convenient location right close to a metro stop which can take you all over the city. The apartment is really cozy. One thing that really surprised us is how quiet it was considering it's above a restaurant. Definitely recommend staying at this place!
Great, clean apartment. Good location. Hair of the Dog is wonderful. Highly recommend.

Keir is an excellent host, very communicative, but unobtrusive. The check-in process was flawless; as promised the keys were with the bartender at the pub downstairs. The mattress was comfortable and seemed new. The bedding and towels were of nice quality. A giant Loblaws supermarket located one block away was a huge plus, they have everything you could possibly want, and more, under one roof. It's a short walk to the Gay Village; the University of Toronto and the Royal Ontario Museum are a very pleasant 10 minutes stroll. The area has a concentration of Japanese restaurants; we especially enjoyed Kinton Ramen. The parking lot across the street from the unit is super convienient, if a bit expensive.

The best Airbnb I have stayed in. The apartment is spectacularly located. VERY close to restaurants, bars the subway and Loblaws. It was incredibly comfortable and I cannot say enough about how awesome the staff at Hair of the Dog are. The food and service was excellent. Parking is literally across the street, reasonably priced and safe. Fantastic!

Keir est un hôte prévenant, l'accueil s'est très bien passé. Nous avons passé 3 jours dans ce  superbe appartement, avec en prime un cadeau de bienvenue. La maison est très centrale, dans un quartier vivant animé a quelques pas de touts les commerces et commodités. Un parking est disponible juste sous les fenêtres.

Great place, great location. Keir is very responsive if you have any questions or concerns at all. The only quibbles I had were that the AC unit was quite loud (though necessary and welcome!), and that the shower is a bit small. But overall, I was very happy with this place, and would highly recommend it.

We had a lovely stay at Keir's place! We were getting in late and had an easy process picking up keys at Hair of the Dog. Then we returned and had an amazing dinner there! The neighborhood and location and incredible, and the apartment is spotless and lovely. A delightful stay and we would definitely stay again!

The place is very well located at the edge of the "village" where some of the guests will find a variety of options for entertainment. Downtown is walking distance for the non-shy walkers, great food shop just in front. The hair of the dog has very good food and vibe so feel free to indulge there!

How lucky were we to find Keir's apartment. We have had a lovely stay. The apartment is really well set up and bed is extra comfortable. The pub downstairs serves great food and atmosphere with exceptionally friendly customer service. Proximity to city is a real plus only one block to Yonge St! Interaction with Keir is seamless and informed. Thanks so much for making our first stop in Canada so memorable. Cheers Helen and Vin.

We stayed two nights in the apartment. The apartment was a clean, charming space with modern touches.  The location is great. Tons of shops and restaurants nearby. We eat at the pub below, the food was fantastic. Keir was a good host and was quick to respond to my messages. I would definitely stay at Keir's place again the next time I'm in Toronto.

I loved Keir's apartment, it was just as amazing as it looked in the photos and the location couldn't have been better. The awesome grocery store just down the street was almost too good to be true!

For a single traveller such as me it provided plenty of room but I would definitely recommend it to couples a well. The pub dowstairs was a charming place as well and the friendly staff made me feel very welcome.

I fell in love with Toronto and look forward to coming back. When I do, I will certainly stay at Keir's again - thanks so much for a fab week!

Keir's place is wonderful, and he is great too.
I was impressed since the very beginning when he contacted me a week ahead to arrange the key pickup. From there, the whole experience just kept getting better.
The location is perfect if you want to move around Downtown Toronto. There is also so many places on walking distance to buy groceries, liquor and others.
The interior is beautifully decorated and was pristine upon our arrival.
Finally, it is located above my favorite pub in this area, The Hair of the Dog... so overall... it couldn't be better.
I would definitely recommend this Airbnb without a doubt.

The apartment was comfortable and clean. The location was great and within walking distance to shopping and yummy restaurants. Picking up the key was easy and having parking right across the street was an added bonus. I would definetly stay here again!

We truly enjoyed our time at Kier's apartment. Everything was exactly as advertised. It was close to shopping transportation and all attractions in the heart of the city. We highly recommend his place and look forward to staying there again.
nice
Keir's place was perfect!  Great location for downtown and all the information needed was handy in his booklet.  We will be staying at Keir's place next time we are downtown Toronto.

If I had to pick one word to describe my stay, it would be excellent. Keir's place is modern, packed with the essentials you need for a great stay, with a perfect central location in the heart of downtown.
Checking in/picking up the keys was hassle free and welcoming. The details and instructions are clearly laid out and easy to follow. You can see the extent of Keir's hospitality throughout the entire space - including the detailed welcome book.
Highly recommended. I would definitely stay here again.

Great apartment in the "Village" -  close to everything!  easy walk to Eaton Center and everything else downtown.  Felt cozy and right at home immediately.  Comfy big bed and lots of room to spread out. Good sized desk and great Wi-Fi.  Hot water takes its time, but the shower was great once the hot water arrived. Large parking lot across the street ($10-15 per night). Very tasty pub food and fun atmosphere at the pub on the main floor.
Easy to book. Great location, beautiful appartement.  Close to everything.

Keir's place is as described, it's just lovely. There wasn't anything I needed that I couldn't find, I was glad there was a hairdryer available as my Australian one didn't work ! It was a short walk to the the hospital and to the St Lawrence market . Thanks so much Keir

The experience from start to finish was fantastic! Keir was very responsive to all communication. Check-in was super simple and convenient! Also, we loved that affordable parking is literally across the street!

The neighborhood was very safe and had lots of great amentities. The most amazing grocery store I've ever been in is right across the street, and you are only about a 10 minute walk away from the shopping area.

The apartment was a great size and the bed was very comfortable! Check-out was quick and easy, as well.

I would recommend this apartment to anyone going to Toronto. We will definitely stay here again!
An excellent place! Charming, cosy and well equipped. Hope to stay again on next visit to the city.

The apartment is very central and cozy while still being quite spacious! We were a little worried about staying above a pub but didn't hear any noise at night. Check-in and check-out were both exceptionally smooth processes. The bed was super comfy, the kitchen was well-equipped, and we appreciated being so close to a great grocery store. We'd definitely recommend this airbnb!

Keir's place was absolutely perfect for my stay in Toronto! Central location, very walkable neighbourhood, conveniently close to grocery stores, shops and restaurants.
Keir made check-in and check-out a breeze and everything was seamless. He even gave me a generous gift certificate for the pub downstairs (which I loved)!
I also really loved the aesthetic of Keir's place- very design-forward with cool art. The bed was also super comfortable.
I will definitely be back!

This is an amazing place, located in the heart of the Village Neighborhood in Toronto. The apartment is super clean and well equipped. The location is excellent as it's close to shopping, restaurant and clubs in the gay neighborhood. I'd certainly come back to stay. Keir's Pub, the Hair on the Dog is super awesome. The food, drinks and staff are just the best and the ambiance is perfect. Keir is also super attentive, very responsive and welcoming.
It will be definitely our little home in the future in Toronto if it's available. Thanks to Keir for its help. And the pub downstairs is AAA. You can't find more central than this !
Great journey in Toronto, well placed, cosy place, good explanations about everything. Thanks you!

Although we didn't get to meet him Keir was an excellent host! Great communication and very helpful. :)
The apartment is super cute and centrally located in Toronto's Gay Village.
Check in was easy and the staff at the pub on the lower level were very kind and helpful.
The only down side was the parking lot next door wouldn't accept our credit cards and we had no Canadian coins .. so we had to find another lot. Which wasn't a problem because there are many in the area.
If we return to Toronto we will definitely be considering Keir's place again!
Thank you Keir!
Great location! Easy check in and out. Great communication! Amazing pub below :) would highly recommend staying here.
This is a great spot for a weekend (or longer) stay. The apartment is stylish and comfy - everything you need is nearby and a short walk or taxi to other great attractions.
Logement bien situé. Parfait pour une escapade d'amoureux. :)
Great location

Keir's place was excellent! We were only in Toronto for a few days, and this was the perfect home base for us. The place itself was cozy and comfortable with a well-equipped kitchen, relaxing living space, and a plush bed. It was central - close to the subway and streetcars and within walking distance to major sites. Keir was really quick to respond to any messages and the check-in and check-out processes were simple with the pub downstairs. We would highly recommend!

Great location and clean and comfortable.  Even though it is above a pub/restaurant, it is very quiet.  Walking distance to many shops, restaurants and very close to public transit.  Would definitely recommend this.
This is our second time at Keir's place it was just as great as the last! Really clean, central location, easy check in and amazing hosts! :)

Our stay at Keir's place was excellent! Great location, easy check-in (picked up the keys at the bar), and the apartment was in pristine condition. Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Toronto.
Nice place; would stay there again.
A great place to stay!

Perfect, clean apartment. Great size and very cozy. Although we didn't stay in the apartment long, the bar downstairs was very welcoming, had a great menu and the location was fairly central to all amenities.
We enjoyed our stay very much and will definitely consider returning to the same spot again in the future!

Very nice place, and large!  Full living room, and large second room with an area for the bed and a great multipurpose table where you can really spread out your stuff.  Very functional kitchen as well.  Great to stay at a place with lots of character, and a good location over a nice pub. Check in and check out a breeze.
Great place for a great price, one block walk to the gay bars and most public transportation. Plenty of space and amenities

A most enjoyable stay.  Keir and Brian were away when I arrived but were great at communicating and made checking in and out easy and convenient. The place was super clean and felt like home. Thank you for a great stay!

Keir and Brian's apartment was exactly as described and pictured. Despite being above a lively pub and restaurant, the apartment is PIN-DROP SILENT. Very comfortable place and great value for the location.
For the best results in the shower, turn the handle counterclockwise to the 3 o'clock position until the water is hot, then to the 1 o'clock position until the water is comfortable.
This is a cool apartment in a great location, and Keir was very helpful with whatever we needed. Also enjoyed the pub downstairs.
It was a lovely apartment and everyone that we met at the pub downstairs was lovely. Wonderful location, close to the street car, subway and grocery store! Would recommend to anyone!

Kier's place has a great location. It was very clean and quiet. The pictures and description are very accurate. Kier is a great host and was okay with being a bit flexible with our check in/check out. I would stay there again and recommend it to anyone who wants to stay close to downtown Toronto.
A very good convenient place to stay. We have been back many times!
Lovely apartment, great location and very clear communication.
Great  location, making everything you might want to do easily accessible on foot or by transit. Well furnished and comfortable unit, just as described in the listing.
Our 2nd stay at Keir's place.  We always have a great stay here and tried out a new room.  The room was very nice!
This place is fantastic and the hosts are so friendly and accommodating,even letting us check out late on our last day. Thanks guys - We will be back soon!!

Keir's place is awesome! Checking in was no muss, no fuss and it was easy to come and go and do as I pleased. The apartment is VERY comfortable and has everything I needed. Close to transit and groceries and bars!
Great location, confortable and lots to do and see
I really enjoyed my stay in this beautiful place! It's conveniently located, has lots of charm and is very spacious. Communication was great and I could leave my big backpack before check in time.
Spacious orivate apartment. Comfy bed.  Full kitchen. Across the street from Loblows. Excellent experience

Très bel appartement, bien équipé et bien situé près des commerces et du métro.
Je n'ai pas rencontré Keir et Brian mais nous avons pu communiquer facilement et ils ont tout fait pour rendre le séjour agréable.
Je conseille également le pub au rez-de-chaussée qui est très sympa !
We had a very comfortable stay. The apartment is centrally located has great light and Keir was a wonderful host.
Clean, spacious, affordable, close to everything you need in Toronto. I am definitely making this place my go to place to stay!

This was our first Airbnb so not sure of the process. Kier was very good with communication and we found the description to be accurate. The hair of the dog restaurant downstairs was. Use but laid back so not noisy at night. We were grateful to find a discount voucher to eat there in the apartment.
The location was close to the main shopping street, close to a fantastic supermarket and close to the restaurants and nightlife of the gay village. As travelers arriving without a car the location was very handy. We enjoyed the city and as newbies to the Airbnb process we were lucky to find a helpful person like Kier. Thanks

A lovely apartment easy walking distance from most of what Toronto has to offer (but very close to the metro and buses too). Check-in and check-out was super easy and Keir and Brian have provided a great guest folder with info about the apartment (e.g. wifi, etc) and local amenities. They were always very quick in responding to requests before I arrived and checked in with me after I arrived to make sure everything was ok (which everything was). It's above a lovely foody pub (Hair of the Dog), which isn't noisy at all and inside the apartment you wouldn't know there's a pub downstairs. I'd definitely stay again.

Cracking apartment and cracking pub. As many others have said you don't hear the pub as it's on the ground floor and apartment is on the second. Really handy for getting around Toronto and further afield. Apartment has more than everything you could need and is very spacious as well. Uber comfy bed, plenty wardrobe space and a decent kitchen and bathroom. Would recommend a feed at the Hair of the Dog pub and Loblaws is the biggest city centre supermarket I've ever seen. Very decent all in!

Great Airbnb for our stay in Toronto! Easy access location, walkable to many great parts of town. Located above a pub with a beautiful outdoor patio and good food - we didn't have any noise issues while staying there. Easy check-in/out and the hosts made sure we had what we needed!
Great place! Very central. Hosts were very attentive and helpful throughout our stay
Charmant appartement très bien situé et hôte très disponible!

Nice and central to everything! Easy to walk or pick up transportation. Great communication and easy checkin/checkout. Overnight parking was difficult due to the lot next door being removed. Construction noise due to highrise being erected next door, but we spent 95% of the time in the city, not in the unit so it was fine with us.
The apartment is extremely comfortable, close to the main areas of the city
Comfortable, spacious, central. Brian and Keir were great hosts. Definitely recommend.

Great place, great location. There was a massive construction project across the street that was underway during our stay that we didn't know about at the time of booking which impacted our sleep and downtime. It would have been nice to know this ahead of time. There is also two sets of narrow and steep stairs to go up that some may find difficult to climb, especially with bulky suitcases. Comfortable bed and pillows and the kitchen was well equipped. The shower was on the smaller side, making it hard to move around in. Close to a great grocery superstore, TTC and restaurants.

The apartment was centrally located. It's above a pub/restaurant, surprisingly we did not hear any noise from the bar which was great. The location is on a busy street so you do hear the traffic and the people going by. There is a grocery store across the street, very convenient. We were unable to meet Keir but he was very easy to get a hold of and was accommodating. The restaurant staff checked us in when it was time to do so. We enjoyed our time in Toronto.
Conveniently located in downtown Toronto.  Very pleasant stay.
The apartment is great! Really cute and great size. The location was perfect too! The pub downstairs is amazing and the food was delicious! We would stay again for sure.

Brilliant spot to stay, close to restaurants, bars and shops. It felt like a very safe area to stay, we walked everywhere at all times of the day. We loved the bar downstairs and very  friendly staff. It felt like home straight away. Would highly recommend. Thank you very much.

A brilliant flat and brilliant value, do a search for hotels in Toronto and you will see how amazing the apartment is in comparison. Light, airy and not too far to walk into the city. Also a nice voucher for the pub downstairs which has some amazing beers and nice food. Thanks so much guys.
Nice location and cute place.  Would definitely recommend to other friends
Great Place!  Enjoyed our stay and would stay again.  Great location and very charming.

What a fantastic spot in my favourite neighbourhood in Toronto. Fabulous pub below with great food and great service- and one of the best ceasers in the city. The apartment had all we needed and more. Very stylish and great spot to entertain a few friends before heading downstairs for dinner. Walkable location and I always feel safe as there are always people out. The Loblaw at Maple Leaf Gardens is so close too. #wallofcheese. Check in was great with the friendly bar staff.
Would absolutely return next time we are in the city.

My boyfriend and I had a great time staying in Keir's apartment. It was a lot bigger than I thought it would be and is very close to the TTC; getting downtown was super quick and easy. The neighbourhood is great, everything from a large grocery store to the Eaton Centre is within walking distance. I hope I can stay with him again the next time I’m in Toronto.
The location is great and the apartment was very large and spacious! Our hosts were kind and easy to contact. I would recommend this airbnb to anyone coming to Toronto!

Keir and Brian are simply wonderful. Have stayed at their Air BnB twice and I hope I’m fortunate enough to stay there again. The apartment is beautiful and comfortable and in an amazing location in Toronto. Highly recommended!
Kier's stylish, comfortable apartment was absolutely perfect for our weekend in TO. It doesn't hurt that it's right above an excellent bar -- would definitely stay here again!
Once again we enjoyed our stay! This is an excellent place to stay in Toronto.
这次的旅行在这里住了三天，非常的满意，因为去哪里都非常方便，如果想要游览多伦多并且节省在路上的时间，这里是个很好的选择。主人的酒吧就在楼下，十分的喜欢。而且这条街上有很多酒吧，夜生活会很丰富
Keir's place was great! Enjoyed the neighborhood and it was close to everything downtown!

Perfect hosts. Really responsive to my last minute enquiry and any questions during my stay. Central location and lovely bolthole for investigating the city.  Flawless in every way.  Thanks again guys.
Great location, spacious living area and good communication. Overall good value and would recommend.
It is a great place, great location and the hosts are very nice and quick to respond to all inquiries.
My partner and I loved the location. The apartment is simply perfect: at the very heart of the action on Church Street. We would definitely consider staying there again. Thanks!
Great, safe location! The apartment is very clean and stylish. Host is incredibly thoughtful and very responsive. Would definitely stay here again!

Keir's place was fantastic. Check in was easy and convenient, and there is a huge grocery store a block and a half away making it simple to get any extra supplies you might need. Very clean apartment with a lot of space. The bed is extraordinarily comfortable, and it was really nice to have an in-unit washer and dryer. It was extremely cold (even for Canada!) while we were there, but the unit stayed warm and was always really nice to return to. It is very centrally located, so much so that we walked to our destinations (the Royal Ontario Museum, Art Gallery of Ontario, Kensington Market, etc) most of the time, even in the extreme cold! If you're interested in getting a workout in, there is a Crunch fitness nearby (5 minute walk) that offers 3 day guest passes.
Keir and Brian are excellent hosts. They were fast to respond to any questions I had, and very helpful with check in. They also went way above and beyond. Our flight home to New York was cancelled due to a snow storm, and they very quickly made it work for us to stay an extra night in the unit. Further, they comped it! I honestly can't fully put into words how excellent our stay was here. You're going to have to experience it for yourself!
Awesome host & well-kept space. Would definitely recommend :)
GREAT LOCATION, GREAT PLACE, GREAT HOST
Have stayed at Keri’s place a few times and would be thrilled to stay there on my next trip. Can’t say enough good things about the place and the hosts!!

I loved staying here. It was super close to everything with lots of shops and restaurants. A 24/7 shoppers was close by along with the subway station. Keir was super helpful when we needed a place to leave our bags before check in and out. I would recommend this place!
Parfait merci beaucoup!!!!

We arrived super early and as the air bnb was free, Keir let us in to the air bnb as we arrived! Very helpful, especially after a long night flight. The victorian design creates a warm homely place, especially during the cold winter nights.

Keir's place was great! We didn't see him during our visit, but communication was very smooth. There is a key code to get inside, which made things very easy. The kitchen had everything we needed, and the living space was very spacious. The bed was comfortable and, despite being right on the main road, we were not bothered by noise. I found it cold when we went to sleep, but it warmed up quite a bit overnight. We tried the restaurant downstairs for brunch and it was delicious! The apartment is centrally located, very close to the subway, and we were able to walk to many different areas of town. Highly recommend!
Amazing space and great host :)
A great place to stay. Nice to be close to lots of unique restaurants!
Keir's place is just as described. Great locale, very lively area, great shopping close by and a full service grocery that is excellent. I even tried the pub downstairs and it was really great.
Amazing place, thanks a lot!

Amazing beautiful stylish place! Walking distance to everything. Best part was the bed, very comfortable, cozy and soft sheets and pillows! We walked pretty much everywhere. If you stay in their place, you must come down to the bar and grab a drinks and/or food. We had breakfast there and it was delicious. HIGHLY recommended!!
Perfect location. Amazing place. Painless check in and out. I’ll be back.

A stellar find!  Close to the Village and centrally located in terms of public transportation, bars and restaurants, and other local amenities.  Keir was a fabulous host, and his apartment was top-notch.  Would highly recommend.
Great location and super clean
Nous avons apprécié les cinq nuits dans ce logement.  C'est très bien situé, en plus à proximité d'un Loblaw et LCBO.  Nous le conseillons!
Keir's apartment was a great hub for our weekend in Toronto. It was within walking distance to many restaurants and bars, and the area was very nice. Would stay again.

This is a great place for a short city stay. The apartment is very centrally located - you can walk to all major attractions... and those who aren’t into walking, metro station is about 4 minutes walk.
The information provided by the host(s) is great, check in and out worked without any issues.
One thing I did have problems with was hot water in the shower....
would recommend this place nonetheless!

I have visited Keir and Brian's place many times and I hope I get to continue to stay there every time I come to Toronto. It's an incredible fully equipped and beautiful suite in an amazing location. Keir and Brian are excellent folks and staying above their fantastic pub is a big bonus. Love that place!
Anyways, suffice it to say I would definitely recommend this place!
Good location, good hosts. I did appreciate the gift certificate for the pub even though I did not use it when I ate there.

I’ve been in Keir’s apartment for 2 weeks as I was staying in Toronto for work. The apartment is excellently furnished (more than my place even!), in downtown next to shops, restaurants and attractions. The check-in is well organised and Keir was contacting me every 3-4 days to ask if I needed something and if I wanted some cleaning and changes of towels and sheets.
So, definitely I would recommend Keir and Brian apartment!!
A very bright and appealing place to stay!
Great apartment in the heart of a really cool neighbourhood. Close to groceries and amenities.
Appartement très fonctionnel, bien équipé, bon emplacement pour visiter Toronto, proche de commerces et métro. Keir est à l'écoute et très réactif pour toute demande.

This is a really nice apartment in a fun part of the city.  Comfortable furnishings, open layout, and nice welcoming touches from the hosts.  I'd recommend this place for anyone looking to spend some time in Toronto.

Fantastic space in a great area of Toronto. Clean, spacious, stylish and easy to find. Food in the pub downstairs was really good with great service. Would 100% reccomend to anyone considering staying here. Keir was easy to contact and checking in and out could not have been simpler. Thanks for  great stay.

We had a great time here. The hosts were extremely friendly and accommodating and rearranged their cleaners so that we could have a later check out (which made all the difference to our 26 hour journey!). The apartment is beautifully furnished and so comfortable. The pub downstairs (run by the same people) has very friendly staff and a great atmosphere. This is a great place to stay and I wholeheartedly recommend it.

We had the pleasure of staying at Keir's place over a 3 day weekend. The space was fantastic, very clean, and comfortable. It's situated above a very cute pub (which has some stellar food and drinks that you should check out). They even hooked us up with a sweet discount with our welcome card.
Brian and Keir were incredibly easy to communicate with and responded quickly every time we needed anything.
The apartment is also in a great location. We were able to walk to pretty much everything we needed and were literally steps away from great spots in the village.
We would definitely stay again.

Keir and Brians place was awesome! The bed was super comfy, and we loved the old building. They were so kind enough to give us a voucher for the restaurant downstairs which was delicious. We enjoyed our stay very much. Clean, good communication, easy check in/out and a great apartment overall. Thanks!

The apartment was absolutely perfect for our weekend in Toronto. Communication was clear and prompt leading up to our reservation. Check-in was a breeze and we were delighted at how nice the apartment was upon our arrival - it was like checking into a hotel, but with so many nice touches and conveniences. The apartment is charming and well-decorated, incredibly clean, and had everything we needed and more. The neighborhood is super convenient to downtown while having its own charm and some great restaurants and bars. Public transit is quite close by, though we ended up mostly walking everywhere. We had dinner at the restaurant below the apartment, and even went back later in our trip for drinks at the bar. The apartment is on a somewhat busy street, so there was definitely a little street noise, but closing the windows and turning on the fan was an easy fix. Overall, we had a fantastic experience and would definitely stay again.
Great place in good location, allowed us to store bags before checkin. Top place!
Keir's place was great, very convenient location.  Everything as promised.
An outstanding location,  perfect access...and a fantastic host!!!

This apartment is on the top floor of a very quaint small building very centrally located. It was easy to get there by taking the train from the airport and the metro to a stop 2 blocks away. The apartment is stylish and very comfortable and clean, exactly as pictured. As described in other reviews, the apartment is in the center of a busy urban area so if you are sensitive to noise bring earplugs. The apartment is also a 20 min walk to the wonderful Art Gallery of Ontario- highly recommended. The hosts were instantly responsive to our inquiries.  A wonderful stay!
We always have a great stay here!

The location of Keir's place is fantastic! We loved the pub downstairs and were able to walk to almost everything we wanted to see. The AC worked really well which was great for our heat-wave stay, and the space had great amenities too. Overall would definitely recommend if you're looking for a downtown Toronto experience!

Keir's place is great for a couple! It's a good-sized one-bedroom, with a large living area and bedroom. Keir left the window A/C on so the apartment was nice and cool when we arrived. The $25 gift certificate to his bar/restaurant downstairs was a nice touch too. The neighborhood is not the most glamorous part of Toronto, but this place is an excellent value and a short Uber ride from the waterfront.

Agréable séjour. Keir a été très réactif à mes messages. Appartement qui ne manquait de rien.
A noter, une gentille attention à notre arrivée, avec une invitation dans leur restaurant (où j'ai très bien mangé d'ailleurs).
Brian and Keir’s place was great for our weekend in Toronto. Perfect location where you could walk everywhere. Try the pub below, the food is amazing.
Keir’s place is perfectly located downtown toronto. Close by subway and bus stops. Lots of good restaurants around, and last but not least its located across a big supermarket.

This house was so nice and clean. I was satisfaction all of the things. we have 4 luggage, so when we went into the house, we are tired. (room is located in 2floors.) but that’s okay. I recommended this house.
Great place in a perfect location. Make sure you visit the pub downstairs
Accommodating host, comfortable space and exceptional location.  Thanks very much!

Keir was so helpful and responsive from the time we booked our stay all the way thru to the end of our stay. We had a small issue with the shower temperature and Keir was so responsive and helpful and fixed it immediately. We also used our coupon to eat at the pub downstairs and it was wonderful! I'll absolutely be reviewing the restaurant too :-)
All in all it was a good stay and the location was perfect, not too far from anything we did during our stay and the neighborhood is great. Thanks again!

Accommodations on a trip can make or break your experience. This place definitely makes it! There is lots of space and lots of light (but also great blinds if you prefer it darker). It is up a couple flights of stairs, but well worth it. There was absolutely no noise travel from the pub downstairs. Extremely clean, organized and just overall wonderful. Highly recommended! Cheers!

Great place to stay and explore downtown Toronto. The pub downstairs is certainly worth paying a visit. The apartment is nicely furnished and everything is there to make you comfortable and feel at home.
It was walking distance to downtown Toronto and very closeby was a big and great shopping place to get good food.
Price and quality fit very good
Keri’s apartment is beautiful, well appointed, and very nicely located.

Great stay at Keir’s place. Perfectly located in downtown- opposite a good supermarket and above a great pub with very tasty food! The apartment is stylish with all you need - a fully equipped kitchen. I’d recommend..

Really central location in gay village, beside maple leaf garden, attntive hosts, wonderful accomodations other than somewhat noisy air con. Very spacious, nicely furnished, relaxing. Good pub food in owners' restaurant below, v charming.

This was our first time using air bnb and it was a wonderful experience. The space was exactly as pictured, clean, and quiet. We used the subway from college and had no trouble getting around. There was a loblaws next store as well so that was a bonus! Will def consider this for return trips!
This was a great place to stay overall. Great amenities and the bar downstairs had great drinks and food.
Keir 很热情，有问必答，房间装饰很有艺术范。房屋位置好，厨房设施很齐全。挺不错的。
Exceeded our expectations. The apartment is cozy, very clean.  In an amazing neighbourhood, great location. 10/10 would recommend.

keir is very kind and his room was so good
And also the location is perfect!!
It was awesome and would definitely recommend and would also definitely stay again!

This was the very nice convergence of a super responsive host, a wonderful space, and a conveniently central location. I couldn’t have asked for more. The best feedback that I can offer is that not only would I stay here again, I would recommend this host and property to my friends and colleagues.

A lovely spot for one person or a couple. The apartment was as illustrated in Airbnb, very comfortable and well-appointed. It's central to downtown--it took me only 20 minutes to walk to King and Bay. It's over a sweet pub/restaurant, where I ate most of my meals. There was as of the writing of this review construction going on across the street which starts 7:00 a.m. each weekday, but I'm an early riser and it wasn't an issue for me. I'd go again.

The apartment is a great space. I love the feel, decor, space and the comfy bed.
Other reviews are completely accurate from my experience when saying you can't hear the pub downstairs. I don't know how that happens - it does.
For me, as a light sleeper I needed to adapt to the traffic noise. I used earplugs after my first night and slept well every night. I eventually realized most of the outside street sound was coming through the A/C unit (which I had turned off) so the traffic noise is likely diminished in other seasons when the A/C unit might be removed.
The shower is a single person stall. It looks like it has been around awhile and was very clean. I had as much hot water as I needed without any problem. The information left in the apartment about how to get hot water was very helpful and accurate.
The kitchen had all I needed and then some.
Thanks to my hosts for welcoming into their apartment.

Keir's place, was great! Location was perfect and the nearby grocery store had anything you would need. Would definitely stay again, and would highly recommend if you are planning a trip to Toronto. Also, check-in was super easy, and Keir answered all messages within minutes.
Great location, super nice appartment, really clean and comfy. thank you!

This is a great apartment for a couple of nights exploring the city. The host took care of us when we arrived, he owns the bar downstairs. Check in was a little late so he gave us lunch on the house, which was very kind. He was really friendly, although we felt communication lacked while we actually stayed and we had an issue with the bathroom light. The place is modern and stylish, we really enjoyed spending time relaxing in the apartment. The shower isn’t that powerful and doesn’t heat up fast. One thing to be aware of when you stay here is that roadworks outside the building start early (around 7:30am we thought?) and the air con unit is louder than others. It was a small inconvenience, however for what it is, this apartment is a good location (5 min walk from subway which can get you to Eaton centre in around 6 minutes), is lovely inside and a good base for your stay on Toronto. It wasn’t excellent, but we still had a great time here!
Great location and spacious apartment. The bed was quite comfortable as well.
The location is great: close to the subway, very close to a huge market. The place is simple but comfortable and has everything that you might need.

Il locale di Keir  è molto carino e ben fornito  di cibo per una perfetta colazione, il quartiere è piuttosto vivace  ed è centrale  con mezzi di trasporto a pochi passi. Consigliamo ai futuri ospiti che sono interessati alla floricultura di visitare il giardino Allan che si trova lì vicino.Grazie  Keir è stato un piacere soggiornare da te. Bruno e Ross

Keir’s place is incredibly well-appointed, within walking distance to downtown and other nearby districts. There’s a big grocery store 2 minutes away and the subway is also easily accessible. The place was very clean and it had great amenities. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would book again in a heartbeat!
Cute and cozy place in good location

Kier's place felt like home and cosy after our long flight. It's very walkable to all the popular spots. Internet gave us some problem initially but after following instructions on the check-in document it worked pretty well.
It would be highly recommendable home and would love to come for another stay.

The bed was very comfy, and the apartment was spacious and stylish. I especially appreciated the TV with chromecast and the bluetooth speaker, as it made me feel at home. There was some construction and street noise, but I was warned about this well in advance via checkin communications and came equipped with earplugs so it wasn't a big issue (and is to be expected given the location). I couldn't actually hear the pub downstairs at all from the bedroom, and the food was excellent, so I was glad to have it there. I would definitely stay here again.

This apartment was very clean and spacious, with lots of amenities (in the kitchen and bathroom) offered by the hosts.  The bed was cozy, and the temperature in the apartment was perfect.  It's within walking distance of the bus terminal which made this location ideal, since we took the Megabus from Buffalo.  It was also a great location to walk to some vegan restaurants, Loblaws (an upscale grocery store) and Kensington Market...if you want to take a break from walking, there's also trolleys to hop on, including one on the street where the apartment is located.  We will definitely book here again.

Everything was pretty much spot on. The location is great close to an LCBO and a Loblaws and walking distance to shopping mall(20 min).  Keir was very available and very fast on answering. The appartement itself was great for 2. Also the bar located in the same building the staff was great and the greeting card(voucher) was a great touch. My friend and I recommend greatly this place.
Great location and nice place.
Great apartment, very clean, well decorated, easy check-in, and good communication. I highly recommend.
I believe I may be the most frequent guest at this suite.  That's because it's perfect and the hosts are both amazing.  Perfect location, amenities etc.  Feels like home. :)
Very close to Glad Day,  other queer spaces.  Be prepared to walk up 2 flights of stairs.

Brian’s apartment is spacious and in a great location close to restaurants and bars. The place is also above a restaurant/bar. He was very responsive and was clear with check-in and check-out instructions. I would recommend this apartment to anyone interested in visiting Toronto!

I went with my husband in January to Toronto and stayed here. It was a great choice! The neighborhood is great, with markets, restaurants and easy access to public transportation. The apartment is larger than I expected, great location and very clean. I was worried about the noise from the pub (for being in the same building), but you can not hear anything. Thanks for everything!

Keir's place was a great find. You can't beat the location as it is close to a number of fantastic bars, restaurants and shopping. If you need a night in to relax, the Hair of the Dog pub is just downstairs, with great food and an amazing selection of beer and other drinks. That being said, we couldn't hear the pub at all when we were inside our Airbnb!
Also extremely close to the subway and streetcars, this is just such a great central hub for getting around.
Thanks for the great hospitality!
This place will surprise you. Super central. Cool chic apartment with some thoughtful touches. You could live here.

It was a perfect room, artistic in style and well furnished, to my satisfaction. The landlord is very concerned about my request and responds to me when I have questions. The location of the room is excellent and I recommend it to all

This is an amazing location!!  It was perfect for work travel. I really liked the bed, it was super comfortable- hard to get out of in the morning. There was a lot of noise from the street, but I sleep with ear plugs so it wasn't a problem for me.
Great location, everything was easy from check-in to check out.
Enjoy a great location with an amazing restaurant underneath.
It’s a lovely and stylish place with great location. And the hosts are all friendly! Also the price is affordable.
This place is amazing! It’s clean, modern and stylish. The location is great and the hosts are wonderful. I cannot recommend this place enough.

This is a roomy, comfortable spot in an unbeatable downtown location. The space is quiet, clean and the check-in/out process was flawless. Seconds from a grocery store and a couple of minutes from the TTC. Wifi and work area were both tip top and made this a great spot for a work trip.
Beautiful place, perfectly clean. Communication with hosts was very easy. No noise at all from the bar, we slept very well. You can go without any hesitation !

The apartment is everything you could need for a trip to Toronto.  The location is perfect, within walking distance of the subway, several food options, and some iconic Toronto nightlife spots.  The host was responsive and helpful, and the place itself was way above my expectations.  The apartment has everything you could need, with helpful amenities you may need.  The pub downstairs has some great food, so be sure to stop down there during your stay.  We parked in a parking garage about two blocks away, and it was fairly expensive, so if you are driving be prepared to dish out a little bit for parking.  There is a lot to discover in the neighborhood and this apartment puts you right in the heart of it.  I would recommend this place to anyone thinking of travelling to Toronto.
This is a wonderful place to stay, with all features just as shown. A very convenient location with great grocery store open late across the street!

The apartment is great, just beautifully decorated, and in an awesome location. Communication with the hosts was easy and simple, and they were very helpful - thank you. :)
I had a great stay in every way.

The apartment is centrally located in the college area which has some of the more hip restaurants and venues. Pretty much walking distance to downtown as well. The place is sparkling clean and the description is very accurate. Kerr and Brian was very responsive when we needed help. My only complaint is the the construction across the street. On the weekdays the crews start working at 5:00 AM and you will hear heavy machinery sounds thru out the morning. If you are a light sleeper you will need to take note of this. Other wise everything else is perfect.
Great location and great responsiveness from the hosts. Would recommend to anyone wanting a great value place in the core!

Keir was communicative and the check in process was a breeze. The space is massive for a one-bedroom and the kitchen was fully equipped. Although the space is above their pub, I never heard a sound from below. Keir even left a generous gift card to their pub downstairs, which is a great spot for a late night dinner or beer. That’s where I made several friends while I was in town. I’d highly recommend to anyone!
Loved staying here .The place is clean and comfortable. Looking forward to staying again.
Appartement bien situé. Propreté laisse à désirer particulièrement dans la salle de bain.
It’s a really nice appartement in a lovely house.
We enjoyed our stay. The location is great.

Keir and Brian’s place was a great find! Great location, close enough to everything but in a quiet spot! They own the bar downstairs and kindly left us a gift card to use which was a lovely gesture. We enjoyed some drinks at the pub and the service and atmosphere was great. The apartment was clean, stylish and had lots of nice touches such as toiletries, tea, coffee and fresh milk. The apartment is in close proximity to the tourist destinations like Dundas Sq and also in the heart of the LGBTQ+ community which is a big part of why we booked and it it did not disappoint. Although we didn’t meet the hosts, communication was excellent and they replied instantly. Our flight was late on the day of check out but they kindly let us keep our bags in the apartment as it was not in use which was a huge help. Would defiantly stay at this place again and we have loved our short stay in Toronto!
Petit appartement confortable en plein centre de Toronto...

My girlfriend and I loved our stay in Toronto here at Keir's and Brian's place. The apartment was very quiet for being in a somewhat lively neighborhood and being above their pub. The apartment had everything we needed. Keir and Brian were both very responsive in their communication. The apartment is in a great neighborhood, and a short walk to the nearest metro station, and well connected by bus and streetcar.
A note about parking: I parked at Toronto Parking (between Mutual and Alexander Pl, you can download the app advertised there), it's $11/day for weekdays, and I believe $8/day for Weekends. You can extend your time at any time via the app.
Great space and close proximity to College St TTC station. Laundry in the unit is really handy.
Very clean and stylish! Much much better than expected. Also very good location. You won’t regret booking here.

The apartment is cute, clean and equipped with all of your basics. It’s conveniently located by Loblaws if you like to prep your own food and the pub downstairs is delicious!
I think the apartment would suit anyone’s needs and you should stay if you get the opportunity!
The whole process from checking in and out was painless.   The location is unbeatable along with the amenities offered in suite.  We will be back!

This location is above a great restaurant and near a variety of other eating establishments, bars, and clubs. It was nice to be in the heart of the Village in Toronto.

So, if you are planning to bring your car and need parking, it is VITAL that you get a temporary parking permit from the City of Toronto ahead of time.
Here's a link for you: https://www.toronto.ca/services-payments/streets-parking-transportation/applying-for-a-parking-permit/temporary-on-street-parking/

Serafin's house is a true Victorian townhouse, beautifully decorated and kept up, and a delight to stay in. While most of the listings in Toronto are for generic glass box condo spaces, the beautiful wood floors, stained glass windows, period runners in the hallway and on the stairs, fabulous staircase and moldings make this a unique time machine of a place to stay, yet only one short block from the subway at Yonge Street. While the main floor goes for period decor, the kitchen is fully updated with stainless steel appliances including a huge fridge/freezer and dishwasher; and there is even a jacuzzi tub in the bath upstairs that I never tried but looks heavenly. Adjacent to the bedroom is a den furnished in comfortably modern style, with a huge plush chaise that is the most comfortable thing I have ever sat - or reclined - in: I defy anyone not to be in full nap mode three minutes after settling into it. I could have spent whole weekend afternoons reading and dozing in this chair, in this room with its bright southern exposure. But the city is at your doorstep, with everything you could need a block or two away, including gourmet 24-hour food shops; 24 hour pharmacy, TD bank and ATM, multiple cleaners, Starbucks on Yonge and Second Cup on Church for coffee at either end of the street; and an urban strolling vibe on Church Street on sunny weekends just yards from the front gate. A few minutes walk uptown brings you to the "Mink Mile" on Bloor and to Yorkville; a few minutes walk downtown leads to the heart of old Toronto, plus the amazing Loblaws supermarket in the Old Maple Leaf Gardens with its wall of cheese, which is worth a trip even if you don't buy. For a winter stay such as mine, the house is fully insulated and well heated and always warm when I wanted it to be. Serafin met me to explain the house and was charming and entertaining company at the start of my stay, as well as immediately accessible and responsive when I had questions or requests during my stay. A cleaning woman comes in every two weeks, and takes care of the house, so that all you need do is take out the garbage on an extended stay. There is even a neighbor to magically show up and shovel and salt the front walk and stairs. I loved coming home to "my house" every evening and settling into "my chair" to watch my shows and doze off (be aware that there is no cable so if watching real-time TV shows is important to your stay, this is not the optimal property; but there are loads of films and recordings of TV series you can play, as well as a direct Netflix connection, and a huge library of books). A sunroom attached to the bedroom heats up quickly even in winter if you want to use it at all,...
