This place is hands down the best Airbnb gem we have ever found. Great location, gorgeous space, and incredible hosts. For all future trips to Toronto I will be checking for availability here first.

Serafin's place is amazing. The amount of space is huge, the location is perfect, the place was spotless, and the value was incredible. I loved that the space felt like a home, and not like a traditional rental. You can tell that the owners care about it very much. I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone looking to stay in Toronto.
Excellent location, beautiful space, good communication - highly recommended.
We were very impressed with Serafin's lovely home in the heart of downtown Toronto. The home was charming and comfortable. The central location was convenient and we would fully  recommend to all.

We have stayed at Serafin’s numerous times and find it is our go to place for Toronto. The location can’t be beat and the home is stylish, comfortable and we find it very relaxing after a busy Toronto day out. We look forward to our next trip.

Location was amazing, so close to the subway station and tons of places to dine. It had everything I needed as a business traveler and would recommend it to everyone.  Serafin was extremely responsive which was important.
I had a great time!
This is a charming house located in a very central location in Toronto. The host is kind and attentive, I highly recommend.

Serafin's house is super cozy and the kitchen is equipped with everything you need. Interesting are also the many great furniture and the various artworks and books on the walls and shelves! Serafin was always quickly available and helpful, so even the problem with the tcleaning service was quickly solved! As compensation, she also waived the first two nights for us. Super service!
Everything was great.
I had a very comfortable stay. The host is very supportive and generous and communicates very quickly.

This was everything we loved about Airbnb — old-school Airbnb, where you were invited into a real home by real people, not dealing with faceless investors who stuff their properties with IKEA-ware or developers trying to squeeze revenue out of overpriced apartments they can’t sell. Serafin’s home is the real deal. It’s gorgeous without being fussy, so comfortable you’ll be sad to leave each day. Honestly, it was a big part of what made our Toronto stay memorable. We can’t wait to come back!

Had a wonderful stay at Serafin's place. My husband and I visited Toronto for summer vacation. Serafin's location was a real short walk to the subway, bus, public transit. Super convenient and saved us a ton of money as we didn't have to use any Uber during our stay. We were easily able to get to all museums, ballpark, downtown...all using public transit. Serafin's place is a real home with a soul. Truly a welcome change from the typical Airbnb cookie-cutter downtown high-rise apartments. Personalized with unique art and decor and tons of interesting books to look at. Comfortable bed and quiet neighborhood, got a lot of great sleep! Our flight was greatly delayed so our arrival time was way off from what we had anticipated, and Serafin and his caretaker were so accomodating with our changes and delays. Highly recommended.

A true oasis next to a lively part of town! The home is spacious and gracious, surrounded by a beautiful front garden and private backyard seating area. Communication with Serafin was fast and very friendly. We truly enjoyed our stay, and hope to be able to visit again.

My colleague and I shared this beautiful house for a few days during the ongoing Toronto International Film Festival. We’re both journalists and needed our own separate space, and Serafin made it extremely easy for us to parcel the space according to our needs. It’s a lovely, huge and tastefully decorated house I would have loved to spend more time in, had I not been at the festival almost the entire day. But I felt right at home at this space and pretty neighborhood after tiring days downtown and found the commute on the 1 subway line extremely easy and convenient. (Hot tip: there is a subway entrance on Serafin’s street, which took me a day to discover.) :) Thanks Serafin; your place will be my go-to TIFF house from now on.

This is a lovely home that provides every comfort needed. It is in a great location in the downtown core, easy walking to groceries and shopping.  Serafin was a great host, so easy to communicate with.  A wonderful place to stay!

Serafin’s place is a lovely comfortable homely place to stay in the heart of Toronto. Easy to walk to places and well placed for subway and bus routes. Serafin was also excellent with communication and really helpful with local information. Thanks!
We enjoyed our stay at this wonderful home and would love to come again some time. Serafin is a great and very responsive host.

We have experienced Serafin’s hospitality quite a few times and we always can’t wait to come back. Being from the States we had a long period of no trips to Canada so it is great to be back and enjoy Serafin’s lovely home. We really enjoy the new Wellesley Station entrance just a few steps away and Serafin’s home is centrally located to all the sights and places we needed to be. The home is well equipped, clean and oh so comfortable.
Susan and Peter Dixon
Very comfortable and spacious home in a great location. Serafin was easy to communicate with and I would definitely stay here again!
A wonderful experience to stay at this beautiful home.  Serafin is very nice and helpful and I highly recommend her to all solo traveller.

Great house in a great location.  Quaint and historic in appearance, while being large and comfortable and located right in the middle of Toronto.  Location is perfect as it's on the same block as the main subway line to go downtown or uptown, and easy to get to museums, downtown waterfront, crosstown Cabbagetown, Distillery District and neighborhoods over on west side as well.  It's also nice as it's in a walkable vibrant community that is away from the sterility of downtown.  The bed was super comfortable, and with multiple floors, a back garden patio and multiple living areas, it felt like a real  home.  Communication was clear and consistent.  I highly recommend this place.

Sean’s house is absolutely gorgeous! It was such a privilege to live in such a fantastic location and have a whole house to myself.
I didn’t meet Sean, his friend David greeted me and checked me in, and Sean was always just a text message away. Sean always helped out and was proactive with instructions on check-in, check-out and any other important instructions.
The house was super cozy and spotlessly clean.
When I travel to Toronto again I would absolutely love to stay here again.

We had a lovely four+ days in Sean’s house. We were met at the door, which we always appreciate. The house was clean, beautifully appointed, had everything we were led to expect. I loved my afternoons in the little back roomreading in peace! Thank you, Sean.

We are repeat guests of Sean’s lovely home. His home is clean, comfortable and beautifully decorated. We find the location to be perfect for getting to the Wellesley Subway Station (1 block) and any other place in Toronto. Sean is great at communicating with us and we have always get a prompt response. All in all we enjoyed our stay and look forward to the next time.

The home was just as advertised - spacious, clean, and comfortable. Check-in was a breeze; we were met by a caretaker who gave a tour of the property and answered all our questions. Sean was very responsive and helpful with questions we had during our stay. The home was very close to the subway which made visiting our family very easy. Very happy with our stay!
Sean's home was very lovely and Sean was an excellent host!!!

I can't say enough about my stay at this Airbnb in Toronto. The location was incredibly convenient, the house itself was ridiculously charming, and felt like what Airbnb's used to feel like back in the day. I felt like I was in someone's home as opposed to being in some Pre-fabricated,  IKEA furniture decorated, cold Airbnb I enjoyed the house so much that I made sure I gave myself plenty of time to stay in and enjoy my surroundings as opposed to running around all the time. And although it's located in downtown Toronto, which for a quick second felt a little sketchy I felt completely safe and it was probably one of my best Airbnb rentals to date. The host was incredibly accommodating and responded quickly to any questions I might have had if you're looking for a place to stay in downtown Toronto I can't recommend this highly enough.

This is a very comfortable and cozy place in a great location, perfect for exploring Toronto.  It's really great to find a comfy home on a residential street in the midst of  so many condos downtown. It's safe,  private, and reasonably quiet.

The house was a lovely home with so much space and great furnishings. Sean was so quick to respond with all our questions and even successfully walked us through using an alarm system although he kindly offered to set it remotely for us. The back porch looked comfy but since it’s winter we didn’t use it. The neighborhood was quiet although it was close to the lively Church Street community. Transit station was down the street but we preferred to walk everywhere. I would definitely stay here again!

9 days at the museum💕
Although I stayed for 9 days, the house felt like a new space every day.
It had everything I needed, it was a bigger house than I expected, and it was a much nicer and more charming space.
The mix and match between the sparkling high-rise buildings right around the house and the very urban night view was so fantastic.
The subway station was right in front, so it was very easy to move around, and in fact, the house was located in the center of downtown so that there was no need to use the subway, so I, who doesn't like being outside the house very much, debated whether or not to go out of this house every day. lol
I think it is an easy and very convenient location for those who are staying in Toronto for the first time.
I would like to thank Sean again for giving me the opportunity to stay in this home.
It was a dream-like 9 days.

Beautiful home that is far superior to any Toronto hotel. I loved coming back to the house at the end of each day. Close to transport and food. It is peaceful even though you're in the city. Sean was very responsive. Hope to be back soon.
Great stay at Sean’s! Church st is right there and the subway stop is literally across the street. Would recommend!

We had such a comfortable stay here! It's a lovely home in an incredible location, and what a treat to have so much space to decompress in the heart of the city. Communication was prompt and friendly and so welcoming! I would absolutely recommend this home and this host.

This was our second stay at Sean’s. We so enjoyed the comfort of this lovely house and felt right at home. Everything met our expectations once again. Sean responded immediately to any questions. We enjoyed two of the local pubs and local coffee shop around the corner. An excellent stay and highly recommended!

We had a wonderful stay in Sean’s lovely home right in the heart of downtown Toronto. The house was huge but cozy and comfortable. This is a great spot for exploring the city as all of downtown is a short walk away, and the subway is just down the street if you want to venture out further. Despite being downtown, the house was so quiet. Would definitely stay here again!

This is one of the best AirBnb's experiences I've had. It was such a great value and the place is just beautiful, unique, beautifully decorated, a well-appointed kitchen with lovely appliances, lots of sitting areas, a great patio. Nothing not to like and lots of make this a way-above-average stay. Host was super-responsive, kind, and helpful.

From day one communication with Sean was amazing. One of the best Air B&B places which we have rented ever, nit only here but also via other platforms. Highly clean home, clear instructions and  cosy place made our visit to Toronto remarkable!
Thanks to Sean for his super kind and flexible approach. We felt very at ease in the space - lots of room. Great bed!  Super warm and lovely shower.

We have stayed at Sean’s 5 or 6 times so it is evident that we love his home and feel very comfortable there. Access to the subway is a 3 minute walk and you can get anywhere in the downtown core within 10 to 15 minutes. Sean is also a very responsive host - if there are any issues he responds quickly. We feel fortunate to have found this place and are happy when it is available.
The location was really excellent.  The house was very comfortable with lots of character.  Sean responded immediately to any questions.

Toronto has changed quite a bit since my last visit 20 years ago. However Sean’s house remains as a comfortable oasis in the modern city. I greatly enjoyed my stay in the historic house. It was in the heart of the gay village with so many restaurants, shops and amenities just steps away, from morning Egg Club breakfast to late night Amore Döner. I was able to find affordable parking a mere six minute walk away. The bed was comfortable, the two living rooms were luxurious, and the updated kitchen had everything one needed. Sean had excellent prompt communication. I would gladly stay again.

Sean was friendly, helpful & very flexible.  The location couldn't have been any better.  TTC was easy to access & there was an abundance of restaurants in the area. We really enjoyed staying at his home.

Pour la toute première fois, nous avons eu le plaisir d'expérimenter l'esprit authentique d'AirBnB. Sean nous a confié sa magnifique maison familiale, qu'il habite lui-même lorsqu'il ne la loue pas. Nous nous sommes sentis tellement bien accueillis! Comme des amis. Et tellement comme chez nous. Sa maison est un bijou, avec une âme, beaucoup d'espace, un confort extraordinaire, une grande propreté, et une grande sécurité.
Nous n'avons pas rencontré Sean, mais il a été chaleureusement présent tout au long de notre séjour, venant au devant de nos besoins, répondant à toutes nos questions, nous faisant immédiatement livrer un élément dont nous avions besoin.
Un mot aussi concernant David qui nous a accueillis à notre arrivée et nous a présenté la maison avec une grande gentillesse.
Nous sommes venus pour la cérémonie de remise de diplôme de notre fils et nous nous sommes régalés.
Nous savons maintenant où nous nous installerons lors de nos futurs passages à Toronto. GRAND MERCI Sean!

5 star rating for a 5 star place. Only wish we could have stayed longer. Sean is the best host for communicating & always responded promptly. We walked everywhere, even though the subway was literally down the street.  The house is a bit of an oasis in the center of a very active neighborhood.

Nicely located in the heart of Toronto with easy access to other neighborhoods by walking or bike.  Near to LGBTQ+ area which was a highlight for us.  This is a nice sized house with a living and family room and a cozy back yard.  It was a great place to work remotely from.
Charming home, very comfortable, fascinating downtown setting.  We were able to explore and enjoy Toronto to our hearts’ content. Sean is a responsive and considerate host.

This house is a real gem. Great location near the subway station and very close to the bars and restaurants.
The house is spacious and very comfortable. We felt right at home here.
Highly recommend. Thanks!

Sean was an excellent host. Communication was clear, timely, and friendly. The check-in and check-out process were straightforward. Besides being a beautiful heritage home with plenty of space, the home also has A/C and a security system, which added to the comfort of our stay. Being close to public transit was helpful. Would definitely stay here again!

Sean’s home is really one of the most beautiful places I’ve ever stayed at and I will carry it in my heart with me! The house is very spacious and even though it’s right next to the busy queer quarter it was very quiet. It was easy to adjust the heating to a good temperature and the bed and couches are very comfortable. Communication with Sean was very easy, we did most of our exploration of the city by foot, which was very convenient. There is a supermarket nearby and also a subway station right across the street. We can definitely recommend staying here and are happy to come back ourselves!

This is a lovely, old, spacious townhouse full of art and furnishings from other eras, and it needs to be treated with affection and respect. You're in a one-block street even a cab driver with 25 years' experience didn't know, in a quiet refuge from the busy, crowded city that can feel like miles away when you're inside. Kitchen and other spaces are well equipped and comfortable, a modern security system keeps you and the house safe, and there's a subway station half a block away. Within walking distance, you have a few decent grocery stores, a few colleges and universities, several excellent museums, lots of restaurants (none of which we tried, I admit), and whatever you can find in mostly flat, endlessly walkable central Toronto. The host lives elsewhere part of the time, but communicates and responds instantly. When you arrive, you're met by a friendly collaborator who welcomes you and shows you around the place. Here, you can exhale and relax into a sheltering flow of time.

Sean's place was absolutely lovely. It's located on a quiet street but is within a short walk to many great restaurants and busy corridors of Toronto. As a host, Sean was super proactive with communications and made sure I was all set prior to, during, and after my stay. The house was very comfy and warm even though I was there in the fall. I highly recommend and would definitely book again!

Sean’s house was the perfect place to stay in Toronto. A 2 minute walk to the subway and we could get anywhere we needed to go. The street was very quiet at night and the house had more than everything we needed. Everything was very clean and Sean was very responsive to any questions. Would definitely stay again!
Beautiful house with all the amenities. Sean is the warmest and most helpful host, always there to answer our endless questions. This has been a memorable and comfortable stay. Thank you soooo much.

I cannot say enough good things about Sean's home. I like places with character and this home just felt so original and lived in. Truly felt like I was staying at a friend's place versus the lifeless/empty places we've stayed in before. This home has heart.
From the gigantic bathroom that felt like a spa to the incredibly cozy living room that I had to dragged away from every time we went to visit the city. My only regret is the weather wasn't too great so we didnt get to enjoy their beautiful patio area and we were out so much I didn't get to enjoy the kitchen.
Location is one block away from the subway but anything you need is in walking distance, Very diverse area which felt alive but not too active. Felt safe without feeling boring and I say this as someone who lives in NYC, for perspective.
Loved our stay SO MUCH and highly recommend it to anyone else!
great place great location great host! no complaints
Thank you Sean! This was a lovely stay.
What a gem! Tucked away on a quiet cross street. A delightful home with abundant feng shui and a delightful host with abundant attentiveness.

Beautiful, historic house in a great location close to restaurants and shops. The subway station is only a couple of minutes walk from the front door, but the street is very quiet. We very much enjoyed our stay.

Sean's place is extremely spacious and he's an excellent communicator if you need anything or have questions. It's very close to the #1 subway line, making it ideal for using public transportation. The house is quite accurate to the photos, although during our visit the outdoor seating area had not been set up or cleaned, so we weren't able to take advantage of the outdoor patio. It didn't spoil our visit, but it was the only thing that didn't line up with his listing. This is a solid choice, especially if you want to stay in the Church Wellesley Village neighborhood while visiting Toronto. It's a lot of space for two people, and it has a lot of character, unlike many of the Toronto apartments in high rise buildings that are rented as Airbnbs. The street is very quiet, which we appreciated.

The house is lovely, large and comfortable! And the location is perfect for visiting the Church Street area. Sean is very accommodating and responsive. Pride weekend was extremely busy but totally enjoyed the visit as it has been a long time since we were in Toronto. If I could give it more than five stars, I would.

Outstanding. A perfect getaway - a quiet oasis, but just steps from the village. The place was spotless, fantastic location, Sean was immediately responsive, and the home is beautiful and well equipped. We’ll be back!
Cozy and clean home located near public transportation.  Host was very responsive and kind.  I would recommend this home.

We had an awesome stay!  Everything we could need and more.  Lots of space and lots of character.  Very friendly and helpful, proactive host.  Easy close access to subway and all manner of restaurants/shops, but just enough distance away that is still sheltered and peaceful and not "in the thick of it" (i.e. avoids noise and traffic).  Would definitely stay again and highly recommend :)

It was a privilege to stay in such a beautiful home in a quiet neighborhood just a few blocks between two of Toronto's main streets. Sean was very responsive, even sending a great recommendation for Indian takeout within minutes of our request. We would stay at Sean's place again in a heartbeat.

My wife and I stayed at Sean's place for 4 nights in September 2025.

The house is amazing, and very large! The front garden and streetscape look amazing. The location is easy to access amenities, shopping, and extremely easy train access.
We would definitely stay again, and recommend this place highly!!

We loved our stay at Sean's charming home. The location was perfect for us and had everything we needed. The home is located on a quiet street. Access is very convenient as the subway station is a half block away. There are lots of restaurants and bars nearby.
Sean communicated detailed instructions for entry and offered tips to enhance our stay. Sean responded promptly to questions and checked in with us to ensure all was well. I would love to stay again on our next visit.
Beautiful home in the heart of Toronto. It is easy to see that this property is loved and cared for. I felt calm and at ease while being in a large city.
Excellent location and beautiful accommodation. Everything you could possibly need!  Great communication and efficient. Highly recommend staying here.

Wonderful heritage home in a fantastic location. Walk to the subway, restaurants and shops.
Lots of space, great kitchen, hardwood floors and comfortable furniture. Eclectic decorations and art abound. Sean is a great host!

Had a great stay at Sean’s home.Sean was a great communicator and the space was very homey and comfortable. No complaints at all. Close to TTC, good wifi, would definitely recommend. Thanks again Sean!

We loved staying at Sean‘s place. Although entering was a bit daunting through the back door, it was fine in the end. It was a lovely house with all what you need for a longer stay. For us the kitchen and the dining room was very valuable as the nice sofas and a large TV. Sean was very helpful and always available for communication. Excellent!

We had a wonderful stay at Sean's beautiful heritage home.  We were very comfortable and the location was perfect.  Despite having easy access to subway, shops, and restaurants, it was quiet and private - a great place to come back to after a busy day.  Sean is easy to communicate with and provided lots of helpful information.  We certainly hope to return another time.
Warm and friendly space with lovely amenities and furnishings and beautiful art in a great central neighbourhood. Sean was a fantastic host. Loved staying here and would come back any time!
We had a wonderful stay at Sean's home - it was clean, comfortable, and absolutely charming. The area was perfect and it was easy to transit everywhere we needed to go in Toronto.

This place was just wonderful! Far beyond what we expected...and the AirBnB description was already enticing. We would (and most likely will) stay again, for sure.

We loved this house. It felt like home away from home and we plan to stay again.
The library of books is excellent and the house was near everything we wanted to do.

Steve was great and very helpful! Since I was from Toronto, I didn't need much help, but he was still very welcoming.
The apartment was so cozy and cute! It was clean, and he even made the bed before he left. Great neighbourhood, very private and was near a bus stop & close to restaurants!
I definitely would recommend this apartment, as there was also TV, kitchen, wifi, shower's! It was great. Thanks again Steve!!

I originally booked a stay because i wanted to stay in toronto for a day but a horrible weather circumstance wouldn't allow me to stay and had to cancel the stay on the day of. I would definitely love to stay at his place if i get a chance to stay in the future. Cheers!

Steve was a great host! Met us as we arrived and helped up with parking then gave us a tour of the place. His place is very true to pictures and the bed was extremely comfortable! Steve was just a quick message away if we needed anything and assured us to ask if there was anything at all but we found our stay without any concerns! Would highly recommend!
Great experience ! The apartment was very nice and clean. We had everything we needed and Steve was easy to get in contact with.  Absolutely no complaints !
Very nice experience and Steve host it very nicely
Really nice clean and quiet place. The host is really nice. And it has its own parking lot.

Steve was great he was there for all our needs and was very flexible, the place was clean and smelled good. My 2 sons 3 and 14 yr old loved it. It was perfect.

Steve was fantastic! My wife and I stayed for 3 days, 2 nights and it was perfect for what we needed. We could cook our own food and had a bright clean place to sleep. Would definitely stay here again and definitely recommend to others!
Steve was very prompt in his responses and his place was just as it looked in the pictures. I really liked the bathroom. Could not have asked for anything more

The accommodations fit the description and photos. We wanted a clean place to sleep before a 4:00 am departure for Pearson International Airport. It was a nice place and close to downtown. Liked it!

Steve was an amazing host! Very receptive and I never had an issue with response time. Location was amazing as well. Check in/ out was a breeze. Property is actually much nicer than pictures . Would 100% recommend staying!

Wonderful host! The room was as described, a bachelor/studio in the lower unit of a quiet house with a full kitchen and bathroom. Bright, cutely decorated and comfortable. Steve was so helpful, very accommodating and lovely company.

Steve is a great host. We just met once, but he was VERY available on phone ou IM. He helped in every little thing and we had a lovely welcome as we were celebrating our anniversary. Very good place and host.
Steve & his girlfriend were great! Great space, very enjoyable stay.

Steve greeted us when we got there and answered our questions and was always accessible by phone. It was perfect for a couple of nights and the restaurant selection nearby was great. Place was exactly as advertised and we really enjoyed our stay.

Everything was so good! Love the place!
Good place 👍🏼

Steve was a great host. He showed us the place when we arrived and showed us where to park. The place is perfect for a 1-2 night stay. Large bed with kitchenette and bathroom. We had no problems during our stay.
Steve was a great host, attentive and quick to respond. The location was perfect for us, close to public transit and the highway. Ideal for short stay trips. Thanks again!!
Great location. Many restaurants within walking distance and easy access to downtown. A nice quiet and cozy room.  Private but with the ability to contact Steve if need be.

Steve was an amazing host. Accommodated a late entry into the airbnb and made every effort to ensure we were settled in and our questions were answered!
Thank you Steve.

The place was in a great location and was very clean. Steve answered all my texts and questions as soon as possible and was very kind. He was very flexible with check-in and check-out times. It is a great place to stay if you're coming to Toronto (:
Great place to stay!! My boyfriend and I had a great time.

The area was perfect for us. We had a car so could easily drive around - only 15 minute drive to downtown. The apartment was great, really well kept and nicely renovated. It had everything we needed. Steve was a great, accommodating host - we had a few questions during our stay and he was always super quick to respond. Overall a really pleasant stay, would recommend.

Great place to stay! Quaint but spacious at the same time and had everything I needed. The coffee and chilled water was extremely appreciated! Steve is super quick to message, and accommodating. Great value for the place!
Great host! Central to everything!
Great value and convenient location.  Steve was quick with tips on getting around and greeted us with a refreshingly friendly smile.  Thanks!

great place to stay would recommend. cozy and welcoming home.

Steve’s was a great place for my wife and I to stay at. He was very helpful and came out to great us when we arrived. The location was close to public transportation which made getting around Toronto a breeze.

The place is awesome 👍🏻

I should start off the review by saying that as I was coming to Toronto for work (but used the Airbnb to meet up with friends for a night prior to my work trip) I was extremely busy leading up to my departure and so I didn't get in touch with Carlos until the day before my arrival. So I was perhaps not the ideal guest. That said, my stay was disappointing for several reasons. Firstly, Carlos tried to set up a time to meet us to hand over the keys, which was proving difficult as my friends had picked me up from the airport and we weren't exactly sure what time we would be at the house (we explicitly said this to Carlos too, as we didn't want him to be waiting around for us). It all got very complicated so he eventually said he would just leave the keys in a safety box outside the house, which made me wonder why he didn't just offer to do this from the beginning, as that surely would have been easier for all parties!Anyway, we got to the house (we found the door very hard to unlock / open) and as we entered were struck with how damp and musty it smelled (not surprising as its a basement with few windows). Then we had to figure out the parking situation (this is partly my fault as I had forgotten we would need a pass, which Carlos does say in his ad) but then we had to figure out signing up to the city site, paying, then sending the file to Carlos to print, etc. Overly complicated for a one night stay. Then, we realized Carlos hadnt left enough towels for the three of us (and I explicitly said three people would be staying) so then rather than him coming and dropping the towel off, we had to coordinate meeting up with him in the street so he could hand us a towel (which we then had to carry around with us as we were on our way to dinner). There also wasn't a duvet provided for the third person, there was a blanket but this was not sufficient in a cold, damp basement. Finally, as this is the bottom storey of the house, you could hear EVERYTHING happening above - footsteps, talking, music, etc. I was very glad I had earplugs. Positives were the bed was comfortable and the kitchen was well equipped, but other than that I was quite disappointed with the experience.

This was an excellent and comfortable apartment and Connie provided a lovely welcome pack for our late arrival. We used both car and public transport to get around and both worked well from venue. We enjoyed great weather so the lovely garden was welcome. A great host with lots of good recommendations.

An enjoyable week spent with great hosts.A very welcoming flat to return to after some very hot days of 30degrees.The back garden is a delightful place to spend time reading, relaxing and watching the squirrels.
Downtown is brilliant for a culture vulture and very accessible with the underground a few minutes walk away through a friendly park...look out for skunks in the evening! Be sure to tune in to Mark on the radio.
Hope all went well in Nova Scotia Connie.

Connie and Mark's apartment was lovely and comfortable in a great area of Toronto. We took up some of their suggestions for eating in the area and particularly liked The Wren for food and drinks. Mark kindly arranged a temporary parking permit for us and stocked the kitchen with fruit and muffins etc for our arrival. Because this is a basement apartment, there is inevitably a little bit of noise from daily life upstairs. The street is quiet and residential with an easy walk to the subway and lots of shops and places to eat.

Very cute, clean place. As others mentioned, there are areas that are very low- my friend, who is 5'10", hit her head a few times. But other than that, great value, and great location. We were able to walk to Danforth Music Hall and many restaurants. Connie and Mark are also great at communicating back to you if you have questions. Would definitely stay again. Can't beat the price for the location.

This apartment is very tastefully decorated. Many nice details. There was a nice supply of breakfast foods supplied and all was well planned. A very nice experience.
Mark and Connie were flexible and we felt welcomed.
I did bump my head twice until I got used to the low places in the ceiling. At 6 feet, there are places I had to duck.
However, a very nice, friendly place with attentive hosts overall. I would recommend it!
This is a quiet place to stay, perfect for exploring a busy city like Toronto!

What a great stay! The location is perfect, and the space is filled with nice little personal touches. Checking in was a breeze, and there were some great suggestions in the welcome binder (we personally loved visiting The Wren!).
Thank you, we had such a great time!

Earl Grey Gardens is a restful and quiet oasis just steps away from the vibrant Greektown section of the Danforth. While the photos are accurate, they don't fully capture how lovely the apartment is.
I appreciated all the little extra amenities and care taken with the décor. The lighting could be very bright or soft and intimate. Connie was very helpful with getting a parking permit and I never had any problems finding a space close by. I hope to stay here again on my next visit to the area.

We really enjoyed our stay at Connie's place. It is one of the best places we've  ever stayed (and we've travelled a lot), with all the little extras making it that much better. Check-in was a breeze, with Connie meeting us personally and taking us through the apartment and providing a run down of the local area. We were made to feel very welcome. The apartment was incredibly comfortable and the bed was like a cloud to sleep on! It's close to shops, great restaurants and the metro, making it really easy to get around the city. We would definately stay here again and would highly recommend it to others. Thanks again Connie for welcoming us into your and Mark's home.

The place is spacious and clean. Connie and Mark left a helpful book of places to get breakfast or dinner (we tried the Wren for dinner and it was delicious). They also left us a small loaf of banana bread which was delicious. The ceilings are quite short but it is specified in the description of the location. We would recommend this location to anyone who wants a nice, safe place to stay.

Pour ceux qui aiment vivre dans les quartiers chaleureux, là où vivent les habitants d'une ville, ce coin de Toronto est idéal. Tout était conforme à l'annonce, propreté des lieux irréprochable, accueil sympathique, facile, accès rapide aux transports en commun et plus services à distance de marche. Connie et Mark nous attendaient avec des fruits, du pain aux bananes, du café, tout le nécessaire pour cuisiner: superbe coin, lieu impec, accueil charmant.

Great place to stay while in Toronto..a home away from home. Close to all amenities; we walked, took the subway or Über.
Very cozy & comfortable... truly enjoyed the space, all the little “extras” & Connie’s helpfulness.
Would definitely recommend.
Connie's place is ideal for our family visits in Toronto.  Very comfortable and cozy and Connie herself is a lovely host.  We like it very much.

This place is wonderful. Clean, good location, and quiet. Connie and Mark were extremely responsive and everything was a described. If you’re tall (>5’9”), reconsider this apartment. The ceilings are low and I had to crouch in areas.

We really enjoyed our stay . Connie and mark were friendly and provided us with lots of recommendations in the area . The neighborhood was very diverse with lots of options for restaurants and bars. Transportation is close by and walkable . The apartment was stocked with some basics such as coffee and even banana bread which was made , thanks for that . The place was very cozy and clean and we enjoyed listening to the jazz music from the radio. We had a great time and really appreciate  all the hospitality! We highly recommend  and would stay here again

Connie is a great host and we enjoyed our stay in this lovely basement place. Everything was super nice, we were welcomed by the radio playing the jazz tunes when we arrived! There was fruit and a banana cake in the kitchen waiting for us, what else could we ask for?
Connie took the extra time to explain us the neighbourhood and the amenities, she was really helpful and responsive. The place is really cosy and I personally enjoyed the books on the history of Toronto and the Danforth village on the shelves. We feel sorry now that we forgot to sign the guestbook and definitely suggest future guests to stay at this beautiful house in this beautiful neighbourhood.

Had a wonderful time at Connie and Marks place, will definitely return. My only complaint was that it was quite warm but I usually don’t turn heat on at my place, lol. The ceiling height would be an issue for a taller gal or guy but I didn’t notice at all. Thanks again

우선 주인집 아랫층에 있는 완전 독립된 공간에서 지낸다는 점이 너무 편했습니다! 세탁/건조시설은 물론이고 기본적인 구비가 다 되어있었구요, 주방도 자유롭게 쓸 수 있어요. 반지하에 위치해 있지만 조명이 다양하게 많아서 전혀 어둡지 않아고, 무엇보다 동네도 정말 안전해보입니다. 시내에 왔다갔다 할 때 교통비가 들긴 하지만, 감안한다면 정말 가성비가 뛰어난 숙소에요! 비슷한 가격대의 호텔보다 훨씬 낫다고 생각!
i would definitely stay there again and it amazing cause it’s a cute cozy place..

Everything about this apartment more than met our expectations. Connie provided so many lovely touches that made it so homey. The bed is extremely comfortable and all the furnishings are comfortable. I would not hesitate to stay here again and recommend it to others.
Valerie

Love this quaint place! HEADS UP... you don’t need to head into downtown every night to get the Toronto experience. This place offers remarkable local pubs and restaurants. We wished we took more advantage of the nearby Danfourth street sights. Enjoy your stay!

Connie does a wonderful job making the place feel like a home away from home. The small touches around the house are very inviting and the house itself is very cozy, warm and welcoming. Would highly recommend!

This is a superb choice for those who want a cosy, quiet haven. Connie is an excellent host, very communicative and friendly. There are many small touches in this accommodation that make it a welcoming and comfortable stay — for us, it was the home-made banana bread, soft music, and lights on at arrival! Excellent local tips for those who want to explore the area. Thanks Connie :)

A great place to stay if you want a very authentic Toronto vibe feel! Connie and Mark have decorated the apartment to really make you feel like you’re living Toronto life. And there was great banana bread!

Lovely and well-equipped apartment, great neighbourhood, and Connie was a wonderful host - she responded quickly and gave us thoughtful extras like toys for my son.  Ceiling height is a bit low, as the listing says, but it was fine for us.
房间性价比一般，其实就是地下室。层高很低，男性高于1米7的都会撞到头。浴室没有大的垃圾桶，不方便女性顾客。另外还在浴室上方发现了一个大蜘蛛。但是房东夫妇二人很和善，还帮我们解决了停车的问题。

Connie and Mark's place is amazing.the neighbourhood is very quiet and a good spot to find silence and relaxation after a busy day in the city.The place actually has everything you are looking for,also nice muffins and fruits.I would book for sure the place again and highly recommand it.thanks Connie and Mark for your lovely hosting!take care,Cornelia
Wonderful place to say. Quaint, clean, great personal touches that made me feel so welcome. Just loved it. And close to a subway station too.
Awesome, cozy place. A great retreat from the busy city.
Awesome location in a great area! Connie was awesome with some local tips which really came in handy. Stylish space with all of the amenities you will ever need.
Please stay with Connie if you can! This place is very cozy, it has everything you would look for, and Connie has really good suggestions for the things you can do in Toronto :)

Earl Grey is a wonderfully comfortable apt with everything one would need to have a great stay.  We have stayed here before and really enjoy the space. The bed and pillows on the bed make for a very restful sleep.  I would highly recommend it.
Connie's place is amazing. Great location with access to restaurants, subway, and everything. A very cozy place in a quiet neighborhood. 100% recommended!;)
Would book again

Wonderful House and wonderful host in a Charming older neighborhood. This was my first Airbnb experience and it was amazing, everything in Connie and Mark's pictures just as good if not better than what was posted on their site. The only downside was the height in one area of the downstairs apartment, but it was still so Charming I could Overlook that with no problem.

If you ever get a chance to stay here, you should.  Connie  and Mark's place is located in a great little neighborhood, close to downtown Toronto.  The moment we walked in we were charmed.  Fresh baked cookies and fruit awaited us after a long 9 hour drive from Chicago.  There was tea, coffee, cream and yogurt too!  The accommodations were equally quaint and nicely decorated and felt so comfortable and welcoming - a keyless entry makes it easy to come in and out. Best of all--despite the fact that we arrived at a ridiculous hour - close to midnight - Mark came downstairs to say hello and make certain we had everything we needed.  AirBnB doesn't get much better than that.  Renata

Connie was an excellent host and was great at communicating, especially on arrival day and checking out. She provided lovely little touches such as shampoo in the bathroom, earplugs in the bedroom and a small amount of food for guests after a long day travelling. Which were all very helpful 😊 Lots of leaflets and a homemade guide were in the apartment providing a range of information on everything to do, see and eat in the city with great recommendations. My boyfriend and I stayed here for 12 nights and we had a lovely time.

There were some issues prior to arrival, and Connie responded to emails promptly - and pleasantly! She was also very helpful when I had some cell phone problems upon arrival.
I knew that I would need to get an on-street temporary parking permit, and was able to do so online from home quite easily. And, I was able to find street parking nearby every evening.
The Airbnb is in a quiet enclave near a nice public park, and is within easy walking distance to The Danforth. There is good access to the subway and Connie provides many recommendations for local restaurants and attractions.
I enjoyed my stay at Connie's and hope to stay again when visiting Toronto.

Connie' s place is cozy and well maintained. Nice touches and cool Toronto memorabilia. Nicely stocked kitchen and she even had some treats o wasn't expecting in the fridge. Short walk from danforth and Gerrard. Quiet location but close to local flavour(which she outlined ina great welcome packet) Low ceilings weren't a problem for me at 5'8". Would definitely recommend this place :)

Great cozy space. Perfect for an unexpectedly chilly April visit to Toronto. Location was quiet and very convenient. Felt like a home away from home! Would not recommend if you are over 6ft tall as it is a basement, but the low ceilings added to the feeling of comfort. Highly recommend.
A lovely cozy space! We had a very good time and enjoyed all the extras we got from Connie. Connie is a very friendly and helpful host, fast and easy communication!

There’s no way I can fault Connie’s place. She was extremely hospitable and gave us a lot of information about the Toronto area. Her place was neat, clean, and just what we needed for our visit to Toronto. Thanks Connie!
Amazing hidden treasure in the heart of Toronto

Connie & Mark's place is a fantastic apartment in a great quiet location. The apartment was bigger than we needed, and so much better than just another hotel.
Every amenity we could imaging was included, including freshly baked banana bread and jazz music to greet us.
As a couple on the shorter side, we enjoyed the lower ceilings, my husband saying he felt like a giant :-)
We were looking for a quiet, solitary get away for the weekend, so we could come and go and enjoy some quiet time, while getting around the city, and this place was perfect. Connie was communicative, but allowed us to self-check and get what we needed without too much contact (which sometimes when things are hectic at work you need) so it was really wonderful to be able to tailor how much interaction we needed.
Thanks again for the fantastic weekend, wonderful apartment. It is a great place to explore the wonders of Toronto, and see the diversity in neighborhoods, activities and opportunities.
Beth & Brad

Had a great stay and Connie's. The location is a bit out of the city but there is lots of transport options. Connie also had lots of small details that made the stay special, like her handmade guide to the local area and Toronto.  Thourghly recommend!

Connie's little apartment is the perfect space for a couple exploring Toronto. It is just a short walk through a very safe neighborhood and a scenic park to get the to Subway and anywhere in the city you may need to go. The apartment itself is clean, cozy and well-appointed. To be fair, as mentioned before, if you are a very tall person, you will probably not be comfortable here. My husband and I are both under 5'7" and had no problems with the low ceilings. Connie was an excellent host, always available to answer our questions and give us advice, but also gave us absolute privacy during our stay.  The apartment is a great value, and I would absolutely stay here again when visiting Toronto.

We really enjoyed our stay at Connie’s place. It’s a good size for a couple and really close to the subway. We even walked back from downtown a couple of days when it was sunny and took us just under an hour and a half and is a nice walk back.
Connie provided so much local information which was great and there were so many small touches such as the banana bread and the filtered water tap which were very much appreciated.
The low ceilings weren’t a problem for us as we’re on the shorter side. The noise we were warned about and for others (including my partner) wasn’t a problem but I’m a light sleeper and not a morning person so it may be something to bear in mind if you’re like me. There are earplugs but we didn’t find them until the final day.
On the whole, it’s a great place and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

The basement apartment was fab! Connie has a great folder with lots of helpful hints and tips and hand drawn map to help you get your bearings.
We had a great stay!
Wonderful place and convenient traffic. Everything needed is prepared, like home!

Connie's space was perfect for our long weekend trip to Toronto!  The subway is only a ten minute walk and the walk is extremely safe and easy to navigate. It was nice to have a cozy 'home' to come back to every night after our daily excursions. Connie also gives great recommendations for things to do as well, so don't just glance them over :)
Superb experience with extra touches like toiletries and home made muffins!  Connie was responsive and helpful.  Best AIrbnb experience I've had.
Connie went above and beyond during our stay. She made us feel at home and her place is really cozy with all the amenities you could ask for. We enjoyed Toronto and will make sure to stay again.

Clean, safe, cozy place close to public transportation. Neighbourhood is friendly with great parks and ample nearby amenities. We especially appreciated the use of the lovely backyard garden, washer/dryer, restaurant recommendations, and excellent communication with our hosts.

The apartment is very clean and extremely cozy. It's really close to public transportation and the neighbourhood is quiet and friendly. There are a washer and dryer and a lovely backyard. Unfortunately we didn't meet Connie but she left all instructions needed for us, so everything worked out.
Heimelige Wohnung - Decken niedrig - da Kellerwohnung etwas dunkel - sehr hübsch eingerichtet.

Muito melhor do que o esperado! Lugar aconchegante, super bem decorado e bem localizado!!! Connie e Mark são extremamente solícitos! Se você tiver a chance de se hospedar nesse lugar, não desperdice isso!
Much better than expected! Cozy place, well decorated and well located!!! Connie and Mark are extremely helpful! If you have the chance to stay in this place, do not waste it!
Great place to stay!! Recommend it!

Great little basement apartment in Greek Town, very close to a tube station which takes you to the centre of Toronto in 20 minutes. Lovely quiet neighbourhood with lots of restaurants etc. Connie was a great host, very helpful and friendly. The apartment itself had everything you would need and more.
Super logement, très bien, à proximité des transports en commun. Plafond un peu bas, attention pour les grands, jolie appartement, très bien équipé !

A beautiful place to stay. Close to Subway and the Greek Neighborhood. Everything you need is provided and Connie is great.
Would stay again

Eine Unterkunft, die mit 5 Sternen unterbewertet ist! Connie und Mark haben haben sehr viel Liebe und Mühe in jedes Detail gesteckt. Obwohl wir nicht die Möglichkeit hatten, die beiden persönlich kennen zu lernen, haben wir die Gastfreundschaft wirklich gespürt.
Als wir ankamen, war das Licht und das Radio an, der Kühlschrank war mit einer "Erstausstattung" bestückt, wir fanden ein ausführliches und mühevoll gestaltetes Buch mit Hinweisen, Wegbeschreibungen, Tipps und Empfehlungen vor.
Bad, Küche, Wohn- und Schlafraum waren liebevoll hergerichtet und sehr sauber und ließen keine Wünsche offen.
Die Earl Grey Road liegt sehr gut angebunden zur Ubahn, in einem ruhigen, freundlichen Viertel in Toronto. Unweit zu Fuß kann man die Danforth Avenue erreichen, in der man Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Bars, Restaurants und die Ubahn findet.
Alles in Allem bezahlt man hier wirklich keinen Cent zu viel für eine stimmige, gastfreundliche Wohnung und Umgebung. Alle Daumen hoch!
This is a great place to stay in Toronto if you don’t want to be downtown.   Close to the subway and lots of restaurants...

This was our first Airbnb experience, and it was a great one! Connie's place was exactly as described; cute, cozy, clean! The bed was incredibly comfortable which was so nice as someone with a very sensitive back!  It was a great location close to many restaurants. We had our car and found it very easy to go into downtown and find parking. We would suggest going to The ROM! The ceilings are low in areas, as warned. This wasn't a problem for me until I tried to shower, at 5'4" I had to duck a bit to wash my hair! Not a big deal, but just an added note :) The only downside was the weather didn't allow us to take advantage of her adorable back yard!  Overall we had a great time!! Would recommend this place for sure!

Connie and Mark’s place was amazing. It was very cozy, clean and equipped with everything we needed. We actually thought their post and photos did not do it justice. The place was much nicer than we expected. It’s also very close to the subway and restaurants. Definitely a recommended stay!

Connie was a perfect host and was very accommodating and welcoming upon arrival. She offered us some great tips for the area and was very quick to respond with any questions we had via email/airbnb.
The appartment itself was fantastic. We felt right at home straight away. The space was spacious with lots of thoughtful touches throughout. We especially loved the old style radio in the kitchen.
Cooking was easy and enjoyable. There was plenty of utensils provided, as well as a proper fridge and oven and stove unit. There was even a washer and dryer available for us to use on the utility room which was a great bonus!
The bedroom and lounge areas were relaxing and comfortable. Plenty of space in the bathroom too with full working bath and shower.
The neighbourhood was really nice too. Bars and coffee shops within walking distance, and the subway station not far away either.
Thank you for such a wonderful stay!
Sam and Kate
Awesome place in a beautiful area in Toronto. It was easy to get in and is pet friendly which is very important to my Fiancé and I. Thank you Connie!

Un excellent accueil de Connie qui nous a donné toutes les explications nécessaires pour passer un bon séjour. Nous avons également apprécié la nourriture nécessaire pour déjeuner, etc. Appartement très propre et bien situé près du métro.

Unfortunately our stay was quite short so we didn't get to enjoy this lovely space for long. Connie's sweet getaway in a great location was cozy and comfortable. Super clean with everything that you would need. Very nicely decorated in a cottage style with interesting vintage items and Toronto themed art. We went to a show at the Danforth Music Hall which was about a 20 minute walk away. So many great restaurants to choose from near by on Danforth. Nice and close to the subway. A note to those over 5'8" tall - ceilings are low due to it being a basement suite. It suited us just fine.
Great place and extremely accommodating​ hosts.
A quaint little apartment fully furnished under their house with all the amenities and a cozy, welcoming environment!
Recommend staying here. Excellent hosts.

This convenient, cozy destination is absolutely perfect for anyone trying to get the full Torontonian experience. The restaurants and bars in the immediate area can easily keep you entertained but the metro being just a few stops away makes the city just as easily accessible. Highly recommend!

Everything was great! Connnie’s place was very comfortable and cute. Right near a bunch of food and shops. Perfect for a couple getaway in Toronto. It does have low ceilings, which is in the description. But if your not tall it’s no problem.

Connie's place was the perfect little haven for us during our stay in Toronto. Close to the subway, quiet neighbourhood, and a private entrance to a cozy space with lots of art & amenities to feel at home. I definitely recommend.

We had a fantastic stay at Connie’s place in Toronto.
The house itself is brilliant. It has absolutely everything you could want and so much more. Very well set up. Cosy and comfortable, with a great bed, we slept great.
The location is superb for exploring Toronto. That bit out of the city centre, but so close to a subway station, that within minutes, you are on a train heading in to the centre. The Main Street that is close to Connie’s home is brilliant. It has everything you could want and need. From bars, restaurants, shops and convenience stores.
We are planning going back to Toronto next year, and would absolutely stay at Connie’s place again.
Highly recommend.
Thank you so much for a great stay.
Great place away from home. Connie & mark response swiftly with all the problems during my stayed.

This place is beautiful, and have everything you would want for a home away from home. I felt like I was staying at a cottage, with everything you need. Immediately felt at home. Our stay was short, but would stay again any time!
Very nice place in a great location.
Super 5-star basement. It was a joy! Very attentive hosts, that addressed everything!
I have stayed at Connie's several times, and it is always perfect. Clean and comfortable place, great location, and, most importantly, good sleeps!

Connie and Mark are very kind. I felt totally welcomed. I have sincerely appreciated their help. The house is lovely, the "apartment" is very comfy; it is like a family home. The neighbourhood is very nice and convenient; the houses architecture of the street is beautiful. If you are a morning late sleeper, you may hear a little noise from the dog upstairs...but it did not bother me, it was not noisy....and  I wake-up early:)

In an effort to pursue happiness I visited Toronto in January and found a lot of comfort in Connie's apartment. Decent sized rooms, comfy beds and couch, a warm welcome (and warm house), and all round greatness made this a wonderful world from which to make a base. Nestled in Greektown it made meeting friends for lunch as easy as picking a great local restaurant to eat in and only a 20 min walk to the Danforth Music Hall (where I saw one of the greatest bands ever play a phenomenal gig) it really is in a perfect location. Easy to find by car and also by walking from the closest metro station its a gem of a place.
I would gladly visit again when the next reason to visit Toronto comes up, which I hope is soon.

*** Perfect stay, great location, great place, right near transport & places to eat/drink etc***
We stayed at Connie's place upon entering Canada for the first time after securing work permits.
After a long trip through the sky and then the Toronto Visa office we were looking forward to getting to a place we could just kick back for the evening.
When we arrived Connie was waiting for us with a big warm welcome and showed us to her place.
I was so excited to see that the Wreath from the photos was still up to give me that christmassy feeling! As soon as I got into the space I knew it was perfect for our week!
Connie sat down with us for 10 mins or so and talked us through her folder of things to do which contained advise on wear to eat, maps for the subway etc. It was nice to meet Connie and we knew we'd be looked after. We didn't see her after but she was on the end of the phone whenever we needed help. We like that we were left to our own devices, it's something we look for when booking a place!
The first room is a quaint, perfectly sized kitchen with fridge freezer, kettle, ample tea & coffee options and also a fresh water tap on the sink. Also a table and 2 chairs for enjoying your breakfast on!
The first thing I noticed were the fresh cookies Connie had left for us which was a really lovely touch!
The next room is the lounge area again a nice comfortable size with 2 comfy sofas and a coffee table as well as an electrical fire which comes in handy during the winter nights. there was plenty of things to read, playing cards as well as calming colouring books. Also a good television with plenty of channels (specifically the sports channel for us playing english premier league games) There were also plenty of DVDs to choose from including trilogies, tv series, comedies, music concerts (Pink Floyd, The Band, The Rolling Stones)
The bathroom was very clean with a good shower and a full length mirror. connie provided plenty of toilet role as well as shampoo & conditioner if you want to avoid packing that.
Another really useful thing was the laundry unit she had which is in another room next to the bathroom, in this space she had plenty of spare pillows, blankets etc.
The bedroom was again very comfortable and a fine size for 2 people with a dressing table and mirror. The bed was super comfortable as I think it was memory foam mattress and memory foam pillows!
In Connies description she mentions the low ceiling, this is basically an air vent that runs from the entrance through the living and is about half a metre wide but unless you stand directly under that you won't have a problem. I am nearing 6ft and this wasn't a problem for me at all, I just made sure to mind my head when entering either room.
We had a really wonderful stay at Connies place, it was the perfect space to come to after a long day and it was near plenty of local restaurants on Danforthone we highly recommend would be the Greenwood Smokehouse BBQ. It was also a short walk to the subway to link you to where ever you need to go.
Connie was a delight and she was really helpful as we were getting set up with bank accounts etc.
Highly recommend to anyone travelling to Toronto!

Stay here! This little apartment is amazing, close to everything like restaurants, the subway station, corner stores, parks and overall great neighborhood! Very safe place and sooo clean. We loved absolutely everything about it!  The French press coffee maker was a life changer and this home has everything you need and more! Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a true home away from home!
We had a lovely stay at Connie’s. The location was excellent and Connie’s map and recommendations for places in the neighbourhood to visit were much appreciated. Would certainly recommend!

Connie is a lovely person. She is very kind, attentive and will always make you feel at home. Moreover, she was available to answer to our questions and help us when we need it, that is the reason why me and my daughter were very happy and thankful during our stay at her gracious and comfortable house. It was really a pleasure to meet Connie and great to "live" at her home for 2 weeks.
Super cool place with great location. You can't go wrong choosing Mark's and Connie's place
The place is super nice and cozy. Located in the Greek town and is close to subway and bus station. The hosts offered a lot of great tips. They were absolutely amazing!
Brilliant place! Would not hesitate to stay again
Great location and Great Host!

Earl Grey Gardens is cute and cozy. The hosts are super thoughtful, from the welcoming banana bread, to the well-equipped tiny kitchen, to the notebook chock-full of local information. It was the perfect base for us while visiting friends in the neighborhood, exploring Greektown on Danforth Street, and sightseeing in downtown Toronto using the convenient subway line.
Outstanding little place.  Very nice touches.  Super cozy.  Extremely comfortable bed.  Very low ceilings for taller folk.
Mark and Connie were great hosts. The space was terrific and it felt warm and cosy. Only caution is if you're really tall - you might hit your head on the ceiling.

Great location. So many great restaurants and bars within walking distance. Right on the subway line. Connie's place is cozy, clean,  and nicely decorated. Lots of thoughtful touches like coffee, cream and snacks and they took care of our parking permit.  Very comfy bed. Just know that the ceilings are really low in places you and can hear the family overhead.

My partner and i enjoyed a lovely stay at connie's place. It was warm and inviting and filled with an atmosphere that is reminiscent of home. Connie provided everything that anyone would need when travelling abroad. Thank you connie for making our 10 day stay such a memorable experience!

Connie and her place are very nice. My husband and I felt welcome immediately! She had great tips and recommendations for the area.
Just like other reviewers said the place is a garden level and has low ceilings - but it didn’t bother us all that much.
Le logement est vraiment propre et Connie a été très attentionnée et chaleureuse. Super séjour.

Connie and Mark have a lovely basement apartment on offer. I was delighted by all the small touches you don’t get when someone is just renting out their spare room—a variety of coffee and tea options, snacks, neighbourhood food recommendations, cable TV, even multiple soap choices! Hotel-style ameneties in a cozy neighbourhood space. The Danforth is a classic Toronto neighbourhood with lots on offer, and the house is about an 8-minute walk to the subway through lovely streets. One caution that the ceilings are low—I am 5’2” and I could touch them! Height restrictions aren’t a concern for me but tall people may feel oppressed. Otherwise, great space, people and dogs.

Overall Impressions:
I stayed at Katya's for 4 nights. The apartment was clean, quiet, and matched the pictures exactly. It would be difficult to find a nicer / closer AirBnB for the price of Katya's.
Apartment:
The apartment comes with a queen bed (which was quite comfortable). There is also a desk and dresser, which were greatly appreciated. The temperature and light in the unit made for a comfortable night's sleep. A dehumidifier in the bathroom keeps the humidity down, which is great for hot days in the summer. Being a basement unit, there were occasional noises from upstairs, but nothing excessive or bothersome. I noticed that some parts of the basement have low ceilings (particularly the stairs and one area of the bathroom). I'm 5' 10" and didn't have any difficulties with regards to height. However, I imagine the height could be a minor inconvenience for anyone over 6' 2".
Privacy:
One of the things I appreciated most was privacy. The apartment has a separate entrance around the side of the house with a key lock. The bedroom in the basement also has a door with a key lock. There is shared laundry in the kitchen area but it was never used during my stay. My interactions with the host (Katya) were limited to check-in and check-out, so it felt like I had the unit completely to myself.
Transportation:
I commuted via subway to/from the financial district in downtown Toronto for work each day. I was able to get downtown within 30–40 minutes of leaving the apartment (10 minute walk to the subway + 20–30 minute subway ride). If you have a vehicle / plan on driving, parking was available on a nearby street. I was able to find a parking spot that was just around the corner from the apartment.

I honestly don't know what to write about my experience, but I will state the issues that I encountered.
I booked the place since the host is a Superhost on Airbnb and had good reviews. When the host accepted the booking, he mentioned that he is away in Europe and I would need to coordinate with his roommate. On the day of checking in, I had to let myself in because the roommate had messaged me saying he was supposedly "not feeling well". When I did meet him a while after checking in, he was sort of dazed and disoriented and held a glass is his hand. The roommate mentioned that he too had just moved in earlier on that day and had paid for 2 months of accommodation to the host while he is away. I was not sure of what to make of the situation at that time. I went out for a quick lunch and came back to find the place was smelling of alcohol and that led me to believe that he was drinking. I started feeling very uncomfortable since this is not one would expect at any accommodation (be it a hotel or Airbnb) for which you have paid a significant amount of money.
I got in touch with the host and asked when he was actually returning and also I got in touch with Airbnb immediately trying to explain all the issues. The host did not respond till much later and all he had to state was that the guy was his roommate. This lack of clarity was enough and I started searching for another accommodation. The Airbnb customer agent got in touch with the host and it seems he denied that his roommate drinks at all. The host clearly has a "no partying or events" in the house rules. Does that apply only for the guests?
I communicated to the host that I am not comfortable and would be checking out and he did not send me any response at all. I got to know from the Airbnb customer service agent that the host also refused to refund my payment since it was my choice to move out. The Airbnb agent, while trying to be helpful, said that it's up to the host to accept and initiate any refund. I spent the night without unpacking my stuff and I frantically searched for a new place and moved out the next morning.
The Airbnb support said they would need some evidence like photos or videos to prove my claims. How would I provide evidence of alcohol smell? Also, it's not as if I would keep a camera on all the time to record what everyone does around me all the time. I am very annoyed at how this whole experience turned out to be. The host could have at least acknowledged that something was not right and should have agreed to refund most of the amount, if not all of it. After all, there should be some consideration about how a guest has to deal with the overall experience of the place. I do acknowledge that some guests expect the sun and the moon, but this was a real issue that I highlighted.
Apparently, since the policies are in favor of the host, there is no incentive for them to accept any of this and can retain the money since this was a long term booking. I, on the other hand, had to move out for my own sanity since I could not spend a month at the place. I moved to another place where I am feeling comfortable. Now I have to deal with the support staff again trying to get my money back, and I know it's a lost cause due to the policies in place. The agent I spoke with previously mentioned that they can just refund the Airbnb service fee and the decision to refund the other portion will need to be taken by the host.
Again, the whole intention of this review is to ensure that other guests do not have to face such incidents. I am sure that the host trusts his friend, who is staying there in his absence, and he expects him to be on his best behavior. But there should be some trust placed on the guest as well, especially when the host himself is not around at all, and I strongly feel that the host could have dealt with this in a better way. Anyways, it's just my bad luck to have come across this place.

That was solved on the third day when Hyla’s husband helped to remove the air-conditioner from the window and closed up the window properly, which stopped the strong currents of cold air coming into the room. The apt was quite warm in the following days.
Another thing we noticed is that there are no microwave or dishwasher in the kitchen. This is accurate in the apt description so it was my bad to neglect that and just assumed there are such amenities available. It was inconvenient for us to reheat any food, but again, that was my negligence. Separately the water kettle provided didn’t work so I used a pot to boil hot water for tea during the whole week.
One thing that didn’t get solved was that WiFi was quite spotty during our stay. Not sure if this was something noticed by previous guests but somehow it quite an issue during our stay. Often time I couldn’t send or receive emails on my phone so I needed to fall back on my international data roaming plan. It is nice that there’s a big TV in house and Netflix is available; however it can buffer 4-5 times during a 20-30min show due to weak WiFi signals, if not more often. So frankly speaking WiFi was a bit frustrating. Hyla did try her best to help by rebooting the router a couple of times (the router is upstairs in Hyla’s home, not in the apt), but that didn’t seem to solve the issue during our stay unfortunately.
We’ve stayed in Airbnb apts across multiple continents and we value reading honest and accurate reviews which was the reason I described the above in good detail.
Overall despite the above, I don’t want to bias anyone—Hyla’s apt is very nice to stay and we like the neighborhood very much. Hyla is very helpful and responsive as a host. All said above is that there are some minor issues to take note/fix, which would have perfected the stay for us. I would still give a 9/10 for Hyla’s place. Thanks for hosting, Hyla!
