The house itself has lot of amenities and is super private on 3 levels with a stunning view of Downtown from the own rooftop. It was just too cold to use it haha… the Toronto weather in November was cooooold ;-)
Konstantin is super supportive and kind as well!
Would definitely recommend to stay here!

Great location…walkable to all the shops on Queen St and Kensington Market. The exterior of the home reminded us of being in Europe, it was very charming! The interior was nice and clean, overall a great stay!

The location was perfect. It was in walking distance to everything and the view from the top level was amazing. It was easy to find but most of the doors have black lock boxes so giving the number on the mailbox would make it easier to find. Besides that, I would highly recommend.
Great place to stay to explore queen and college and everything in between.
We had a great stay at Konstantin’s place. The location was super convenient and walkable to plenty of amazing food spots. Konstantin was a great host and very accommodating.

This was a perfect stay, close to so much within walking distance.  The townhouse was well appointed, the views from the rooftop were sublime, and the street was quiet. We loved the easily accessible parking area. All in all we would not hesitate to stay here in the future. Highly recommended!

Konstantin's was a great home base for my husband and my first visit to Toronto. We were able to walk to bars, restaurants, and it was close to street car stops to get to other parts of town. His house was clean, easy to find, and looked just like the pictures of the home utilizing vertical space. We enjoyed being able to pop up on the roof to see the skyline and CN Tower. The parking spot included in the rental was very much appreciated.

We wanted a place that was located walking distance to Queen West neighborhood as well as to the lakefront, and this place was perfectly located.  Lots of great restaurants in walking distance, as well as a couple beautiful parks, and a short drive or longer walk to other enjoyable sights like the St. Lawrence Market and Distillery district.
awesome stay in a really nice place
Stayed here for 3 days for a quick trip to Toronto. Excellent place that met all my needs. Great central location. Would highly recommend.
Beautiful townhouse in walking distance to so many attractions.
Excellent location, near Kensington, Spadina, and multiple streetcar lines for good access to the city. Comfortable furnishings, diverse and active and walkable neighborhood. Would stay again.

Great location and a lovely place!
Konstantinos is a friendly host and the instructions to his place was perfect for our needs!
Looking forward to staying there again!

We were staying due to a medical emergency with our daughter.  Konstantin's place was perfect.   Easy walk to the hospital and many good restaurants in walkable distance, too.  Communication was straight forward and quick.  Made a stressful time easier for us.

Another excellent stay with Konstantin.
He is a great host, very responsive and proactive!
The AirBnB is a quiet haven in the middle of the city centre of Toronto and has all the amenities that it mentions in the descriptions.
We could easily walk to all the restaurants, bars, clubs and attractions but still get back to relax in a very quiet neighbourhood and peaceful home.
It was a perfect stay for us and would recommend this place for couples looking for all things to see into Toronto and in be at home!

Great spot in a highly desirable location that’s very close to many trendy restaurants, bars and other tourist attractions.
Konstantin is a phenomenal host whose clear and concise instructions made checking in and out a breeze.
Konstantin’s place was fantastic - a true gem. The neighborhood was convenient to everything, and the space made for a perfect, quiet retreat after a long day of exploring.
Lovely stay in a house that has a fantastic view of the CN Tower
Great townhouse in a excellent location. Easily walkable to restaurants and attractions.
Condo was great. Everything was clean. It was nice having underground parking. There were plenty of TV streaming services.  The rooftop balcony was great!!!
Wonderful location in a walkable city. Great view from the rooftop. Quiet at night. We had a great time in Toronto.

Konstantin’s place was great! It was clean, comfortable and had everything we needed. It’s a nice, central location near restaurants and very active area. The streetcar/bus stop is right on the corner so extremely convenient. We definitely recommend it!

Perfect home base from which to explore Toronto! We were able to walk, bike or take public just about anywhere within the downtown area with ease. If you do need to drive somewhere, the on-site parking makes things so much easier when you return. Home itself was very nicely appointed and clean. Definitely recommend!

Konstantin went above and beyond to help us make sure the garage would work for our truck, sent pictures and everything. It was slightly confusing to find the place in the complex but then everything was super easy and perfect for our stay.
I had a great time in Toronto the accommodation was perfect for me. Great location, lovely surroundings. Lisa

Konstantin was a responsive and helpful host.  My sister and I really enjoyed our stay.  The townhouse was very clean and in a great location.  The bed was very comfy as well!  My only piece of feedback is that more bath towels are needed, but that's an easy fix.  I'd definitely recommend Konstantin's place to other travelers and would stay there again :)
Spotless! Very handy to have assigned parking
Konstantin’s place was exactly as described. Check in was easy and instructions were very clear. The home was exactly as described and very clean.
great place to stay with lots to do nearby

Very nice week-long stay in Toronto and Konstantin provided a great place to stay. Was a solid stay for two people coming in internationally. Fair warning, those carpet stairs are slippery with socks!

We had a great stay at Konstantin’s place for a week. The host was responsive and communicative. The place was very clean and comfortable as well. It’s an easy walk to the queen west street and Chinatown both of which have a lot of good restaurants and shops, so the place is great for walking to different places without the need of public transport.

I had a very disappointing experience at this property. The area is surrounded by homeless encampments, and it’s impossible to go for a walk without encountering people openly using drugs. I had an unsettling incident where someone forced their way into the garage as I was exiting. When I notified the host, they said there was nothing they could do. The house itself was underwhelming, a small stacked townhouse, spread between four levels. Several cabinets were locked, and it was poorly stocked with basic essentials — I had to purchase many items that are normally provided in an Airbnb. There were also small bugs running around inside; the rooftop space was dirty and not usable as advertised. To make matters worse, after my stay, the host repeatedly messaged me trying to blame me for a broken washing machine, which was both frustrating and unfair. Overall, I would not recommend this place. There are serious safety concerns and the overall experience was far below expectations.

I would highly recommend the apartment.  The description is very accurate.  There are 2 floors and an outside upper deck.  Everything is well maintained and very clean.  The location is great. The underground parking space is a definite plus.  It is only a couple blocks from Queen Street which has an incredible number of restaurants and bars.  Kensington Market is nearby as is the U of T.  Konstantin is a great host and is readily accessible.

We really enjoyed the location with easy walking distance to museums and places to eat. The place was really clean and communication was excellent. Small issues but I would recommend a bedside table on both sides of the bed with reading lights and some area lighting, not just overhead lighting in the living room, and a rubber mat in the tub for showering as it felt slippery (otherwise the shower was excellent!)
. The place is small but otherwise has what you need. There are a lot of stairs so be prepared for that.
I loved the place. The surrounding area of the townhome was so serene and peaceful. Konstantine was very helpful and communicative. I would highly recommend his place!

Konstantin's place was great! It's in a very nice location walkable to a ton of restaurants. Konstantin is very responsive to any inquiries and generally a pleasant host. We'll definitely consider staying here again.
This place was exactly as described, great location for us. Air conditioning was great and much needed at night. We will be back.

Great accommodation in a great location. Plenty of space and added bonus of the rooftop terrace.
Would definitely stay again.

We very much enjoyed our stay in Konstantin’s townhouse. It was fun to be very near to Queen Street West with so many shops and restaurants!
I hadn't realized in advance that I should get the garage pass from inside Konstantin’s townhouse before trying to drive into the garage. A helpful neighbor opened the garage door for me.
Really nice place to stay. close enough to Queen St and Kensington to enjoy everything, but far enough away to be quiet and peaceful.
Location was great. The place was clean. Bed was comfortable.

Great place to stay if visiting Toronto. Location had us in good proximity for walking and driving to and from sights as well as local eateries and the supermarket, which we used a lot during our trip. Konstantin was very communicative and accomodating when the complex had repair work on the garage driveway on a couple of different days. Very clean and quiet complex, which is great to come "home" to after long days of touring. Not far from the entertainment, financial districts, or the shore.
This was a fantastic base for exploring Toronto.

This is a great location, with all essentials in walking distance - grocery/pharmacy/restaurants/TTC.
As a single woman, I felt safe in the neighbourhood.
The condo itself has a LOT of stairs and narrow stairways.
The small front entry way makes it tricky to get your belongings in the door and up the stairs, especially if you're fat. Once up the first flight of stairs it gets easier to navigate and is a nice little condo with a great view from the balcony - it feels private.
It was missing some of the things that I expect: full length mirror, throw blanket on the couch, lamp in the livingroom (to avoid overhead lights), privacy curtains in the livingroom.
Unfortunately, there was a heat wave and the AC stopped working properly - it made it miserable to climb all the stairs, and each level more hot.
The host was very responsive, brought me a fan, and called a technician try to fix it.
It was not fixed while I was there, so I had to relocate and received $ compensation.
Great location and clean, thank you for letting us stay.
The location and accommodation were ideal. Very pleasant stay.
Konstantin's place had everything I needed and is in a fantastic location. Konstantin was very helpful and accommodating. I have no problem recommending this apartment.

Beautiful apartment. Packed with everything needed for a comfortable stay. Excellent location close to shops and restaurants. And very close to the centre of Toronto without having to stay in the hustle and bustle of a city centre.
Konstantin is an amazing host. Very responsive, helpful, and accommodating.
Can't recommend enough.

Had a great stay at Konstantins place, really comfortable, cosy, warm with everything we needed. the parking was great and we loved the bohemian neighborhood with lots of great options for food. We walked everywhere in Toronto but there's lots of public transport options on your doorstep, and if you wanted a ride back it was only $8 in an Uber from the CN Tower.
The only reason we didn't give this a 5 star rating was the roof terrace was out of bounds for repairs which we only found out last minute which was a shame as we had great weather (for October), but other than that we would definitely recommend.

Totally loved this place and would definitely stay here again! SO clean, all amenities available (seriously, kitchen had everything one needs), and more. Clean appliances, utensils, towels, sheets, cleaning supplies, etc. Loved the small touches, such as the Keurig machine fully filled with fresh water.  John ensured that my preferred breakfast food was available, including water, juice, & milk. John was available for any questions, when needed. Very easy to get to Pape subway station, the bus stop is 1 minute walk away and the wait is a few minutes at most, or you can walk about 12 minutes to the station. Easy to check in, liked the easy-to-use keypad for suite entrance, access to his movies & video games (PS3), brand new bathroom, all the finishing touches were available to make my stay very comfortable, enjoyable, and relaxing. Thanks John!

I highly recommend Jonh´s place! The house is pretty clean, comfortable, beatiful and has everything that you need. The location is the best, just 5 min by bus to Pape subway station. Jonh is very helful and kind, always asking if everything was ok and if I needed something. When I got in the place he had already bought the breakfast, which was very kind of him!

Overall on OK stay. The place itself was nice and modern. I found the host a bit lacking, in particular he wasn't too keen to assist (and didn't) when I had an issue with the wifi and when the remote stopped working. You're treated more like a tenant here - given the high cost of this place, I expected quite a bit more in the way of hospitality. Not enough toilet paper provided for the whole stay and some issues with bugs (bitten twice and multiple centipedes) which the host brushed off as well. The host's wife was kind to bring candles over when the electricity went out though.

I can't recommend John's place enough! It's spotless, modern, great location, every amenity you could need. John is an amazing host- he will give you all the privacy you need but will reply to you in a minute if you need anything. Thank you John! I will be staying again :)

The place is amazing,  comfortable, clean, modern, all furniture is new and have everything you need include the details, in the my opinion is very important. New from Subway Station, have a lot of options the Supermarket and Restaurants. I recomend this unit.
Good place to stay. Good lcomunication. The place is sparkly clean and cozy. There were coffee, tea, milk, bread, fruit and pretty much everything you need! John is really a very good host.

It's just a wonderful apartment. Very clean, bright, stylish and comfortable. Excellent location right in the center of Toronto. Thanks to Natasha, she always answers very quickly and gives detailed instructions!
Natasha's place is beautiful, clean and in the perfect location for a lovely weekend in the heart of the city!

Natasha's apartment was welcoming and very comfortable. It was just like being at home. The bed was very comfortable. Anything we needed was there. Nice big windows to look out at the world and see the lake in the distance. Such a convenient spot. We walked wherever we went but public transport is just at the front door, food shopping and restaurants close by. It was perfect for us

Staying at Natasha's place was awesome. It was in the center of everything we needed. She was a great host. Very helpful and always quick to answer any questions. She was very accommodating and the place was very clean

The location of Natasha's space was very central to majority of eating places in Toronto.
She was very helpful in suggesting places to eat, sights to see, as well as answered as promptly as she could. The bed in Natasha's apartment was super comfortable, and the couch was just as comfy. Would highly recommend to those looking for a space that is in close proximity to Toronto attractions!
The location is great for restaurants and bars. It is vey busy in the evenings but you don't hear anything inside. The bed is very comfortable.
Great host. Plenty of communication and everything was explained clearly. Amazing location and lots of car parking close by.
Great location, right at King +Bathurst. Balcony for fresh air. Comfortable bed, and sofa!

Natasha is a wonderful host and she made sure my stay was comfortable and enjoyable. Her residence is walking distance to many of the main attractions
of Toronto including the nightlife. I would definitely recommend Natasha to host my next visit to Toronto!!

Me and my girlfriend were so pleased with our stay at Natasha's place. The place was set up exactly as it was in the photos and was very clean upon our arrival. She even provided us with towels and some extra toiletries. She definitely made our stay very comfortable and responded to any of our requests or questions right away. Definitely would stay here again!

Natasha's apartment was very well located in downtown Toronto - convenient to groceries, restaurants, microbreweries, Fort York, the waterfront, Chinatown etc.  It was very spacious for 2 people and she provided lovely linens and amenities like shampoo and conditioner.  The check-in and check-out were convenient and easy.  Natasha was a great host - even offering to ship me a clothing item that I accidentally left behind.

It is in a great location, easy to find and was easy to get the key. I arrived late  because of my flight and it wasn’t an issue. The place is cute, modern and spacious. Walkable to get to the downtown area. It was a great stay!
Fun location! Not the most comfortable beds and no AC.

The best part about this place was the location! It’s right in the center of downtown, so many food and drink options. The view from the balcony is amazing! I wanted to move in. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants to explore Toronto. And Natasha is super nice and accommodating.

This was our second time staying at Natasha’s for a weekend and once again were very satisfied with our stay. We were provided all the amenities that we needed and the A/C worked perfectly. The place was very clean as well. Definitely looking forward to staying here again :)

We had a great stay at Larry's house. The house was recently renovated and is beautiful. Downstairs with living room, dining room and kitchen and upstairs two bedrooms and the bathroom. Little yard outside for the kids to play. Very well furnished and equipped. They even put toys and games for our kids to play with! We had everything we needed for our family. The area is great near the subway and Bloor St with restaurants and shops. Larry and his family were great host and live next door so they are easily available if needed. Thanks for a great stay in Toronto!
A beautiful home and a great host thank you Larry ,  our visitors absolutely love staying at your home

I've stayed at many Airbnb homes over the years and Larry's place is by far the nicest. Everything was immaculate and the space is beyond beautiful. This was really my dream midcentury modern house with every aesthetic detail considered. It is one of those spaces that makes you feel inspired, productive, and calm all at once. I can't recommend it highly enough. Plus, Larry and his family are incredibly sweet and helpful. I'll be staying there next visit to Toronto!

A wonderful place in the heart of The Annex.
Larry went above and beyond to ensure our comfort.
Highly recommended!

The house is beautifully decorated and great for a family. It is situated far off the main roads so it's quiet and safe, but a 5 minute walk to convenience stores,coffee shops, and subway lines.  Larry was available for any issues and super friendly!! Would definitely stay again on our next trip to Toronto!

This place is amazing - a true gem in the city!  The location is fantastic.  Close to transit, dining, sights, this historic neighbourhood is at once urban and serene.  Larry and his family are great hosts and went above and beyond to ensure our family had a comfortable stay.  We loved the decor and appointments of this house and found all we needed was taken care of.  We highly recommend!!

This delightful house, tucked away in urban Toronto, is a dream. It feels like a cottage in the middle of the city, with all the mod cons you could hope for.  The beds, bedding, and linens were all super comfortable, each room is full of design and taste, and everything you could want for is there -- from an iron and steamer, easy to use washing machine and dryer, all kinds of teas and condiments in the kitchen, and several hang-out spaces outside for when the weather is nice. Larry was very kind and extremely easy to communicate with.  One of our top Air BnB experiences.

This is a superior airbnb - one of the very best I've stayed in.  Four of us (a couple and two young adults) were extremely comfortable in this compact but very well designed space  full of light and air.  The coach house has been charmingly renovated with high quality, clever and tasteful furnishings and art.  It is also very comfortable and highly functional.  We held a dinner party because the kitchen was fully equipped (even had fresh herbs) and a pleasure to work in.  Great location just a few minutes walk to the subway and 20 minutes walk to U of Toronto.  Larry and his family were welcoming and helpful. We arrived with our own coffee and needed a cafetiere to prepare it (there was a Keurig-style coffee maker in the kitchen).  Larry and Susan insisted on giving us their cafetiere right then and there! The coach house is set back off the street among tall trees with a shady garden to relax in.  I had a linen work wardrobe with me and was able to iron and hang things in the excellent laundry area.  It was like being at home!  A pleasure to stay here and I hope to return again. Thanks again, Larry, for the good bottle of wine that awaited us on arrival.
Larry is a lovely host and his place is fantastic.

An amazing place and amazing host - to the point that words cannot describe.
Ideal location, beautiful home, tucked away, quiet and yet walkable to everything in the city.
The house is impeccable - beautiful design and features and the extras made us feel so welcome - comfortable beds, covers, towels, caring drinks teas coffees and everything a traveller needs and may have not even thought of yet themselves!
Larry is a fabulous host. There when we needed but also had our privacy. A person with a very kind heart. We so highly recommend this AirBNB!

This was by far the most comfortable beautiful space to stay in the heart of Toronto. The hosts were amazing and welcoming. A little piece of paradise tucked away in such a great location
Felt so taken care of !! Looking forward to staying again on future stays in Toronto!!
Excellent home in spectacular location and setting. Everything is where you want it.
Larry's place is in absolute gem in the core of Toronto! Can't wait for our next stay at Larry's.

It was our first experience on Airbnb... and the bar is now set very high for any other places we will rent for our travels! Larry and cie are wonderful; the place is amazing - clean, well equiped, cozy, enchanting; the neighbourhood is charming and super well located for attractions and public transportation. We could not have asked for a better experience. Thank you so much!

Great stay!  Great hosts who made us feel at home!  Nothing but kind words about Larry and Susan!  Their house is beautiful, clean and every detail is looked after. There were toys for the kids, coffee, condiments and spices.  Just a great stay!  Thanks again Larry + Susan!
Great hosts , beautiful house ,fantastic  location with fantastic transport links . We can't say enough good things about our stay . Thanks Larry !

Fantastic host, great place, great location, definitely felt like home! It was really a wonderful choice for us as a family with 6 year old kid. Larry and his wife Suzan are great people to hang out  with.
Excellent location! great house!

Absolutely lovely property - the nicest we have stayed in many years and many cities with airbnb. Great for families and young kids. Great for having friends over as the unit is beautiful. Larry and his wife were fantastic hosts and ensured we felt at home. Would stay again.

This airbnb was spectacular for our family during our son's wedding. It is a brand new, well appointed unit with all you could imagine. The location was central; the outdoor space was an oasis; and Larry and Susan were warm and generous hosts.
We couldn't have asked for anything more!

The finest rental we've stayed at. If you appreciate design, architecture, serenity, greenery, and a great location, I highly recommend Larry's rental. With the entire "cottage" to ourselves, we enjoyed the clean, minimal aesthetic, the understated design choices and Larry's warm and helpful demeanor. We look forward to coming back!

This beautiful home was perfect for our stay - it's even better when you get there and Larry and his wife were so helpful and accommodating. We arrived late on the Saturday night and they were there to greet us and show us around which was much appreciated! The home is a good size an amazing space in the very beautiful Annex area of Toronto - walkable distance to town (or by public transport is easy) and lots going on in that area too.
I would highly recommend Larry's home for anyone wanting to stay in Toronto.

I was so glad I selected the Annex Hideaway House for my visit.  Hidden from the street at the end of a long driveway, it is in a green oasis surrounded by large, mature trees with a small yard, therefore peaceful, quiet and very private. It is in an older central neighbourhood with a strong community feel.  The house is close to the University of Toronto, excellent coffee shops (Ezras's Pound is a must) and restaurants (suggest Nord Bistro) on Bloor St. and Dupont St.  Jean Sibelius Park is a 3 minute walk around the corner with a great children's playground (structures and many toys for public use) Stops for both subway lines are close by. The house is stylishly (i.e. tasteful, minimalist) designed and furnished  with great detail to comfort and convenience. Everything you need is provided (hairdryer, laundry, iron, cooking equipment, some staples, etc.), with thoughtful extras such as fresh flowers and a welcome bottle of wine (or beer). I particularly loved having morning coffee on the upstairs porch surrounded by huge trees. Larry and Susan are charming and extremely accommodating hosts, always available for information or assistance while being respectful of guest privacy. A parking spot was very useful. This house and hosts are highly recommended and I look forward to returning in a few weeks.

Amazing unit. Highly recommended. Super quiet and serene in a noisy busy city. Larry had way too many lovely touches to list here but they all contributed to making us comfortable. Beautifully appointed cottage. Close to transit, walking distance to the ROM & Yorkville, restaurants close by on Bloor, grocery stores conveniently located, all of this in a leafy neighbourhood. Larry lives next store and makes himself available for questions. I can't imagine a better AirBNB in Toronto.
Wonderful house in a lovely neighbourhood. Just a great place to be. Thank you.

The Annex Hideaway was one of my most memorable Airbnb’s to date. You can tell that Larry is an expert host by his hospitality and thoughtful details in the listing. Larry was always quick to respond if we had any questions, and made sure to check in to ensure we were having a comfortable stay. The listing is exactly as described, spotlessly clean, bright, and the beds were incredibly comfortable. Having a parking spot available was also very convenient, but do note if you have an SUV or larger, it can be a very tight space to maneuver.
I would 100% recommend staying here if you plan on visiting Toronto. Thanks again Larry!

Excellent house, friendly & helpful host, strongly recommended. And Toronto is a great city to visit - the house is close to several public transport links, or you can even walk to downtown if you want (we did!).

This place is perfect.  Location is fabulous: central, safe, quiet and beautiful.   House is exceptionally clean, comfortable, cosy and very well equipped.   The host, Larry, stays right next door but was never intrusive, only welcoming and friendly.  We have just stayed for 8 nights and if we return to Toronto, which hopefully we will do, we won't waste our time looking elsewhere - just hope it's available!
Another amazing stay at Larry's coach house!!

We’ve stayed at a lot of Airbnb’s and this is one of the best. Excellent location in the Annex - just a short walk down to all the great shops and restaurants on Bloor. And the place was outstanding. High end appliances, luxurious towels and bedding, and a kitchen that was stocked better than our own at home. It was quaint and cozy, warm and inviting, and even better than the pictures showed. Larry and Susan were great hosts, quick to answer any questions, but respectful of our privacy. Five stars all the way.

We travelled for a visit to Toronto with our two kids aged 5 and 3. Had a great stay here, Larry and Susan were gracious hosts with one of the best appointed rentals we have stayed at. It is an easy walk to restaurants and Dupont station even with two little kids, and we especially enjoyed all the toys and crafts left out for them. Would love to return!

My second stay at Annex Hideaway House was as great as the first. It is a beautifully appointed and stylish appartment downtown in a highly desirable neighbourhood close to subways groceries and restaurants  All of the furnishings are top quality from the very comfortable beds to high end appliances. There were thoughtful Christmas touches with decorations, wine, treats and lots of staples.  Larry always had the path promptly cleared after snowfalls. While respecting my privacy Larry is a most helpful and generous host. If their calendar permits I will stay nowhere else in Toronto when visiting family. Listening to the calls of the local eastern screech owl in this oasis was the icing on the cake!

I’ve been traveling for business for 18 years, 9 with children, and have rented homes all over the world. Larry’s beautiful space in Toronto instantly became my favorite of them all. Quite a feat! It has absolutely everything I could possibly ever need or want, it is gorgeously decorated, and Larry’s hospitality was top-notch and so appreciated. I’ve already booked to go back for a month and I can’t wait!
We LOVED staying at Larry’s wonderful house for a whole month. The beds were heaven, the decor was perfect, the hospitality wonderful. We couldn’t have asked for more, truly! Thank you!!
A third return visit did not disappoint.  My home away from home in this comfortable, well equipped, stylish and conveniently located coach house surrounded by trees. Can’t wait to go back

My partner and I had such a great stay at Larry's. The space itself is even lovelier in person than in the photos. Larry and Susan were such gracious hosts and we loved our daily greeting from thier dog, Coda. Everything about this place was superlative: the kitchen well-equipped, the bed comfortable, the neighbourhood charming, the peaceful yard. Can't imagine a better place to stay in the city!

Larry’s rental was incredible and our favorite in Toronto! The ‘secret house’ (we called it that as it is tucked away down a driveway amidst everyone else’s gardens) was so quiet and zen although smack in the middle of Toronto.
The house was recently renovated a year ago (I asked lots of questions as I adored the space) and architecturally has the most amazing details such as the beams, extra little windows and skylights to make the light extraordinary throughout the space, and the open storage and high vaulted ceilings on the second level to make the space feel larger. The house is very stylish and chic and is stocked with absolutely anything one may want, from all the kitchen tools to vintage board games to luxurious bathroom amenities.
Larry was a pleasure to deal with and we really enjoyed meeting him. He went above and beyond to make our trip great and I just can’t recommend his space enough. Enjoy!

The place was sparkling and modern, with all the amenities; not a flaw. We arrived to a complementary bottle of wine and brief tour. Larry and his family were gracious hosts. I would highly recommend it if you are ever in Toronto.

This was our first experience of renting an Airbnb home for a holiday and it's very hard to imagine that we'll find a better host or accomodation. The house is beautifully set up and perfectly located for families looking to explore the area. The attention to detail, design and decor are of the highest standard and we couldn't believe how spotlessly clean out was.
Larry was the perfect host, we really enjoyed his company and putting the hockey net and sticks out for our son to play with was one of the many little things he did to made our trip so enjoyable!
We can't recommend this house and host highly enough, thanks Larry!

Larry and Susan are the most kind hosts! Our flight came in pretty late, by the time we got to the space it was about 12:20AM. Although we were given detailed instructions, we had a bit of a hard time finding the place in the dark, so we ended up giving Larry a call, he graciously popped out, welcomed us in and gave us a tour of the space! So ridiculously kind.
The place was wonderful and felt like home, truly. I was with my cousin and we each took one of the rooms. I asked for the beds in the second room to be pushed together, and both of us agreed it was probably the sleep we've had in ages. Absolutely lovely.
The bathroom was beautiful. It had everything we needed including some luxurious sample sized bath products. Epsom salts, bath bombs, everything. Forgot the flooring in the bathroom was heated- that was truly a delight.
The kitchen was stocked with (biodegradable, YAY!) K-Cups, Larry and Susan got us some skim milk, fresh fruit, all the awesome things.
The living room was so cozy, full access to Netflix and all the channels you can imagine.
I'm putting this last bit here, because I do not want it to take away for both the brilliant space, and the delightful hosts.
Because of the ice storm the week before, there were ants coming into the space. From our understanding there was ant poison placed/sprayed, so most ants where coming in and dying. Larry did explain that they have lived in this space for over 20 years and that this was one of the only incidents. I think it was just a way for Toronto to welcome me as I move from the prairies to Ontario. Now for many folks, this is not going to be a problem. However- back to the graciousness of Larry and Susan. I texted Larry and explained that bigger ants were coming through, and he offered to come in to see at our earliest convenience. SIMPLY PERFECT! Myself, husband and son have just spent the most brilliant 4 days in Toronto and enjoyed the most perfect setting for this. Larry’s accommodation is just what we needed. Larry can only be described as the perfect host. Cheery, ready to chat, not in the way and always available. This coach house is stylish, clean, bright, cheery, has outstanding appliances and kitchen utensils, a luxurious bed and linens, a beautiful setting, a garden and it is simply wonderful for relaxing. It's in the Annex which happens to be one of my favourite parts of Toronto (it's where I grew up but I haven't lived in the Annex since 1961 and permanently left Toronto in 1981). Nearby there are three grocery stores, two are chains and the third is a large family-owned store with beautiful produce and meats and cheeses just to name a few items. For those who don't know Toronto, the Annex is just peripheral to the heart of downtown. It's a lovely, heavily treed residential neighbourhood with 100-year-old brick homes many of which have been refurbished without losing their street charm. It's an integral part of the Toronto urban forest. A 15-minute subway ride and you're in the heart of downtown, or, if you're up to it, the heart of downtown is a 4.5 km walk through beautiful neighbourhoods, interesting stores and parks.
Yorkville and the ROM (Royal Ontario Museum) are 1.8 km away (about a mile) and it's a lovely walk to get there. This is the start of the Bloor St. strip with exclusive shops. The Eaton Centre is a bit further.
A block away from the coach house is Dupont Street where there are a number of great restaurants and a couple of short blocks away is Bloor Street with restaurants, the Hot Docs Movie Theatre and much more.
Larry’s a well deserved Superhost and a Plus Host. We’ll be back, hopefully in September 2019.

This was far and above one of the best air bnb experiences I've ever had. In every way.
Larry and his family were absolutely lovely and wonderful to communicate with.

Would love to stay again next time I'm in Toronto, what a gem!!!

This is an absolutely gorgeous Airbnb — a perfect place to land for my family to land in Toronto. It is exceptionally well designed, carefully maintained and very comfortable. Our children were thrilled with all the toys... we will  definitely try and stay here again on a future trip to Toronto. With gratitude to Larry and his family for their terrific hosting!

This is my go to place in Toronto because it is so wonderful.  It's very tastefully decorated, very well equipped, very comfortable and in a fabulous location.  The host is excellent.  Can't say enough about how great this spot it.

After having stayed here with my family last fall, I decided to stay again by myself on a business trip.  Larry's place is like a home away from home and so comfortable to come back to after a long day of meetings.  I will be back.  Thanks again, Doug.

We are beyond impressed with this Airbnb - it has everything you need AND more. The home was thoughtfully decorated and stocked, and importantly, the king sized bed was like a cloud to sleep on. The Annex Couch House was a wonderful place to stay. The place was tastefully decorated and it felt relaxing and homely. The bed was very comfortable.

I would highly recommend the Annex Couch House.
Kind host, amazing space, clean, modern and well kept. Would highly recommend!

We stayed at the coach house for a month, the first two weeks of which were in quarantine. The house has every convenience. It is well laid out, with a kitchen one can cook anything in. This is a fantastic place right in the heart of everything. Larry and family were just lovely. Thanks for a great stay!

This is a one of the best Air BnB's I have stayed in. So many reasons but Larry is wonderful. The attention to detail is second to none. He provided the best coffee! Everything you could possibly need. It felt like home. I can't wait to come back.

Everything about this property was as pictured and promised in the listing, and even better.  The indoor space felt bigger than in the pictures, and the outdoor space was excellent. Larry and his family were more than welcoming and always available if needed, but not at all intrusive.  A superb space in an excellent location, we were sad to leave after 14 days!

Absolutely the best AirBnB I've ever stayed in. The property, interior design, and amenities were perfect. Larry was very accommodating with date changes and a stay extension. The place was spotless and beautiful.

This is a gem of a place to stay in the heart of the city!  It is so quiet and serene you would never know that you are steps to Bloor Street, restaurants, and the downtown.  The decor and amenities make everything so relaxing and easy.  The windows overlook beautiful tall trees and we felt as if we were staying at a cottage! Larry and his family could not have been more kind or helpful.  We are so grateful! Thank you!

Wow! Such a wonderful city escape...in the city!
My family and I had such a lovely time staying at Larry’s. The house is hidden from the road, and staying there gives you the feeling of being at a cottage.
Larry was incredibly attentive, and the house had all of the amenities that we could ask for.
Thank you Larry!

Our stay at Larry's house was outstanding. Although we were in Toronto, we had always the impression to live in a big park, as it's so calm there and the house has no street front. We don't think that there is a better host than Larry and better option for a stay in Toronto than Larry's house. Thank you so much!
Winderful, as always

Just a gem! A garden oasis in the centre of the city, with walking to everything but so private and tucked away - we still can't believe how it was really the best of all worlds. And Larry and his family were so warm, friendly, and hospitable... a truly wonderful stay.
An absolutely lovely stay in a well-decorated and very comfortable home, an oasis in the middle of the city!

Well located. Very contemporary decor. Amazing kitchen, well equipped and stocked.
Owner is very friendly and available.
This is a great find!!

Our stay in the cottage oasis was amazing. Everything you could ask for, and some! Larry and family were very friendly, discreet, excellent hosts that went above & beyond to make us feel comfortable and at home. A special thanks for the thoughtful gestures for our 2 young boys. Highly recommended and will definitely stay again!!

What a truly magical stay!!! Larry and Susan were just wonderful hosts. So kind, thoughtful, and very caring! The space is beyond beautiful, and every detail has been taken care of! I have stayed at the coach house many times  over the last few years.    The apartment has clean uncluttered stylish decor with first class amenities. Larry is a pleasure to do business with  - friendly, helpful and always mindful of your privacy.   I always look forward to my next visit

We had a fabulous stay at Larry’s coach house. Everything was well kitted out especially for children & babies. Our daughter loved all the toys & we appreciated the extra touches. We felt at home and will definitely be coming back!
Couldn’t ask for a better experience. Great all around!
Larry’s place is a gem in the city of Toronto and he is the most gracious host, will stay again!

My husband and I had an absolutely fabulous stay at Larry's coach house. The place was warm and welcoming and absolutely wonderfully equiped. The location is also amazing. It is surrounded by trees and the back yards of other houses, so you almost feel like you are staying in a forest! We will definitely be back!
Such a well curated house. Everything was perfect. I felt cozy and relaxed the whole time. I will definitely be back.

Hands down the most stylish and comfortable airbnb we have ever stayed in!  Perfect location, outstanding amenities, exceptional selection of toys, games, crafts, children's books.  The house is even better than photos.  Finally, Larry and his wife are kind and generous hosts.  We would stay again in a heartbeat!

What can be said that hasn’t already been said?!? An exceptional & cosy home-away from-home - thoughtful decor + comfortable, functional, design-minded furniture in a light-filled, spacious home in a quiet locale in walkable inner-city neighbourhood. Kitchen well-stocked for cooking daily meals. Appreciated the local roast provided for our morning brew.  Bathroom amenities well beyond just shampoo/soap for travellers. Larry is friendly, communicative, accommodating & flexible. Coda the dog & Whiskers the cat lovely too.  Would love to return on future travels.
Just an incredible Airbnb with the most gracious and attentive hosts! We can't wait to return!

This house is what you would get if Le Corbusier had designed Hogwarts room of requirement. First, it's a beautiful house, with a million small touches that made me feel right at home, in a home that is frankly much nicer than my own. It manages to be both cozy and spacious, homey but also artfully designed, with a kitchen you cant wait to cook in. But what sets this place apart is the host family, who go way above and beyond to make sure you have everything you need. I showed up with a 6 month old baby, and Larry had redone the guest room into a perfect nursery including a fantastic baby bed, a rocking chair for nursing, dozens of stuffed animals and kids toys all over... There were even plastic baby plates and cups in the kitchen and a high chair for feeding. I could have shown up with nothing for the baby. My husband needed to work while there, so Larry waved his room of requirement wand and provided an office space, with a desk, lamp, and chair for him to work at. Anytime we needed anything at all, a quick message was swiftly responded, and an excellent high-end version of whatever we needed was promptly provided. I have stayed in dozens of airbnbs around the world, but nothing quite like this house. To boot, its in the perfect neighborhood. Beautiful and quiet streets, around the corner from a park with a skating rink, (and an amazing food market) but right in the heart of downtown. If this place is available, book it.

My partner and I enjoyed staying at Larry's airbnb. The place was super clean and we absolutely loved the kitchen!. The kitchen was stocked up well with packaged hot beverages and we had  a couple of options on how to make our coffee. Larry was super warm and welcoming and we felt really comfortable. Even on our way out his daughter checked in with us to make sure we had an enjoyable stay. I can't recommend this place enough as the  listing is even more beautiful in person!

If towering trees, uncluttered and modern style, high end equipment, location and helpful, accommodating hosts who respect your privacy are what you want then the annex coach house is your place. Still a joy after many visits
Highly recommended

Larry's place was in one word, perfect! The house is nicely designed and felt like a second home. The attention to detail and the amenities were so well thought out. Everything that you could need and more were available. The house was in a great location, right in the middle of the city but felt secluded enough. We hope to stay again!

We had a fabulous stay in this beautifully designed and furnished coach house. It is bright, yet cozy, especially nice on grey winter days. Everything was spotless. A great place in a great location!

We had a marvelous time at Larry's place. I highly recommend his place to anyone (except people who cannot go up the stairs).

The best Airbnb I have ever stayed at. WOW Larry was phenomenal and the location was perfect. Lots to do in the area and great places to eat. Wi-Fi was strong and had plenty of entertainment with an amazing TV setup and plenty of board games. Phenomenal host and I’m already looking forward for my next trip here!! Cheers!

For all you Airbnb’ers don’t hesitate it was great.
Location into town on the underground was local and the shops/restaurants were all nearby job done for a city break thank you Larry.👍

Our stay was wonderful - from the personalized offerings of beverages (beer, wine, coffee, milk, and juice), to the property tour and greeting with Larry, to the well-designed and outfitted home. Highly recommended!

Hands down the best place you could stay in the city.  Larry and his family are great hosts with excellent communication. And the place itself... a slice of privacy/cottage with all the amenities you could possibly ask for while being in the heart of the city. 10/10, would recommend to anyone thinking of visiting Toronto.

We have been to many airBNB properties in many countries. Larry place is by far the best that we have been to. Larry is a superhost. Larry's place is great with lots of fine details. Just absolutely great vacation rental.  One of the best we have ever stayed in.

This was one of the best places we've stayed on Airbnb. Apartment was well designed and organized with all the needed necessities. Location is great, close to public transportation and Bloor st. Larry was a wonderful host! We definitely recommend for Toronto downtown visit
Wonderful house in a great neighborhood in Toronto. Absolutely perfect when traveling with kids with toys, games and even craft supplies available.
This place is an ideal place to stay in Toronto, hidden in a neighbourhood I've known for years but had no idea it existed. Absolutely the best AirBnB I've ever stayed in.

Larry and his family are excellent hosts that made sure everything went well for my family.  The Annex Garden Coach House was very cozy and extremely well appointed.   We highly recommend this 2 bedroom coach house.
THE place to stay in Toronto! Perfect home, fantastic host, and amazing location!

Clearly the best Airbnb we have ever rented in the last ten years! Everything was as described and pictured, and much more. It made our little trip in Toronto truly memorable!

Nous avons passé 5 nuits dans cette coach house  merveilleusement décorée. Accueil chaleureux et sympathique , tout est fonctionnel. De bons restaurants à proximité et le centre-ville à environ 20 min en métro. Nous reviendrons, merci !

A beautiful and pristine place to call home for a few days. Larry was more than kind and responsive. Thank you Larry!
Great location for us!

Wonderful place. Very thoughtful with amenities, space, light, surroundings. Wonderful kitchen to stay in a prepare meals or walk near by to eat. We played games from his board game collection, relaxed and enjoyed being there.  Hosts Larry and Susan are very kind and accesible if needed.

We'd give this home 15 stars if we could.  Seriously, the love and thoughtfulness that Larry & Co. have put into this house is visible and palpable all over. Absolutely the best accommodations in Toronto. Larry and his family were amazing hosts. We loved our stay and we'll definitely be back. Thank you for everything!!

Accueil chaleureux par Larry et son adorable chien Koda! Location idéale, on se croirait à la campagne. Accès facile et rapide au centre ville, aux restaurants, etc.

Recommandations +++++

Plus parking!!

Larry’s place was great, it was clean, comfortable, and very well equipped. It was quiet and private but also just a short walk to amenities and transit. The hosts were friendly and helpful. A great clean place that's within walking distance from the station! Larry was very friendly and helpful throughout our stay.

My best airbnb stay! ⭐️ Larry’s place was excellent and the house has all you need to feel right at home. The location is great too located on a beautiful and quiet street and close to all you need. Great stay!

This amazing place is even more beautiful than what you see in the pictures. Great blend of old (it was built in the 1880s) and new (pristine kitchen, contemporary furniture).  The collection of architecture books is also very impressive. We did not want to leave!  Could not recommend more highly!
Fantastic place - it's our second time staying here. Great location in a quiet, leafy neighbourhood and excellent walking / public transport links. Check out Casa Loma on the doorstep!

We’ve been to many airbnbs in our day and Lawrence aka Larry was THE BEST HOST we’ve ever had.

We truly found a gem in Toronto & would definitely stay there again if given the opportunity.

Larry was the best host we could’ve asked for, and provided us with everything we needed and beyond. Larry and his wife were very welcoming and helped us when needed, and the coach house had everything we needed for our stay, and we are looking forward to coming back!

a wonderful place to stay -- one of my best ever airbnb experiences

I would highly recommend it as a place to stay in Toronto

Amazing, beautiful little place. Super cute, well stocked, and the kids enjoyed the toys and games.
Very thoughtful hosts and a home with lots of little touches we appreciated. Thank you for having us!

Super cute Airbnb that was great for 4 of us! The home was thoughtfully designed and felt luxurious. The kitchen appliances were really nice, and loads of dishware and cooking utensils were provided. This home is absolutely wonderful! Clean, well maintained and looks just like the pictures. It’s centrally located on a tree lined street in a lovely walkable neighborhood. A perfect experience! I will add my voice to others who have said Lawrence and his family provide the best Airbnb experience in Toronto (and probably many other cities).

great place, well located for visiting toronto. lots of inclusion and little attention. quiet, proactive host, we recommend it without a doubt

183 Howland Ave, Toronto is a perfect location for any visitor to the city. Centraly situated with convinient access to main attraction, great restaurants and transportation. We would be more than happy to recommend this place to any of our friends visiting Toronto.

Staying here felt like staying in a peaceful nature filled setting in the middle of downtown near everything you could need. The place was exactly as shown in the photos and was a clean and comfortable place to stay. I would highly recommend staying here!

Lawrence was literally the nicest and most welcome host we've ever had! Communication was a breeze the whole way through. The place is beautiful, private, with all the amenities you could need. Highly highly recommend!!

Perfect stay. Larry was welcoming from the moment we pulled into the driveway. Coach house had the best stocked kitchen we’ve ever found at a rental - including sharp knives! Beautifully decorated and very comfortable beds. Wonderful!!!

Ideale locatie om Toronto te verkennen, met de metro ben je op slechts enkele haltes van de belangrijkste bezienswaardigheden. This was one of the best AirBnB experiences we’ve had. Larry’s place was immaculate, comfortable, convenient, everything we could want. We had an amazing stay. The house was beautifully designed with all necessary equipment. The neighbourhood was lovely and a short walk from the subway. Larry was very kind and helpful. Very warmly recommended!!

We had an excellent stay! It was cozy, quiet, spotlessly clean, and in a very convenient location (easy access to transit, playgrounds, restaurants, grocers, coffee shops, etc). Absolutely recommended.

I think it’s safe to say that this was the best Airbnb we ever stayed in! Perfect for our needs with two small boys. We like to walk and could easily access U of T and Yorkville.
11/10!!!!!!

Great stay in a beautiful spot. We loved the accomodations and the amenities. Perfect Oasis in the City!

I highly recommend the Annex Garden Coach House to anyone seeking a peaceful, convenient, and comfortable stay in Toronto. Thank you Larry for creating such a wonderful space!

My parents stayed at Lawrence’s AirBnb for a week while visiting me and absolutely loved it. It was so cozy, very spacious, the games & books were such a lovely touch. Beds were very comfy too! They will be staying here every time they visit :)

Out of all the places I’ve stayed in over the years, this was definitely one of the best. The house was spotless, beautifully set up, and fully stocked with everything needed for day-to-day living.
One of the best stays we’ve ever had!  It’s truly a unique place in a wonderful setting and central location with the consummate host, Larry.

Myself and my partner stayed here for our first two months in Canada after relocating from the UK. We honestly couldn’t have picked a better location, apartment, or host for our first experience of Toronto.
The apartment is on a picturesque and peaceful residential street in Riverdale, on the East side of the city. A two-minute walk to the end of the street brings you out at Riverdale Park which offers a breathtaking view of Toronto. This a great place to start your day with a coffee from Juliana Social or Rooster, both just another two-minute walk in opposite directions.
There is a regular bus and streetcar stop at the end of the road too, which allows for easy access to anywhere in the city. A twenty-minute journey West and you’re in downtown Toronto, near all the tourist spots such as; CN Tower, Ripleys Aquarium, Rogers Centre, Eaton Centre, etc. Twenty minutes further and you’re on the West side of the city, where you can explore; Kensington Market and the trendy Queen West neighbourhood, or you can escape the city with a walk around High Park.
However, with all that Toronto has to offer, we found ourselves spending most of our time close to the apartment. Leslieville and Greek town, where you can find amazing food and nightlife, are both within walking distance. If you’re visiting in the Summer, then we would also highly recommend a bike ride to Woodbine beach! If you need to go shopping there are plenty of supermarkets; No Frills, Loblaws, and Gerard Square shopping centre with Walmart and others, all close-by.
Whatever you end up doing for the day, coming back to the apartment is always a lovely feeling. It is a shared building with other guests adjacent to and above you, but the whole time we were there it felt like our own private home. Everything you need to cook, wash and clean is provided. The fridge and cupboards are already stocked with essential bits and bobs, we were even greeted with a bottle of wine, which we thought was a lovely touch.
The hosts, James and Michael live next door, which makes you feel very comfortable and at ease. Any problems that we encountered were handled straight away. A small issue with the door was quickly fixed by Michael. We had a fire alarm going off in the building, and James was there immediately checking everybody was ok. They even went above and beyond by keeping an eye out for my partner, whilst she was very ill for a few days and I was back in the UK for a work trip. James and Michael were wonderful hosts and they really make the place feel like a home away from home.
