The period I stayed was very good. The location is excellent: the house is very close to restaurants, bars, super market, laundry, gym, bus stop and street-car stop. The neighborhood is very residential, safe and close to the down town, which made my day-to-day easier.
The accommodation is very comfortable and has new furniture. It is located in the basement of Karen's house (Although it is very common in "American" houses, I did not know that the accommodation was in the basement - I did not see or payed attention to this description in the ad). As a suggestion for improvement, I suggest a renovation of the entrance stairs: As the accommodation is in the basement, I was a little afraid of access, especially at night.
During the stay, two spiders appeared in my room, but as the street is very tree-lined and with many plants, I understand that it is nature.
Karen was very attentive and asked whenever I needed to communicate.

Karen was a great host; she gave me excellent recommendations for the area and was thoughtful and kind throughout my stay. The apartment is well located and very well maintained, it was a treat to stay there

I had a wonderful one-month stay at Karen’s Airbnb. Despite being a basement apartment, the space is well-lit with elevated ceilings. Fully stocked, it had everything I needed and more including towels, sheets, kitchenware and toiletries. A lot of thought was put into the space, the overhead shower, warm tone lighting and extremely comfortable mattress and bedding gives it a luxurious feel. (I had the best sleeps here!) Surrounded by local restaurants, cafe’s, drugstores, boutiques and more, the apartment is perfectly located on a quiet street but still within a 5 min walk to the Queen St. streetcar. As a young solo female, I felt extremely safe in the area, Leslieville is a true pocket of peace within Toronto. Karen was friendly, welcoming and ensured I had everything I needed. I am very grateful for my time here and hope to come back someday!
Karen’s place was great. She was the best host ever! And I would stay here again for sure. Leslieville is a great neighbourhood with a lot to offer. Highly recommended

Karen's place is a great location for a long-term stay in Toronto! The apartment is cozy with a great shower and bed. Easy access to lots of different streetcar routes, and a very walkable and safe-feeling neighborhood, steps away from several good coffeeshops, takeout, and a laundromat. Karen and her family are very welcoming and responsive - probably some of the best hosts I've ever had! I wouldn't hesitate to return or recommend their space :)

I can only recommend staying at Karen and her family’s place, it’s just so peaceful yet so close to the vibrant city.
Everything met my expectations, the apartment is clean, tastefully decorated and it’s equipped with everything you’ll need. While working remotely I really appreciated the high-speed wifi as well as the comfort of the room with a huge desk. Being located in the basement wasn’t a problem at all as it’s still very bright with lots of lights.
Also Karen is very friendly, responsive and always ready to help. She provided me with all the information I needed to enjoy the neighborhood.
I felt comfortable and safe to begin my new adventure to Toronto, and I'm really grateful for my stay here. I’ll come back without any hesitation!

Karen is very kindness. She is always ready to help and answers fast. The neighborhood of Karen's place is fabulous. The guest can go  walking to restaurants, markets and plenty of services. I loved my time there.

In the basement it was cold and you may have little guests but I enjoy my experience in Toronto. Karen is a welcoming host and the accommodation is near downtown with public transport so you can do a lot of things!
Karen is a great host and her apartment is perfectly fitted with eveything you may need. I strongly recommend it, I had a great stay.

Karen is a fantastic host. I had never stayed in this part of the city before and Karen was great in describing the neighbourhood and giving great recommendations. Great location by public transit and the apartment is nice and comfy. Highly recommend it.

WHAT A FIND! This place was PERFECT. It's on a quiet street that's also very close to everything you could need -- including transit, groceries, restaurants, shops, even a Home Depot! And speaking of everything, the apartment itself was the best equipped Airbnb I've ever encountered. You know how some places have like one cup and two dishes? Not this place -- the full kitchen comes complete with full cupboards. It's very clear that a great deal of care goes into every detail of this Airbnb; that stands to reason, since the best thing about this place is the host. Karen is a kind, friendly person who responds promptly and was dedicated to making sure everything was perfect during my stay. I can't say enough good things about this unit, so I'll simply say this: you are lucky if you get to stay here, and you most certainly will not be disappointed. Enjoy!
Apartment was exactly as described. Everybody was very friendly! Enjoyed my time talking to Karen :)
Karen’s place is in a great location. The basement is new and clean. Karen was helpful with any questions.

Karen is very kind, friendly and always willing to help. Her apartment is very nice. I was a bit surprised when I realized that it was a basement because I didn't find that in the description, but I took that as part of getting to know Canada (basements are common here!). The apartment is very well-maintained, spacious, and comfortable. The location is great; I loved Leslieville from the moment I arrived. Lovely first impression of Toronto :)

Fantastic little retreat (😉) in the city for sure! Host is also very lovely, plenty of nice convos when we crossed paths. And their little boy, super cute and friendly as well!
The place’s pros:
Cute little basement apartment that is modern and well laid out
The host takes pride in it and it shows.
Definitely cozy with a nice little l-couch and tv to make up living room
Even has a dedicated workspace that is roomy in the bedroom
Internet was strong, water pressure was great, and kitchen was good
The place’s cons:
This is a basement, but you know that and must be okay with i, for me it was no issue
Some might not like the dampness, noise from above but there wasn’t too much, or limited natural light But again, you know that before coming so if you’re okay with it you’ll love this place
Noise from above is definitely worse at other basement apartments too
And if you need some light, just head upstairs quickly to stand in the sun on the deck
Lastly, the bed was small for me, male, 6’
Excellent place, perfect location. Everything is very clean and tidy. Karen and her family are very attentive
Great place, very clean and comfortable. Very responsive host!

I loved my month-long stay at Karen's! The unit was bright, clean, and very well-maintained. The kitchen and bathroom were well-stocked with cooking supplies and clean towels. The apartment is an amazing neighbourhood with lots to do, pretty surrounding, and easy access to multiple transit options.
Karen was an excellent host! She was responsive, helpful, and knowledgeable about the area while also respecting my privacy. I felt very comfortable throughout my stay and would absolutely stay here again in the future!

Great stay! Karen was kind and helpful, replied really quickly and even gave nice recommendations for delicious eateries with walking distance of the apartment. The was spotless and had the basic necessities for a month-long stay. The bed was REALLY comfy and I loved the neighbourhood.
A few things to keep in mind.
-As mentioned in the ad, you're underneath a family home with kids. You can very much feel and hear them milling about. They're super kind and respectful of your space, and there's no noise at night! But If you want to feel like you're truly alone, it might not be ideal for you.
-The electric furnace system is intermittent and I found it to be quite loud. I needed to put in my noise cancelling ear buds with white noise to sleep. Something to keep in mind if you're a light sleeper.
Other than that, recommend this place. Cozy and new and in a central neighbourhood close to restaurants, cafe, parks, the lake, and downtown.

Lovely area with lots to do and lots of great recommendations from Karen. The place looks exactly like the pictures and feels very safe and homey.  Karen is a very friendly and responsive host and does her best to make you feel at home! Would recommend this lovely place to anyone and everyone :)

I stayed at Karen’s place for two months and had an excellent experience. The space is clean and exactly as described, and I felt very safe throughout my stay — which was especially important since I was traveling alone.
I also had plenty of privacy, and Karen was always available to help with anything I needed. The location is amazing: just one block from a laundromat and a bus stop, and only 10 minutes from the subway station. There are also great bars and restaurants nearby.
Karen’s family is wonderful, and I felt truly welcomed from the moment I arrived. Without a doubt, if I ever return to Toronto, I will definitely stay with Karen again.
Great stay, great location, Karen and her family were wonderful hosts.
Really enjoy my month long stay. The neighborhood was fantastic and was a great home base to explore the city.

I had a fantastic two-month stay—Karen's place is the best AirBNB I've stayed at so far! She has put a lot of effort into making the apartment look beautiful and feel comfortable. It's also spacious and looks exactly like on the pictures. Karen is very kind and helpful: she was always quick to respond, gave clear instructions, and was flexible about my check-out time. Finally, the location is great: the area is safe and close to downtown. Highly recommended!
everything is very good. Large private space.

We had a great stay at Pavlena’s place. It’s located in a beautiful, quiet neighbourhood, and is within walking distance to restaurants, grocery stores and a stone’s throw from a street car stop. The basement flat was nicely decorated, clean, spacious, yet cosy and warm. The bed was very comfortable, the shower was great, and the kitchen was very well stocked with many utensils that made cooking a pleasure. We were really pleased to have a washer/dryer within the flat, as well as seamless WiFi and a coffee machine. Pavlena responded promptly to messages and was very helpful. Considering this place is a recent addition to Airbnb, we were really satisfied with our time here. Small additions would make the experience flawless- a dish rack next to the sink, a chest of drawers/hanging shelves so that one can unpack, and blinds or curtains in the lounge/dining area. Thanks, Pavlena!

Although the place is on a lower level of a family home, it promises privacy. It is cozy, and has a TV to spend time in case one can't really sleep. The place is just minutes walk to two streetcar routes, also close to Chinatown! As a tourist, this can be an ideal place to stay if one wants to explore Canadian houses? I just loved my stay here and I would reconsider staying here next time when I go Toronto.
Great place. Exactly as advertised. Spacious. Clean. Modern. Bright for a basement apartment. Pavlena was quick to respond to any question. Overall a great stay. Highly recommended.

Pavlena's place is great, it's tastefully decorated and stylish. If you're planning on spending a few weeks there it is well kitted out. The kitchen has everything you could need; a variety of utensils, pots, pans, knifes, etc. Everything that you would have at home! The appliances are high-end and modern. There is a full size dining table and a TV with Roku. The location was great, nestled between Queen and King St made access to streetcars easy. Although there is no A/C and we were there for a few 30+ degree days, it seemed to remain cool inside.

The location was fine but a little bit far from the centre. The shower curtain was quite dirty and moldy the rest was alright. Perhaps Pavlena was very busy since the messages were not enlightening or friendly.

This apartment is a fantastic base to see Toronto, right by street car lines to downtown. The space is bigger than the photos suggest and in great condition. The neighborhood is lovely with great places to eat. Also, Pavlena is a superb host. I'd happily come back here!

Great place to stay if you don't may a basement and taking the risk of being weaken up around 7:30 AM with the noise coming from upstairs. The flat is nicely decorated, clean and is good for a couple with a child. As it is a basement the temperature keeps cool. Landlady is very reliable. The location is good with public trasport.

Everything was clean and it was a great stay - very clean, interior exactly as advertised, wifi and all basic kitchen appliances and utensils are provided.  Easy to travel to downtown by streetcar on Queen or King West. At night, very quiet neighbourhood, however, there were a lot of noise coming from upstairs during the morning and during the day that might be from kids running upstairs and construction around. In general, great stay and easy travel.
Great location in Parkdale and nicely decorated. My only complaint would be the noise from the children upstairs. Everything else was lovely !

Great host, with a fantastic location, getting you everywhere within 20 minutes via streetcar. Entertainment such as Netflix and Cable TV was great  and the internet was reliable. Washing Machine and Tumble Dryer was a huge help. Pavlena was such a great host who never hesitated to help me with any problem or questions I had, which I was very thankful for!

Great location, loved being able to cook in the well set up kitchen.  Place was as described very clean and comfortable and in a great location to get around with public transport within walking distance.
Great place if you need to be in the Parkdale area of Toronto.   The apartment is within walking distance to everything.   Plenty of space  and everything you need to be comfortable.   I recommend.

O basiment era muito confortável, agradável, estiloso, limpo e confortável!
Adorei o espaço e ficaria novamente.
Fica bem perto da rua principal, que andando você encontra tudo como farmácia, restaurantes, lojas, fast foods, enfim, tudo para qualquer necessidade. E também perto do ponto de ônibus q deixa no metro ou na rua principal do downtown.
Achei tudo maravilhoso! A única observação é que às 7h da manhã as crianças acordam e vc escuta os passos. Mas não me incomodou em nada, talvez quem seja mais sensível pode achar ruim.
Tive excelentes dias, obrigada Pavlena!
Pavlena has a lovely downstairs space. Perfect location for getting downtown, exploring the neighborhood, and visiting Lake Ontario.

Super appartement, très bien situé, le tramway est à proximité et l’accès au centre ville est parfait. Pour les amateurs de vélo, la station des vélos est à seulement 10 m de marche. Découvrir la ville en vélo est super !
Tout était très propre et confortable. Excellente literie. Notre seul regret est le bruit après 7h30 du matin a l’étage au dessus... très inconfortable pour se reposer
A nice, cozy place. Clean, spacious and easy access. Location is great.
The place is nice and in good location to get around Toronto. It is beyond my expectation for first time doing airbnb

Really close to downtown core. Pictures don’t do this place justice. From the moment I walked in you felt like your at home. Even though the family lives upstairs they promise privacy and that’s exactly what you get. One amazing way to experience my first Airbnb. Book this place if your ever in Toronto, trust me. You will not regret it

Appartement très propre et conforme à la description, parfait pour un séjour à deux ou trois voyageurs. Le quartier est agréable et tranquille, à 15-20 min du centre de Toronto. Je vous recommande ce Airbnb.

Brilliant little apartment right next to down town Toronto on a quiet street just 10 minutes on a street caramel your in the centre. The apartment is spacious and clean has all the amendments you need. Check in is super easy and hassle free. Had a brilliant stay
Great place to stay. Suite had everything one needs. Being in the basement there was noise from the floors above. Not a problem for us. Would definitely book again.
Really nice flat, very clean and everything you need for long holidays.

Very good place. Sometimes We've heard noise from the children, especially in the morning, but it wasn't a problem.
The basement is pretty well-located. There is groceries, bus stop, dollarama and close from lake. I recommend it.

Pavlena's place was absolutely amazing. The home is close to many restaurants but more importantly its a 10 minute walk from one of Torontos most beautiful beaches. Pavlena gave us our privacy which we really appreciated. We would love to stay here again , when time permits!

It is a basement, a very nice basement. It rained much of my stay and the basement was humid, but still dry.  The people walking arround upstairs can be loud in the morning and evening, but I usually tried to be out at those times.  It's close to several bus and trolley lines and it was easy to get arround the city.  There's lots of cute shops and cafes within walking distance up Roncesvalles Ave.

This place is great and Pavlena as a host was very helpful. For a longer than usual stay (1 month), this place can't be beat with size and location, with lots of shops and cafes close by and the lake within walking distance. It can get noisy in the morning and afternoon periods with people walking around upstairs but other than that, this is a great place to stay.

Our stay was for the entire month as a family of three, two adults and a two year old. The suite looked very similar to the photos. Easy to access and navigate to and from with a stroller. The mud room entrance was super helpful for that. The floors had not been washed and there was a bit of mould but the host was super responsive when advised and provider cleaner for us to use. Was a bit disappointed they didn't offer to refund the cleaning deposit at that point, but I didn't ask for it either. There was quite an ant issue, which we let the host know about and they were going to take steps to fix it (this is a super common issue in the area for this time of year and has nothing to do with cleanliness of the suite). There where no children's items in the unit and nothing in the kitchen like s&p or oil so make sure you bring some. Some of the electrical outlet covers were also broken, a bit of a safety concern for our little one, we brought our own outlet plug covers as well. The coin-op laundry was a bit of a drag, giving the cost of the stay, but they worked. The noise from upstairs was unfortunately a really big deal for us, having a napping age child. It was very loud. It is an old home and is understandable but it was awful to deal with as our kiddo was constantly waking during naps and at night. The host was good at letting us know if there was going to be extra noise due to guests etc so that was nice. For non-kiddo people it would likely have been fine.

Our stay was really good. The apartment was light through the ceiling lights and there was enough space for two adults for three months. The wifi was also good enough for home office. Sometimes you need to turn on the heating but that's no problem. I can recommend this apartment.

Definitely a good start to live in downtown nearby. High privacy and strong support from the host. All amenities are well equipped. Just a little bit noisy from the upper floor but it’s acceptable. Would recommend this place :)

Enjoyed our stay here. The host Were helpful when we had concerns or problems. We heard a lot from upstairs but since that was stated in the description we were prepared. Had quite the problem with ants but the host were really helpful when dealing with that problem. Otherwise it was close to two of the main streets which Made it Easy getting around on the ttc. The pictures are accurate and we liked the place.

This place is great  to stay .The home is close to many restaurants, lots of cute shops and cafes and its a 10 minute walk from one of Torontos most beautiful beaches. Just a little bit noisy from the upper floor.
The host was friendly and very responsive to our request during our stay.
Comfortable stay. but the second bedroom was very small. also sometimes it got noisy above.

Spent the summer here and it exceeded our expectations. Solid 10/10 experience, the host was responsive and the place was wonderful. Great local restaurants and easy access to downtown. Would 100% recommend staying here.

Patrick's home felt simultaneously cozy and palatial. The multiple spaces with fireplaces and the shelves and shelves of books to explore made the time we spent in the Bellevue Sq Bagel Factory (during a chilly weekend in January) extremely satisfying. Amazing location in Kensington Market and close to everything - Second City, the AGO, and Billy Bishop City Airport. Our host shared many local recommendations and the fascinating history of the area, which made the time outside the house equally entertaining. I would gladly stay again in any season.

Patrick is a super host who is very attentive and kind. My family and cats stayed for 2 weeks and thoroughly enjoyed the beautiful 4 storey space. Patrick looked after all our needs, such as shoveling the snow/ice outside the door, removing garbage and checking in to see if everything was working. Our favorite things about the home is all the art work, the sunroof and natural lighting, the 3 gorgeous fireplaces, the jacuzzi, the music ambiance(stereo playing classic music), the huge TV, and the countless books to keep any length of stay occupied and fun. Our cats also loved the stairs and different vantage points.
Also there are so many cafes, restaurants and shops in walking distance to this place that you will never be bored staying here. Definitely can't wait to return in summer for the rooftop deck. 10/10!

Patrick's place is cozy, eclectic, expansive, and perfect for a group! The location in Kensington Market is a dream, situated next to dozens of restaurants, bars, and cafes. The rest of the city was very accessible from the house, and we ended up walking almost everywhere. Patrick is one of the most accommodating hosts I have ever met, providing us with coffee, extensive breakfast supplies, and tips for the surrounding neighborhoods. Of particular note is the rooftop deck with a beautiful view of downtown - even though it was chilly winter weather, we had a great time bundled up in blankets, drinking wine and looking at the city. We would definitely stay here again, thanks Patrick!

as my first time using airbnb, I absolutely loved staying here. I loved the style and the house just felt cozy and extremely comfortable. Patrick was such a great host and helped my friends and I with any questions we had and was very very kind and funny. The top loft has a patio that we enjoyed because it was quiet and the view was so beautiful, it included furniture so we would just relax outside. The whole house was decorated so nicely and cute. The kitchen does come fully equipped so it was easy for us to cook without having trouble. The house is located near bus stops and also very close to Kensington market which we enjoyed. I definitely recommend staying here!!:)

Patrick's home was absolutely amazing!  We were so grateful every day of our family vacation that we chose his home to stay in.  It is roomy and beautiful and had everything we could possibly need. Comfortable beds with nice sheets. Lots of towels and a fully stocked kitchen.  Hundreds of books to look through, and interesting art to admire made downtime fun. It was great to have lots of space for spreading out and relaxing between outings.  The giant jacuzzi tub was amazing!  It was chilly when we were there, but we still appreciated the amazing view of the city from the fabulous roof top deck.    We all had to go out every night to see, and photograph the CN tower, as it is lit up differently every night.  We loved the two fireplaces and gas wood stove.  The location was wonderful, too.  It was very easy to get anywhere we wanted to go.  We used the street cars and subways and never drove our car once.  Kensington market was such a fun neighborhood.  We saw many of the classic tourist sights in Toronto, but our favorite times were spent strolling around Patrick's neighborhood sampling all the great eats and shopping in the fun, quirky stores.  Chinatown is right around the corner, and we truly enjoyed this area as well.  We never once felt unsafe.  The square the house sits on is being redone, and I'm sure will be beautiful when finished.  It looks like a nice play ground is being installed.  Another plus to this location is how surprisingly quiet it is, for being right in the city! It is a four level single family home, which means no one above or below! Patrick was an amazing host and answered all of our questions promptly.  He provided lots of information tailored to our interests, which, I must admit, involved food for us most of the time! He has lived in Toronto for a long time, and is a wealth of information.  We were thrilled that we got to spend some time getting to know him, and will always treasure our time together.  I am sure he is always an impeccable host, and would be happy to check in on his guests, or give them all the privacy they wanted.  We felt comfortable and at home from the minute we stepped through the front door, to the minute we left.  If we return again, I hope we can stay here, possibly in the summer to enjoy the rooftop deck and cute backyard.  The stairs in the house would not work well with young children, but Patrick explains that very well in his description.  We loved it, however, and felt truly lucky that Patrick shared his lovely, interesting, one-of-a-kind home with us!

Patrick's home is truly unique and well worth the stay. From the fully stocked fridge, sparkling wine and Nespresso machine these little touches were unexpected and amazing. Prior to arrival, Patrick communicated frequently and assisted us in finding parking nearby. When we arrived Patrick was there to meet us and stayed to clean up the house as some things still needed to be put away. Patrick was very helpful and a great host!

What a great place to stay, close to everything. Patrick took all the time to make sure we felt at home. He even helped us out parking the car (late at night). There was wine, good coffee, what more could you wish for :-)

If you enjoy the Kensington Market vibe, you will enjoy staying at Patrick's cozy, quirky and eclectic house.  The location is terrific, right in the heart of Kensington Market.  The old house is bright and has lots of character.  It's spacious and has all the amenities you could ever need, including a wonderful Nespresso machine which makes the best coffee I've had in a long time.  There is also outdoor space, including a terrific roof terrace with a great view of the CN tower.  Patrick is a gracious and generous host.  We tried several of his recommendations and were delighted by all of them.  Check-in was a breeze and communication was easy.  We had a wonderful stay and hope to come back again to this lovely place next time we come to Toronto.

"No matter your approach, once you crossed College Street or Spadina Avenue or Dundas, you were somewhere else when you entered Kensington Market." (from the Giller award winning novel "Bellevue Square" by Michael Redhill)
I hadn't realized that we would be living in the setting of an award winning novel when we booked our stay with Patrick! Our eldest son was getting married at Hart House so we decided to rent a house nearby. In the end, we hosted a pre-wedding brunch for the bridegroom, his 4 groomsmen and the photographer. Thanks to helpful tips from Patrick, our brunch was a huge success. The boys fell in love with the house and couldn't stop raving about what a wonderful house we had found. The kitchen is a chef's kitchen, outfitted with everything a cook could possibly need to host an event. Staying at Patrick's house is like staying with your best friend who thoughtfully provides your favourite coffee and Lush products. For anyone attending an event on the U of T campus, Patrick's house is the perfect fit! Because of the close proximity to Hart House the boys could get dressed at the house and then walk to the wedding venue directly. We will definitely be back!

Patrick’s home is definitely eccentric and not like anything you’ll have ever stayed in before! 4 floors with bright lights made it the perfect place for my wedding day preparations! The photographer loved it! Rooftop balcony had an amazing view of the CN Tower and the city. Thanks again Patrick for going out of the way to make my wedding unforgettable!

What a fantastic experience! Patrick’s home is unique and full of personality. We loved sitting on the peaceful and lovely back patio, walking through the diverse and eclectic Kensington Market neighborhood, and exploring the many neighborhoods and their restaurants. If you enjoy walking and exploring then this is the perfect spot. After spending each day in the city it was such a joy returning to the welcoming and warm home. I recommend Patrick’s home unreservedly. My only concern would be for people that can’t manage stairs. This house a lot of them!

Patrick’s house was eccentric and amazing, right in Kensington market. Patrick is by far a host that goes above and beyond for his guests. From the nice detailed messages before arrival, the great welcome, the amazing recommendations given for local restaurants and night life (which were all accurate)...Patrick’s house and Patrick will not disappoint!

Un endroit agréable pour séjourner près du centre animé et avec des terrasse en plein centre
A faire en famille

A true gem smack in the middle of Kensington Market. The place has such a unique vibe, and the rooftop patio and fenced in backyard were perfect for low-key evening hangouts before hitting the town, beautiful breakfast (made with goodies we bought right in the market), and lazy afternoons in the sun.  Patrick was very accommodating with our group, and tremendously communicative for our two-day stay. The location of this place cannot be overstated. A perfect spot for a tried and true Toronto experience. Looking forward to booking another visit in the future!

This house is a gem. It’s full of history and quirky details. Patrick went out of his way to be a great host. Fabulous tips for buying food and eating out. We loved the Blackbird bakery, cheese magic and sanagans meat locker.
Patrick left the fridge really well stocked which was much appreciated.
We loved the backyard for breakfast and the roof terrace for evening drinks.
Thanks again Patrick.
The Lockley family, London. UK

If you want to stay in gorgeous house in a bustling, fun and always exciting Toronto neighborhood, walking distance to all the points of interest, look no more! Patrick's place is just as described (even better). We loved the way it was set up and decorated and that it was not a sterile airbnb but a place that allowed us to feel like we were staying at a friend's house. The house was also very comfortable with plenty of space, lovely back deck and rooftop deck, lovely private bedrooms for all of us (master suite on the top floor is great!) and plenty of space to hang out. Great, well stocked kitchen. Patrick was the best host ever and gave us a ton of tips on what to do as if he knew what our particular family would enjoy most. The house is right at Kensington Market but by the little park so it is not loud as some of the other places in the area may be. There are a lot of places to eat, shop and have fun all around. We were able to walk everywhere - University, downtown, Yorkville, Cabbagetown. We drove just once when we went to the Distillery district and the beaches. Parking was easy - permit parking that you can get and pay for online and there was always a space available right in front of the gate.
Overall, great place, great host, great neighborhood. Highly recommended.

If you want a unique space at the HEART of people-watching, restaurants, Chinatown, cafes, street musicians, pleasant parks, great coffee, and nightlife, THIS four story unique space is perfect! Patrick is a fount of fascinating information on the history or the city, the neighborhood, and literally ANY local info you might want. He was always available for any questions, and was very gracious and informative. He had a bottle of sparkling white on ice for us, and the kitchen was stocked with good coffee and basics. The neighborhood was the highlight for me, and I really appreciated the location! All you have to do is step outside to be swept up into tons of local color, flavor, shopping, creativity, and excitement!
Amazing place! Stylish, comfortable, well-stocked, very chic. Great location. Patrick is the best!

Patrick is a great host….engaging, thoughtful, flexible, overall super nice!!
Will book with him on next trip to Toronto!

Patrick was a fantastic host, super responsive & flexible, and the place was absolutely lovely in the most vibrant way. Everything was as described, if not better. The location was very walkable to everything we needed, which was great. Would definitely recommend!

Patrick was amazing to deal with, always responsive! The place itself is in a great location and full of interesting items that give character. Plenty of space, great, fully stocked backyard and lots of places to sit! We had booked a while in advance and no matter when I sent a message, there was an almost immediate response. Had a blast borrowing this home and would definitely come back!

Patrick was a great host and was very responsive and had lots of great recommendations for the area.  The house was very nice and had plenty of room for our large family and was very well stocked with everything we needed.  The neighborhood was very walkable with lots of great restaurants and public transportation was nearby.  Definitely recommend this house for a stay in Toronto!

We had a delightful stay for 7 adults for a weekend of family time, bar hopping and a blue jays game! Great location and space. Patrick was responsive to all our questions and even had a stocked fridge of goodies for us. The A/Cs in the bedrooms made sleeping conditions perfect. Also, while the inside has been renovated, the exterior of the home was not at all renovated or updated. We were surprised based on the interior pics, so that’s something to be aware of upon arriving and could likely be a bit of a shock. Another thing to note for future guests and as Mel points out in her welcome notes, you will more than likely not want to stay in the paid parking across the street in the lot, or the paid parking on the street, but rather the covered underground parking about .25 miles away (located on the street behind the townhome). The current daily rates for that garage are $14/day, so consider adding that in for your costs.

YuLin’s place is great for a short stay given the price and location:
- It’s among the cheapest options in a neighborhood full of good restaurants and cafes;
- It’s less than 5 min walk to the nearest streetcar station to downtown.
However, if you want to stay a bit longer, there are a few things to be aware of:
- After ~2 days, the sewage smell starts to build up in the bathroom and it can’t be totally removed by the ventilation fan;
- There are dust mites in the bedding and our stay first night was a nightmare because of them. Remember to tumble dry the bedsheets at a high temperature before you sleep.
- The heater temperature is not adjustable.
- There are guest rooms both above and next to your room, which means your quality of sleep is dependent on courtesy of other guests.

Great place to stay in Toronto. Quiet street, but close to main areas. Lots of amenities in walking distance or quick Ubers. The host was very responsive and helpful. Would definitely stay again.

We enjoyed our stay in Andrew's apartment very much!

Would stay again!

Great home base to explore downtown with our two adult sons, particularly some of the up and coming areas on the west side of downtown. Andrew was helpful and responsive as well.

Andrew a été très attentionné et proactif. Il s’assure qu’on passe un beau séjour. On a aussi oublié de quoi à la maison qu’il a pris le temps de récupérer et de nous renvoyer par la poste, ce fut très apprécié. La location était vraiment parfaite! Merci pour ce beau séjour!

Great location in downtown Toronto. Lots of space for our family. Nice dining area and charming house.
A great location to stay downtown! Andrew was a great host and the house was exactly what we pictured!

We were a group of 8 middle aged women.  The place perfectly located, it is walking distance to stores, restaurants and public transportation.  Andrew’s place has everything you need, from cooking utensils to extra bedding.  We LOVED your place and highly recommend it.
Great location! We loved having 3 bedrooms and lots of living space for our family. House was as shown in the pictures.
Clean and a great location.

Amazing home in downtown Toronto. Perfect for my 3 adult kids, my husband and I. Lots of space and everything was well stocked. the location was the best! My family and I enjoyed our stay!
Elizabeth

Overall the home was clean, the beds were comfortable, and the location is very central. Andrew was very responsive when we contacted him regarding the temperature of the second floor.
The second floor doors knobs were all problematic and potential safety hazards. The door knobs had issues turning and opening.
The overall poor condition of the doors lead to some trim lifting from the wall while normally using the door. After checkout Andrew claimed we caused over $3000 of property damage. The claim is still ongoing with Airbnb.

Emplacement parfait pour visiter le centre-ville. Belle vieille maison avec planchers un peu croches qui craquent. Hôte tres accommodant. Un stationnement privé et stationnement public à proximité. Commodités et transports en communs à un coin de rue. Merci!
Great townhouse in the heart of downtown Toronto.

Andrew’s house is an old townhouse renovated with very well appointed modern amenities. At first I was worried about the 1-1/2 bathrooms for a family of 9, but it seemed to have worked out without incident.
We really enjoyed the central location to major downtown sites and venues. We were able to walk to the waterfront, Rogers Center, Scotiabank Center and all the nearby restaurants and food markets. Not having to deal with downtown traffic was a big plus.

Location is perfect. The house was very clean and is a short walking distance to restaurants, located in a vibrant and safe area. The downside is that the house is showing signs of ageing and it isn't very spacious.  Host is wonderful!

Very clean and well curated townhouse in a great location in the cool neighborhood of West Wellington area of Toronto. Both full bath and half bath definitely a plus for the location of the property.  The property host was always quickly responsive and amiable, and provided much appreciated detailed info regarding the rental.  Four stars on pricing due to a billing issue on host's side that was eventually remedied both by the host and Airbnb, though it took a bit of time.
Andrew was a marvellous host, always helpful. It’s the second time we have stayed and we felt more at home the second time.
Perfect week-end in Toronto!

It was awesome to be back in Toronto at an Airbnb locations me and my team had stayed before. Another great work trip!
Looking forward to coming back again.
Had a great stay at Andrew’s place. Location was walkable to lots of great coffee shops and parks. He was very accommodating to everything we needed :)

Wir hatten einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt in diesem kleinen, gemütlichen Townhouse mitten in Toronto. Andrew’s place was a great spot for our work trip! He was super responsive and great to deal with. Thanks for having us.

It would be a pleasant stay in the spring/fall, but unfortunately the cold and inability to fix it ruined it for us. Host offered for us to work with Airbnb for alternate accommodations but we had a dog, and we couldn’t find anything that met our needs on such short notice. Given he provided space heaters preemptively, I assume he knew about the issue and wish it had been communicated to us before we showed up.
Lovely space. Great location
Great host, very flexible, great communicator and super nice! Highly recommend.
This place is very quaint, warm, and the host is tremendously friendly/accommodating!
We spend 13 nights at Randi’s and it was perfect!  Charming home, clean and confortable. Randi was waiting for us when we arrived and felt welcome by her friendly reception.

The space is down the hallway from a really nice sauna, hot tub, and pool, which we enjoyed!
Great location! Great hospitality! It would be great to do bar hopping around or attend festivals or exhibitions nearby in summer! The best place to enjoy downtown Toronto!
Great place, great location. Check-in was really easy. Randi was quick to communicate and available for any questions. I would highly recommend!

Great place with a great host!

Very good place to stay for couple of days!

Great place. Awesome location!

Randi was really responsive and accurate with her instructions. I really appreciated her help when we encountered issues with the apartment or with questions you may had during our stay in the city. I will gladly recommend her to friends and family :)

Great location with a ground floor entrance (that has immediate access to the train and park) and with secured underground parking. Keys were easily accessible. Absolutely amazing! Great accommodations, outstanding hospitality and an ideal location. Definitely willing to book for another occasion. Nothing negative whatsoever!

We were two couples and staid two nights. Randi’s condo is a five star rbnb at an absolutely affordable price. Access is easy and well organised and exactly as described. Randi is always responding promptly, the place is clean and very well located. I’m recommending with two 👍👍.

Randi was so great to communicate with. She responded right away! It was so easy to find her place and check in was super simple. Her place was perfect for a girls weekend away and easily walkable to many things we did. I highly recommend  her place.
Great location everything is within walking distance. Highly recommend
Great location and amenities.

Great communication. Clean unit with comfortable bed, TV with Netflix and guest parking on premises. Willing to accomodate late check-out. Looking forward to staying with Randi in the future!
A great, cozy space that anyone will enjoy. FANTASTIC location. Randi is most certainly a superhost - thorough explanations, quick to respond, polite and friendly, etc
Great place, well located and Randi replies fast and always gentle!

Needed a place to stay while our home was undergoing renovations. The Concrete Jungle was everything we needed and Randi made us feel incredibly welcome. Great space in a great location!
Awesome place!

Central location in Toronto, very clean and well maintained apartment for short or long stays.

Excellent experience in this clean, comfortable home in a great location. Anna is a great host. The house was beautiful and clean. Also located near many restaurants and shops.

Great location on the edge of Koreatown. Walking distance to lots of great restaurants and dessert places. Lots of space for a good price. The beds are VERY firm, and there could me more glasses and plates and such. My family had a good time exploring Toronto from Anna's house.

Great place! Lots of beds, good setup.

Lovely house, felt right at home.  Plenty of space for the 5 of us (2 adults, 3 boys - 14, 11, 11).   Was pleased with the cleanliness of everything, even the spacious garage. Great location and a nice little place. Extremely close to the Train which made it easy to get to and from downtown. Nice place.

Conveniently located near metro station and all the services on Bloor st., very clean, spacious and comfortable, very good base to explore the city. Parking space in the garage   as well. Big house for group of 6, happy staying at this house.

Excellent location,  close to public transit as well as eateries and shopping, and the home was roomy enough to accommodate our group of five.  would definitely consider a repeat visit.

Anna is great. Very responsive, very helpful.  Place is great, nice extra touches (teas in the cupboards, salt/pepper/sugar, tin foil, etc) - a lot of places are completely bare bones. Fantastic location. Homeowner offers excellent instruction and communication. Garage parking is a big perk.
Definitely recommended.
Excellent visit. Great for larger groups. Lots of room to spread out (inside and outside). Very clean and welcoming host.
House was clean, uber was very quick, access to downtown airport and Rogers stadium was easy.

Everything was great, place was clean and exactly as described.

Beds could be more comfortable.
Great location, comfortable beds, and easy communication with host. Only thing is the AC is very loud, otherwise we had a very comfortable stay.

Anna was a great host and communicated well. Apartment was in a great location.

Conveniently located to a lot of restaurants and stores.  Short drive to the sites in downtown.
My team and I had a wonderful stay here. The location is perfect for getting to other areas in the city via the subway. As well, perfect communication and a beautiful home.
Great location. Only a block from the subway. Very spacious. Idea for a large group. Includes parking for two cars which is a plus in this area. Relaxing covered patio and nicely manicured backyard.
I had a great stay at Anna's.

Anna was quick responding, but we had a water problem and I had to be messaging her for a few hours because she wouldn’t come to the place herself to check it out, so I spent half a day of my 2 days holidays in Toronto taking and sending her pictures and messages of the toilet because she wouldn’t come to the house to fix it herself. The Airbnb is comfortable for a large group of people and surely allows for people to sleep comfortably. It's in a good area near a high street with a lot of shops and stores as well as restaurant. The backyard was an added bonus and definitely nice to hang out with a large group

Great and convenient place close to downtown!

Anna was a great host and was responsive, but my group and I were probably expecting g a bit much for what we paid. That said, if you are on a budget this is the place for you. We ended up getting a hotel room our last night since we were all uncomfortable.
Had a great stay, the place was clean and the host responded to questions quickly. She was even kind enough to drop off an iron for us to use when we requested about it.
Great amenities and space for a large family. Central location.

We - four adults with three children - lived four days in Anna's house. The house was very clean and fulfilled all our needs. A big plus is the location so close to the subway. The cars stayed in the garage almost all the time. We can highly recommend the accommodation.
Very basic accommodation, clean but old and run down. Some expected items missing or limited ex clean towels, no dishwasher and expected to do dishes w no dishtowels. However excellent location.
Great location, helpful local tips from the host. Easy to communicate with and everything appeared as described in the listing.

Anna’s house was perfect for our brothers weekend away. It is located close to the subway station, restaurants, cafes, and parks.
Anna is a great host giving you all the information you would need while staying at her house.
Great place and Anna was very helpful. Would recommend!

This house is in an awesome location in the city with a lot going on in the neighbourhood and a metro station right around the corner. Clean space with enough roo. for large groups, definitely recommend!
Perfect for our stay in Toronto for a trade show. Great location and suitable for larger groups. Walking distance to everything you need.

I would really recommend this place!

Good house for the price. Few issues with loud noises in the bathrooms and a few items randomly left from the previous guest left around. Great neighborhood for young people with lots of cool bars and good restaurants.

The house location is truly a gem. Everything is so close to this safe clean location.

We would definitely recommend this property.
Thanks Anna.
Anna is a wonderful host. Any questions we had during our stay was promptly answered. Beautiful house and neighbourhood. We will stay again and highly recommend it.

My co-workers stayed at Anna's house from September 2020 till March 2021. The house is great, spacious, has everything you need. Anna’s place is spacious and easy to access. To have a parking garage near Bloor Street is very convenient. Comfortable beds are essential for us and we had good night sleeps at Anna’s. Very well located in a cozy neighbourhood 10 min drive from Toronto.

All bedrooms are large and well equipped with comfortable beds.
Great place to stay. Close to lots of restaurants and transit. Anna was a very helpful host. Strongly recommend to stay here if you are planning to explore Toronto.
Great location! Communication with Anna very easy and fast. The place is pretty big and the backyard is nice. Good to know that the bedroom downstairs has no door.

This house was exactly what we needed. There were five of us. My wife and I slept in the basement which was lovely and cool. Our 3 children all over 18 had a room each so they all had their own space. The street was nice and quiet. Yet the Main Street was just two minutes away.
We would highly recommend for families or groups of 5 or more.
Thanks Anna for loaning us your lovely house
Alan & Caroline

Anna was responsive and made everything easy. This place is SO close to the subway and is an ideal home base for sightseeing. Our party of seven had a fabulous time! Will definitely stay with Anna again. :)
The house is clean and was perfect for us. The beds are comfy and Anna replied very quick to any questions we had.
We had a great 3 nights in Anna’s house. Perfect place to stay with kids, clean and had everything we need, felt like home!

Anna is a very attentive and helpful host. Location is excellent. Easy to get around, super vibrant neighbourhood and great restaurants. Place itself could use updating and some good TLC. Back garden is lovely and nice to sit out having dinner. Air Conditioning throughout house was great.

The location of this place is it's best feature. We travelled as two families consisting of two couples with 4 little children (ages 0-6) and the area was perfect! There was an amazing park just a few blocks away that included a free wading pool and plenty of space to run amuck. The small restaurants nearby were extremely kind and accommodating to families with young kids. There is a McDonalds a block away that is open 24 hrs, which is perfect when little ones wake up very early. Everything was within walking distance and we were in a great location to drive to tourist attractions without dealing with overwhelming traffic.
The amenities were great. Being able to have parking for two cars in Toronto was awesome, and having access to laundry was helpful with little kids.
Anna did a great job in answering correspondences promptly during our visit. She showed consideration and even offered a later checkout as she knew we had kids with us. She sent recommendations for restaurants nearby and we had a great experience at each one we tried off her list
The one thing that did catch me off guard was that the place was a bit more aged/less well maintained than the pictures would suggest. Some holes and pealing paint on the walls and many drywall patches; aging notes taped around the house and tape over switches; loose electrical outlets and cords on the ground making it a bit unsafe to have small children crawl around, a slight mildew smell to the towels; dirty grout around the bathtubs, wear and tear on the furniture. That being said, the bedding was clean and comfy, the kitchen utensils and appliances were in good condition, and the backyard was lovely.
This place makes a great launching point. We were rarely in the building during the day and found that it was a very convenient location with useful amenities for any large group who wants to be out and about on the town. It is hard to find lodging for a group of 8 in downtown Toronto and this place fit the bill.
Great location! Spacious house for large group. Would recommend!
Perfect location for a group of 10 to stay, very nice and clean house in a great area with lots of nearby restaurants. Would recommend anyone to stay here.

The thermostat for the air conditioner was locked at 22 degree C so we need to ask the host for lower the setting and she gave us the code.  It was a little complicate newer thermostat so we couldn't figure out how to change it.  But we were able to open all the windows so it was great.   YueQin was extremely helpful on our parking situation - the house comes with a 2 car garage but we rented a 12 passenger van and it was too tall for the garage to enter.  YueQin showed me how to get a street parking permit and although it was a little hard to find a street parking spot on the first night where we have to park a block away, but it worked out perfectly.  The house furnishing is basic but all functional.  The nice size dining table came in very handy with us gathering around - there are actually 10 chairs that we can use for dining! Great bnb and great host
Perfect location to use as base with our friends before our wedding! Great communication when there were issues! Definitely will stay again as a group next time we are in town!

The sliders should consist of 2 parts, the outer portion are either sliding windows (in this case) or screens, and the interior windows should be sliding locking windows. In my case, the interior windows were missing and the outer windows provided easy access from outside the apartment as they do not have a locking mechanism. After cancelling my stay there (15 minutes after arriving), I have only been refunded just over half of my fee. My husband and I stayed here for 2 weeks. Maria is quick to respond, check in was easy and it was generally clean, however there were many things that could have been flagged to us prior to our stay about the state of the unit. There was no indication that the ceiling was so low. My husband (who has a history of concussions) is only 5'11" but kept smacking his head because the low ceiling was throughout most of the apartment, including over the bed and right at the entrance. He had to slouch for our entire stay and was dizzy from inadvertently hitting his head so many times - despite being extremely cautious. He still has a lump on his head from it. Considering his history with concussions, we absolutely never would have booked to stay here had we known that you had to be shorter than the average height to fit.
Secondly, there was no indication on the listing of the limitations for appliance use due to the inadequate electrical set up. We couldn't use more than one small appliance at a time without running the risk of shutting off the power. Something like this should have been more clearly communicated with a physical sign in the kitchen area and a mention about it in the listing, prior to booking.
Lastly, this apartment is advertised upfront as "Fully separate, very quiet" which is misleading given we could hear every single thing that went on upstairs: footsteps, going down the stairs / wood creaking, full word-for-word conversations, appliance use, phone and alarm chimes. While these are not examples of extremely excessive noise, this was not as advertised and was misleading from the first line of the listing's description. There were two instances of either the phone or door alarm chime going off loudly at ~4am in the morning as well. All of this made the living conditions difficult to deal with and our general point here is that this is an older building / unit, which clearly already has a few significant kinks that could very easily have been communicated in the listing prior to booking.

These are simply facts of the home and they may, or may not, be an issue for you but you should know so you can make an informed decision.
First...right next to the house is a major construction site. Looks like an apartment building is going up and the loud noise starts at 7am Monday - Friday and goes throughout the day. Not sure how long it will last so, if this is an issue, you should inquire about the status of the construction.
Second...you do not have access to the whole house in two ways. First, there is a tenant in the basement. This is the owner's nanny and her husband as well as a dog. And, second, about 80% of the cupboards, closets and drawers in the house are locked, presumably with the owner's personal items. This leaves very little room for a guest's clothes, toiletries, food, etc. For example, in the master bedroom, there is a nice size closet and one small 3 drawer dresser. Since it was just two of us, this wasn't a problem, but for a family, it could be an issue. Possibly, you could ask if more space could be freed up, if you think you would need it. Based on my experience with Alex, that would not be a problem.

I really wish that I could have given Reem-Mayah’s condo a higher rating. But in good conscience, we cannot, as that would be unfair to future AirBnB'ers who are looking for honest feedback. The two most significant issues we faced were the lack of air conditioning for 6 nights (of our 7 night stay), and the size of the 2nd bed ”room”… both are described below.
Air Conditioning
The Air Conditioning in the condo was not functioning as expected when we moved in (Tue night) – some air was flowing, but it was not cooling the condo. Initially we tried to “fix” it by adjusting the Control Panel settings, but to no avail. There were no fans in the condo (ceiling or portable)
When we first contacted the hosts about it (wed morning), Mayah’s response was to question whether we were actually uncomfortable (!) or merely complaining because the Control Panel was showing a high reading. Note: We had emailed a picture of the Control Panel to her to ensure that we had the correct settings.
Mayah informed us that they had other condos in the building and no one else had complained, and suggested that we give it some time. So we did.
When we had no improvement by the evening (Wed), WE suggested to her to escalate the issue to building management to see what was going on.
After several hours, she got back to us with the news that it was a building-wide problem, and the building management folks were waiting for parts from the US, expected resolution was Friday evening. Mind you this was still Wed night…
No interim comfort measures were offered to make our stay bearable in the poorly ventilated unit with zero cross ventilation. There are two small “windows” that open about 4 or 5 inches in a vertical plane by use of a crank – the open vent reminded me of the Carbon Monoxide vents we have in garages – these vents are not designed to facilitate any cross ventilation! There is also a door that leads to the balcony, but that is also positioned so that no cross-ventilation happens when it is kept open.
So Thu and Fri we mostly stayed out of the condo and only came back to sleep…
On Friday night when we returned to the condo, we saw a new notice from building management that the issue was not yet resolved and the new ETA was Monday evening. No updates or messages from our hosts…
Then we sent Mayah a message requesting 3-4 portable fans so we could have air circulation. This was late Friday night, so we didn’t expect an immediate answer.
We heard back from Mayah on Saturday morning, stating that she was out of the country and the earliest she could help us would be after her return on Sunday!
We responded by asking her about her partner (Reem) or other emergency arrangements they might have.
Mayah’s response was that Reem was also out of the country, and that if we wanted quicker relief we could buy fans from Walmart, and return them when we left, as Walmart had a 30 day return policy… R-E-A-L-L-Y?!!!!
We were so shocked by this absurd and unethical (illegal?) suggestion that we didn’t even respond.
Later that day we got a message from Mayah that 2 Air Circulators (those cylindrical vertical fans) had been left for us with the lobby concierge, and that we should assemble and use them, but to save the boxes they came in, which we did.
The 2 fans were definitely better than nothing and we gladly used them, although we did have to move them around often, based on whether we were in the bedrooms, the living room or the kitchen. Also we had to find makeshift stands/platforms to place them, as they were not really effective when placed on the floor.
Finally on Monday evening, the air-conditioning was restored and we were able to sleep in comfort on the seventh (and last) night of our Toronto vacation.
The Second Bed “Room” (Niche??)
This review would be incomplete without commenting on the second bed-room… it is NOT a real room, but an alcove or nook that is scarcely bigger than the bed that is located in there. There is no door to this “room” and not even space for a night stand!! One has to get on to the bed near the foot area, and then crawl up into position to lie down to sleep!!
Now, to end on a positive note: the view of the Toronto skyline from the balcony is very pretty, and there is a nice breeze in the balcony!
