We were  traveling with our infant and toddler which is not an easy task but Fannie helped with her own insight and she also had little books and puzzles for my toddler to play with and he really loved that so much. The neighborhood is very close to many restaurants, a close by park you can walk to. We were able to walk to a few places for sushi and breakfast and if we needed to drive I would say it took us about 10 to 15 minutes to get to a few attractions. All in all I would stay here again. The home was exactly as the pictures (if not better in person). Truly we had an amazing time. Thank you to Fannie and her family ❤️

Fannie was super helpful and responsive. She gave great instructions for parking.
This house is exactly like in the photos, clean, and very comfortable. Considering the size of the house, the location is great - only a block from the Queen Street streetcar service and local shops and cafes.

Fanny’s place is as you see it in the pictures.   Place has good access to public transit and to the downtown core.   Fanny was very responsive and check in was easy!  This place is great place to gather with friends and family. The fish and chips next door is also good grub food!
Clean and nicely appointed for a large family.
Great host
Four big bedrooms and a great living room/kitchen space. Good host who was very responsive and friendly.
Great place and location. Would visit again if I am ever in Canada!

Wocheng's place is perfectly located, between the fantastic dosa on Gerard and the book stores / bakeries / cafes on Queen. The home is comfortable, spacious as advertised, and perfectly clean. Thank you Wocheng!
The place was beautiful and clean. Great stay! Parking was a bit far but that is true of most places in town.

Looking around the area; this was a clear winner for our group. It was much less expensive than everything else and walking distance to several breweries and places to eat.
Everything we wanted to do was either a 10-15 min walk or a 10-30 min drive. Not bad at all!
We felt really close to everything we wanted to do!
The place was very clean. The beds were super comfy.
I think the only comment from the ladies in our group was that they wished there was a full length mirror in the house.
Other than that, if you're debating between this place and another... choose this place!
It was everything expected.  Very clean. Would stay again in the future.
Ótima estadia. Recomendo.

We spent a long weekend at the house with 7 adults.  There was plenty of space for all of us, the house is pretty much brand new and looked just like the photos.  Plenty of linens and towels, well equipped kitchen.  What we really appreciated was water bottles and a few snacks that had been left out for us when we arrived, really needed after a long journey.  The host was very responsive and the directions were easy to follow and clear.  Thanks for a great visit!

This house is very well located on the east side of Toronto, there are stores, restaurants and bars within walking distance.  The house was well laid out for our group of 6 with plenty of space.  The host left us a few snacks and bottled water which was a very nice touch.

My friends and I spent a week at Wocheng's place and we had an amazing stay! She was a responsive and considerate host who provided clear instructions for check-in and check-out. Her place was clean, tidy and had all required necessities. She even accommodated us to store our luggage on the last day as our flight was later in the day. Her place is a short Uber ride from downtown and the neighbourhood was quite nice to walk around and explore. We would definitely recommend Wocheng's place to our travellers!
Great stay! photos and description matched expectations perfectly. ample room. would definitely stay again!
The home was great,  great neighborhood and the home it self was clean and just right for our family.  I would definitely be a guest again!

We had a great stay in Toronto with 7 of us.  The place was clean and had nice living areas.  While parking was not on site, there was close overnight Green P parking plus some street parking available.  Good proximity to many great restaurants and the heart of downtown Toronto.

This was a beautiful property, walking distance to the beaches and groceries. The hosts were very responsive and wonderful to deal with. Happy to recommend for anyone looking for an amazing space in the beaches. We plan to be back.
Great place for our staff to stay in while on a work trip! Highly Recommend.

Enjoyed Wocheng's place. Very responsive hosts, and the place was clean and just as pictured. Street parking was not too far too find. Area was nice and quiet.
A few things to be aware of: The kitchen trash was very small, the same size as bathrooms. The bedroom and bathroom doors do not lock. We were provided towels aplenty, but no washcloths, so you'll want to bring your own.
Overall, really enjoyed our stay!
We were 3 couples and one 2 year-old.  The place was laid out great to enjoy each others company.  For the 2 year old we just needed to stay vigilant as there are stairs between the 3 floors.
This is the second time we’ve stayed and the house was good as the first time. Wocheng is a great host.

Beautiful Home. Very clean. Plenty of linens and towels. Laundry pods to do laundry was a plus. (Not common at previous rentals). Host was responsive. We had issues with sufficient heat so the host brought over heaters. Completely out of the host control. Only thing that was a little bother is not having a printer available to print out the parking permit. Parking wasn’t too bad. Had to drive 10 minutes to print at fedex. Having a wireless printer available would’ve made it much more convenient.
Stayed with family for a wedding. Great location, host was very responsive and had no issues whatsoever.

This is a really clean, nicely laid out house.
The host is really friendly and responsive.
The kitchen was well stocked and clean.
However, the road it is on is quite busy, there is a police station opposite so you can here sirens sometimes. It has double glazing throughout so that is not too much of a problem.
Their is no parking outside the house and I usually managed to find parking within about 100m further down the road. You can park outside to load and unload.
I would describe the location as half way between Leslieville and the Beaches and as such there is not much to do right there but it is easy to drive to lots of cool areas.
Nice, comfortable, and practical for 8. I am a light sleeper, but I slept very well here with the blackout curtains.

This listing is amazing. The home was so clean and welcoming with coffee, water and snacks provided.
The beds are so comfortable!!! ❤️
The hosts were very responsive, kind, caring, and quick to respond to every need! I have stayed at many Airbnb’s. This listing has been the best. The hosts thought of everything!! The home is well equipped for a gathering!
The location is easy to get to and many restaurants bakeries grocery store and liquor store all in walking distance. Thank you for sharing ring your home with us 💕
Had a great stay with my co workers! Host was very responsive and helpful. Space is great for groups where space is needed.

This is an easily accessible, pristine clean place to stay for your Toronto visit.
Out host was very responsive and check in and out were easy.
Great space inside/out, only downfall was parking other than that It fit the needs for 5 adults
Great stay! 5 of us stayed in this and felt very comfortable with many bathrooms and bedrooms. A good home base for our conference.
Overall amazing stay

Found Wocheng's Airbnb listing last minute due to mischeduling of a reserved place prior, and felt like we lucked out finding this property to accommodate my family of 7 during our trip to Toronto. We were provided very detailed instructions prior to arriving that once we had actually arrived, everything felt seamless as if we were at home away from home. Will definitely be booking with Wocheng for the next time again in Toronto.
Awesome stay! House has plenty of room and in a great location. Wocheng was very responsive and accommodated all of our requests. Highly recommend!
Wocheng was great, easy to deal with! There was 8 of us and the space was perfect! Just a little bit away from Downtown Toronto but it was only a 10-15 Uber ride away!
Great place to stay in the east end of Toronto. Responsive and proactive host. Would recommend!
My group of friends stayed here for a wedding weekend, it was comfortable for a group, close to downtown, and the host was super nice and responsive to anything we needed!
Very comfortable!  Lots of room.

Place was clean. Host had thought through all the essential necessities that made stay comfortable and convenient. Location is on a busy street but overall walkable to grocery stores and some coffee shops. Parking was I thought the main drawback but was easy to find parking by driving few blocks away.
For the cleanliness and space, would stay again in the future.

We had a wonderful stay at Wocheng's lovely home, which is nicer even than the photos. It allowed our group both to spread out and have their own space when needed then gather comfortably together in the large open living space. She is a particularly responsive, thoughtful host. Highly recommended, many thanks!
I'd recommend this place to any big group staying in Toronto.
The place was amazing. It had plenty of room for 5 couples. Everything was very clean and comfortable

We had a large group of 8 adults. This AirBnB had all we needed for our week long stay. Our host were wonderful at responding for the few requests we had and prompt to supply additional products (listed in the ammenties). Check in was a breeze and check out was even easier. Thank you for a wonderful stay.

Wocheng was amazing. Was always super responsive always super kind always available. The listing look exactly how it was supposed to when we showed up. It was located in a great location with easy access to the tram that took you right into the heart of downtown. There were restaurants, small shops, a grocery store and more all within walking distance. Rooms were spacious, bathrooms were clean, and clean towels were readily available in each room upon arrival, which I thought was a nice touch. She even provided water and a snack tray, which was amazing and very much needed after long flights. All in all highly recommend I would 100% stay again.
Great find for larger groups!  Responsive, easy to connect with. Great hosting. Thank you!

She was a great host : fast communication and awesome kindness.
Her house was perfect to stay with big family.
I stayed 3 nights, I especially liked the bedding and the location of the laundry and dry machine. Plus, well organized kitchen. I ll definitely choose this place again in next time.

We had a wonderful stay at Wocheng's place. It was perfect for two families with kids, and we found the location great - close to the beach, to some great restaurants, and an easy shot down the main road to get to other neighborhoods. We appreciated that they had dishes the kids could use, and the kitchen had all the equipment you'd need.
Great house and location. 10/10 would highly recommend!
This was our third stay at the house and was as good as previous visits. Host is very accommodating and flexible. Great location too.

This house was perfect for our needs (family of 3 couples there for a wedding). Walking distance to Queen St., street car lines, and to the whole Beaches area, the house is new, immaculate, modern, clean, bright with modern amenities throughout. Highly recommend.

We had a very enjoyable stay at Wocheng’s home. She was very responsive and accommodating. The location is great as easy access to the city and some great spots close by. Would recommend staying here next time you’re travelling to Toronto.
safe area, lots to do, would totally come back
Beautiful home and responsive hosts.  Thank you

Great neighborhood stay. The place is exactly as it looked in pictures and walkable to the events we were attending. The location is in a charming older neighborhood close to food, a few bars and the beach. The parking situation is not ideal but the hosts communicated thoroughly & we did find an alternative that worked. I bet this place is even better in the summer or fall!

We were attending a few shows at HISTORY, this location could not have been better. It was a five minute walk to the venue. Can I add that simple coffee around the block has the friendliest owner and great coffee. Place was super clean and modern, do I wish the living room was a little bigger for hanging out, yes, but it still provided everything you need. If it was the summer time and we had access to the outdoor space then it would have been perfect.  If you are attending an event at HISTORY there is no better place to stay.
The house is clean. There are a lot board games available in living room, which is pretty nice. Definitely would live here again!
Beautiful home and perfect location. Would definitely stay again.

This is a very spacious, well-cared for and mostly comfortable home. We enjoyed staying there except for wishing there was enough comfortable seating in the living room for all 5 of us. There was only a couch; we wish there'd been a second couch/loveseat or a couple of armchairs, since we spent a lot of our evenings sitting and talking together. Other than that, the place was perfect for us.
We enjoyed exploring the neighbourhood - lots of shopping, coffee shops & restaurants - and we could easily catch a tram or bus to go elsewhere in the city.

We were very impressed with this Airbnb. It was spotlessly clean, with little thoughtful touches all around the house to make your stay convenient. The beds were extremely comfortable, the house is quiet from outside noise. The location is amazing - super close to all transit, tons of bars and restaurants to chose from.
Beautiful home. Host was great and easy to contact if needed. 100% recommend

Great house
We were 6 adults attending a wedding. We had everything we needed.
Restaurants a nice 10 min walk away and Lake Ontario shore boardwalk / beach and cafes not much further.
Great communication from the owner.
Easy to get Ubers everywhere we needed to go.

Wocheng's place was great! It had a nice, well-equipped kitchen, all of the beds were comfortable, and the house was spotless! They were also very responsive when we had questions. Would recommend to anyone.

Wocheng and Josh were very good hosts who provided a house that felt like home from home. The house was spacious, spotless, well equipped and the beds were extremely comfortable. The provision of children's dishes, boardgames, complimentary coffee, water in the fridge and a snack tray were very welcome. There was plenty of hot water, clean towels and the air conditioning was a great relief during the very hot and humid weather.
The house is conveniently located for shops, restaurants and the beach.
We would not hesitate to recommend a stay at Wocheng's house.

We loved our stay. It was a very comfortable stay. We really felt at home. The place was very clean, all amenities available. The location is great, quieter area close to so many parks and shops. Although the house is on a Main Street, it was very quiet inside. The house is very spacious, just the right amount of furniture for the space, no clutter.
Highly recommend Wocheng’s place.
Great accommodating host. Comfy beds and plenty of pillows/towels.

Wocheng Feng's home was perfect in every way.  Fully stocked kitchen and beautiful, comfy linens on the beds. The entire home was spotless and was a perfect home for a large group.  It was also in a perfect location. I would highly recommend this home!!
Great spot to stay!
Had a great stay! Super close to great restaurants in the area and to public transportation. The house is super comfortable and really clean. Would HIGHLY recommend!

Beautiful home and great hosts! Their fridge unfortunately stopped working a day before our arrival  but they were quick to solve the issue and purchased a mini fridge for us which was a life saver! House is exactly like the pictures and very clean! The only thing that sucked a little was the parking but it wasn’t too bad because the area is beautiful and the walk to and from the car was pleasant every time!
Have stayed at this location several times for long weekend visits, stay is always great. Host very responsive and flexible.

Perfect place to stay . We were in town for a wedding . Very spacious ,super clean and quiet .  Beds were very comfortable. Host was fantastic and very quick to respond to any questions I had . I would definitely stay here again.

An enjoyable stay for wedding activities and family to gather. It was comfortable to come back to. Although no parking on site, ubers and taxis were very available
Thank you for sharing your hospitality.

Casa bastante confortável e acomodou bem a equipe. Estava limpa e organizada. A cozinha é completa.
A equipe ficou bem instalada nos 4 confortáveis quartos, com privacidade e segurança.
O anfitrião foi bastante gentil e compreensivo ao flexibilizar horários para facilitar a logística com horários dos voos internacionais.
Somos gratos e pretendemos voltar e lá se instalar no congresso do próximo ano.

This apt is so well situated - being on one of the main streets for food and drinks it was perfect for our stay.
Hosts were beyond helpful and gave great recommendations to the area. The apt was beautiful and had the most insane view of downtown!
10/10 recommend and will definitely be staying again if in Toronto

Donald and Caroline's downtown condo was the perfect place to spend 3 nights during our family vacation! The apartment was super clean, well stocked and located in a great area. We were near a LOT of restaurants and the water as well  - every tourist site felt easily walkable. We also really enjoyed having a dedicated parking spot that we can come in and out of included in this reservation for the faraway sites. Caroline and Donald were both also very responsive in a timely manner. The apartment was stocked full of anything you'd need included shampoo/conditioner/kitchen etc. It was a very enjoyable stay and we had a great time! We highly recommend it!

We had a wonderful stay at Donald’s! It was really spacious and clean. Location-wise, it was perfect for all the activities we planned in the King West area! Donald was also easy to reach if we had any questions.
We loved the neighborhood & the view!  Very nice accommodations and our hosts were very communicative.  Thanks again!
Great place in a great neighborhood, close to many of the best bars and restaurants in the city, plus a Starbucks and grocery store right on the corner. Love the downtown view!
Excellent stay- perfect location, and despite being downtown is so quiet! Thank you for sharing your space.
Dons place was a great location, super clean, easy to access, lots of parking, and Don was very responsive!  Place had everything you needed and then some!

Donald is a fabulous host! His listing was clean, accurate, in a great location close to downtown, and the included parking spot was a huge plus. Donald was very responsive and accommodating. I would highly recommend him to anyone!
We spent four wonderful months at Donald’s place. The apartment was perfect and in a great neighborhood. Donald was very helpful and reactive to our requests.
Great location, great residence, great host.

Magnificent apartments. I'm so glad we chose them! Clean, comfortable, and bright. The apartments have everything you might need. The location is amazing, there is everything around: shops, a gym, several parks, and coffee shops - within walking distance. Landlord is simply gorgeous - sympathetic, and always ready to help, explain, and advise.
10 stars out of 5!
So close to the grocery store.  Very comfy bed.  Clear instructions on check in and check out.  Would stay there again!
Caroline’s place was clean and tidy, exactly how it was described. The location is perfect.

Caroline and Don's place is just steps away from some of my favourite places in Toronto (I'm from the city so I'm very familiar with the area), comes equipped with almost everything you'd need for your stay (the kitchen was missing some basics advertised in the listing, like oil, but there's a grocery store right across the street), is close to transit, has free parking if you'd rather drive, and one bedroom has an epic view of the city skyline. Definitely recommend!
Caroline and Donald were super responsive. Condo was airy, clean, comfy, and peaceful! Perfect location for our first visit to Canada.. great view of downtown. I recommend booking with this host!
Great location, cozy place. Amazing communication! We couldn't find the tv remote, and they had one delivered the next morning!

The host was very responsive and answered all my questions also got back to me in a timely manner. Although the building was going through renovations and could be noisy at times the overall stay was great. This really is no fault of the host if anything it shows that the building is also upgrading and will look even better after the renovations.
The rental was well kept, clean and is exactly as the pictures. The neighborhood is also nice with things to and places to eat. There is a market around the corner and Starbucks. You can walk to other locations/neighborhoods and find things to do and places to eat as well. Public transportation is also worth doing felt very safe.

Caroline and Donald were extremely helpful and responsive hosts with a lovely home to share. The building is in a very walkable area - close to transit and stores (grocery/Liqour). The apartment is extremely comfortable with two great bedrooms and amazing bathrooms with two large showers. The balcony is fantastic and even though we did not get to use it -we brought the West Coast rain with us - I can see it as a lovely addition on a nice evening with super views of the Toronto skyline.
Bel appartement pour un séjour à Toronto.
In town for a work conference and got absolutely spoiled by this listing. Everything we were promised and more. Would recommend this to any and all!

Caroline and Donald were great hosts. Great communication and helpful. Place was comfortable, super quiet, close to restaurants and walking distance or short Uber ride to CN Tower etc. would stay with them again.
Our stay here was great! Free parking included, great location with walkable distance to many restaurants and bars etc. I would recommend staying here!
We had a wonderful time with my family with the Toronto Tower nearby. The in-room facilities were excellent and helpful.

Very nice place! The master bedroom is very spacious and the City Views are Incredible. The Hosts are super friendly and responsive. Very safe neighborhood—Secure building. Would definitely recommend and stay again.

Caroline & Donald's place was perfect! They are awesome hosts who are super responsive and accommodating. Amazing neighborhood with everything you need and easy access to the rest of the city. The apartment has a great setup with more amenities then you will typically see.

We were happy to find a 2 bed/bath with parking but a few things could have gone better. The bed in the master bedroom was awfully squeaky and uncomfortable and we were bummed that the roof deck was closed due to construction. We appreciated how responsive Caroline & Don were during our stay.
Nice place to continue our Great Lakes Road Trip. It was fairly close to major attractions, clean, and comfortable though a bit cramped.

The checkin was smooth,  we even arrived a little early and it was not a problem.  On the other end of the trip,  we had a late flight and Caroline and Donald were so accommodating. We will always remember that about this trip. The beds are very comfortable.  The extras in the kitchen were great. Salt, pepper, etc.  We Ubered our way around,  and the longest we waited was 3 minutes. Make sure you are ready before you order the Uber.  Toronto was hot during our stay and the condo was a refreshing place to rest at the end of the day. All in all a great trip and airbandb. Thank you Caroline and Donald.

What a great place to spend a long weekend in Toronto. Easy access to walking trails, the streetcar and downtown as well as some great restaurants and shops. The apartment was clean and comfortable and one of the few places with parking included, which made getting around much easier. The hosts were easy to communicate with and very helpful about getting into the building. We'll definitely be back next time we're in town.

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour chez Caroline et Donald! L’appartement est très bien situé, très propre, confortable et très bien équipé. La vue sur le centre-ville est superbe! Les hôtes sont hors pair, communiquer avec eux était simple et rapide. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié la proximité des services et l’accès facile au transport en commun pour nous déplacer plus loin dans la ville.
Super séjour! Logement propre et bien situé. Les hôtes sont super également.

We had a great visit at Caroline’s place. Condo was stocked with plenty of towels, wash cloths, bedding, toiletries, and dish soaps. The only thing that caught us off guard was the bathrooms both had mold/mildew in the showers/tubs.
Other than the bathroom stains, everything was very clean, smelled fresh, and was very comfortable.
Great location! We will certainly stay again!

While attending a wedding and a funeral in Toronto, we found immense comfort in coming back to this immaculate and beautiful Airbnb each day! The hosts were accommodating and incredibly attentive. The space was exceptional, with a breathtaking balcony view and within walking distance to shopping areas. I wholeheartedly recommend it and will surely book again for future trips.

We had a great visit to Toronto! As a first-time visitor attending a couple of Blue Jays games, we were happy to be within walking distance to Rodgers Centre (20ish min) or an even closer walk to take public transit. Our hosts were very helpful in answering all of our questions and went above and beyond in ordering a fan with next day delivery for us. I would stay here again!
Great communication, easy check-in and enjoyable stay.

We had a fantastic week staying in this apartment. The place is well equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay. Caroline and Donald are fantastic hosts and were so helpful and quick to respond to any questions I had.
Lots of great vegan restaurants and cafes around. Great central location, walking distance to city centre but tram is also available which takes you into the city centre in no time at all.
I would 100% stay here again!
This place is a little gem.

Caroline and Donald’s place was an ideal place to stay.  The apartment is comfortable, clean, in a great location, and has a balcony with views of downtown Toronto.  The hosts were easy to work with and helpfully communicated all the check-in and check-out instructions.  My friends and I had a fun weekend.  Highly recommend.

Great place to stay. Was able to walk to the Start line for the Toronto race. Nearby Liberty Village has all amenities. Caroline and Donald were very responsive. Great place with a good size balcony. Two good size bedrooms one and comfortable living space. Would stay here again.
Great apartment, well furnished and amazing location!!
This is such a great place to stay! Not only were the views and location amazing but the place itself was great. I will gladly stay here again!
Exceptional stay! Impeccably clean, stylish, and cozy space. Thoughtful amenities, great communication, and a prime location. Highly recommend! Thank you Caroline & Donald!

We loved our stay! Four nights away can be a lot when it doesn’t feel like home.. luckily our experience was excellent! Lots to see and do nearby, comfortable beds and a safe building! Would love to stay again! Thank you!!
First time to Canada. Thank you Caroline and Don for providing a safe space for us to explore. Your info and great communication was great!
Great stay,  cozy and felt  like home. Caroline and Donald were great hosts! Highly recommended.
I’ve used Caroline and Donald’s place twice and it’s perfect. Love Liberty Village and the close proximity to downtown.

The apartment was definitely worth the stay! The views from the apartment of the Toronto skyline is stunning, and the area the apartment is located in is nice and quiet despite being right on the city. Having a supermarket and streetcar on our doorstep made everything so much easier too.
The apartment itself is perfect for everyones needs, well equipped and modern. Most importantly it was very comfortable!
Would definitely recommend to anyone looking to travel to Toronto.

Another perfect stay at Caroline and Donald’s condo!  Excellent communication, super easy check in, everything close by and most importantly slept like a baby every night :)  Thank you and we will stay again next time we are in Toronto.

We had a wonderful stay at Caroline's apartment in Toronto. The apartment had a beautiful view of the CN Tower, which added to the overall experience. The location was perfect for us as we were attending a conference at the Enercare Center, which was just a 10-minute walk away.
Caroline was an excellent host and provided us with great recommendations for local restaurants. We visited a couple of them and they turned out to be amazing! It was evident that she had a good knowledge of the area and was genuinely interested in ensuring we had a memorable stay.
The only minor drawback was the parking, which was a bit challenging to navigate. However, it didn't overshadow the overall positive experience we had.
We highly recommend Caroline's apartment to anyone visiting Toronto. Thank you, Caroline, for being such a great host!

The apartment was very charming and exactly as described. Caroline and Donald were terrific to deal with- very responsive and flexible. Loved their guide to Toronto. The neighborhood is super convenient and walkable. All in all, would highly recommend this delightful apartment if you are planning a trip to Toronto!

This was a 10 out of 10 stay! We had a reunion trip in Toronto and it was perfectly located to get to the hustle and bustle of queen west, liberty village and lakeshore. Caroline was very responsive and we had taken a red eye flight into Toronto and she allowed for an early check in so we could get a rest in. The beds were incredibly comfortable and no complaints! Also a beauty view of the CN Tower! Loved every minute and would definitely rebook!
Caroline’s place was just as pictured and she was a great host. She was very responsive and check in was easy. The neighborhood felt safe and was a reasonable walk to lots of fun areas.

Caroline was very responsive and also flexible with check in/check out times which was great as we were travelling from the UK.
The apartment is central and the view is better than it looks on the photo's. One of the bedrooms is definitely superior to the other one, so be prepared for that.
The kitchen was very well stocked and we did not need for anything.
We had an issue with one of the showers which was only discovered just before we checked it. It was a shame that a plumber could not come & fix it during our stay, but I guess some things are out of our control. Caroline did send a small refund in recompense for the issue.
Caroline did send over some local suggestions, but as we were visiting family and already had a full schedule we did not use them.
Overall I would recommend Caroline's place and would have no hesitation of staying there again. I did come back on my own on one of the nights and the building felt very safe & secure.

Stayed here to travel to a nearby concert at the Coca-Cola Coliseum and my friends and I rented this airbnb as a small get away. There's a streetcar stop extremely close to the outside to get to other parts of the city quicker and the apartment itself was super nice. Great view, very clean interior, comfy beds. Host was very responsive. ☺️

We had a lovely stay at Caroline’s place. Great location for getting to downtown Toronto with a street car right outside and convenient parking with the condo.
The apartment was clean, and well equipped. We were a party of 3 and there was enough room for us, even though the condo is quite compact.
The balcony was a bit disappointing, as it was not well maintained with old furniture that needed cleaning, and a bbq that was not useable (it was very dirty and rusty, probably better to not have a bbq than keep that and advertise as having one!)
The balcony did let the place down a little which was a shame.
Overall, we had a pleasant stay, but there are some places where a little extra TLC wouldn’t go a miss.

The location cannot be beat! Its well connected via the TTC and has tons of restaurants brarby. The place is well kept and the host are very responsive. Having parking inside the premises is also a big plus in Toronto.

Caroline was excellent to deal with.
Her AirBNB is the most fully equipped- kitchen and bathrooms. It was not lacking a thing.
The balcony is great for morning coffee in the sunshine.
We’ll definitely be back.
So kindly and good place!
Excellent stay. Nice place has everything you need and very spacious. The balcony is awesome. Host was very responsive and helpful. Would recommend staying here!

It's in a great location, and the house has everything we looked for a fitness center, parking, access to all attractions, a nearby grocery store, and public transport.
Really, there's nothing to complain about. This is an excellent choice if you plan to spend time in and around downtown Toronto!
Great place to stay in Toronto! In a fantastic neighborhood, walk to Indy and the Budweiser stage, close to the lake!

I can’t say enough good things about the Air Bnb! Caroline and Donald were very responsive and would 100% recommend their place! Excellent location, spacious, clean and just the perfect place to stay.
Wonderful home and extremely nice host we look forward to coming back again

Great location. View of the skyline was lovely. The view was beautiful, you definitely wake with the sun. Bring your sleep mask if you want to sleep in. It was easy to get around, and great to have free parking.

Caroline's apartment is in a great location with excellent access to public transport as well as all the best local spots in Liberty Village! The apartment had everything we needed for our stay and Caroline was easy to communicate with. Would recommend to anyone visiting Toronto.
Very convenient location with great views of downtown from the master bedroom! The apartment is comfortable & well-appointed. Caroline is a very responsive, helpful host.

We really enjoyed our stay at Caroline's place. There is plenty of space, all the necessary amenities & a beautiful view! The neighborhood is safe & pleasant to walk around. I highly recommend staying here if you want something bright with two beds/bath & an amazing view of the CN tower.

We had a wonderful stay. The communication was good and we were able to check in and out easily. The view was great! The neighborhood was very nice and centrally located. The condo had everything we needed for our stay and more. It was very clean and stylish. We would definitely stay here again.

We really enjoyed staying at Jie‘s apartment. It was very clean and tidy. The location in Yorkville is a great starting point to discover Toronto. Jie is a great host, replies fast and very friendly. Coming back to Toronto we will definitly stay at Jie‘s again.

We loved staying at Jie's place! It felt like staying at a super high end hotel, and we smelled flowers as soon as we walked in. The condo was incredibly clean, and at the perfect location in Yorkville to go explore all of Toronto. Everything feels very modern inside as well, and the view is beautiful. It's the perfect place to wind down after a long day of exploring Toronto!
The place is so clean and smells good. I love my stay at Jie’s place.

Jie’s place was immaculate and had everything you could possibly need to enjoy your stay. Best location in Yorkville while also being super private and peaceful. Jie was great with communication and obviously takes pride in keeping her place clean and up to date. The bed was very comfortable and the shower had great pressure - two things I’m always hoping for when booking an Airbnb or hotel stay!
Would highly recommend staying here!
Wonderful stay in the heart of Yorkville, Jie was very accommodating and communicative. Check in and valet was fantastic, would highly recommend!

Jie and her condo were 5 stars!  She was so responsive and helpful to make our stay easy and comfortable.  The neighborhood is fantastic for shopping, relaxing strolls, delicious meals, coffees, gelatos and people watching!  We are already talking about coming back because it was such a great trip for our family!

My wife and I visited Toronto for her 50th birthday and since we’ve never been, we were unsure about where to stay. We were extremely happy with Jie’s place. It was the perfect size for us with all the amenities needed. Fully stocked kitchen with a Keurig/coffee pot, even had Keurig coffee pods for us. The bed was comfortable, shower great! The place was spotless as well. I can’t say enough about the place. The location is walking distance to shopping and great restaurants. Free parking is a nice bonus too! Also, I must add that Jie was such a great host. She checked in with us throughout the weekend to make sure check in went well and if there was anything we needed. Very responsive with everything. We will be staying here again if it’s not booked.

Great to have valet parking included.  We drove from Pittsburgh and then left the car and walked everywhere.  It was fun to be on a high floor with a great city view.  Apartment is small but has everything you need and it was spotless.  Our family of four was very comfortable.
What a fantastic stay. Very clean, quiet, safe and comfortable. Situated in a great neighborhood with lots to do and eat. Host was very communicative. A great place to stay.
Perfect host, clean place and  perfect experience. I would definitely stay again

Parking 6 floors down! Depending on who staffed the concierge desk, some days the accessibility to that level required 2 stops at the desk, driving back and forth.
My wife complained about the a-hole drivers at night who were revving their loud engines.
It would be nice to have a 2nd TV in the bedroom.
Otherwise no complaints.

This Toronto apartment was perfect for our 4 night stay.  And Jie is a truly Super Host.  He stays in touch throughout the stay inviting his guests to feel certain that he is there as needed.  The slight distance out of the downtown in “beautiful and trendy” Yorkville is easily walkable to downtown, and is supported by two Subway stops to the east and west of the apartment.  With so much to see and do in Toronto, this provided a perfect location.  Jie provides a very helpful guidebook as well.  We loved our stay in every way.  Jie, thank you again.
Great stay! Perfect location, the valet parking and the building were very nice. The apartment was clean and had everything we could need for our stay.

Jie’s condo is always my first choice when I visit Toronto because it’s so clean and well appointed and its close proximity to UofT.   Yorkville is a nice area with lots of cafes, restaurants and a Whole Foods nearby.    Jie is a remarkably responsive host and her place has everything one needs for a few days or a week with a nice gym in the building too.

Great spot in Toronto! Lots of awesome places to eat and shop in the area. Having the valet included was amazing since we drove into the city. Gorgeous views from the apartment. Space was clean and cozy! Would definitely recommend!

Gym / Pool / Hot Tub were very nice and often had them to ourselves. Location is very walkable to multiple train lines, so close to ROM, grocery store, and shopping.  Apartment was clean and quiet - great for our weeklong stay.
Thank you, Jie, for a great stay! The place was exactly as described and very well-appointed. You were a pleasure to deal with, and I especially appreciated your clear and detailed instructions!
Wonderful place to stay.  Close to the University, shops, restaurants.  Very nice apartment and building.  It's small but totally functional.  Highly recommend.
Great place to stay!

We really enjoyed our stay. Jie was so helpful and proactive in arranging check in and check out. The apartment was perfect and in a very nice building. It’s a beautiful area near shops, the University of Toronto, Royal Museum, and the subway. Very easy to get everywhere. Would absolutely recommend staying here!
The condo was great! It was clean, comfortable, well-appointed, great location and the gym was a great bonus. We will stay here again when visiting our family in Toronto.

Cozy modern condo in a unique central part of Toronto. Very easy to get on subway or just walk around beautiful neighbourhood. Major museums are steps away.
The apartment isn’t huge, but my daughter and I were very comfortable, and it had everything we needed. Nice pool. Would definitely book again.
The place is very clean and well managed.  The unit is on a high floor of a secure building and nestled in a good location in Yorkville.
We stayed here and enjoyed everything about the accommodation. It is situated in a lively part of Toronto. Easy to get on the subway from here.

One of the best stays we've had since we started using Airbnb. Jie was an incredible host and the apartment was amazing. From cleanliness, to amenities, to location - Jie's place excelled at it all! Thank you!

We had a great 4-night stay at Jie’s with my wife, daughter, and me. The apartment was perfect and exactly as described. The amenities in the building were fantastic, including valet parking, a pool, hot tub, sauna, gym, sun deck, and garden patio. The neighborhood had beautiful shops and galleries, trendy restaurants, great sweet treats, and a Whole Foods around the corner. The location could not be beat for access to metro stops, nice walks, shopping, and the Royal Ontario Museum. And Jie was a great host. She was very responsive to any questions we had. We will definitely return the next time we are in Toronto!

Attractive, spotless, comfortable property.
Attractive, upscale building in the middle of Toronto neighborhood

The space was very clean, and the Yorkville location was perfect - easy access to the subway and lots of restaurants nearby. Jie was super responsive and made check-in simple. The pool and hot tub were a nice bonus after long days exploring the city, and the valet parking made everything so convenient.
Great accommodating place right in Yorkville.  Jie helped make the process really simple.  Highly recommended!
Great location and excellent host!

Very convenient high floor unit in an amazing Yorkville location. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a downtown stay in a luxury location!

Spotless and convenient!
The host was very easy to communicate and check in was very smooth!
Beautiful place to stay in a safe and gorgeous neighborhood. Lots of shops and restaurants nearby.
Jie is a very good host and very professional. I will recommend to my friends.

Jie was extremely responsive and helpful.
It’s a great place to stay right in Yorkville with great food and shopping.
I will stay there again when I return to Toronto.

My mum and I stayed 17 days in Jessica’s lovely one-bedroom condo on Cumberland Street, and it truly felt like home — we didn’t want to leave! The condo was very comfortable, well-equipped with everything you could possibly need, and perfectly located. Being close to TTC stations for both Lines 1 and 2 made sightseeing around the city incredibly easy.
Most importantly, Jessica was an outstanding host. She provided high-quality amenities, responded promptly to our queries, and even personally delivered extra bed sheets when we needed them. Her care and attention made our stay extra special.
I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for accommodation in downtown Toronto. Jessica is one of the best hosts I’ve met on Airbnb, and we were lucky to stay in her wonderful condo.
It was a great place,loved the view.
Wonderful location!! Amazing shopping and restaurants right outside your door!! Jie was always available if needed!! Felt at home!!  Highly recommend!!  🩷
Perfect stay for Toronto

I usually stay in a hotel when I visit Toronto but since my partner and I were coming for two nights, I decided to check out Airbnb options in the part of the city where my to-do list was taking me. Jie’s condo was close to museums, dining, and more. It was squeaky clean, the bed and sofa are both very comfortable, and we enjoyed being able to make breakfast both days. The front desk staff is friendly and helpful, and so is Jie! Thanks for a lovely stay.

I had an absolutely fantastic experience staying at this Airbnb! The place was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay. The host was incredibly welcoming and responsive, making check-in and communication a breeze. The location was perfect—close to great restaurants, shops, and public transit, yet quiet and peaceful at night. I especially loved the cozy touches like fresh coffee, soft linens, and local recommendations. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

Fabulous location right in the heart of Yorkville near shops, cafes and restaurants.  Easy access to the TTC.  Unit was as described. Clean with comfy bed and nice added touches.  24 hour concierge was a plus and Jie (the host) was super responsive.
Jie's place was incredibly comfortable! It was in a wonderful location and truly an amazing place!
Great place. Great location. Near both major subways. Upscale neighborhood so hard to fine cheap food which is good and bad

Really enjoyed my stay here! The suite was exactly as pictured and spotlessly clean. Location is fantastic; just a few steps away from the Bay station subway, and excellent shopping and restaurants.

As a host, I found Jie to be responsive, kind and helpful.
I'm local to TO myself but wouldn't hesitate to recommend this suite to visiting family and friends.
Jie’s place was well situated and felt like home away from home. Flexibility in check in and out was highly appreciated. Highly recommended.

We really enjoyed our stay. Jie was very proactive with making sure we checked in okay, found parking and had everything we needed.
The bed was very comfortable. We really liked the layout of the condo. Having access to the gym was a bonus. We didn't use the pool/spa area but it looked nice and clean, and we plan on using it next time.
Hopefully, Jie's condo is available next time we are in Toronto because it is the only place we want to stay. Thanks for hosting us!
Absolutely lovely spot in Yorkville! Clean and tastefully furnished apartment! Thoughtful hosts

I loved the apartment - it’s spacious, charming, cozy & warm. It feels just like home - total jackpot! Eric is an awesome host; he’s responsive, attentive and you can tell he really cares. I’ll be back for sure!

The apartment and the district are perfect. The neighborhood is super safe and there is a park within walkable distance.
I definitely recommend this place to stay at as it's fully equipped with everything, clean and spacious! Eric is a super-responsive host.

Eric’s place was the perfect spot for my stay in Toronto. The space is perfect, lots of character and exactly as described. I was told this is the best area of the city and it is; I loved how close it is to restaurants and bars; very close to transit and bike share as well. Try breakfast at The Federal and coffee at Milou. Would definitely stay again, highly recommend!

Eric’s place was in an amazing location. Very spacious, big backyard and had all the comforts needed to feel at home.
He was easy to reach and very accommodating. Would highly recommend for anyone that is looking to be close to Toronto’s lovely west end bars and restaurants, but also quiet enough to have a peaceful rest when needed. Would certainly book again!

I stayed at Eric's place for over a month during a work trip and I have to say, he is a great host and extremely responsive. He was very accommodating and answered my questions quickly. The light in the morning and in the late afternoon is beautiful, the living room is definitely a cosy spot to read and relax. And the bed was extremely comfortable. The neighbourhood is very fun, there are a lot of coffee shops, bars and restaurants around. Even with my busy work schedule, I had time to visit quite a few because everything is so close by and walkable. Also, do not be dissuaded by the house being on a "busy" street, it's actually quite calm around, and it is very quiet in the unit.
Thanks so much Eric! I would stay here again in a heartbeat.

I love love loved staying at Eric's place. I chose it for a few reasons: stylish decor, reviews about a great bed, location and pet friendliness and all of those things were exactly true! The place looks exactly like the photos and the bed is amazing. I literally asked him what the mattress was because I want to buy one. The location is unbeatable in downtown Toronto, walkable to great bars and restaurants as well as Trinity Bellwoods park. And Eric was so accommodating and welcoming to my dog who was having a tough transition from Costa Rica to Toronto. There's a backyard right off the unit which is great for those early morning dog bathroom runs, and of course it's super walkable to off-leash dog parks as well. Eric was also flexible when I messed something up with the reservation and was amenable to figuring everything out so that I could stay for the allotted time that I needed to in order to make my transition easier. 10/10 would recommend to anyone! Such a great place and host.
Eric’s an amazing host, and it was a pleasure staying at his place. The location is in the best part of the city, and the apartment was everything I needed. Really enjoyed this stay.

The apartment is nicely furnished, clean and well maintained. Little Portugal is a hip area with great vintage shops, restaurants and cafes. You can get anything you need here. Eric was very helpful and a great and friendly host. I really enjoyed staying at Eric's place.

I had a great stay at Eric’s place! He was very responsive and accommodating, which made the whole experience smooth and enjoyable. The apartment is in a great area—safe, walkable, and close to everything you need, with plenty of excellent restaurants nearby. I would definitely recommend staying here!
Eric was a gracious and communicative host. The space was very nicely decorated and comfortable. Fantastic location, also surprisingly quiet!

We had a great long term stay at Eric’s place. It was a great size for us and our cat. We felt right at home. Eric was very accommodating and responsive to all our messages.
The neighborhood is amazing. There are a ton of great local coffee shops and restaurants within a few minutes walk. Plus, Trinity Bellwoods Park is also nearby and a great place to spend a weekend afternoon.

This flat is two blocks from the main Ossington drag and one block from Dundas. It's a 10 minute walk from Queen Street West and there are loads of hidden gems all around. The shower has two heads, kitchen is equipped with all basic cooking necessities (including spices) and the black out curtain in the bedroom is a real blackout curtain. The bedroom can get too cosy in the winter months. Eric is super personable and flexible. The building is older and so the floorboards are wonky in areas. But other than that it's private and perfectly located.
Liliya was a great host.  We really enjoyed the dishwasher as well as the in-unit  laundry facilities.   She was quick to respond to our needs and very friendly.
Amazing place! Communication with Liliya was perfect. Highly recommend this place.
This was a great stay. We were in Toronto for a concert at Roger’s stadium and this place worked out perfect. Very clean and convenient.
This is a great place to stay...sheets, pillow, bed was excellent I had a great and confort sleep. The apartment very clean and confortable!!

Thanks Liliya for everything. Highly recommend! Can’t wait to be back :)

Sans voiture, j'ai marché facilement jusqu'aux lieux où je devais me rendre ; le bus ou le tram sont à proximité si besoin. Un supermarché se trouve également à proximité.
Bref, un super séjour !

When I first met her she was very nice and sweet. However, I had to leave 4 days early on an emergency to rush to the hospital to see my great grandfather, who has died by the way just days after I got back home.
The full refund was $461 and she told the Airbnb support to give me $91. $91 days for 4 days when each day was $139. Also, on the cancellation policy it’s states that, I am able to be fully refunded for the 24 hours I did not stay, not including the previous day, but Airbnb says the final say is up to the host discretion. I asked her kindly for a full refund and she would not and will not respond. The only time I reached out to her during my stay was to let her know I had to leave for an emergency and I spoke with Airbnb as well. Liliya’s place was perfect for our stay in Toronto. It was ideal for three people — spacious, clean, and fully equipped for cooking. She welcomed us in person and was incredibly warm and kind. We had a great experience and would absolutely recommend her apartment!
Liliya, thanks for your great hosting!

Liliya responded quickly to our questions prior to our arrival and after we arrived. She met us when we arrived and showed us to her condo unit. The location was excellent, within walking distance to many things and close to public transit. Great value for the price and we would definitely stay here again.

Nous avons reçu un accueil chaleureux et cordial de la part de Liliya, qui a pris soin de nous faire faire un tour des lieux et qui s'est rendue disponible tout au long du séjour en cas de besoin. Nous avons adoré le temps passé au logement de Liliya et si nous avons à retourner un jour à Toronto, nous ne chercherons pas plus loin! :)

Great hospitality and fabulous service. The place was very clean and everything was available as described. Would recommend.

Great stay! Very clean and nice place in a large building. Very convenient for getting to either the lakefront or southern end of downtown (CN Tower, Rogers Centre) by foot.

The place was great.  There was even a little area with a desk that was separate from the rest of the space.  I had forgot about that and it was perfect.  The balcony was also very useable.  I will stay there again in the future.

Lovely spacious apartment in the annex! David was a great host. Would definitely stay here again!

The best Air BnB we have stayed in, in Toronto. Close to our son’s neighborhood, easy parking with the Toronto street-parking pass. Excellent place… great backyard and the little extras were definitely appreciated!  Awesome

My stay at David's Annex apartment was superb. Large, bright & welcoming, this home away from home has everything you could possibly need for a comfy stay.

David was fantastic! Always easy to reach, friendly and so accommodating (e.g. an early check-in request, a request about visitors). A minor issue shortly after check-in (my doing) was resolved immediately. There was even a lovely welcome note and some treats!
The Annex area is a quiet and safe home base. So much within walking distance and the subway close by. Great area to explore. I'll be back to enjoy that lovely yard in better weather!
David was an AMAZING host. So attentive, kind and helpful. The place was spotless. The area is great, super safe and a ton of local spots to try. A five star stay, truly!

The apartment is great; well decorated with spacious bathroom and nice kitchen. David is a lovely guy and very helpful, friendly and chatty. If work takes me to Toronto again, I would happily rent this unit again. I have already recommended the place to friends!

David’s place was spotless and in such a cute neighborhood! I felt right at home. Walking distance to coffee shops, bars, and restaurants. David is an excellent communicator. Would definitely stay again :)

Great location!!
Thank you for being friendly and responsive. Being centrally located made our trip easier, and the little apartment was just what we needed.

10/10 experience :)

Very clean, very responsive host.
Appartement bien situé : de nombreuses lignes de bus à proximité pour accéder au centre ville.

The area is super calm, residential. College Street has everything you need: Shoppers (pharmacy) right next to Metro (grocery). Metro has all the good stuff. Great restaurants. Great coffee places (Mayil gets a special mention). Emmet Ray jazz bar is right nearby. The 506 streetcar is right there.
Multiple bikeshare locations in the area so it’s easy to just hop on a bike and explore. I did a lot of this.
Luca was very nice and super responsive. I appreciated his flexibility when I needed it. He lives there in the same house with his family. They seem pretty happy :)
All in all, great experience! I’d stay there again.
Luca was a great host, always responsive and extra detailed. The place felt like home and was very comfortable, clean and just as the pictures portrayed. I would recommend!
We enjoyed this well maintained updated lovely unit we will for sure come back and would highly recommend this listing

Excellent location! Great walkability to restos and services. Cozy and comfortable unit. Bed and bedding super comfy. Great communication with host. Would definitely return and would highly recommend this rental. Thank you!

Great location in one of Toronto’s best neighbors. The home is down the street from major commercial areas with dozens of restaurants, coffee shops, small business shops, bars, and grocery stores. Overall the space is well appointed, clean & comfortable.
The kitchen is well equipped for basic cooking, and the Roku tv is nice because you can choose from so many streaming apps.
The host was friendly as responsive, as well as accommodating for my one or two requests.
Just one note regarding noise: the hosts & his family live upstairs & have young children, plus they had another tenant living below. The level of noise from both was intense at times. You can hear everything, including conversations. I’m not sure if the home is poorly insulated, but there is zero sound dampening. This made it very hard to relax and sleep, adding some carpets and a white noise machine might help, but just know that the home is very noisy.
Me and my family had a great time at their home place was peaceful very clean beautiful backyard. Definitely recommend the place. Look forward to going back.

We stayed at Allan’s place when my parents were visiting me for a month in July. The house is spacious and clean. Allan is a very responsive and caring host. The air conditioning stopped working the day we checked in, he was quick in getting it fixed and even refunded us some money to compensate for that. The neighbourhood is extremely calm and quiet, you are at luck if you are looking for peace. The only thing that needs to be addressed is lack of furniture and comfortable sitting in the living rooms and outdoor area. We were 4 adults and one kid and we struggled to sit together anywhere in the house. Both the living rooms have one couch each (a 3 seater), although we were provided with additional chairs but they weren’t comfortable enough and no one wants to sit on a chair in the living room. Other than that we didn’t have any problems and I will recommend Allan’s place to anyone looking for a nice and quiet home.

Loved staying at Alessandra and Giacomo’s place! The studio is super clean, beautifully decorated, and the bed is really comfy. The location is perfect—right near all the best spots on Ossington. Alessandra and Giacomo were amazing hosts—friendly, responsive, and full of great local tips. Highly recommend if you’re visiting Toronto!

Allesandra was a fantastic host! The apartment was adorable, spotless, and in a great location. We were able to walk to everything and loved returning to a cozy space at the end of the day. The beds were incredibly comfortable, and communication with Allesandra was always easy and responsive. She was thoughtful and accommodating throughout our stay with suggestions on where to go.
Very clean unit and responsive nice hosts.

I had a wonderful 2.5 week stay at Alessandra and Giacomo’s Airbnb. This space looks exactly like the pictures, it’s cozy, comfortable, well decorated and great for remote work. The location is fantastic, it’s close to the gym, grocery store, public transit, the Ossington strip and tons of restaurants. The hosts were responsive, friendly and made sure I had everything for a great stay. Overall I’d highly recommend this place and I’d definitely stay here again!

Cozy and quiet little suite in an unbeatable location. Alessandra was an excellent communicator and the apartment was stocked with small amenities that made the stay very comfortable. Slept like a baby in that bed and was able to prep all day for an interview without any distractions. It’s also totally spotless and well decorated. Truly a score for a short business trip. Thank you so much!

Everything about the place was perfect, even better than the listing itself! She was such an amazing and lovely host, and the room was spotless and sooo cozy. I would book again if i’m ever back in Toronto

Alessandra was vey responsive; always ready with advice and recommendations which were very appreciated. She is very considerate and the place was very pristine. I definitely felt at home away from home. I felt safe and yet very close to all Toronto has to offer. She made my trip even more memorable.

My boyfriend and I had a great time at Alessandra’s space, we came from Ottawa to spend a couple of days in Toronto and unwind—perfect spot for that. We were very comfortable, all of our needs and wants were met. Would definitely rebook in the future!

A beautiful home in a beautiful neighborhood with everything you could need. Lots of cafes, restaurants, and shopping whichever way you walk. The only thing to be aware of is the low ceilings! We’re both 5’8”, and if we were any taller it would have been a real squeeze!

Lovely guest suite, cosy and on a quiet residential road. Great location with amazing restaurants, parks and vintage shops nearby. Short public transport ride to city centre, or a very walkable 45mins through colourful neighbourhoods. Alessandra and Giacomo were so friendly and chill, responsive and helpful throughout the trip. Wonderful people and a lovely place, would recommend to anyone visiting!

I really enjoyed my stay at Alessandra’s place. The suite was spacious and very clean. The neighborhood is very walkable and close to major streetcar and bus lines. Alessandra is an excellent host. She was very friendly, communicative, and proactive. I would highly recommend staying here if you’re visiting Toronto.
Thank you for a great stay. Very helpful and answered all our questions.
Very nice and clean apartment, location is amazong close to Ossington restaurants.
Great place to stay. Thank you.

Vi havde et virkelig dejligt ophold i Toronto hos disse søde og imødekommende værter. De var hjælpsomme og lette at kommunikere med – fra første kontakt til afrejse. Beliggenheden var perfekt, med gåafstand til både lokale caféer, butikker og offentlig transport, hvilket gjorde det nemt at udforske byen. Værelset var lyst, komfortabelt og virkelig hyggeligt – lige hvad vi havde håbet på. Alt var rent og indbydende, og vi følte os hurtigt hjemme. Vi kan varmt anbefale dette sted til alle, der ønsker et afslappet og bekvemt ophold i Toronto.
Beautiful and comfortable place in a great part of town. Very accommodating and great communication. Really loved my stay here. Thank you for having me

L’appartamento di Alessandra si trova in un quartiere residenziale molto carino e vicino a locali e fermate dei mezzi pubblici. Si tratta di un seminterrato che si compone di camera, bagno e angolo cottura (c’è tutto tranne i fornelli), molto pulito. Check in semplice, host reattivo che ci ha anche procurato una culla per il nostro bambino. Scale e passaggio un po’ stretto per raggiungere la casa, soprattutto se si hanno valigie grandi. Per il resto ottima soluzione!
We had a lovely time staying in this beautiful cosy guest house. Our host were very helpful and lovely. We look forward to our next time visiting Canada. Many many thanks!
Fab stay, easy, responsive, practical and comfortable!!!!
Had a nice stay. Place is small and cozy. Alessandra was generous and made sure we had everything we needed.

Highly recommend this spot for staying in the city! The hosts were so friendly and accommodating. The place was spotless, comfortable and cute! Loved being able to get around the neighbourhood so easily from their place. I will definitely be staying here again.
Alessandra was very friendly and her place was clean and cozy, neighborhood was also trendy and cute.
We had a wonderful stay! Great location, very clean, and excellent communication. Would absolutely stay again!
Alessandra and Giacomo were fantastic hosts who went above and beyond to accommodate us! The apartment was in an excellent location and was perfect for our stay. Would definitely recommend :)

Thanks so much for the charming Airbnb stay! We came for a concert at the Budweiser Stage and a Jays game. It was perfect and exactly as described! Super close to get to the buses and streetcars.
The cute shops and eateries/pubs in Ossington were amazing. Total vibe! Super walkable. Safe walking. Close grocery stores nearby to pick up food and drinks.
The Airbnb itself was super clean and charming! The bed was super comfortable, linens great, and the decor was very inviting. The little bar inside the living room reminded me of a speak-easy! Loved it!
Communication with Alessandra was extremely easy :)
Thanks again, we loved our short trip to Toronto and this charming Airbnb!

The place was very clean and comfortable. Our host Alessandra was friendly, accommodating, and went out of their way to provide us with great recommendations around the area. We really appreciated their kindness and hospitality!

This was the perfect spot for my few days in toronto. the area was very convenient and the space itself was clean, private, and very cozy. Alessandra was a great host, very communicative and I felt the whole time that if any issues arose (though there weren't any) that help would be close at hand.

The stay was excellent. I would recommend to other friends to stay there. Was close by to everything we had to do .
Thank you next time in Toronto I will be making my reservation with you .
We enjoyed our 3 night stay, the suite is as described and has all amenities listed. The location is great, near public transit, many restaurants and shops. The hosts were very responsive.

Diese Unterkunft war besser als wir uns hätten vorstellen können. Die Gastgeber sind ganz tolle, freundliche Leute, bei denen man sich nur wohlfühlen kann. Great space for a quick trip. Lovely location, and host. Thank you Alessandra for a seamless stay!

Cozy, clean and central! It had all of the amenities we needed. The bed was comfy, there's coffee and a coffee machine in the kitchenette, and the hosts were communicative and accomodating. Would highly recommend and stay again in the future!

Loved this spot so much!! It was so cozy, with cute details such as little stickers for guests to take, puzzles and games, amazingly comfortable bed. Great location if you’re exploring Toronto!

My partner and I visited Toronto for a few days and Alessandra's basement suite was the perfect location - close to many restaurants but on a quiet street that allowed us to have restful nights of sleep. Great location and comfy bed!

The only reason I didn’t give a 5 star review is the last night of our stay they had people over at 2:30am and were playing music and talking loudly. We were there for business and had to be up early and unfortunately only got 3 hours of sleep that night. The host felt bad the next day and refunded us for part of that nights stay. We appreciated that but we’re still shocked they thought it would be a good idea to host at that hour when you had people paying to stay there. Overall, we would stay there again and doubt that would be an ongoing issue.

My stay at the Ossington suite was wonderful. The place was exactly as described. I felt extremely comfortable and at home. Alessandra was friendly, proactive, and responsive. I would highly recommend staying in their suite.

Stayed at this cute and cozy place for 6 nights. As soon as i walked in, the place felt like home. The hosts are very friendly, and responsive to your needs. The space is neat and clean and you have the place all to yourself. Really enjoyed my stay :)
Clean, pretty, easy check in/out and great location! We enjoyed our stay immensely and would recommend it to anyone wanting to stay in this area.
we had a wonderful stay! entry instructions were clear and the suite was cozy and clean. would reccomend and stay again!

Visiting Toronto for the weekend and we had a great stay! The place was cozy, clean and conveniently located near lots of cool bars and restaurants!

We booked this apartment for my in-laws for a month, and it was absolutely perfect. Amazing stay. Really responsive. Clean and well arranged apartment. Close to everything. I would come back anytime.

Great long term stay.  Everything was as advertised in the listing.  Clean well appointed space.  Great location to walk any where for anything (groceries, gyms, lots of restaurants, sights etc) and easy access to transit for anything further out.  Would happily stay again.

I came to Toronto for a baseball weekend with 2 friends and I will be booking this place again! it is close to everything you need from grocery stores to fast food to sit down restaurants, I highly recommend staying here if you're going to Toronto as it's only a 5 minute Uber ride to the GO station and 20 minute on the GO train downtown union station, much better than driving downtown.
Thank you for having us, we loved staying here!

Had a wonderful stay in Toronto here. Very easy check in and check out instructions. Easy street parking with permit purchased online. The hosts were available and very friendly. What a great place! Everything was exactly as described. It was clean, comfortable and in a quiet neighbourhood.  Location is great and easily accessible via bus/streetcar. Love the added touch of the snacks and sparkling water. I would definitely recommend this place and would go back anytime. An overall wonderful experience!
Nice and cozy place, well kept. Great and helpful host. We had zero issues during our stay.

What a great stay in Toronto!  We felt right at home.  Well stocked kitchen, and comfortable beds. We really appreciated the snacks and drinks. Super easy check-in.  Host was very responsive, proactive and friendly.
Good location, 10 minutes from downtown via UBER.

The whole place has a nice atmosphere and is tastefully decorated. It is very quiet. There are good restaurants nearby. We really enjoyed our stay, and are grateful for the snacks that were left for us in the kitchen. Would definitely stay there again.

We had a lovely stay at Nokomis' place - spacious, clean and comfortable with a very well equipped kitchen. Location was great with a nice coffee shop at the end of the street. The host was very responsive to our questions and we would recommend to others without hesitation. Thanks for a great experience!

You won't be disappointed when you stay at Anjelikas!

My parents and I had the best time at Anjelika’s home. The space was beautiful and comfortable. We had a truly memorable stay at this lovely Airbnb in Toronto. The location couldn’t have been more perfect—just steps away from the UofT St George campus.
The home itself was beautifully maintained, thoughtfully equipped with all the amenities we needed, and had a comforting, welcoming atmosphere. It genuinely felt like a home away from home, which was exactly what we needed.
Our host Anjelika was gracious, responsive, and made everything seamless from check-in to check-out. We’re so grateful for the space and the experience.

Anjelika’s home is a home away from home in Toronto, within walking distance of great restaurants, cafes, museums, shopping centres etc…

Would stay again if back in Toronto and highly recommend!

My parents stayed at Mia’s place for a few days when their place is renovated, it was convenient and comfortable. Highly recommended.
